`auth/bnet/peer.go`:

```go
package bnet

import (
	"io"
	"sync"
)

// PeerFunc handles one request on a Peer and returns the response body and
// Header.status (0 for success).
type PeerFunc func(h Header, body []byte) (resp []byte, status uint32)

// Peer is a minimal in-process bgs server: it answers requests by service
// hash and method, and can push server-initiated requests. It exists so the
// client, login and realm layers can be exercised end to end without a
// network, and so a replay harness can stand in for Battle.net. It does not
// model any server behaviour beyond what a test scripts.
type Peer struct {
	conn *Conn

	mu       sync.Mutex
	handlers map[handlerKey]PeerFunc
}

// NewPeer wraps the server end of a stream.
func NewPeer(rw io.ReadWriter) *Peer {
	return &Peer{conn: NewConn(rw), handlers: map[handlerKey]PeerFunc{}}
}

// Handle registers the handler for a service method.
func (p *Peer) Handle(svc Service, method uint32, fn PeerFunc) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	p.handlers[handlerKey{svc.Hash, method}] = fn
	p.mu.Unlock()
}

// Notify sends a server-initiated request (token 0, no response expected).
func (p *Peer) Notify(svc Service, method uint32, body []byte) error {
	return p.conn.WriteFrame(Frame{
		Header: Header{MethodID: method, ServiceHash: svc.Hash},
		Body:   body,
	})
}

// Serve answers requests until the stream ends. A clean end returns nil.
func (p *Peer) Serve() error {
	for {
		f, err := p.conn.ReadFrame()
		if err != nil {
			if err == io.EOF {
				return nil
			}
			return err
		}
		if f.Header.IsResponse {
			continue
		}
		p.mu.Lock()
		fn := p.handlers[handlerKey{f.Header.ServiceHash, f.Header.MethodID}]
		p.mu.Unlock()
		var body []byte
		status := uint32(0xbd3) // 0xbd3: the client's own code for "no such service" (0x102394a38)
		if fn != nil {
			body, status = fn(f.Header, f.Body)
		}
		resp := Frame{
			Header: Header{Token: f.Header.Token, IsResponse: true, Status: status},
			Body:   body,
		}
		if err := p.conn.WriteFrame(resp); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
}
```

`auth/bnet/services.go`:

```go
package bnet

// Service is one bgs service as the client addresses it.
//
// Outbound requests are addressed by hash. The generated stubs pass
// (hash, method) to the connection manager (e.g. 0x1023948c0 calls
// vtable+0x18 with 0x5dbb51c2, 1, ...) and register each method under the
// 64-bit key hash<<32 | flags | method (FUN_1022e2ddc in the registrars
// 0x102393bfc and 0x10239446c), so the hash really is the routing identity.
//
// The hash is FNV-1a (32-bit) of the service's descriptor_name, the string in
// BGSServiceOptions (extension 90000, field 1) on the service in the embedded
// descriptor. TestServiceHashes recomputes every constant below from its name,
// and each literal also occurs as an immediate in the client's code at the
// address given beside it, which is independent evidence that FNV-1a over that
// name is what the client uses.
type Service struct {
	// Name is BGSServiceOptions.descriptor_name.
	Name string
	// Proto is the protobuf package-qualified service name.
	Proto string
	// Hash is FNV-1a-32(Name).
	Hash uint32
	// UseClientID is SDKServiceOptions.use_client_id: the client attaches its
	// client instance id (Header.ciid) to requests for this service. In the
	// registrar this shows up as the 0x40000000 flag in the method key
	// (0x5dbb51c240000001 for ProcessTask, against 0x6544699100000001 for
	// Connect).
	UseClientID bool
}

// The services present in the image. Method ids are BGSMethodOptions.id from
// the descriptors (tools/pbdesc.py dump <file>).
var (
	// ConnectionService: bgs/low/pb/client/connection_service.proto. Hash
	// immediate at 0x10238f4bc and in the Connect stub 0x1023942f8.
	ConnectionService = Service{
		Name:  "bnet.protocol.connection.ConnectionService",
		Proto: "bgs.protocol.connection.v1.ConnectionService",
		Hash:  0x65446991,
	}
	// AuthenticationService: authentication_service.proto (v2). Hash immediate
	// at 0x1023928c4 / Logon stub 0x102392dd0.
	AuthenticationService = Service{
		Name:        "bnet.protocol.authentication.v2.client.AuthenticationService",
		Proto:       "bgs.protocol.authentication.v2.client.AuthenticationService",
		Hash:        0xc02f8216,
		UseClientID: true,
	}
	// AuthenticationListener: the service the server calls back on
	// (authentication_listener.proto). Hash immediate at 0x10238e6a0 and as
	// fixed32 data at image offset 0x31f79e8.
	AuthenticationListener = Service{
		Name:  "bnet.protocol.authentication.v2.client.AuthenticationListener",
		Proto: "bgs.protocol.authentication.v2.client.AuthenticationListener",
		Hash:  0x9da8116b,
		// Inbound; its service options carry use_client_id as well.
		UseClientID: true,
	}
	// GameUtilities: game_utilities_service.proto (v2). Hash immediate at
	// 0x102394498, registrar 0x10239446c.
	GameUtilities = Service{
		Name:        "bnet.protocol.game_utilities.v2.client.GameUtilities",
		Proto:       "bgs.protocol.game_utilities.v2.client.GameUtilitiesService",
		Hash:        0x5dbb51c2,
		UseClientID: true,
	}
	// AccountService: account_service.proto (v2). Hash immediate at
	// 0x10238fcd8.
	AccountService = Service{
		Name:        "bnet.protocol.account.v2.client.AccountService",
		Proto:       "bgs.protocol.account.v2.client.AccountService",
		Hash:        0x22dc2464,
		UseClientID: true,
	}
)

// Services lists every service this package knows.
var Services = []Service{
	ConnectionService, AuthenticationService, AuthenticationListener, GameUtilities, AccountService,
}

// ServiceHash is the hash the client derives from a descriptor name.
func ServiceHash(descriptorName string) uint32 {
	h := uint32(0x811c9dc5)
	for i := 0; i < len(descriptorName); i++ {
		h = (h ^ uint32(descriptorName[i])) * 0x01000193
	}
	return h
}

// Method ids (BGSMethodOptions.id). The service options of the connection
// service mark Bind and Encrypt as `obsolete` (method option field 10), which
// is why the client connects with use_bindless_rpc and never calls Bind.
const (
	MethodConnect           = 1 // ConnectionService.Connect
	MethodBind              = 2 // ConnectionService.Bind, obsolete
	MethodEcho              = 3
	MethodForceDisconnect   = 4
	MethodKeepAlive         = 5
	MethodEncrypt           = 6 // obsolete
	MethodRequestDisconnect = 7

	MethodLogon             = 1 // AuthenticationService.Logon
	MethodVerifyAuthToken   = 2
	MethodGenerateAuthToken = 3

	MethodOnLogonComplete     = 1 // AuthenticationListener.*, server to client
	MethodOnLogonQueueUpdate  = 2
	MethodOnLogonQueueEnd     = 3
	MethodOnExternalChallenge = 4

	MethodProcessTask               = 1 // GameUtilities.ProcessTask
	MethodGetAllValuesForAttributes = 2 // GameUtilities.GetAllValuesForAttribute
)

// Router maps service hashes to the numeric service ids a bound (non-bindless)
// connection uses in Header.service_id. In bindless mode, which is the only
// mode the shipped client uses, every id is 0 and the hash alone routes.
type Router struct {
	idByHash map[uint32]uint32
	hashByID map[uint32]uint32
}

// NewRouter returns an empty (bindless) routing table.
func NewRouter() *Router {
	return &Router{idByHash: map[uint32]uint32{}, hashByID: map[uint32]uint32{}}
}

// Set binds hash to id.
func (r *Router) Set(hash, id uint32) {
	r.idByHash[hash] = id
	r.hashByID[id] = hash
}

// ServiceID returns the id bound to hash, or 0 (bindless) if none is.
func (r *Router) ServiceID(hash uint32) uint32 { return r.idByHash[hash] }

// Hash resolves an inbound request to its service: the explicit hash if the
// header carries one, otherwise the hash bound to the header's service id.
func (r *Router) Hash(h Header) (uint32, bool) {
	if h.ServiceHash != 0 {
		return h.ServiceHash, true
	}
	hash, ok := r.hashByID[h.ServiceID]
	return hash, ok
}
```

`auth/realm/clientinfo.go`:

```go
package realm

// The ClientInformation object of Param_ClientInfo.
//
// The framing is E26's (TypeName ':' json NUL); the object itself is the shape
// of JSON.RealmList.ClientInformation in the fork's RealmList.proto, which its
// bnetserver parses field by field (GameUtilitiesService.cpp GetRealmListTicket:
// it reads info().secret(), info().platformtype(), info().clientarch() and
// info().type(), and refuses the ticket without a 32-byte secret). The client
// fills the same members from runtime values (0x1014333f4) but does not name
// them, so the member names here are the fork's.
//
// platform, type, platformType, clientArch and systemArch are FourCC values
// (ClientBuildInfo.h): the client's own MacA / WoW / Mac / A64 / A64 for this
// build. secret is 32 random bytes per connection, matching the fork's
// per-session client secret.

import (
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/version"
)

// SecretLen is the exact length of the client secret (the fork wants 32).
const SecretLen = 32

// Values as the 70707/70755 ticket builder (0x1014333f4) fills them (EVIDENCE
// E32): platform "MacA" (0x1022b4cfc), type "WoW" (set by 0x1014cbde4 at
// startup), buildVariant the literal at 0x1031d3828, platformType and
// systemArch the 8 bytes at 0x10318f5e0 ("caM\0" "46A\0" read as u32 LE),
// clientArch from the table at 0x10318f604, locales as big-endian FourCCs of
// the locale name (0x100527928), timeZone the literal "Etc/UTC" and
// systemVersion "%u.%u.%u.%u" of the OS version (0x102e88c40).
const (
	PlatformMacARM  uint32 = 0x4D616341 // "MacA"
	PlatformTypeMac uint32 = 0x004D6163 // "Mac"
	ArchARM64       uint32 = 0x413634   // "A64"
	TypeWoW         uint32 = 0x576F57   // "WoW"
	LocaleEnUSText  uint32 = 0x656E5553 // "enUS"
	LocaleEnUSAudio uint32 = 0x656E5553 // "enUS"
	DefaultTimeZone        = "Etc/UTC"
	// DefaultSystemVer is what the stock 70755 client sent from this Mac
	// (macOS 27.2, build 26B123) in its realm ticket (E37); the fourth part is
	// not the zero the format string suggested.
	DefaultSystemVer    = "27.2.0.131524635"
	DefaultBuildVariant = "darwin-ARM64-clang-release"
)

// dataBuilds maps a client build to the versionDataBuild the stock client of
// that build sends (E37: 70755 sends 61631, not its own build number).
var dataBuilds = map[int]uint32{70755: 61631}

// DataBuild returns the versionDataBuild for build.
func DataBuild(build int) uint32 {
	if d, ok := dataBuilds[build]; ok {
		return d
	}
	return uint32(build)
}

// ErrSecret means the client secret is not SecretLen bytes.
var ErrSecret = errors.New("realm: client secret must be 32 bytes")

// clientVersion is JSON.RealmList.ClientVersion.
type clientVersion struct {
	Major    uint32 `json:"versionMajor"`
	Minor    uint32 `json:"versionMinor"`
	Revision uint32 `json:"versionRevision"`
	Build    uint32 `json:"versionBuild"`
}

// clientInformation is JSON.RealmList.ClientInformation. Every member is
// required by the fork's proto, so all of them are always sent.
type clientInformation struct {
	Platform         uint32        `json:"platform"`
	BuildVariant     string        `json:"buildVariant"`
	Type             uint32        `json:"type"`
	TimeZone         string        `json:"timeZone"`
	CurrentTime      uint32        `json:"currentTime"`
	TextLocale       uint32        `json:"textLocale"`
	AudioLocale      uint32        `json:"audioLocale"`
	VersionDataBuild uint32        `json:"versionDataBuild"`
	Version          clientVersion `json:"version"`
	Secret           []int         `json:"secret"`
	ClientArch       uint32        `json:"clientArch"`
	SystemVersion    string        `json:"systemVersion"`
	PlatformType     uint32        `json:"platformType"`
	SystemArch       uint32        `json:"systemArch"`
}

// secretInts renders the 32 secret bytes as the JSON array of byte values the
// fork's ClientInformation reads ([]int, not base64: Go would base64-encode a
// []byte field, and the server reads secret only as an array of numbers).
func secretInts(b []byte) []int {
	out := make([]int, len(b))
	for i, v := range b {
		out[i] = int(v)
	}
	return out
}

// ClientInfo is the caller-facing form: the values that differ per run.
type ClientInfo struct {
	// Secret is the 32-byte client secret; nil means fresh random bytes.
	Secret []byte
	// Now is the currentTime; zero means time.Now().
	Now time.Time
	// Version defaults to the reference build (version.Forever()).
	Version *version.ID
	// TimeZone, SystemVersion, BuildVariant and the locale ids default to the
	// constants above and may be overridden.
	TimeZone      string
	SystemVersion string
	BuildVariant  string
	TextLocale    uint32
	AudioLocale   uint32
	// VersionDataBuild overrides DataBuild(Version.Build) when non-zero.
	VersionDataBuild uint32
}

// JSON renders the object, with fresh random bytes and the current time when
// the caller left them out.
func (c ClientInfo) JSON() (json.RawMessage, error) {
	secret := c.Secret
	if secret == nil {
		secret = make([]byte, SecretLen)
		if _, err := rand.Read(secret); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	if len(secret) != SecretLen {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: got %d", ErrSecret, len(secret))
	}
	now := c.Now
	if now.IsZero() {
		now = time.Now()
	}
	v := version.Forever()
	if c.Version != nil {
		v = *c.Version
	}
	tz, sys, variant := c.TimeZone, c.SystemVersion, c.BuildVariant
	if tz == "" {
		tz = DefaultTimeZone
	}
	if sys == "" {
		sys = DefaultSystemVer
	}
	if variant == "" {
		variant = DefaultBuildVariant
	}
	textLocale, audioLocale := c.TextLocale, c.AudioLocale
	if textLocale == 0 {
		textLocale = LocaleEnUSText
	}
	if audioLocale == 0 {
		audioLocale = LocaleEnUSAudio
	}
	dataBuild := c.VersionDataBuild
	if dataBuild == 0 {
		dataBuild = DataBuild(int(v.Build))
	}
	info := clientInformation{
		Platform:         PlatformMacARM,
		BuildVariant:     variant,
		Type:             TypeWoW,
		TimeZone:         tz,
		CurrentTime:      uint32(now.Unix()),
		TextLocale:       textLocale,
		AudioLocale:      audioLocale,
		VersionDataBuild: dataBuild,
		Version: clientVersion{
			Major:    uint32(v.Major),
			Minor:    uint32(v.Minor),
			Revision: uint32(v.Patch),
			Build:    uint32(v.Build),
		},
		Secret:        secretInts(secret),
		ClientArch:    ArchARM64,
		SystemVersion: sys,
		PlatformType:  PlatformTypeMac,
		SystemArch:    ArchARM64,
	}
	// RealmListTicketClientInformation wraps ClientInformation in "info".
	return json.Marshal(struct {
		Info clientInformation `json:"info"`
	}{info})
}

```

```go
package realm

// The realm-flow calls the stock 70755 client makes that the join itself does
// not need, recorded from the fork's bnetserver with service.protobuf logging
// (EVIDENCE.md E37): after the list ticket it fetches the BLEEP proxy list,
// asks for the last character played (twice: ContentSetIDFilter -1 without
// locality filtering, then 137 with it and its ping data) and the super
// district list, and its realm join carries Param_BleepClientPingData.

import (
	"bytes"
	"compress/zlib"
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/auth/bnet"
)

const (
	CmdFetchBleepProxies = "Command_FetchBleepProxiesRequest_v1"
	CmdLastCharPlayed    = "Command_LastCharPlayedRequest_v1"
	CmdSuperDistrictList = "Command_SuperDistrictListRequest_v1"

	ParamBleepClientPingData    = "Param_BleepClientPingData"
	ParamBleepProxyList         = "Param_BleepProxyList"
	ParamContentSetIDFilter     = "Param_ContentSetIDFilter"
	ParamFilterToPreferredLocal = "Param_FilterToPreferredLocality"
	ParamSuperDistrictList      = "Param_SuperDistrictList"
	ParamRealmEntry             = "Param_RealmEntry"

	TypeBleepPingDataList = "JSONBleepPingDataList"
	TypeBleepProxyList    = "JSONBleepProxyList"
	TypeSuperDistrictList = "JSONSuperDistrictList"

	// ContentSetForever is the ContentSetIDFilter of the stock client's
	// second LastCharPlayed request.
	ContentSetForever = 137
)

// EmptyPingData is the stock client's ping blob when it has no proxy to
// ping: JSONBleepPingDataList:{"pingData":[]}.
const EmptyPingData = `{"pingData":[]}`

// DeflateBlob frames json as u32le uncompressed length + zlib("Type:json\0"),
// at the best compression, as the client's 78 DA header shows.
func DeflateBlob(typeName, json string) []byte {
	plain := append([]byte(typeName+":"+json), 0)
	var zb bytes.Buffer
	zw, _ := zlib.NewWriterLevel(&zb, zlib.BestCompression)
	zw.Write(plain)
	zw.Close()
	out := binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint32(nil, uint32(len(plain)))
	return append(out, zb.Bytes()...)
}

// PingDataBlob is Param_BleepClientPingData for json.
func PingDataBlob(json string) []byte { return DeflateBlob(TypeBleepPingDataList, json) }

// FetchBleepProxies runs Command_FetchBleepProxiesRequest_v1 and returns the
// proxy list JSON.
func FetchBleepProxies(ctx context.Context, c Caller) ([]byte, error) {
	resp, err := c.ProcessTask(ctx, bnet.ProcessTaskRequest{Attributes: []bnet.Attribute{
		{Name: commandName(CmdFetchBleepProxies, ""), Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantNone}},
	}})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if a, ok := bnet.Lookup(resp.Results, ParamBleepProxyList); ok && a.Value.Kind == bnet.VariantBlob {
		return inflate(a.Value.Blob, TypeBleepProxyList, 1<<20)
	}
	return nil, nil
}

// LastCharPlayedRequest is one Command_LastCharPlayedRequest_v1.
type LastCharPlayedRequest struct {
	SubRegion  string
	Ticket     []byte
	ContentSet int64
	Preferred  bool
	// PingData, when set, is sent as Param_BleepClientPingData.
	PingData []byte
}

// LastCharPlayed runs Command_LastCharPlayedRequest_v1 and returns the raw
// Param_RealmEntry blob, if any.
func LastCharPlayed(ctx context.Context, c Caller, req LastCharPlayedRequest) ([]byte, error) {
	attrs := []bnet.Attribute{
		{Name: commandName(CmdLastCharPlayed, ""), Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantString, String: req.SubRegion}},
		{Name: ParamRealmListTicket, Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantBlob, Blob: req.Ticket}},
		{Name: ParamContentSetIDFilter, Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantInt, Int: req.ContentSet}},
		{Name: ParamFilterToPreferredLocal, Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantBool, Bool: req.Preferred}},
	}
	if req.PingData != nil {
		attrs = append(attrs, bnet.Attribute{Name: ParamBleepClientPingData, Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantBlob, Blob: req.PingData}})
	}
	resp, err := c.ProcessTask(ctx, bnet.ProcessTaskRequest{Attributes: attrs})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if a, ok := bnet.Lookup(resp.Results, ParamRealmEntry); ok && a.Value.Kind == bnet.VariantBlob {
		return a.Value.Blob, nil
	}
	return nil, nil
}

// SuperDistrictList runs Command_SuperDistrictListRequest_v1 and returns the
// list JSON.
func SuperDistrictList(ctx context.Context, c Caller, subRegion string, ticket []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	resp, err := c.ProcessTask(ctx, bnet.ProcessTaskRequest{Attributes: []bnet.Attribute{
		{Name: commandName(CmdSuperDistrictList, ""), Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantString, String: subRegion}},
		{Name: ParamRealmListTicket, Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantBlob, Blob: ticket}},
	}})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if a, ok := bnet.Lookup(resp.Results, ParamSuperDistrictList); ok && a.Value.Kind == bnet.VariantBlob {
		return inflate(a.Value.Blob, TypeSuperDistrictList, 1<<20)
	}
	return nil, nil
}
```

`auth/realm/realm.go`:

```go
// Package realm runs the two GameUtilities commands that turn a Battle.net
// logon into a world-server join: Command_RealmListTicketRequest_v1, which
// yields Param_RealmListTicket, and Command_RealmJoinRequest_v1, which yields
// the join ticket, the server addresses and the join secret.
//
// Both ride GameUtilitiesService.ProcessTask as a bag of named v2 attributes.
// What is decoded from the client (docs/EVIDENCE.md E26) and what is not:
//
// Decoded:
//   - the command and parameter names, and the Variant kind of each: the
//     client's bag setters 0x10139f648 / 0x10139f594 / 0x10139f734 write kinds
//     4 (string), 6 (uint) and 5 (blob), the numbering of bgs.protocol.v2.Variant;
//   - the request builders 0x1014333f4 (ticket) and 0x101434b44 (join) and the
//     response readers 0x1014339d8 (ticket) and 0x101434e10 (join), including
//     their error codes;
//   - the blob framings: "<TypeName>:<json>\0" for Param_Identity and
//     Param_ClientInfo (0x10139f824), and u32le length + zlib of
//     "<TypeName>:<json>\0" for Param_ServerAddresses (0x1014af4ac, limit
//     0x40000), with Param_JoinSecret exactly 32 bytes (0x101434f28).
//
// Modelled but not settled by the binary (each is a typed value or error, never
// a silent guess):
//   - the JSON member names and nesting inside the blobs beyond the names in
//     the image's string inventory (Identity, ClientInfo, ServerAddresses);
//   - where the 64-byte world KeyData comes from. The join-info struct built at
//     0x101434e10 is JoinSecret (32 bytes) followed by 32 bytes read from the
//     Aurora context at +0x48, whose origin is not resolved; see JoinResult.KeyData;
//   - that the world AUTH_SESSION ticket string is the RealmJoinTicket.
package realm

import (
	"bytes"
	"compress/zlib"
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/auth/bnet"
	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/world"
)

// Command and parameter names, as the client registers them
// (strings at 0x1030128a8..0x103012ac7; referenced from the builders named in
// the package comment).
const (
	CmdRealmListTicket = "Command_RealmListTicketRequest_v1"
	CmdRealmJoin       = "Command_RealmJoinRequest_v1"

	ParamIdentity        = "Param_Identity"
	ParamClientInfo      = "Param_ClientInfo"
	ParamRealmListTicket = "Param_RealmListTicket"
	ParamRealmAddress    = "Param_RealmAddress"
	ParamBnetSessionKey  = "Param_BnetSessionKey"
	ParamRealmJoinTicket = "Param_RealmJoinTicket"
	ParamServerAddresses = "Param_ServerAddresses"
	ParamJoinSecret      = "Param_JoinSecret"
)

// JSON blob type names, from the image's string inventory
// (JSONRealmListTicketIdentity, JSONRealmListTicketClientInformation,
// JSONRealmListServerIPAddresses). The blob codecs compare the text before the
// first ':' with the type's own name (0x1014af4ac, 0x10139f824).
const (
	TypeIdentity        = "JSONRealmListTicketIdentity"
	TypeClientInfo      = "JSONRealmListTicketClientInformation"
	TypeServerAddresses = "JSONRealmListServerIPAddresses"
)

// JoinSecretLen is the exact length of Param_JoinSecret (0x101434f28 rejects
// anything else with 0x80000130).
const JoinSecretLen = 32

// MaxServerAddresses is the cap on the decompressed address JSON (the
// `0x40000` argument at 0x10139ef28).
const MaxServerAddresses = 0x40000

// Errors. The numeric codes are the ones the client's readers report.
var (
	ErrNotConnected    = errors.New("realm: no connection (client 0x80000149)")
	ErrNoTicket        = errors.New("realm: response has no Param_RealmListTicket blob (client 0x8000012d)")
	ErrNoJoinTicket    = errors.New("realm: response has no Param_RealmJoinTicket blob (client 0x8000012e)")
	ErrNoAddresses     = errors.New("realm: response has no valid Param_ServerAddresses (client 0x8000012f)")
	ErrBadJoinSecret   = errors.New("realm: Param_JoinSecret is missing or not 32 bytes (client 0x80000130)")
	ErrBadBlob         = errors.New("realm: malformed JSON blob")
	ErrKeyHalfRequired = errors.New("realm: the second 32 bytes of the world KeyData come from client state the binary does not resolve (Aurora context +0x48 at 0x101434e10); supply them explicitly")
)

// Caller is what the realm commands need from the bgs client;
// *bnet.Client satisfies it.
type Caller interface {
	ProcessTask(ctx context.Context, req bnet.ProcessTaskRequest) (bnet.ProcessTaskResponse, error)
	// ProcessTaskV2 is ProcessTask addressed by the v2 (OriginalHash) service
	// hash, whose handlers keep attribute names untruncated.
	ProcessTaskV2(ctx context.Context, req bnet.ProcessTaskRequest) (bnet.ProcessTaskResponse, error)
}

// JSONBlob renders a Param_Identity / Param_ClientInfo style blob:
// TypeName ':' json NUL (0x10139f824 writes the type name, a colon, the JSON
// and a terminating NUL byte, and stores all of it as the blob).
func JSONBlob(typeName string, v any) ([]byte, error) {
	js, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return jsonBlobRaw(typeName, js), nil
}

func jsonBlobRaw(typeName string, js []byte) []byte {
	out := make([]byte, 0, len(typeName)+1+len(js)+1)
	out = append(out, typeName...)
	out = append(out, ':')
	out = append(out, js...)
	return append(out, 0)
}

// Identity is the Param_Identity object: the game account the ticket is for.
// The member names gameAccountID and gameAccountRegion are in the image's
// string inventory next to the realm JSON types; the object's two members at
// 0x1014333f4 are a u64 and a byte, matching a 64-bit account id and a region.
type Identity struct {
	GameAccountID     uint64 `json:"gameAccountID"`
	GameAccountRegion uint32 `json:"gameAccountRegion"`
}

// TicketRequest is everything Command_RealmListTicketRequest_v1 carries.
type TicketRequest struct {
	Identity Identity
	// ClientInfoJSON is the JSON object of JSONRealmListTicketClientInformation.
	// The client fills it from a dozen runtime values (version, platform,
	// currentTime, clientArch, systemVersion, buildVariant, timeZone,
	// versionDataBuild, audioLocale, textLocale, platformType, systemArch;
	// 0x1014333f4); how each is typed and nested is not settled, so the caller
	// supplies the object.
	ClientInfoJSON json.RawMessage
	// CommandSuffix is appended as Command_X_<suffix> when non-empty
	// (0x10139efb0 does that with the string from 0x1014e01e0, which is empty
	// in the paths decoded here).
	CommandSuffix string
	// NoNUL drops the NUL that terminates the identity blob (debug knob).
	NoNUL bool
}

// ClientRequestSuffix is the default of the client's auroraClientRequestSuffix
// CVar, which it appends to every Command_* attribute name as "_<suffix>".
// The 70755 default is built by 0x10139e844 from two build flags
// (0x1033ee1cd = 0, 0x1033ee1ce = 1): "camelot1" (retail builds use "b9").
// Live Battle.net matches the full name; the fork truncates a command at its
// last underscore (ParseParamName), so it accepts the same names (EVIDENCE E32).
const ClientRequestSuffix = "camelot1"

// nameSuffix is "_" + ClientRequestSuffix.
const nameSuffix = "_" + ClientRequestSuffix

func commandName(base, suffix string) string {
	if suffix == "" {
		return base + nameSuffix
	}
	return base + "_" + suffix
}

// RealmListTicket runs Command_RealmListTicketRequest_v1 and returns the
// Param_RealmListTicket blob.
//
// Request: the command attribute (value an empty Variant), then
// Param_Identity and Param_ClientInfo as JSON blobs, in ProcessTaskRequest.attribute
// (the client's bag is the request's first repeated field).
func RealmListTicket(ctx context.Context, c Caller, req TicketRequest) ([]byte, error) {
	if len(req.ClientInfoJSON) == 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("realm: ClientInfoJSON is required")
	}
	ident, err := JSONBlob(TypeIdentity, req.Identity)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if req.NoNUL {
		ident = bytes.TrimSuffix(ident, []byte{0})
	}
	pt := bnet.ProcessTaskRequest{Attributes: []bnet.Attribute{
		{Name: commandName(CmdRealmListTicket, req.CommandSuffix)},
		{Name: ParamIdentity, Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantBlob, Blob: ident}},
		{Name: ParamClientInfo, Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantBlob, Blob: jsonBlobRaw(TypeClientInfo, req.ClientInfoJSON)}},
	}}
	resp, err := c.ProcessTask(ctx, pt)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	a, ok := bnet.Lookup(resp.Results, ParamRealmListTicket)
	if !ok || a.Value.Kind != bnet.VariantBlob {
		return nil, ErrNoTicket
	}
	return a.Value.Blob, nil
}

// JoinRequest is everything Command_RealmJoinRequest_v1 carries.
type JoinRequest struct {
	// SubRegion is the command attribute's string value; the client logs it as
	// "subRegion" when it starts the join (0x1013ad9a8).
	SubRegion string
	// RealmAddress is the realm's virtual address (a uint attribute).
	RealmAddress uint32
	// Ticket is the Param_RealmListTicket blob from RealmListTicket.
	Ticket []byte
	// SessionKey is the LogonRecord.session_key the server sent in
	// LogonCompleteNotification (field 5, bytes; EVIDENCE.md E27); the client
	// forwards it unchanged as Param_BnetSessionKey (0x101434b44).
	SessionKey    []byte
	CommandSuffix string
	// PingData, when set, is sent last as Param_BleepClientPingData, as the
	// stock client does (E37).
	PingData []byte
}

// Address is one server endpoint from Param_ServerAddresses.
type Address struct {
	Family int    `json:"family"`
	IP     string `json:"ip"`
	Port   uint16 `json:"port"`
}

// JoinResult is the decoded Command_RealmJoinRequest_v1 response.
type JoinResult struct {
	// JoinTicket is Param_RealmJoinTicket, the first member of the client's
	// join-info struct (0x101434e10).
	JoinTicket []byte
	// Addresses are the endpoints in Param_ServerAddresses, in server order.
	Addresses []Address
	// JoinSecret is Param_JoinSecret, exactly 32 bytes.
	JoinSecret [JoinSecretLen]byte
}

// RealmJoin runs Command_RealmJoinRequest_v1.
//
// Request attribute order is the builder's (0x101434b44): the command (string
// value), Param_RealmAddress (uint), Param_RealmListTicket (blob),
// Param_BnetSessionKey (blob). Response members are those 0x101434e10 reads,
// with the same failure order and the same limits.
func RealmJoin(ctx context.Context, c Caller, req JoinRequest) (JoinResult, error) {
	pt := bnet.ProcessTaskRequest{Attributes: []bnet.Attribute{
		{Name: commandName(CmdRealmJoin, req.CommandSuffix), Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantString, String: req.SubRegion}},
		{Name: ParamRealmAddress, Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantUint, Uint: uint64(req.RealmAddress)}},
		{Name: ParamRealmListTicket, Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantBlob, Blob: req.Ticket}},
		{Name: ParamBnetSessionKey, Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantBlob, Blob: req.SessionKey}},
	}}
	if req.PingData != nil {
		pt.Attributes = append(pt.Attributes, bnet.Attribute{Name: ParamBleepClientPingData, Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantBlob, Blob: req.PingData}})
	}
	resp, err := c.ProcessTask(ctx, pt)
	if err != nil {
		return JoinResult{}, err
	}
	return decodeJoin(resp.Results)
}

func decodeJoin(results []bnet.Attribute) (JoinResult, error) {
	var out JoinResult
	jt, ok := bnet.Lookup(results, ParamRealmJoinTicket)
	if !ok || jt.Value.Kind != bnet.VariantBlob {
		return out, ErrNoJoinTicket
	}
	out.JoinTicket = jt.Value.Blob
	sa, ok := bnet.Lookup(results, ParamServerAddresses)
	if !ok || sa.Value.Kind != bnet.VariantBlob {
		return out, ErrNoAddresses
	}
	addrs, err := DecodeServerAddresses(sa.Value.Blob)
	if err != nil {
		return out, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrNoAddresses, err)
	}
	out.Addresses = addrs
	js, ok := bnet.Lookup(results, ParamJoinSecret)
	if !ok || js.Value.Kind != bnet.VariantBlob || len(js.Value.Blob) != JoinSecretLen {
		return out, ErrBadJoinSecret
	}
	copy(out.JoinSecret[:], js.Value.Blob)
	return out, nil
}

// serverAddresses is the JSONRealmListServerIPAddresses object. The member
// names families, family and addresses are in the image's string inventory;
// ip and port are the only strings of that shape in it. Their nesting here is
// the conventional one and is not separately confirmed.
type serverAddresses struct {
	Families []struct {
		Family    int `json:"family"`
		Addresses []struct {
			IP   string `json:"ip"`
			Port uint16 `json:"port"`
		} `json:"addresses"`
	} `json:"families"`
}

// DecodeServerAddresses decodes a Param_ServerAddresses blob: a little-endian
// u32 uncompressed length (at least 3, at most MaxServerAddresses), then a
// zlib stream that inflates to exactly that many bytes ending in NUL, holding
// "JSONRealmListServerIPAddresses:" and the JSON object (0x1014af4ac).
func DecodeServerAddresses(blob []byte) ([]Address, error) {
	if len(blob) < 4 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %d bytes", ErrBadBlob, len(blob))
	}
	n := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(blob)
	if n > MaxServerAddresses {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: uncompressed length %d above %d", ErrBadBlob, n, MaxServerAddresses)
	}
	if n < 3 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: uncompressed length %d", ErrBadBlob, n)
	}
	zr, err := zlib.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(blob[4:]))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrBadBlob, err)
	}
	defer zr.Close()
	raw, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(zr, int64(n)+1))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrBadBlob, err)
	}
	if uint32(len(raw)) != n {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: inflated %d bytes, header says %d", ErrBadBlob, len(raw), n)
	}
	if raw[n-1] != 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: not NUL-terminated", ErrBadBlob)
	}
	raw = raw[:n-1]
	i := bytes.IndexByte(raw, ':')
	if i < 0 || string(raw[:i]) != TypeServerAddresses {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: type prefix is not %q", ErrBadBlob, TypeServerAddresses)
	}
	var sa serverAddresses
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw[i+1:], &sa); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrBadBlob, err)
	}
	var out []Address
	for _, f := range sa.Families {
		for _, a := range f.Addresses {
			out = append(out, Address{Family: f.Family, IP: a.IP, Port: a.Port})
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

// EncodeServerAddresses is the server half of DecodeServerAddresses, for tests
// and replay peers.
func EncodeServerAddresses(addrs []Address) ([]byte, error) {
	var sa serverAddresses
	byFamily := map[int]int{}
	for _, a := range addrs {
		idx, ok := byFamily[a.Family]
		if !ok {
			sa.Families = append(sa.Families, struct {
				Family    int `json:"family"`
				Addresses []struct {
					IP   string `json:"ip"`
					Port uint16 `json:"port"`
				} `json:"addresses"`
			}{Family: a.Family})
			idx = len(sa.Families) - 1
			byFamily[a.Family] = idx
		}
		sa.Families[idx].Addresses = append(sa.Families[idx].Addresses, struct {
			IP   string `json:"ip"`
			Port uint16 `json:"port"`
		}{a.IP, a.Port})
	}
	js, err := json.Marshal(sa)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	plain := jsonBlobRaw(TypeServerAddresses, js)
	var zb bytes.Buffer
	zw := zlib.NewWriter(&zb)
	zw.Write(plain)
	zw.Close()
	out := binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint32(nil, uint32(len(plain)))
	return append(out, zb.Bytes()...), nil
}

// KeyData assembles the 64-byte world KeyData as the client's join-info struct
// is laid out at 0x101434e10: JoinSecret first, then 32 bytes read from the
// Aurora context at +0x48. The binary does not resolve what those 32 bytes
// are (it does not generate them in the join builder), so the caller supplies
// them; with no second half the call fails rather than invent one.
func (r JoinResult) KeyData(secondHalf []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	if len(secondHalf) == 0 {
		return nil, ErrKeyHalfRequired
	}
	if len(secondHalf) != world.KeyDataLen-JoinSecretLen {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("realm: second half of KeyData must be %d bytes, got %d", world.KeyDataLen-JoinSecretLen, len(secondHalf))
	}
	out := make([]byte, 0, world.KeyDataLen)
	out = append(out, r.JoinSecret[:]...)
	return append(out, secondHalf...), nil
}

// WorldAuth is what the world connection takes from the Battle.net side.
type WorldAuth struct {
	KeyData []byte // 64 bytes
	Ticket  []byte
}

// WorldAuth returns the auth material for world.Config. Ticket is the
// RealmJoinTicket; that the world AUTH_SESSION ticket string is this value is
// inferred (it is the join-info struct's first member and AUTH_SESSION's only
// string field), not read off a packet.
func (r JoinResult) WorldAuth(secondHalf []byte) (WorldAuth, error) {
	kd, err := r.KeyData(secondHalf)
	if err != nil {
		return WorldAuth{}, err
	}
	return WorldAuth{KeyData: kd, Ticket: append([]byte(nil), r.JoinTicket...)}, nil
}

// Apply fills the auth fields of a world.Config.
func (w WorldAuth) Apply(cfg *world.Config) {
	cfg.KeyData = w.KeyData
	cfg.Ticket = w.Ticket
}
```

`auth/realm/realm_list.go`:

```go
package realm

// The realm list: Command_RealmListRequest_v1 and the sub-region list.
//
// E26 covers the ticket and join commands; the list command sits before them
// and is what supplies the realm address the join needs. Its shape is public
// (fork bnetserver GameUtilitiesService.cpp GetRealmList / Shared::
// HandleGetAllValuesForAttribute):
//
//   - GameUtilities.GetAllValuesForAttribute("Command_RealmListRequest_v1")
//     answers the sub-regions, so the client knows what to ask for;
//   - Command_RealmListRequest_v1 takes the sub-region as its string value and
//     answers Param_RealmList, a u32le length + zlib of
//     "JSONRealmListUpdates:" followed by JSON.RealmList.RealmListUpdates.
//
// The client's own request/response builders for this command are not decoded,
// so this file follows the public side. The JSON is parsed tolerantly (the
// member names are JSON.RealmList's, but only the address and the name are
// used), because a mis-guessed member should not lose the whole list.

import (
	"bytes"
	"compress/zlib"
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/auth/bnet"
)

const (
	// CmdRealmList is the client's list command (fork GetRealmList).
	CmdRealmList = "Command_RealmListRequest_v1"
	// ParamRealmList is its response attribute.
	ParamRealmList = "Param_RealmList"
	// ParamCharacterCountList is the second response attribute; not decoded.
	ParamCharacterCountList = "Param_CharacterCountList"
	// TypeRealmList is the blob type name in front of the JSON.
	TypeRealmList = "JSONRealmListUpdates"

	// MaxRealmList is the cap on the decompressed JSON, the same 0x40000 the
	// client uses for the address blob.
	MaxRealmList = MaxServerAddresses
)

// ErrNoRealmList means the response carried no usable Param_RealmList.
var ErrNoRealmList = errors.New("realm: response has no valid Param_RealmList")

// GameUtilitiesCaller is the generic GameUtilities call, for the commands that
// are not ProcessTask. *bnet.Client satisfies it.
type GameUtilitiesCaller interface {
	Call(ctx context.Context, svc bnet.Service, method uint32, req []byte) ([]byte, error)
}

// SubRegions asks for the sub-region values of the realm list command.
func SubRegions(ctx context.Context, c GameUtilitiesCaller) ([]string, error) {
	req := bnet.GetAllValuesForAttributeRequest{AttributeKey: CmdRealmList + nameSuffix}
	body, err := c.Call(ctx, bnet.GameUtilities, bnet.MethodGetAllValuesForAttributes, req.Encode())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	resp, err := bnet.DecodeGetAllValuesForAttributeResponse(body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var out []string
	for _, v := range resp.Values {
		if v.Kind == bnet.VariantString && v.String != "" {
			out = append(out, v.String)
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

// Realm is one entry of the list.
type Realm struct {
	Address uint32
	Name    string
	// Characters is the game account's character count there
	// (Param_CharacterCountList); 0 when none or not sent.
	Characters int
	// Rest keeps the raw object fields for anything a later step wants.
	Rest map[string]any
}

// ListRequest is one Command_RealmListRequest_v1.
type ListRequest struct {
	SubRegion     string
	CommandSuffix string
	// Ticket is the Param_RealmListTicket from RealmListTicket, and
	// BuildVariant the Param_BuildVariant string: the client's list builder
	// (0x1014346cc) always sends both; live Battle.net refuses the list
	// without them (0x8000012d, EVIDENCE E32). The fork ignores both.
	Ticket       []byte
	BuildVariant string
	// Timeout bounds the call; zero means 20 s.
	Timeout time.Duration
}

// RealmList runs Command_RealmListRequest_v1 and returns the live realms in
// server order.
func RealmList(ctx context.Context, c Caller, req ListRequest) ([]Realm, error) {
	if req.Timeout > 0 {
		var cancel context.CancelFunc
		ctx, cancel = context.WithTimeout(ctx, req.Timeout)
		defer cancel()
	}
	pt := bnet.ProcessTaskRequest{Attributes: []bnet.Attribute{
		{Name: commandName(CmdRealmList, req.CommandSuffix), Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantString, String: req.SubRegion}},
	}}
	if req.Ticket != nil {
		pt.Attributes = append(pt.Attributes, bnet.Attribute{Name: "Param_RealmListTicket", Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantBlob, Blob: req.Ticket}})
	}
	if req.BuildVariant != "" {
		pt.Attributes = append(pt.Attributes, bnet.Attribute{Name: "Param_BuildVariant", Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantString, String: req.BuildVariant}})
	}
	resp, err := c.ProcessTask(ctx, pt)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	a, ok := bnet.Lookup(resp.Results, ParamRealmList)
	if !ok || a.Value.Kind != bnet.VariantBlob {
		return nil, ErrNoRealmList
	}
	realms, err := DecodeRealmList(a.Value.Blob)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if cc, ok := bnet.Lookup(resp.Results, ParamCharacterCountList); ok && cc.Value.Kind == bnet.VariantBlob {
		if counts, err := DecodeCharacterCounts(cc.Value.Blob); err == nil {
			for i := range realms {
				realms[i].Characters = counts[realms[i].Address]
			}
		}
	}
	return realms, nil
}

// DecodeCharacterCounts decodes Param_CharacterCountList: the number of the
// game account's characters on each realm, keyed by realm address. The client
// uses it to put a player back on the realm their characters live on.
func DecodeCharacterCounts(blob []byte) (map[uint32]int, error) {
	raw, err := inflateAny(blob, MaxRealmList)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if os.Getenv("WOW_DBG_COUNTS") != "" {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "DBG character counts: %s\n", raw)
	}
	var list struct {
		Counts []struct {
			Address json.RawMessage `json:"wowRealmAddress"`
			Count   int             `json:"count"`
		} `json:"counts"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &list); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrBadBlob, err)
	}
	out := map[uint32]int{}
	for _, c := range list.Counts {
		if a, ok := number(c.Address); ok {
			out[a] = c.Count
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

// inflateAny is inflate without a fixed type name: it strips whatever
// "Type:" prefix the blob carries.
func inflateAny(blob []byte, max int) ([]byte, error) {
	if len(blob) < 4 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %d bytes", ErrBadBlob, len(blob))
	}
	zr, err := zlib.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(blob[4:]))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrBadBlob, err)
	}
	defer zr.Close()
	plain, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(zr, int64(max)))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrBadBlob, err)
	}
	plain = bytes.TrimRight(plain, "\x00")
	if i := bytes.IndexByte(plain, ':'); i > 0 && i < 64 && bytes.IndexByte(plain[:i], '{') < 0 {
		plain = plain[i+1:]
	}
	return plain, nil
}

// DecodeRealmList decodes a Param_RealmList blob and drops deleting entries.
func DecodeRealmList(blob []byte) ([]Realm, error) {
	raw, err := inflate(blob, TypeRealmList, MaxRealmList)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrNoRealmList, err)
	}
	// updates: [ { wowRealmAddress, update: {...}, deleting: bool } ]
	var list struct {
		Updates []struct {
			Address  json.RawMessage `json:"wowRealmAddress"`
			Deleting bool            `json:"deleting"`
			Update   map[string]any  `json:"update"`
		} `json:"updates"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &list); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrNoRealmList, err)
	}
	var out []Realm
	for _, u := range list.Updates {
		if u.Deleting || u.Update == nil {
			continue
		}
		addr, ok := number(u.Address)
		if !ok || addr == 0 {
			// The address may sit inside update instead, depending on nesting.
			if v, ok := number(rawField(u.Update, "wowRealmAddress")); ok && v != 0 {
				addr = v
			} else {
				continue
			}
		}
		name, _ := u.Update["name"].(string)
		out = append(out, Realm{Address: addr, Name: name, Rest: u.Update})
	}
	return out, nil
}

func rawField(m map[string]any, key string) json.RawMessage {
	if v, ok := m[key]; ok {
		b, _ := json.Marshal(v)
		return b
	}
	return nil
}

// number reads a JSON number, tolerating both a quoted and an unquoted form.
func number(raw json.RawMessage) (uint32, bool) {
	if len(raw) == 0 {
		return 0, false
	}
	var n float64
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &n); err == nil {
		return uint32(n), true
	}
	var s string
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err == nil {
		var v uint32
		if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(s, "%d", &v); err == nil {
			return v, true
		}
	}
	return 0, false
}

// inflate decodes the u32le length + zlib + "Type:" + JSON + NUL blob framing
// (E26). It returns the JSON after the type prefix.
func inflate(blob []byte, typeName string, max int) ([]byte, error) {
	if len(blob) < 4 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %d bytes", ErrBadBlob, len(blob))
	}
	n := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(blob)
	if n > uint32(max) || n < 3 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: uncompressed length %d", ErrBadBlob, n)
	}
	zr, err := zlib.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(blob[4:]))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrBadBlob, err)
	}
	defer zr.Close()
	plain, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(zr, int64(n)+1))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrBadBlob, err)
	}
	if uint32(len(plain)) != n {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: inflated %d bytes, header says %d", ErrBadBlob, len(plain), n)
	}
	if plain[n-1] != 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: not NUL-terminated", ErrBadBlob)
	}
	plain = plain[:n-1]
	prefix := []byte(typeName + ":")
	if !bytes.HasPrefix(plain, prefix) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: type prefix is not %q", ErrBadBlob, typeName)
	}
	return plain[len(prefix):], nil
}

// EncodeRealmList is the server half of DecodeRealmList, for tests and replay
// peers.
func EncodeRealmList(realms []Realm) ([]byte, error) {
	type part struct {
		Address  uint32         `json:"wowRealmAddress"`
		Update   map[string]any `json:"update"`
		Deleting bool           `json:"deleting"`
	}
	list := struct {
		Updates []part `json:"updates"`
	}{}
	for _, r := range realms {
		upd := r.Rest
		if upd == nil {
			upd = map[string]any{}
		}
		upd["wowRealmAddress"] = r.Address
		upd["name"] = r.Name
		list.Updates = append(list.Updates, part{Address: r.Address, Update: upd})
	}
	js, err := json.Marshal(list)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	plain := append([]byte(TypeRealmList+":"), js...)
	plain = append(plain, 0)
	var zb bytes.Buffer
	zw := zlib.NewWriter(&zb)
	zw.Write(plain)
	zw.Close()
	out := binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint32(nil, uint32(len(plain)))
	return append(out, zb.Bytes()...), nil
}
```

```go
import (
	"bytes"

type fakeUtil struct {

	list     []byte
	lastKey  string
	lastAttr []bnet.Attribute
}

func (f *fakeUtil) Call(_ context.Context, svc bnet.Service, method uint32, req []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	if svc != bnet.GameUtilities || method != bnet.MethodGetAllValuesForAttributes {
		return nil, errors.New("unexpected call")

func TestSubRegions(t *testing.T) {
	f := &fakeUtil{values: []string{"70-1-70", "70-1-71"}}
	got, err := SubRegions(context.Background(), f)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(got) != 2 || got[0] != "70-1-70" {
		t.Fatalf("got %v", got)
	}
}

func TestRealmListRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	blob, err := EncodeRealmList([]Realm{
		{Address: 0x46010046, Name: "Trinity"},
		{Address: 0x46010047, Name: "Second"},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f := &fakeUtil{list: blob}
	got, err := RealmList(context.Background(), f, ListRequest{SubRegion: "70-1-70"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(got) != 2 || got[0].Address != 0x46010046 || got[0].Name != "Trinity" {
		t.Fatalf("got %+v", got)
	}
	if len(f.lastAttr) != 1 || f.lastAttr[0].Name != CmdRealmList+nameSuffix || f.lastAttr[0].Value.String != "70-1-70" {
		t.Fatalf("request %+v", f.lastAttr)
	}
}

func TestDecodeRealmListDropsDeleting(t *testing.T) {
	raw := `{"updates":[{"wowRealmAddress":7,"update":{"name":"A"},"deleting":false},` +
		`{"wowRealmAddress":8,"deleting":true}]}`
	blob := compressForTest(t, raw)
	got, err := DecodeRealmList(blob)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(got) != 1 || got[0].Address != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("got %+v", got)
	}
}

func TestDecodeRealmListRejectsBadPrefix(t *testing.T) {
	blob := compressRaw(t, `{"updates":[]}`) // no type prefix
	if _, err := DecodeRealmList(blob); !errors.Is(err, ErrNoRealmList) {
		t.Fatalf("err %v", err)
	}
}

func TestRealmListWithoutAttribute(t *testing.T) {

		t.Fatalf("err %v", err)
	}

func TestClientInfoJSON(t *testing.T) {
	raw, err := ClientInfo{}.JSON()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var obj struct {
		Info struct {
			Platform     uint32 `json:"platform"`
			Type         uint32 `json:"type"`
			PlatformType uint32 `json:"platformType"`
			ClientArch   uint32 `json:"clientArch"`
			SystemArch   uint32 `json:"systemArch"`
			Secret       []int  `json:"secret"`
			Version      struct {
				Major    uint32 `json:"versionMajor"`
				Minor    uint32 `json:"versionMinor"`
				Revision uint32 `json:"versionRevision"`
				Build    uint32 `json:"versionBuild"`
			} `json:"version"`
			TimeZone    string `json:"timeZone"`
			CurrentTime uint32 `json:"currentTime"`
		} `json:"info"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &obj); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	i := obj.Info
	if i.Platform != PlatformMacARM || i.Type != TypeWoW || i.PlatformType != PlatformTypeMac ||
		i.ClientArch != ArchARM64 || i.SystemArch != ArchARM64 {
		t.Fatalf("identities %+v", i)
	}
	// the default is the installed build (version.Forever(), 70755)
	if i.Version.Build != 70755 || i.Version.Major != 1 || i.Version.Minor != 60 || i.Version.Revision != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("version %+v", i.Version)
	}
	old := version.Build70707
	raw707, err := ClientInfo{Version: &old}.JSON()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(raw707), `"versionBuild":70707`) {
		t.Fatalf("explicit 70707 not honoured: %s", raw707)
	}
	if len(i.Secret) != SecretLen {
		t.Fatalf("secret %v: want %d byte values", i.Secret, SecretLen)
	}
	secret := i.Secret
	for _, v := range secret {
		if v < 0 || v > 255 {
			t.Fatalf("secret %v: byte values out of range", i.Secret)
		}
	}
	if i.TimeZone == "" || i.CurrentTime == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("time fields %+v", i)
	}
}

func TestClientInfoSecretLength(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := (ClientInfo{Secret: make([]byte, 31)}).JSON(); !errors.Is(err, ErrSecret) {
		t.Fatalf("err %v", err)
	}
}

func compressForTest(t *testing.T, payload string) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	blob, err := EncodeRealmList(nil) // reuse the framing code through one empty encode
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = blob
	return compressRaw(t, TypeRealmList+":"+payload)
}

// compressRaw wraps plain bytes in the u32le length + zlib framing.
func compressRaw(t *testing.T, plain string) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	b := append([]byte(plain), 0)
	var zb bytes.Buffer
	zw := zlib.NewWriter(&zb)
	if _, err := zw.Write(b); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	zw.Close()
	out := binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint32(nil, uint32(len(b)))
	return append(out, zb.Bytes()...)
}
```

`auth/realm/realm_test.go`:

```go
package realm

import (
	"bytes"
	"compress/zlib"
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/auth/bnet"
	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/world"
)

func ctx(t *testing.T) context.Context {
	c, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	t.Cleanup(cancel)
	return c
}

// fakeRealmd plays the Battle.net side of both realm commands over a real
// bgs frame stream.
type fakeRealmd struct {
	t          *testing.T
	ticket     []byte
	secret     []byte
	addrs      []Address
	sawSession []byte
	sawAddr    uint64
	sawSub     string
	mutate     func(*bnet.ProcessTaskResponse) // lets a test break the reply
}

func newFake(t *testing.T) *fakeRealmd {
	return &fakeRealmd{
		t:      t,
		ticket: []byte("realm-list-ticket-bytes"),
		secret: bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x5a}, JoinSecretLen),
		addrs:  []Address{{Family: 1, IP: "10.0.0.7", Port: 8085}, {Family: 1, IP: "10.0.0.8", Port: 8086}, {Family: 2, IP: "::1", Port: 8085}},
	}
}

func (f *fakeRealmd) serve(h bnet.Header, body []byte) ([]byte, uint32) {
	req, err := bnet.DecodeProcessTaskRequest(body)
	if err != nil || len(req.Attributes) == 0 {
		return nil, 0x7d1
	}
	var resp bnet.ProcessTaskResponse
	switch strings.TrimSuffix(req.Attributes[0].Name, nameSuffix) {
	case CmdRealmListTicket:
		id, _ := bnet.Lookup(req.Attributes, ParamIdentity)
		ci, _ := bnet.Lookup(req.Attributes, ParamClientInfo)
		if !bytes.HasPrefix(id.Value.Blob, []byte(TypeIdentity+":{")) || id.Value.Blob[len(id.Value.Blob)-1] != 0 ||
			!bytes.HasPrefix(ci.Value.Blob, []byte(TypeClientInfo+":{")) || ci.Value.Blob[len(ci.Value.Blob)-1] != 0 {
			f.t.Errorf("ticket request blobs are not Type:json NUL: %q %q", id.Value.Blob, ci.Value.Blob)
			return nil, 0x7d2
		}
		var who Identity
		if err := json.Unmarshal(id.Value.Blob[len(TypeIdentity)+1:len(id.Value.Blob)-1], &who); err != nil || who.GameAccountID != 77 {
			f.t.Errorf("identity %+v %v", who, err)
		}
		resp.Results = []bnet.Attribute{{Name: ParamRealmListTicket, Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantBlob, Blob: f.ticket}}}
	case CmdRealmJoin:
		cmd := req.Attributes[0]
		f.sawSub = cmd.Value.String
		if cmd.Value.Kind != bnet.VariantString {
			f.t.Errorf("join command value kind %d, want string", cmd.Value.Kind)
		}
		ra, _ := bnet.Lookup(req.Attributes, ParamRealmAddress)
		if ra.Value.Kind != bnet.VariantUint {
			f.t.Errorf("realm address kind %d, want uint", ra.Value.Kind)
		}
		f.sawAddr = ra.Value.Uint
		tk, _ := bnet.Lookup(req.Attributes, ParamRealmListTicket)
		if !bytes.Equal(tk.Value.Blob, f.ticket) {
			f.t.Errorf("join carried ticket %q", tk.Value.Blob)
		}
		sk, _ := bnet.Lookup(req.Attributes, ParamBnetSessionKey)
		f.sawSession = sk.Value.Blob
		blob, _ := EncodeServerAddresses(f.addrs)
		resp.Results = []bnet.Attribute{
			{Name: ParamRealmJoinTicket, Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantBlob, Blob: []byte("JOIN-TICKET")}},
			{Name: ParamServerAddresses, Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantBlob, Blob: blob}},
			{Name: ParamJoinSecret, Value: bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantBlob, Blob: f.secret}},
		}
	default:
		return nil, 0x7d3
	}
	if f.mutate != nil {
		f.mutate(&resp)
	}
	return resp.Encode(), 0
}

func connect(t *testing.T, f *fakeRealmd) *bnet.Client {
	a, b := net.Pipe()
	p := bnet.NewPeer(b)
	p.Handle(bnet.GameUtilities, bnet.MethodProcessTask, f.serve)
	go p.Serve()
	c := bnet.NewClient(a)
	t.Cleanup(func() { c.Close(); b.Close() })
	return c
}

var clientInfo = json.RawMessage(`{"platform":"Mac","textLocale":"enUS","version":{"versionBuild":70707}}`)

func TestTicketThenJoinRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	f := newFake(t)
	c := connect(t, f)

	ticket, err := RealmListTicket(ctx(t), c, TicketRequest{Identity: Identity{GameAccountID: 77, GameAccountRegion: 2}, ClientInfoJSON: clientInfo})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(ticket, f.ticket) {
		t.Fatalf("ticket %q", ticket)
	}

	session := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x33}, 64)
	res, err := RealmJoin(ctx(t), c, JoinRequest{SubRegion: "wow-forever", RealmAddress: 0x1234abcd, Ticket: ticket, SessionKey: session})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if f.sawAddr != 0x1234abcd || f.sawSub != "wow-forever" || !bytes.Equal(f.sawSession, session) {
		t.Fatalf("server saw addr=%#x sub=%q session=%x", f.sawAddr, f.sawSub, f.sawSession)
	}
	if string(res.JoinTicket) != "JOIN-TICKET" || !bytes.Equal(res.JoinSecret[:], f.secret) {
		t.Fatalf("result %+v", res)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(res.Addresses, f.addrs) {
		t.Fatalf("addresses %+v", res.Addresses)
	}

	// The result drops into world.Config.
	half := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xc3}, 32)
	wa, err := res.WorldAuth(half)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var cfg world.Config
	wa.Apply(&cfg)
	if len(cfg.KeyData) != world.KeyDataLen || !bytes.Equal(cfg.KeyData[:32], f.secret) || !bytes.Equal(cfg.KeyData[32:], half) {
		t.Fatalf("KeyData %x", cfg.KeyData)
	}
	if string(cfg.Ticket) != "JOIN-TICKET" {
		t.Fatalf("Ticket %q", cfg.Ticket)
	}
}

		t.Fatal("31-byte half accepted")
	}
	if _, err := r.WorldAuth(nil); !errors.Is(err, ErrKeyHalfRequired) {
		t.Fatalf("WorldAuth: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestResponseFailures(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name string
		mut  func(*bnet.ProcessTaskResponse)
		want error
	}{
		{"no join ticket", func(r *bnet.ProcessTaskResponse) { r.Results = r.Results[1:] }, ErrNoJoinTicket},
		{"join ticket not a blob", func(r *bnet.ProcessTaskResponse) {
			r.Results[0].Value = bnet.Variant{Kind: bnet.VariantString, String: "x"}
		}, ErrNoJoinTicket},
		{"no addresses", func(r *bnet.ProcessTaskResponse) { r.Results = append(r.Results[:1], r.Results[2:]...) }, ErrNoAddresses},
		{"addresses garbage", func(r *bnet.ProcessTaskResponse) { r.Results[1].Value.Blob = []byte{1, 2, 3, 4, 5} }, ErrNoAddresses},
		{"secret too short", func(r *bnet.ProcessTaskResponse) { r.Results[2].Value.Blob = make([]byte, 31) }, ErrBadJoinSecret},
		{"secret too long", func(r *bnet.ProcessTaskResponse) { r.Results[2].Value.Blob = make([]byte, 33) }, ErrBadJoinSecret},
		{"no secret", func(r *bnet.ProcessTaskResponse) { r.Results = r.Results[:2] }, ErrBadJoinSecret},
		{"duplicate join ticket reads as absent", func(r *bnet.ProcessTaskResponse) { r.Results = append(r.Results, r.Results[0]) }, ErrNoJoinTicket},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := newFake(t)
			f.mutate = tc.mut
			c := connect(t, f)
			_, err := RealmJoin(ctx(t), c, JoinRequest{Ticket: f.ticket, SessionKey: make([]byte, 64)})
			if !errors.Is(err, tc.want) {
				t.Fatalf("got %v, want %v", err, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

// blob builds a Param_ServerAddresses blob from raw parts so a test can break
// one rule at a time.
func blob(declared uint32, plain []byte) []byte {
	var zb bytes.Buffer
	zw := zlib.NewWriter(&zb)
	zw.Write(plain)
	zw.Close()
	return append(binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint32(nil, declared), zb.Bytes()...)
}

func TestDecodeServerAddressesRules(t *testing.T) {
	good := append([]byte(TypeServerAddresses+`:{"families":[{"family":1,"addresses":[{"ip":"1.2.3.4","port":9}]}]}`), 0)
	if got, err := DecodeServerAddresses(blob(uint32(len(good)), good)); err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(got, []Address{{1, "1.2.3.4", 9}}) {
		t.Fatalf("good blob: %+v %v", got, err)
	}
	tests := []struct {
		name string
		blob []byte
	}{
		{"too short", []byte{1, 2, 3}},
		{"declared length below 3", blob(2, []byte{0, 0})},
		{"declared above the 0x40000 cap", blob(MaxServerAddresses+1, good)},
		{"declared shorter than inflated", blob(uint32(len(good)-1), good)},
		{"declared longer than inflated", blob(uint32(len(good)+1), good)},
		{"not NUL terminated", blob(uint32(len(good)-1), good[:len(good)-1])},
		{"no colon", blob(4, []byte{'a', 'b', 'c', 0})},
		{"wrong type name", blob(uint32(len(good)), []byte(strings.Replace(string(good), "IPAddresses", "IPAddressesX", 1) + "\x00")[:len(good)])},
		{"not zlib", append(binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint32(nil, 10), bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xff}, 10)...)},
		{"bad json", blob(uint32(len(TypeServerAddresses)+4), append([]byte(TypeServerAddresses+":{{x"), 0)[:len(TypeServerAddresses)+4])},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if _, err := DecodeServerAddresses(tc.blob); !errors.Is(err, ErrBadBlob) {
				t.Fatalf("got %v, want ErrBadBlob", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestBgsLogonToWorldConfig walks the whole bgs side over one connection:
// Connect, Logon (the AP token as the auth token, the session key coming back
// in OnLogonComplete), the ticket request, the join, and the hand-off into
// world.Config.
func TestBgsLogonToWorldConfig(t *testing.T) {
	f := newFake(t)
	a, b := net.Pipe()
	p := bnet.NewPeer(b)
	sessionKey := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x77}, 64)
	p.Handle(bnet.ConnectionService, bnet.MethodConnect, func(bnet.Header, []byte) ([]byte, uint32) {
		return bnet.EncodeConnectResponse(bnet.ConnectResponse{ServerID: bnet.ProcessID{Label: 1, Epoch: 1}, UseBindlessRPC: true, CIID: "ciid-1"}), 0
	})
	p.Handle(bnet.AuthenticationService, bnet.MethodLogon, func(h bnet.Header, body []byte) ([]byte, uint32) {
		req, _ := bnet.DecodeLogonRequest(body)
		if h.CIID != "ciid-1" || string(req.Options.AuthToken) != "AP-TOKEN" {
			return nil, 0x7d0
		}
		go p.Notify(bnet.AuthenticationListener, bnet.MethodOnLogonComplete, bnet.LogonComplete{Record: bnet.LogonRecord{
			AccountID: 1, SessionKey: sessionKey, GameAccounts: []bnet.GameAccountHandle{{ID: 77, TitleID: bnet.TitleIDWoW, Region: 2}},
		}}.Encode())
		return nil, 0
	})
	p.Handle(bnet.GameUtilities, bnet.MethodProcessTask, func(h bnet.Header, body []byte) ([]byte, uint32) {
		if h.CIID != "ciid-1" {
			t.Errorf("ProcessTask without the client instance id: %+v", h)
		}
		return f.serve(h, body)
	})
	go p.Serve()
	c := bnet.NewClient(a)
	t.Cleanup(func() { c.Close(); b.Close() })

	if _, err := c.Connect(ctx(t)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	rec, err := c.Logon(ctx(t), bnet.LogonRequest{TitleID: bnet.TitleIDWoW, Platform: bnet.PlatformMacARM, Options: bnet.LogonOptions{AuthToken: []byte("AP-TOKEN")}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ga := rec.GameAccounts[0]
	ticket, err := RealmListTicket(ctx(t), c, TicketRequest{Identity: Identity{GameAccountID: ga.ID, GameAccountRegion: ga.Region}, ClientInfoJSON: clientInfo})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	res, err := RealmJoin(ctx(t), c, JoinRequest{SubRegion: "x", RealmAddress: 1, Ticket: ticket, SessionKey: rec.SessionKey})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(f.sawSession, sessionKey) {
		t.Fatal("the logon session key did not reach Param_BnetSessionKey")
	}
	wa, err := res.WorldAuth(sessionKey[32:])
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cfg := world.Config{}
	wa.Apply(&cfg)
	if len(cfg.KeyData) != world.KeyDataLen || len(cfg.Ticket) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("world.Config auth material %d/%d", len(cfg.KeyData), len(cfg.Ticket))
	}
}
```

```go
package codec

import (
	"bytes"
	"errors"
	"testing"
)

// The first flag of a group is bit 7: the create-block reader 0x10085e31c
// takes HasEntityPosition with `lsr w8, w21, #7` and MovementUpdate with
// `and w8, w21, #4` (the sixth flag).
func TestBitsAreMostSignificantFirst(t *testing.T) {
	r := NewReader([]byte{0x84})
	for i, want := range []bool{true, false, false, false, false, true, false, false} {
		got, err := r.Bit()
		if err != nil || got != want {
			t.Fatalf("bit %d = %v err=%v, want %v", i, got, err, want)
		}
	}
	w := NewWriter()
	w.Bit(true)
	w.Bits(0, 4)
	w.Bit(true)
	w.FlushBits()
	if !bytes.Equal(w.Bytes(), []byte{0x84}) {
		t.Fatalf("encoded %x, want 84", w.Bytes())
	}
}

// The spline-move reader (0x100858054) assembles a 16-bit point count that
// starts after one flag bit: 7 bits of byte 0, all of byte 1, the top bit of
// byte 2.
func TestMultiBitValueSpansBytes(t *testing.T) {
	w := NewWriter()
	w.Bit(true)
	w.Bits(0xABCD, 16)
	w.Bits(0b101101, 6)
	w.FlushBits()
	if want := []byte{0x80 | 0xABCD>>9, 0xABCD >> 1 & 0xFF, 0x80 | 0b101101<<1}; !bytes.Equal(w.Bytes(), want) {
		t.Fatalf("encoded %x, want %x", w.Bytes(), want)
	}
	r := NewReader(w.Bytes())
	if b, _ := r.Bit(); !b {
		t.Fatal("first bit")
	}
	if v, err := r.Bits(16); err != nil || v != 0xABCD {
		t.Fatalf("16 bits = %#x err=%v", v, err)
	}
	if v, err := r.Bits(6); err != nil || v != 0b101101 {
		t.Fatalf("6 bits = %b err=%v", v, err)
	}
}

func TestByteReadsDiscardPendingBits(t *testing.T) {
	w := NewWriter()
	w.Bit(true)
	w.Uint32(0x01020304) // flushes the pending bit first
	w.Bit(true)
	w.Bit(true)
	w.Uint8(0x55)
	if want := []byte{0x80, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0xC0, 0x55}; !bytes.Equal(w.Bytes(), want) {
		t.Fatalf("encoded %x, want %x", w.Bytes(), want)
	}
	r := NewReader(w.Bytes())
	_, _ = r.Bit()
	if v, err := r.Uint32(); err != nil || v != 0x01020304 {
		t.Fatalf("uint32 = %#x err=%v", v, err)
	}
	_, _ = r.Bit()
	if r.Aligned() {
		t.Fatal("one bit read must leave bits pending")
	}
	if v, err := r.Uint8(); err != nil || v != 0x55 {
		t.Fatalf("uint8 = %#x err=%v", v, err)
	}
	if r.Remaining() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("remaining %d", r.Remaining())
	}
}

func TestGUIDKnownEncoding(t *testing.T) {
	// u16 mask: bit i set for each non-zero byte; low half first.
	g := GUID{Lo: 0x0000000000000102, Hi: 0x0800000000000000}
	w := NewWriter()
	w.GUID(g)
	if want := []byte{0x03, 0x80, 0x02, 0x01, 0x08}; !bytes.Equal(w.Bytes(), want) {
		t.Fatalf("encoded %x, want %x", w.Bytes(), want)
	}
	got, err := NewReader(w.Bytes()).GUID()
	if err != nil || got != g {
		t.Fatalf("decoded %v err=%v", got, err)
	}
	w = NewWriter()
	w.GUID(GUID{})
	if !bytes.Equal(w.Bytes(), []byte{0, 0}) {
		t.Fatalf("empty guid encoded %x", w.Bytes())
	}
}

func TestGUIDRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	for _, g := range []GUID{{}, {Lo: 1}, {Hi: 1}, {Lo: 0x1122334455667788, Hi: 0x99AABBCCDDEEFF00}} {
		w := NewWriter()
		w.GUID(g)
		got, err := NewReader(w.Bytes()).GUID()
		if err != nil || got != g {
			t.Fatalf("%v -> %v err=%v (bytes %x)", g, got, err, w.Bytes())
		}
	}
}

func TestLegacyPackedGUID(t *testing.T) {
	w := NewWriter()
	w.PackedGUID(0x0102)
	if want := []byte{0x03, 0x02, 0x01}; !bytes.Equal(w.Bytes(), want) {
		t.Fatalf("encoded %x, want %x", w.Bytes(), want)
	}

		t.Fatalf("decoded %#x err=%v", got, err)
	}
}

func TestFloatAndCString(t *testing.T) {
	w := NewWriter()
	w.Float32(1.0)
	w.CString("hello")
	if want := append([]byte{0, 0, 0x80, 0x3F}, "hello\x00"...); !bytes.Equal(w.Bytes(), want) {
		t.Fatalf("encoded %x", w.Bytes())
	}

		t.Fatalf("float %v err=%v", f, err)

	if s, err := r.CString(); err != nil || s != "hello" {
		t.Fatalf("string %q err=%v", s, err)
	}
}

func TestUnderflowIsReported(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := NewReader([]byte{1, 2}).Uint32(); !errors.Is(err, ErrUnderflow) {
		t.Fatalf("want ErrUnderflow, got %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := NewReader([]byte{0x03, 0x00, 0x01}).GUID(); !errors.Is(err, ErrUnderflow) {
		t.Fatalf("want ErrUnderflow for truncated guid, got %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := NewReader(nil).Bit(); !errors.Is(err, ErrUnderflow) {
		t.Fatalf("want ErrUnderflow for bit, got %v", err)
	}
}
```

`protocol/codec/reader.go`:

```go
// Package codec implements the byte- and bit-level reader and writer used by
// World of Warcraft: Forever 1.60.1.70707 message bodies.
//
// Conventions [observed in the decrypted client, docs/EVIDENCE.md E21]:
//
//   - Integers and floats are little-endian.
//   - Bit fields are packed most-significant bit first: the first flag is bit 7
//     of its byte (the client extracts flags with `lsr w, #7`, `ubfx w, #6, 1`,
//     ...). A multi-bit value is read high bit first and may span bytes.
//   - Every byte-sized read discards the unread bits of a partly read byte, and
//     every byte-sized write first flushes pending bits. The client reads each
//     flag group as whole bytes, so a group always starts on a byte boundary.
//   - Object GUIDs are 128-bit and packed: a little-endian uint16 mask (low byte
//     for the low 64 bits, high byte for the high 64 bits), then the non-zero
//     bytes of the low half and then the high half, least significant first
//     (client reader 0x1014bf588).
//
// Per-message layouts live in their own packages and are added only once
// checked against the client's decoders.
package codec

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"math/bits"
)

var (
	// ErrUnderflow means a read ran past the end of the buffer.
	ErrUnderflow = errors.New("codec: read past end of buffer")
	// ErrPackedGUID means a packed GUID mask or byte count is impossible.
	ErrPackedGUID = errors.New("codec: malformed packed guid")
)

// GUID is a 128-bit object GUID as the 70707 client stores it: [Lo, Hi].
type GUID struct {
	Lo, Hi uint64
}

// IsEmpty reports whether g is the empty GUID.
func (g GUID) IsEmpty() bool { return g.Lo == 0 && g.Hi == 0 }

// String formats g as Hi:Lo in hex.
func (g GUID) String() string { return fmt.Sprintf("%016x%016x", g.Hi, g.Lo) }

// Reader reads a message body.
type Reader struct {
	buf []byte
	pos int  // next unread byte
	cur byte // byte being consumed by bit reads
	bit uint // unread bits left in cur, 0..7
}

// NewReader returns a Reader over b. The Reader does not copy b.
func NewReader(b []byte) *Reader { return &Reader{buf: b} }

// Remaining reports how many whole bytes are unread. Bits left in a partly
// read byte are not counted: the next byte read discards them.
func (r *Reader) Remaining() int { return len(r.buf) - r.pos }

// Pos reports the byte offset of the next byte read.
func (r *Reader) Pos() int { return r.pos }

// Aligned reports whether no bits of a partly read byte are pending.
func (r *Reader) Aligned() bool { return r.bit == 0 }

// ResetBits discards the unread bits of a partly read byte.
func (r *Reader) ResetBits() { r.bit = 0 }

// Bit reads one bit.
func (r *Reader) Bit() (bool, error) {
	v, err := r.Bits(1)
	return v != 0, err
}

// Bits reads n (0..64) bits, most significant first, and returns them
// right-aligned.
func (r *Reader) Bits(n uint) (uint64, error) {
	if n > 64 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("codec: cannot read %d bits at once", n)
	}
	var out uint64
	for i := uint(0); i < n; i++ {
		if r.bit == 0 {
			if r.pos >= len(r.buf) {
				return 0, ErrUnderflow
			}
			r.cur = r.buf[r.pos]
			r.pos++
			r.bit = 8
		}
		r.bit--
		out = out<<1 | uint64(r.cur>>r.bit&1)
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (r *Reader) take(n int) ([]byte, error) {
	r.bit = 0
	if n < 0 || len(r.buf)-r.pos < n {
		return nil, ErrUnderflow
	}
	b := r.buf[r.pos : r.pos+n]
	r.pos += n
	return b, nil
}

// Uint8 reads one byte.
func (r *Reader) Uint8() (uint8, error) {
	b, err := r.take(1)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return b[0], nil
}

// Uint16 reads a little-endian uint16.
func (r *Reader) Uint16() (uint16, error) {
	b, err := r.take(2)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return uint16(b[0]) | uint16(b[1])<<8, nil
}

// Uint32 reads a little-endian uint32.
func (r *Reader) Uint32() (uint32, error) {
	b, err := r.take(4)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return uint32(b[0]) | uint32(b[1])<<8 | uint32(b[2])<<16 | uint32(b[3])<<24, nil
}

// Uint64 reads a little-endian uint64.
func (r *Reader) Uint64() (uint64, error) {
	b, err := r.take(8)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	var v uint64
	for i := 7; i >= 0; i-- {
		v = v<<8 | uint64(b[i])
	}
	return v, nil
}

// Int32 reads a little-endian int32.
func (r *Reader) Int32() (int32, error) {
	v, err := r.Uint32()
	return int32(v), err
}

// Float32 reads a little-endian IEEE-754 float.
func (r *Reader) Float32() (float32, error) {
	v, err := r.Uint32()
	return math.Float32frombits(v), err
}

// Bytes reads n bytes and returns a copy.
func (r *Reader) Bytes(n int) ([]byte, error) {
	b, err := r.take(n)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return append([]byte(nil), b...), nil
}

// CString reads a NUL-terminated string.
func (r *Reader) CString() (string, error) {
	r.bit = 0
	for i := r.pos; i < len(r.buf); i++ {
		if r.buf[i] == 0 {
			s := string(r.buf[r.pos:i])
			r.pos = i + 1
			return s, nil
		}
	}
	return "", ErrUnderflow
}

// GUID reads a packed 128-bit GUID (see the package comment).
func (r *Reader) GUID() (GUID, error) {
	mask, err := r.Uint16()
	if err != nil {
		return GUID{}, err
	}
	b, err := r.take(bits.OnesCount16(mask))
	if err != nil {
		return GUID{}, err
	}
	var g GUID
	k := 0
	for i := 0; i < 16; i++ {
		if mask&(1<<uint(i)) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		if i < 8 {
			g.Lo |= uint64(b[k]) << (8 * uint(i))
		} else {
			g.Hi |= uint64(b[k]) << (8 * uint(i-8))
		}
		k++
	}
	return g, nil
}

// PackedGUID reads a legacy 64-bit packed GUID (one mask byte). The 70707
// client does not use this form; it remains for the synthetic replay fixtures.
func (r *Reader) PackedGUID() (uint64, error) {
	mask, err := r.Uint8()
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	b, err := r.take(bits.OnesCount8(mask))
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	var guid uint64
	k := 0
	for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
		if mask&(1<<uint(i)) != 0 {
			guid |= uint64(b[k]) << (8 * uint(i))
			k++
		}
	}
	return guid, nil
}

// Reset rewinds the reader to the start of the buffer.
func (r *Reader) Reset() { r.pos, r.bit = 0, 0 }

```

`protocol/codec/writer.go`:

```go
package codec

import (
	"errors"
	"math"
)

// Writer builds a message body with the conventions in the package comment.
// Byte-sized writes first flush pending bits.
type Writer struct {
	buf []byte
	bit uint // bits already used in the last byte, 0 = none pending
}

// NewWriter returns an empty Writer.
func NewWriter() *Writer { return &Writer{} }

// NewWriterCap returns an empty Writer with capacity n.
func NewWriterCap(n int) *Writer { return &Writer{buf: make([]byte, 0, n)} }

// Len reports the number of bytes written so far, including a partly filled one.
func (w *Writer) Len() int { return len(w.buf) }

// Bytes returns the written bytes. A partly filled byte is included, padded
// with zero bits.
func (w *Writer) Bytes() []byte { return w.buf }

// Bit appends one bit.
func (w *Writer) Bit(v bool) {
	var b uint64
	if v {
		b = 1
	}
	_ = w.Bits(b, 1)
}

// Bits appends the low n bits of v (0..64), most significant first.
func (w *Writer) Bits(v uint64, n uint) error {
	if n > 64 {
		return errors.New("codec: cannot write more than 64 bits at once")
	}
	for i := n; i > 0; i-- {
		if w.bit == 0 {
			w.buf = append(w.buf, 0)
		}
		if v>>(i-1)&1 != 0 {
			w.buf[len(w.buf)-1] |= 0x80 >> w.bit
		}
		w.bit = (w.bit + 1) % 8
	}
	return nil
}

// FlushBits pads the current byte with zero bits.
func (w *Writer) FlushBits() { w.bit = 0 }

func (w *Writer) put(b ...byte) {
	w.bit = 0
	w.buf = append(w.buf, b...)
}

// Uint8 appends one byte.
func (w *Writer) Uint8(v uint8) { w.put(v) }

// Uint16 appends a little-endian uint16.
func (w *Writer) Uint16(v uint16) { w.put(byte(v), byte(v>>8)) }

// Uint32 appends a little-endian uint32.
func (w *Writer) Uint32(v uint32) { w.put(byte(v), byte(v>>8), byte(v>>16), byte(v>>24)) }

// Uint64 appends a little-endian uint64.
func (w *Writer) Uint64(v uint64) {
	for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
		w.put(byte(v >> (8 * uint(i))))
	}
}

// Int32 appends a little-endian int32.
func (w *Writer) Int32(v int32) { w.Uint32(uint32(v)) }

// Float32 appends a little-endian IEEE-754 float.
func (w *Writer) Float32(v float32) { w.Uint32(math.Float32bits(v)) }

// RawBytes appends raw bytes.
func (w *Writer) RawBytes(b []byte) { w.put(b...) }

// CString appends a NUL-terminated string.
func (w *Writer) CString(s string) {
	w.put([]byte(s)...)
	w.put(0)
}

// GUID appends a packed 128-bit GUID.
func (w *Writer) GUID(g GUID) {
	var mask uint16
	var out []byte
	for i := 0; i < 16; i++ {
		var b byte
		if i < 8 {
			b = byte(g.Lo >> (8 * uint(i)))
		} else {
			b = byte(g.Hi >> (8 * uint(i-8)))
		}
		if b != 0 {
			mask |= 1 << uint(i)
			out = append(out, b)
		}
	}
	w.Uint16(mask)
	w.put(out...)
}

// PackedGUID appends a legacy 64-bit packed GUID (synthetic fixtures only).
func (w *Writer) PackedGUID(guid uint64) {
	var mask byte
	var out []byte
	for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
		if b := byte(guid >> (8 * uint(i))); b != 0 {
			mask |= 1 << uint(i)
			out = append(out, b)
		}
	}
	w.put(mask)
	w.put(out...)
}
```
