`protocol/updateobject/delta.go`:

```go
package updateobject

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/codec"
)

// Delta (values-update) layouts. A struct's delta starts with its change
// mask, MSB-first in one bit stream: a word of block-present bits (one per
// 32-bit block) and then each present block (bit i of block k is mask bit
// 32k+i). ObjectData and GameObjectData are the exception: a plain mask of 4
// and 28 bits. Values follow,
// byte aligned, in the order the client reads them (delta_tables.go,
// generated by tools/ufdelta.py from the client's delta readers).
//
// A child bit counts only when its group bit is set too: the client tests
// the group first. Any effective bit the tables mark unsupported, or do not
// know, makes the whole delta ErrUnsupported: without it the position of
// every later value is unknown.

type deltaGroup struct{ bit, last int }

type deltaField struct {
	bit     int
	name    string
	width   Width
	trailer bool // a bit-group byte read when group bit is set
	// read, when set, reads a nested part (a sub-struct with its own change
	// mask, a map, a list) at this point of the client's read order, when
	// the bit is effective. name and width are unused (delta_nested.go).
	read func(d *rd, m mask, out *fieldSet)
}

type deltaLayout struct {
	name        string
	blocks      int // 0: a plain mask of plainBits bits
	plainBits   int
	groups      []deltaGroup
	prelude     int // bit-group bytes before the first value
	fields      []deltaField
	unsupported map[int]string
	// prelude reads the struct's bits between the mask and the first value
	// (UnitData, PlayerData); nil when there are none.
	preludeFn func(d *rd, m mask, out *fieldSet)
}

// mask is a decoded change mask.
type mask []uint32

func (m mask) has(bit int) bool {
	k := bit / 32
	return k < len(m) && m[k]&(1<<uint(bit%32)) != 0
}

func (l *deltaLayout) groupOf(bit int) (int, bool) {
	for _, g := range l.groups {
		if g.bit < bit && bit <= g.last {
			return g.bit, true
		}
	}
	return 0, false
}

func (l *deltaLayout) effective(m mask, bit int) bool {
	if !m.has(bit) {
		return false
	}
	if g, ok := l.groupOf(bit); ok {
		return m.has(g)
	}
	return true
}

func (l *deltaLayout) isGroup(bit int) bool {
	for _, g := range l.groups {
		if g.bit == bit {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func (d *rd) readMask(l *deltaLayout) mask {
	if l.blocks == 0 {
		return mask{uint32(d.bitsTraced0(uint(l.plainBits)))}
	}
	present := d.bitsTraced0(uint(l.blocks))
	m := make(mask, l.blocks)
	for k := 0; k < l.blocks; k++ {
		if present&(1<<uint(k)) != 0 {
			m[k] = uint32(d.bitsTraced(32))
		}
	}
	return m
}

// bitsTraced0 starts a bit group and reads n bits.
func (d *rd) bitsTraced0(n uint) uint64 {
	d.group()
	return d.bitsTraced(n)
}

// readDelta decodes one struct's delta. prelude handles the struct's bit
// group before the first value (UnitData); it is nil when there is none.
func (d *rd) readDelta(l *deltaLayout, prelude func(*rd, mask, *fieldSet)) []Field {
	m := d.readMask(l)
	if d.err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	known := map[int]bool{}
	for _, f := range l.fields {
		if !f.trailer {
			known[f.bit] = true
		}
	}
	if prelude == nil {
		prelude = l.preludeFn
	}
	d.fullNested = false
	for k, w := range m {
		for i := 0; i < 32; i++ {
			bit := 32*k + i
			if w&(1<<uint(i)) == 0 || l.isGroup(bit) || !l.effective(m, bit) {
				continue
			}
			if why, ok := l.unsupported[bit]; ok {
				d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: %s delta bit %d (%s)", ErrUnsupported, l.name, bit, why))
				return nil
			}
			if !known[bit] && (prelude == nil || !preludeBits[l.name][bit]) {
				d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: %s delta bit %d is not in the client's layout", ErrUnsupported, l.name, bit))
				return nil
			}
		}
	}
	var out fieldSet
	if prelude != nil {
		prelude(d, m, &out)
	} else if l.prelude != 0 {
		d.fail(fmt.Errorf("updateobject: %s has a prelude but no handler", l.name))
	}
	d.inBits = false
	for _, f := range l.fields {
		if d.err != nil {
			return nil
		}
		if f.read != nil {
			if l.effective(m, f.bit) {
				f.read(d, m, &out)
			}
			continue
		}
		if f.trailer {
			if m.has(f.bit) {
				d.group()
				d.traceRead("1", 0)
				if b := d.bits(8); b != 0 {
					d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: %s bit group after group %d is %#02x", ErrUnsupported, l.name, f.bit, b))
				}
			}
			continue
		}
		if l.effective(m, f.bit) {
			d.traceRead(getterOf(f.width), 0)
			out.add(Field{Name: f.name, Width: f.width, Value: d.value(f.width)})
		}
	}
	return out.list
}

// preludeBits are bits read inside a struct's prelude.
var preludeBits = map[string]map[int]bool{
	"UnitData":       {1: true, 2: true, 3: true, 4: true, 5: true},
	"PlayerData":     {1: true, 2: true},
	"GameObjectData": {1: true, 2: true, 3: true},
	"ItemData":       {1: true, 2: true},
}

// deltaBit is one changed bit, for writeDelta.
type deltaValues map[string]any

// writeDelta encodes a delta that sets exactly the given fields (by name)
// and their group bits. It exists for fixtures.
func writeDelta(w *codec.Writer, l *deltaLayout, vals deltaValues) error {
	byName := map[string]deltaField{}
	for _, f := range l.fields {
		if !f.trailer && f.read == nil {
			byName[f.name] = f
		}
	}
	nblocks := l.blocks
	if nblocks == 0 {
		nblocks = 1
	}
	m := make(mask, nblocks)
	set := func(bit int) { m[bit/32] |= 1 << uint(bit%32) }
	for name := range vals {
		if name == "Field_314" && l == &unitDataDelta {
			set(1)
			set(0)
			continue
		}
		f, ok := byName[name]
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("updateobject: %s has no delta field %q", l.name, name)
		}
		set(f.bit)
		if g, ok := l.groupOf(f.bit); ok {
			set(g)
		}
	}
	w.FlushBits()
	if l.blocks == 0 {
		if err := w.Bits(uint64(m[0]), uint(l.plainBits)); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	} else {
		var present uint64
		for k := range m {
			if m[k] != 0 {
				present |= 1 << uint(k)
			}
		}
		if err := w.Bits(present, uint(l.blocks)); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for k := range m {
			if m[k] != 0 {
				if err := w.Bits(uint64(m[k]), 32); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if l == &unitDataDelta {
		w.FlushBits()
		w.Bit(false)
		if v, ok := vals["Field_314"]; ok {
			b, _ := v.(bool)
			w.Bit(b)
		}
	}
	for _, f := range l.fields {
		if f.read != nil && !f.trailer {
			continue
		}
		if f.trailer {
			if m.has(f.bit) {
				w.FlushBits()
				w.Uint8(0)
			}
			continue
		}
		if l.effective(m, f.bit) {
			if err := writeValue(w, f.width, vals[f.name]); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", f.name, err)
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

```

`protocol/updateobject/delta_lists.go`:

```go
package updateobject

import (
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
)

// Lists and the remaining nested parts of the UnitData, GameObjectData and
// ItemData delta readers (70755). See delta_nested.go for the mechanism.
//
// Two list kinds:
//
//   - A whole list ("static"): a 32-bit count in the bit stream it follows,
//     then count values with the byte getters; it replaces the list.
//     UnitData bit 2 StateWorldEffectIDs (0x1008e962c), GameObjectData
//     bit 1 StateWorldEffectIDs (0x1008b6bb4, only with bits 0 and 1 both).
//   - A dynamic list's change mask (readDynMask), then, after every mask of
//     that run, the changed elements in index order.

// readDynMask reads a dynamic list's update mask the way the client does
// inline (e.g. UnitData 0x1008e969c..0x1008e97ec): a 32-bit size in the
// current bit stream, then ceil(size/32) mask words. When size > 32 the
// words are read whole with the u32 getter (0x100037054) if the bit reader
// has no pending bits, else as 32 bits each (0x1008367bc); a word is taken
// while more than 32 bits remain before it; a last partial word is read as
// its remaining bits (0x1008346ac). Returns the size and the changed
// indices.
func (d *rd) readDynMask(name string, out *fieldSet) []int {
	n := uint32(d.bitsTraced(32))
	out.add(Field{Name: name + ".size", Width: WU32, Value: n})
	if d.err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	if n > 1<<16 {
		d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: %s.size %d", ErrMalformed, name, n))
		return nil
	}
	return d.readDynMaskWords(int(n))
}

func (d *rd) readDynMaskWords(n int) []int {
	words := (n + 31) / 32
	m := make([]uint32, words)
	rem, k := n, 0
	if n > 32 && words > 0 {
		aligned := d.r.Aligned()
		for k < words {
			prev := rem
			if aligned {
				d.traceRead("4", 0)
				m[k] = d.u32()
			} else {
				m[k] = uint32(d.bitsTraced(32))
			}
			k++
			rem = prev - 32
			if prev < 65 {
				break
			}
		}
	}
	if rem != 0 && k < words {
		m[k] = uint32(d.bitsTraced(uint(rem)))
	}
	var changed []int
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		if m[i/32]&(1<<uint(i%32)) != 0 {
			changed = append(changed, i)
		}
	}
	return changed
}

// readWholeList is a static list: a 32-bit count in the current bit stream,
// then count u32s (getter 0x100037054).
func (d *rd) readWholeList(name string, out *fieldSet) {
	n := uint32(d.bitsTraced(32))
	out.add(Field{Name: name + ".size", Width: WU32, Value: n})
	if uint64(n)*4 > uint64(d.r.Remaining()) {
		d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: %s.size %d in %d bytes", ErrMalformed, name, n, d.r.Remaining()))
		return
	}
	for i := 0; i < int(n) && d.err == nil; i++ {
		d.val(out, idx(name, i), WU32)
	}
}

func init() {
	// UnitData, 0x1008e93e0.
	ud := &unitDataDelta
	ud.preludeFn = unitDataPrelude
	splice(ud, []deltaField{{bit: 143, read: mapDelta("Unk_0x368.", "A", "B")}})
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		// VirtualItems, group 193 (0x1008ee5a8): 0x1008e2974 three times.
		splice(ud, []deltaField{{bit: 194 + i, read: visibleItemDelta("VirtualItems.", i)}})
	}
	// The byte after group 128's values (0x1008ee0f0) is HasAssistActionData;
	// bit 151 is read right after it.
	replaceTrailer(ud, 128, unitAssistActionData)
	splice(ud, []deltaField{{bit: 151, read: readNothing}})
	for _, b := range []int{2, 3, 4, 5, 143, 151, 194, 195, 196} {
		delete(ud.unsupported, b)
	}

	// GameObjectData, 0x1008b6b60.
	gd := &gameObjectDataDelta
	gd.preludeFn = gameObjectDataPrelude
	replaceTrailer(gd, 0, gameObjectAssistActionDataDelta)
	splice(gd, []deltaField{{bit: 27, read: readNothing}})
	for _, b := range []int{1, 2, 3, 27} {
		delete(gd.unsupported, b)
	}

	// ItemData, 0x1008c9ec0.
	id := &itemDataDelta
	id.preludeFn = itemDataPrelude
	splice(id, []deltaField{
		{bit: 17, read: itemModifiersDelta},
		{bit: 19, read: itemBonusKeyDelta},
	})
	var ench []deltaField
	for i := 0; i < 14; i++ {
		ench = append(ench, deltaField{bit: 28 + i, read: enchantmentDelta(i)})
	}
	splice(id, ench)
	for _, b := range []int{1, 2} {
		delete(id.unsupported, b)
	}
}

// readNothing marks a bit another part reads (the bit is known, and its
// data comes with an earlier field).
func readNothing(*rd, mask, *fieldSet) {}

// replaceTrailer turns a struct's trailing bit-group byte into a reader.
func replaceTrailer(l *deltaLayout, group int, read func(d *rd, m mask, out *fieldSet)) {
	for i, f := range l.fields {
		if f.trailer && f.bit == group {
			l.fields[i] = deltaField{bit: group, read: read, trailer: true}
			return
		}
	}
	panic(fmt.Sprintf("updateobject: %s has no trailer for group %d", l.name, group))
}

// unitDataPrelude is UnitData's bit stream after the mask (0x1008e9470):
// the full-values flag (kept at [sp+0x18]; it selects the bit-143 map's
// reader, 0x1008edce8), bit 1 Field_314 (+0x388), bit 2 StateWorldEffectIDs
// as a whole list (+0x18). Then, with group 0, a new bit reader
// (0x1008e9684) takes the masks of bits 3 PassiveSpells (+0x2A0), 4
// WorldEffects (+0x2D8) and 5 ChannelObjects (+0x310), and the changed
// elements follow: PassiveSpells two i32s (0x1008e9c04, 0x1008e9c1c),
// WorldEffects an i32 (0x1008e9cfc), ChannelObjects a GUID (0x1008e9d78).
func unitDataPrelude(d *rd, m mask, out *fieldSet) {
	l := &unitDataDelta
	d.group()
	d.fullNested = d.bitsTraced(1) != 0
	if l.effective(m, 1) {
		out.add(Field{Name: "Field_314", Width: WBit, Value: d.bitsTraced(1) != 0})
	}
	if l.effective(m, 2) {
		d.readWholeList("StateWorldEffectIDs", out)
	}
	if !m.has(0) {
		return
	}
	d.group()
	var passive, effects, channel []int
	if l.effective(m, 3) {
		passive = d.readDynMask("PassiveSpells", out)
	}
	if l.effective(m, 4) {
		effects = d.readDynMask("WorldEffects", out)
	}
	if l.effective(m, 5) {
		channel = d.readDynMask("ChannelObjects", out)
	}
	for _, i := range passive {
		d.val(out, idx("PassiveSpells.SpellID", i), WI32)
		d.val(out, idx("PassiveSpells.AuraSpellID", i), WI32)
	}
	for _, i := range effects {
		d.val(out, idx("WorldEffects", i), WI32)
	}
	for _, i := range channel {
		d.val(out, idx("ChannelObjects", i), WGUID)
	}
}

// unitAssistActionData: the byte after group 128's values; its top bit is
// HasAssistActionData (allocated or freed, +0x3C0). If present and bit 151
// is set, 0x1008e356c: a 4-bit mask on a new byte; bit 0 groups 1 Type u8
// (+0), 3 VirtualRealmAddress u32 (+0x34), and with bits 0 and 2 a byte
// whose top 6 bits are the player name's length, then the name.
func unitAssistActionData(d *rd, m mask, out *fieldSet) {
	d.group()
	d.traceRead("1", 0)
	b := d.u8()
	has := b&0x80 != 0
	if b&0x7f != 0 {
		d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: UnitData bit group after group 128 is %#02x", ErrUnsupported, b))
		return
	}
	out.add(Field{Name: "HasAssistActionData", Width: WBit, Value: has})
	if !has || !unitDataDelta.effective(m, 151) {
		return
	}
	d.group()
	am := d.bitsTraced(4)
	if am&1 == 0 {
		return
	}
	if am&2 != 0 {
		d.val(out, "AssistActionData.Type", WU8)
	}
	if am&8 != 0 {
		d.val(out, "AssistActionData.VirtualRealmAddress", WU32)
	}
	if am&5 == 5 {
		d.traceRead("1", 0)
		n := int(d.u8() >> 2)
		out.add(Field{Name: "AssistActionData.PlayerName.len", Width: WBits, Value: uint64(n)})
		d.traceRead("D", n)
		s, err := d.r.Bytes(n)
		d.fail(err)
		out.add(Field{Name: "AssistActionData.PlayerName", Width: WString, Value: string(s)})
	}
}

// gameObjectDataPrelude: with bits 0 and 1, StateWorldEffectIDs (+0x18) as a
// whole list in the mask's bit stream (0x1008b6bb4). Then, with group 0, a
// new bit reader (0x1008b6c0c) takes the masks of bits 2 EnableDoodadSets
// (+0x80) and 3 WorldEffects (+0xD0), and the changed elements follow, an
// i32 each (0x1008b6ef0, 0x1008b6fc0).
func gameObjectDataPrelude(d *rd, m mask, out *fieldSet) {
	l := &gameObjectDataDelta
	if l.effective(m, 1) {
		d.readWholeList("StateWorldEffectIDs", out)
	}
	if !m.has(0) {
		return
	}
	d.group()
	var doodads, effects []int
	if l.effective(m, 2) {
		doodads = d.readDynMask("EnableDoodadSets", out)
	}
	if l.effective(m, 3) {
		effects = d.readDynMask("WorldEffects", out)
	}
	for _, i := range doodads {
		d.val(out, idx("EnableDoodadSets", i), WI32)
	}
	for _, i := range effects {
		d.val(out, idx("WorldEffects", i), WI32)
	}
}

// gameObjectAssistActionDataDelta: the byte after group 0's values
// (0x1008b755c); its top bit is HasAssistActionData (+0x180). If present
// and bit 27 is set, the struct is read whole by 0x100851f08, the create's
// reader (gameObjectAssistActionData).
func gameObjectAssistActionDataDelta(d *rd, m mask, out *fieldSet) {
	d.group()
	d.traceRead("1", 0)
	b := d.u8()
	has := b&0x80 != 0
	if b&0x7f != 0 {
		d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: GameObjectData bit group after group 0 is %#02x", ErrUnsupported, b))
		return
	}
	out.add(Field{Name: "HasAssistActionData", Width: WBit, Value: has})
	if has && gameObjectDataDelta.effective(m, 27) {
		d.inBits = false
		d.runOps(gameObjectAssistActionData, 0, out, "")
		d.inBits = false
	}
}

// itemDataPrelude: with group 0, the masks of bits 1 ArtifactPowers (+0xB8)
// and 2 Gems (+0xF0) continue the item's mask bit stream (0x1008c9f60,
// 0x1008ca140); then the changed elements: an ArtifactPower is i16, u8, u8
// (0x1008ca384..0x1008ca3b4), a Gem a nested delta (0x1008c88cc).
func itemDataPrelude(d *rd, m mask, out *fieldSet) {
	l := &itemDataDelta
	if !m.has(0) {
		return
	}
	var powers, gems []int
	if l.effective(m, 1) {
		powers = d.readDynMask("ArtifactPowers", out)
	}
	if l.effective(m, 2) {
		gems = d.readDynMask("Gems", out)
	}
	for _, i := range powers {
		d.val(out, idx("ArtifactPowers.ArtifactPowerID", i), WI16)
		d.val(out, idx("ArtifactPowers.PurchasedRank", i), WU8)
		d.val(out, idx("ArtifactPowers.CurrentRankWithBonus", i), WU8)
	}
	for _, i := range gems {
		gemDelta(d, i, out)
	}
}

// gemDelta is SocketedGem, 0x1008c88cc: a byte whose top bit says mask
// block 0 follows, then 32 bits. Bit 0 groups 1 ItemID i32 (+0), 2 Context
// u8 (+4); bit 3 groups 4+j, j < 16, BonusListIDs[j] u16 (+6 + 2j).
func gemDelta(d *rd, i int, out *fieldSet) {
	d.group()
	var gm uint32
	if d.bitsTraced(1) != 0 {
		gm = uint32(d.bitsTraced(32))
	}
	if gm&1 != 0 {
		if gm&2 != 0 {
			d.val(out, idx("Gems.ItemID", i), WI32)
		}
		if gm&4 != 0 {
			d.val(out, idx("Gems.Context", i), WU8)
		}
	}
	if gm&8 != 0 {
		for j := 0; j < 16; j++ {
			if gm&(1<<uint(4+j)) != 0 {
				d.val(out, "Gems.BonusListIDs["+strconv.Itoa(i)+"]["+strconv.Itoa(j)+"]", WU16)
			}
		}
	}
}

// itemModifiersDelta is bit 17, ItemModList (+0xB0), 0x100833fdc: a byte;
// without its top bit nothing more. Else its low 7 bits are the size, a
// new bit reader takes the size's mask words (readDynMaskWords), and each
// changed modifier is a u8 Type and an i32 Value.
func itemModifiersDelta(d *rd, _ mask, out *fieldSet) {
	d.traceRead("1", 0)
	b := d.u8()
	out.add(Field{Name: "Modifiers.Changed", Width: WBit, Value: b&0x80 != 0})
	if b&0x80 == 0 {
		return
	}
	n := int(b & 0x7f)
	out.add(Field{Name: "Modifiers.size", Width: WBits, Value: uint64(n)})
	d.group()
	for _, i := range d.readDynMaskWords(n) {
		d.val(out, idx("Modifiers.Type", i), WU8)
		d.val(out, idx("Modifiers.Value", i), WI32)
	}
}

// itemBonusKeyDelta is bit 19, ItemBonusKey (+0x130), read whole by
// 0x100834584, the create's reader.
func itemBonusKeyDelta(d *rd, _ mask, out *fieldSet) {
	d.inBits = false
	d.runOps(prefixed("ItemBonusKey.", itemBonusKey), 0, out, "")
	d.inBits = false
}

// enchantmentDelta is Enchantment[i] (+0x180 + 0xC i), group 27, bits 28+i
// (loop 0x1008cb24c), 0x1008c862c: a 5-bit mask on a new byte; bit 0
// groups 1 ID i32 (+0), 2 Duration u32 (+4), 3 Charges i16 (+8),
// 4 Inactive u16 (+0xA). Names follow the create.
func enchantmentDelta(i int) func(d *rd, _ mask, out *fieldSet) {
	return func(d *rd, _ mask, out *fieldSet) {
		d.group()
		em := d.bitsTraced(5)
		if em&1 == 0 {
			return
		}
		for b, f := range []struct {
			name string
			w    Width
		}{{"ID", WI32}, {"Duration", WU32}, {"Charges", WI16}, {"Inactive", WU16}} {
			if em&(1<<uint(b+1)) != 0 {
				d.val(out, idx("Enchantment."+f.name, i), f.w)
			}
		}
	}
}

```

`protocol/updateobject/delta_nested.go`:

```go
package updateobject

import (
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
)

// Nested parts of the delta readers: sub-structs with their own change
// masks, maps and the flag that switches them to full values. Each is read
// at the point of the client's read order where the reader calls it, so it
// is spliced into the generated table (delta_tables.go) by bit.
//
// PlayerData, reader 0x1008d4e40 (70755):
//
//   - After the last mask block, in the same bit stream, one bit is kept at
//     [sp+0x38] (str at 0x1008d4fe0). Set, the quest log entries
//     (0x1008d78d4) and the QuestLogQuestIdToIndex map (0x1008d6994) are
//     read as full values instead of nested deltas. Then, inside group 0,
//     bit 1 → one bit at +0x340 (HasQuestSession), bit 2 → one bit at +0x341
//     (HasLevelLink). Bits 3..8 (dynamic lists) follow in the same stream
//     and stay unsupported.
//   - Bit 26, QuestLogQuestIdToIndex (+0xF0), between GuildTimeStamp (25)
//     and PlayerTitle (27): full flag → 0x1008d4d24, else 0x1008d7fcc.
//   - Bits 58+i, i < 175, QuestLog[i] (+0x470 + 0x48 i), after PartyType,
//     group 57 (loop 0x1008d77d0): full flag → 0x1008e2dac, else 0x1008e3080.
//   - Bits 234+i, i < 19, VisibleItems[i] (+0x35A8 + 0x20 i), group 233
//     (loop 0x1008d798c): 0x1008e2974 whatever the flag.
//   - Bits 261+i, i < 32, ForcedReactions[i] (+0x3820 + 8 i), group 260
//     (loop 0x1008d7be4), after AvgItemLevel: 0x1008e33a0.

func init() {
	pd := &playerDataDelta
	pd.preludeFn = playerDataPrelude
	nested := []deltaField{{bit: 26, read: mapDelta("QuestLogQuestIdToIndex.", "Key", "Value")}}
	for i := 0; i < 175; i++ {
		nested = append(nested, deltaField{bit: 58 + i, read: questLogDelta(i)})
	}
	for i := 0; i < 19; i++ {
		nested = append(nested, deltaField{bit: 234 + i, read: visibleItemDelta("VisibleItems.", i)})
	}
	for i := 0; i < 32; i++ {
		nested = append(nested, deltaField{bit: 261 + i, read: forcedReactionDelta(i)})
	}
	splice(pd, nested)
	for _, b := range []int{1, 2} {
		delete(pd.unsupported, b)
	}
}

// splice inserts nested readers into l's read order: each before the first
// field (not a trailer) with a higher bit, and marks their bits supported.
func splice(l *deltaLayout, nested []deltaField) {
	for _, n := range nested {
		at := len(l.fields)
		for i, f := range l.fields {
			if !f.trailer && f.bit > n.bit {
				at = i
				break
			}
		}
		l.fields = append(l.fields[:at], append([]deltaField{n}, l.fields[at:]...)...)
		delete(l.unsupported, n.bit)
	}
}

// playerDataPrelude: the full-values flag, then group 0's bits 1 and 2, in
// the mask's bit stream (0x1008d4fb0..0x1008d5198).
func playerDataPrelude(d *rd, m mask, out *fieldSet) {
	d.fullNested = d.bitsTraced(1) != 0
	if playerDataDelta.effective(m, 1) {
		out.add(Field{Name: "HasQuestSession", Width: WBit, Value: d.bitsTraced(1) != 0})
	}
	if playerDataDelta.effective(m, 2) {
		out.add(Field{Name: "HasLevelLink", Width: WBit, Value: d.bitsTraced(1) != 0})
	}
}

// val reads one byte-aligned value and records it.
func (d *rd) val(out *fieldSet, name string, w Width) {
	d.traceRead(getterOf(w), 0)
	out.add(Field{Name: name, Width: w, Value: d.value(w)})
}

// mapDelta reads an int32 → int32 map's delta: PlayerData bit 26
// QuestLogQuestIdToIndex (+0xF0) and UnitData bit 143 (+0x368, keys and
// values named A and B as in the create). With the struct's full-values
// flag set the reader calls 0x1008d4d24 directly; otherwise 0x1008d7fcc: a
// u8, non-zero → 0x1008d4d24; else a u16 change count and per change an
// i32 key, a u8 state and, unless the state is 2 (deleted, 0x1008d80c4), an
// i32 value. 0x1008d4d24 clears the map, then reads a u32 count and count ×
// (i32 key, i32 value), the create's reader.
func mapDelta(prefix, key, value string) func(d *rd, _ mask, out *fieldSet) {
	full := func(d *rd, out *fieldSet) {
		d.traceRead("4", 0)
		n := d.u32()
		out.add(Field{Name: prefix + "size", Width: WU32, Value: n})
		if uint64(n)*8 > uint64(d.r.Remaining()) {
			d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: %s%d entries in %d bytes", ErrMalformed, prefix, n, d.r.Remaining()))
			return
		}
		for i := 0; i < int(n) && d.err == nil; i++ {
			d.val(out, prefix+key, WI32)
			d.val(out, prefix+value, WI32)
		}
	}
	return func(d *rd, _ mask, out *fieldSet) {
		if d.fullNested {
			full(d, out)
			return
		}
		d.val(out, prefix+"Full", WU8)
		if v, _ := out.get(prefix + "Full"); v != uint8(0) {
			full(d, out)
			return
		}
		d.traceRead("2", 0)
		n := d.u16()
		out.add(Field{Name: prefix + "changes", Width: WU16, Value: n})
		if int(n)*5 > d.r.Remaining() {
			d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: %s%d changes in %d bytes", ErrMalformed, prefix, n, d.r.Remaining()))
			return
		}
		for i := 0; i < int(n) && d.err == nil; i++ {
			d.val(out, prefix+key, WI32)
			d.val(out, prefix+"State", WU8)
			if v, _ := out.get(prefix + "State"); v != uint8(MapDeleted) {
				d.val(out, prefix+value, WI32)
			}
		}
	}
}

// MapDeleted is the state byte of a map change that removes its key.
const MapDeleted = 2

// questLogDelta is QuestLog[i].
//
// Delta, 0x1008e3080: a byte; its top bit says whether mask block 0
// follows, then 32 bits (0x1008367bc). Bit 0 groups 1 QuestID i32 (+0),
// 2 StateFlags u16 (+4), 3 EndTime i64 (+8), 4 ObjectiveFlags u32 (+0x10),
// 5 EnabledObjectivesMask u32 (+0x14); bit 6 (tested on its own) groups
// 7+j, j < 24, ObjectiveProgress[j] i16 (+0x18 + 2j).
//
// Full, 0x1008e2dac: QuestID, StateFlags, 24 × ObjectiveProgress, EndTime,
// ObjectiveFlags, EnabledObjectivesMask (the create's order).
func questLogDelta(i int) func(d *rd, _ mask, out *fieldSet) {
	n := func(f string) string { return idx("QuestLog."+f, i) }
	prog := func(j int) string {
		return "QuestLog.ObjectiveProgress[" + strconv.Itoa(i) + "][" + strconv.Itoa(j) + "]"
	}
	return func(d *rd, _ mask, out *fieldSet) {
		if d.fullNested {
			d.val(out, n("QuestID"), WI32)
			d.val(out, n("StateFlags"), WU16)
			for j := 0; j < 24; j++ {
				d.val(out, prog(j), WI16)
			}
			d.val(out, n("EndTime"), WI64)
			d.val(out, n("ObjectiveFlags"), WU32)
			d.val(out, n("EnabledObjectivesMask"), WU32)
			return
		}
		d.group()
		var m uint32
		if d.bitsTraced(1) != 0 {
			m = uint32(d.bitsTraced(32))
		}
		if m&1 != 0 {
			for b, f := range []struct {
				name string
				w    Width
			}{{"QuestID", WI32}, {"StateFlags", WU16}, {"EndTime", WI64}, {"ObjectiveFlags", WU32}, {"EnabledObjectivesMask", WU32}} {
				if m&(1<<uint(b+1)) != 0 {
					d.val(out, n(f.name), f.w)
				}
			}
		}
		if m&(1<<6) != 0 {
			for j := 0; j < 24; j++ {
				if m&(1<<uint(7+j)) != 0 {
					d.val(out, prog(j), WI16)
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

// visibleItemDelta is one VisibleItem, 0x1008e2974: a 12-bit mask
// (0x1006ca7e8) on a new byte; nothing unless bit 0. Then in the same bit
// stream 1 → HasTransmog (+0x14), 2 → HasIllusion (+0x15); then values:
// 3 ItemID i32 (+0), 4 SecondaryItemModifiedAppearanceID i32 (+4),
// 5 ConditionalItemAppearanceID i32 (+8), 6 Unk_0xC i32 (+0xC),
// 7 ItemAppearanceModID u16 (+0x10), 8 ItemVisual u16 (+0x12),
// 9 ItemModifiedAppearanceID u32 (+0x18), 10 TransmogSlotOption u8 (+0x1C),
// 11 SheatheCategory u8 (+0x1D). Names follow the create (visibleItem).
func visibleItemDelta(prefix string, i int) func(d *rd, _ mask, out *fieldSet) {
	n := func(f string) string { return idx(prefix+f, i) }
	return func(d *rd, _ mask, out *fieldSet) {
		d.group()
		m := d.bitsTraced(12)
		if m&1 == 0 {
			return
		}
		if m&(1<<1) != 0 {
			out.add(Field{Name: n("HasTransmog"), Width: WBit, Value: d.bitsTraced(1) != 0})
		}
		if m&(1<<2) != 0 {
			out.add(Field{Name: n("HasIllusion"), Width: WBit, Value: d.bitsTraced(1) != 0})
		}
		for b, f := range []struct {
			name string
			w    Width
		}{
			{"ItemID", WI32}, {"SecondaryItemModifiedAppearanceID", WI32}, {"ConditionalItemAppearanceID", WI32},
			{"Unk_0xC", WI32}, {"ItemAppearanceModID", WU16}, {"ItemVisual", WU16},
			{"ItemModifiedAppearanceID", WU32}, {"TransmogSlotOption", WU8}, {"SheatheCategory", WU8},
		} {
			if m&(1<<uint(b+3)) != 0 {
				d.val(out, n(f.name), f.w)
			}
		}
	}
}

// forcedReactionDelta is ForcedReactions[i], 0x1008e33a0: a 3-bit mask on a
// new byte (0x1008346ac); bit 0 groups 1 FactionID i32 (+0), 2 Reaction i32
// (+4). Names follow the create.
func forcedReactionDelta(i int) func(d *rd, _ mask, out *fieldSet) {
	return func(d *rd, _ mask, out *fieldSet) {
		d.group()
		m := d.bitsTraced(3)
		if m&1 == 0 {
			return
		}
		if m&(1<<1) != 0 {
			d.val(out, idx("ForcedReactions.FactionID", i), WI32)
		}
		if m&(1<<2) != 0 {
			d.val(out, idx("ForcedReactions.Reaction", i), WI32)
		}
	}
}
```

`protocol/updateobject/fields.go`:

```go
package updateobject

import (
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/codec"
)

// Fragment data and the per-type chains (docs/EVIDENCE.md E20, E23).
//
// Create (0x102cddad0): for each fragment of the entity that is not a tag,
// an indirect fragment first has a u8 "active" byte (0x100036c2c, then
// 0x102cde284), then the fragment's create data. Of the updateable
// fragments only CGObject (wire id 3) is decoded; its create data is the
// type's chain of update-field structs:
//
//	TypeActivePlayer  0x101725d88: Object, Unit, Player, ActivePlayer
//	TypePlayer        0x1018cb440: Object, Unit, Player
//	TypeUnit          0x1019ea338: Object, Unit
//
// Values (0x102cde4a8): u8 owner, u8 ids-changed [u8 kind, fragment ids],
// then a change mask of ceil(n/8) bytes, LSB first, two bits per indirect
// updateable fragment (active, contents changed). For CGObject the update
// data is a u32 type mask, then the delta of each struct whose TypeID bit is
// set (0 ObjectData, 5 UnitData, 6 PlayerData, 7 ActivePlayerData; chains
// 0x101725e3c active player, 0x1018cb4c8 player, 0x1019ea398 unit). The client ignores
// other bits.

// isTagFragment reports a tag fragment (no data). The registry kind of tags
// is 4 (0x100597740); the 200..226 range is the fork's [public].
func isTagFragment(id uint8) bool { return id >= 200 && id <= 226 }

// ObjectData is the decoded ObjectData struct.
type ObjectData struct {
	EntryID      int32
	DynamicFlags uint32
	Scale        float32
}

// UnitData holds the UnitData fields this package models; Fields has every
// decoded field in read order, so nothing is dropped.
type UnitData struct {
	DisplayID       int32
	Target          GUID
	Race            uint8
	ClassID         uint8
	Sex             uint8
	DisplayPower    uint8
	Health          int64
	MaxHealth       int64
	Level           int32
	FactionTemplate int32
	// Power and MaxPower are indexed by the class's power slot, not by power
	// type: mapping a slot to a type needs the class's power table.
	Power    [10]int32
	MaxPower [10]int32
	Flags    uint32
	// VirtualItems are the three weapon slots a unit shows (+0x468).
	VirtualItems [3]VisibleItem
	Fields       []Field
}

// PlayerData holds the PlayerData fields this package models. QuestLog and
// QuestLogQuestIDToIndex are visible to the owner and party members only;
// they stay zero/nil when the create did not carry them.
type PlayerData struct {
	Name        string
	PlayerFlags uint32
	// QuestLog is the 175-entry quest log (+0x470, 0x48 each).
	QuestLog [175]QuestLogEntry
	// QuestLogQuestIDToIndex maps a quest ID to its QuestLog index (+0xF0).
	QuestLogQuestIDToIndex map[int32]int32
	// VisibleItems are the 19 equipment slots as others see them (+0x35A8).
	VisibleItems [19]VisibleItem
	Fields       []Field
}

// QuestLogEntry is one QuestLog slot (client readers 0x1008e2dac full,
// 0x1008e3080 delta).
type QuestLogEntry struct {
	QuestID               int32
	StateFlags            uint16
	ObjectiveProgress     [24]int16
	EndTime               int64
	ObjectiveFlags        uint32
	EnabledObjectivesMask uint32
}

// VisibleItem is one VisibleItem (client readers 0x1008e2858 create,
// 0x1008e2974 delta); UnitData's VirtualItems share it.
type VisibleItem struct {
	ItemID                            int32
	SecondaryItemModifiedAppearanceID int32
	ConditionalItemAppearanceID       int32
	Unk0xC                            int32
	ItemAppearanceModID               uint16
	ItemVisual                        uint16
	ItemModifiedAppearanceID          uint32
	TransmogSlotOption                uint8
	SheatheCategory                   uint8
	HasTransmog                       bool
	HasIllusion                       bool
}

// ActivePlayerData is not decoded yet. In a create it is the last thing in
// the block (CGObject is the only fragment with data, and ActivePlayerData
// ends its chain), so its bytes are kept exactly.
type ActivePlayerData struct {
	Raw []byte
}

// GameObjectData holds the GameObjectData fields this package models.
type GameObjectData struct {
	DisplayID       int32
	Flags           uint32
	ParentRotation  Quat
	FactionTemplate int32
	State           int8
	TypeID          int8
	PercentHealth   uint8
	ArtKit          uint32
	Level           int32
	CreatedBy       GUID
	Fields          []Field
}

// ItemData holds the ItemData fields this package models. The owner-only
// ones (StackCount, Durability, MaxDurability) are zero unless the create
// carried the owner visibility flag.
type ItemData struct {
	Owner         GUID
	ContainedIn   GUID
	Creator       GUID
	StackCount    uint32
	DynamicFlags  uint32
	Durability    uint32
	MaxDurability uint32
	// Enchantments are the 14 enchantment slots (+0x180, 0xC each; the
	// delta reader 0x1008c862c).
	Enchantments [14]ItemEnchantment
	Fields       []Field
}

// ItemEnchantment is one item enchantment slot.
type ItemEnchantment struct {
	ID       int32
	Duration uint32
	Charges  int16
	Inactive uint16
}

// VendorData is the FVendor_C fragment (wire id 18).
type VendorData struct {
	Flags int32
}

// ObjectFields is a decoded create: the CGObject fragment's structs and any
// other updateable fragment.
type ObjectFields struct {
	Object       *ObjectData
	Unit         *UnitData
	Player       *PlayerData
	ActivePlayer *ActivePlayerData
	GameObject   *GameObjectData
	Item         *ItemData
	Vendor       *VendorData
	// Other has ObjectData's fields in read order (ObjectData has no
	// unmodelled ones today; kept for symmetry).
	Other []Field
}

// Wire ids of the updateable fragments this package decodes. The registry
// entry's kind byte (+0x1c) is 1 for CGObject (indirect: an active byte
// precedes its data) and 0 for FVendor_C.
const FragmentVendor uint8 = 18

// DecodeFields decodes a create block's fragment data. The client reads the
// updateable fragments in id order (0x102cddad0), each preceded by an active
// byte if it is indirect.
func (c *CreateBlock) DecodeFields() (*ObjectFields, error) {
	ids := append([]uint8(nil), c.Fragments...)
	sort.Slice(ids, func(i, j int) bool { return ids[i] < ids[j] })
	for _, id := range ids {
		switch {
		case id == FragmentCGObject, id == FragmentVendor, isTagFragment(id):
		default:
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: entity fragment %d", ErrUnsupported, id)
		}
	}
	d := &rd{r: codec.NewReader(c.FragmentData)}
	of := &ObjectFields{}
	for _, id := range ids {
		switch id {
		case FragmentCGObject:
			active := d.u8()
			if d.err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: CGObject active byte: %v", ErrMalformed, d.err)
			}
			if active == 0 {
				continue
			}
			if err := decodeChain(d, c.ObjectType, c.FieldFlags, of); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		case FragmentVendor:
			var fs fieldSet
			d.readLayout(vendorDataCreate, c.FieldFlags, &fs)
			if d.err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: FVendor_C: %v", ErrMalformed, d.err)
			}
			of.Vendor = &VendorData{Flags: get[int32](&fs, "Flags")}
		}
	}
	if d.r.Remaining() != 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %d bytes after the fragments of a type %d create", ErrMalformed, d.r.Remaining(), c.ObjectType)
	}
	return of, nil
}

func decodeChain(d *rd, t ObjectType, flags uint8, of *ObjectFields) error {
	var parts [][]op
	switch t {
	case TypeActivePlayer, TypePlayer:
		parts = [][]op{objectDataCreate, unitDataCreate, playerDataCreate}
	case TypeUnit:
		parts = [][]op{objectDataCreate, unitDataCreate}
	case TypeGameObject:
		parts = [][]op{objectDataCreate, gameObjectDataCreate}
	case TypeItem:
		parts = [][]op{objectDataCreate, itemDataCreate}
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: update fields of object type %d", ErrUnsupported, t)
	}
	sets := make([]fieldSet, len(parts))
	for i, p := range parts {
		d.readLayout(p, flags, &sets[i])
		d.inBits = false
		if d.err != nil {
			return d.err
		}
	}
	of.Object, of.Other = objectFrom(&sets[0]), sets[0].list
	switch t {
	case TypeActivePlayer, TypePlayer, TypeUnit:
		of.Unit = unitFrom(&sets[1])
		if len(sets) > 2 {
			of.Player = playerFrom(&sets[2])
		}
	case TypeGameObject:
		of.GameObject = gameObjectFrom(&sets[1])
	case TypeItem:
		of.Item = itemFrom(&sets[1])
	}
	if t == TypeActivePlayer {
		// ActivePlayerData is not decoded: it ends the chain, and CGObject
		// is the only fragment with data in a player's create, so it is
		// the rest of the block.
		raw, _ := d.r.Bytes(d.r.Remaining())
		of.ActivePlayer = &ActivePlayerData{Raw: raw}
	}
	return nil
}

func gameObjectFrom(s *fieldSet) *GameObjectData {
	g := &GameObjectData{Fields: s.list}
	g.apply(s)
	return g
}

func (g *GameObjectData) apply(s *fieldSet) {
	set := func(name string, f func(any)) {
		if v, ok := s.get(name); ok {
			f(v)
		}
	}
	set("DisplayID", func(v any) { g.DisplayID = v.(int32) })
	set("Flags", func(v any) { g.Flags = v.(uint32) })
	set("ParentRotation.X", func(v any) { g.ParentRotation.X = v.(float32) })
	set("ParentRotation.Y", func(v any) { g.ParentRotation.Y = v.(float32) })
	set("ParentRotation.Z", func(v any) { g.ParentRotation.Z = v.(float32) })
	set("ParentRotation.W", func(v any) { g.ParentRotation.W = v.(float32) })
	set("FactionTemplate", func(v any) { g.FactionTemplate = v.(int32) })
	set("State", func(v any) { g.State = v.(int8) })
	set("TypeID", func(v any) { g.TypeID = v.(int8) })
	set("PercentHealth", func(v any) { g.PercentHealth = v.(uint8) })
	set("ArtKit", func(v any) { g.ArtKit = v.(uint32) })
	set("Level", func(v any) { g.Level = v.(int32) })
	set("CreatedBy", func(v any) { g.CreatedBy = v.(GUID) })
}

func itemFrom(s *fieldSet) *ItemData {
	it := &ItemData{Fields: s.list}
	it.apply(s)
	return it
}

func (it *ItemData) apply(s *fieldSet) {
	set := func(name string, f func(any)) {
		if v, ok := s.get(name); ok {
			f(v)
		}
	}
	set("Owner", func(v any) { it.Owner = v.(GUID) })
	set("ContainedIn", func(v any) { it.ContainedIn = v.(GUID) })
	set("Creator", func(v any) { it.Creator = v.(GUID) })
	set("StackCount", func(v any) { it.StackCount = v.(uint32) })
	set("DynamicFlags", func(v any) { it.DynamicFlags = v.(uint32) })
	set("Durability", func(v any) { it.Durability = v.(uint32) })
	set("MaxDurability", func(v any) { it.MaxDurability = v.(uint32) })
	for _, f := range s.list {
		base, ix := splitIndex(f.Name)
		if len(ix) != 1 || ix[0] >= len(it.Enchantments) {
			continue
		}
		e := &it.Enchantments[ix[0]]
		switch base {
		case "Enchantment.ID":
			e.ID = f.Value.(int32)
		case "Enchantment.Duration":
			e.Duration = f.Value.(uint32)
		case "Enchantment.Charges":
			e.Charges = f.Value.(int16)
		case "Enchantment.Inactive":
			e.Inactive = f.Value.(uint16)
		}
	}
}

// ApplyTo updates the modelled ItemData fields from a delta.
func (it *ItemData) ApplyTo(fields []Field) {
	var s fieldSet
	for _, f := range fields {
		s.add(f)
	}
	it.apply(&s)
}

func get[T any](s *fieldSet, name string) T {
	var zero T
	v, ok := s.get(name)
	if !ok {
		return zero
	}
	x, _ := v.(T)
	return x
}

func objectFrom(s *fieldSet) *ObjectData {
	return &ObjectData{
		EntryID:      get[int32](s, "EntryID"),
		DynamicFlags: get[uint32](s, "DynamicFlags"),
		Scale:        get[float32](s, "Scale"),
	}
}

func unitFrom(s *fieldSet) *UnitData {
	u := &UnitData{Fields: s.list}
	u.apply(s)
	return u
}

// apply copies the modelled fields present in s into u.
func (u *UnitData) apply(s *fieldSet) {
	set := func(name string, f func(any)) {
		if v, ok := s.get(name); ok {
			f(v)
		}
	}
	set("DisplayID", func(v any) { u.DisplayID = v.(int32) })
	set("Target", func(v any) { u.Target = v.(GUID) })
	set("Race", func(v any) { u.Race = v.(uint8) })
	set("ClassId", func(v any) { u.ClassID = v.(uint8) })
	set("Sex", func(v any) { u.Sex = v.(uint8) })
	set("DisplayPower", func(v any) { u.DisplayPower = v.(uint8) })
	set("Health", func(v any) { u.Health = v.(int64) })
	set("MaxHealth", func(v any) { u.MaxHealth = v.(int64) })
	set("Level", func(v any) { u.Level = v.(int32) })
	set("FactionTemplate", func(v any) { u.FactionTemplate = v.(int32) })
	set("Flags", func(v any) { u.Flags = v.(uint32) })
	for i := range u.Power {
		set(idx("Power", i), func(v any) { u.Power[i] = v.(int32) })
		set(idx("MaxPower", i), func(v any) { u.MaxPower[i] = v.(int32) })
	}
	for _, f := range s.list {
		base, ix := splitIndex(f.Name)
		if len(ix) == 1 && ix[0] < len(u.VirtualItems) && strings.HasPrefix(base, "VirtualItems.") {
			u.VirtualItems[ix[0]].set(base[len("VirtualItems."):], f.Value)
		}
	}
}

func playerFrom(s *fieldSet) *PlayerData {
	p := &PlayerData{Fields: s.list}
	p.apply(s)
	return p
}

func (p *PlayerData) apply(s *fieldSet) {
	if v, ok := s.get("Name"); ok {
		p.Name = v.(string)
	}
	if v, ok := s.get("PlayerFlags"); ok {
		p.PlayerFlags = v.(uint32)
	}
	p.applyNested(s.list)
}

// ApplyTo updates the modelled PlayerData fields from a delta (or a
// create's field list). Map changes are applied in order: a full map
// (QuestLogQuestIdToIndex.size) replaces it, a change with state 2
// removes its key.
func (p *PlayerData) ApplyTo(fields []Field) {
	var s fieldSet
	for _, f := range fields {
		s.add(f)
	}
	p.apply(&s)
}

func (p *PlayerData) applyNested(fields []Field) {
	const qm = "QuestLogQuestIdToIndex."
	var key int32
	var state uint8
	for _, f := range fields {
		switch f.Name {
		case qm + "size":
			p.QuestLogQuestIDToIndex = map[int32]int32{}
			state = 0
			continue
		case qm + "changes":
			if p.QuestLogQuestIDToIndex == nil {
				p.QuestLogQuestIDToIndex = map[int32]int32{}
			}
			continue
		case qm + "Key":
			key, state = f.Value.(int32), 0
			if p.QuestLogQuestIDToIndex == nil {
				p.QuestLogQuestIDToIndex = map[int32]int32{}
			}
			continue
		case qm + "State":
			if state = f.Value.(uint8); state == MapDeleted {
				delete(p.QuestLogQuestIDToIndex, key)
			}
			continue
		case qm + "Value":
			p.QuestLogQuestIDToIndex[key] = f.Value.(int32)
			continue
		}
		base, ix := splitIndex(f.Name)
		if len(ix) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		i := ix[0]
		switch {
		case strings.HasPrefix(base, "QuestLog.") && i < len(p.QuestLog):
			q := &p.QuestLog[i]
			switch base[len("QuestLog."):] {
			case "QuestID":
				q.QuestID = f.Value.(int32)
			case "StateFlags":
				q.StateFlags = f.Value.(uint16)
			case "EndTime":
				q.EndTime = f.Value.(int64)
			case "ObjectiveFlags":
				q.ObjectiveFlags = f.Value.(uint32)
			case "EnabledObjectivesMask":
				q.EnabledObjectivesMask = f.Value.(uint32)
			case "ObjectiveProgress":
				if len(ix) == 2 && ix[1] < len(q.ObjectiveProgress) {
					q.ObjectiveProgress[ix[1]] = f.Value.(int16)
				}
			}
		case strings.HasPrefix(base, "VisibleItems.") && i < len(p.VisibleItems):
			p.VisibleItems[i].set(base[len("VisibleItems."):], f.Value)
		}
	}
}

func (v *VisibleItem) set(name string, x any) {
	switch name {
	case "ItemID":
		v.ItemID = x.(int32)
	case "SecondaryItemModifiedAppearanceID":
		v.SecondaryItemModifiedAppearanceID = x.(int32)
	case "ConditionalItemAppearanceID":
		v.ConditionalItemAppearanceID = x.(int32)
	case "Unk_0xC":
		v.Unk0xC = x.(int32)
	case "ItemAppearanceModID":
		v.ItemAppearanceModID = x.(uint16)
	case "ItemVisual":
		v.ItemVisual = x.(uint16)
	case "ItemModifiedAppearanceID":
		v.ItemModifiedAppearanceID = x.(uint32)
	case "TransmogSlotOption":
		v.TransmogSlotOption = x.(uint8)
	case "SheatheCategory":
		v.SheatheCategory = x.(uint8)
	case "HasTransmog":
		v.HasTransmog = x.(bool)
	case "HasIllusion":
		v.HasIllusion = x.(bool)
	}
}

// splitIndex splits "A.B[1][2]" into "A.B" and [1, 2].
func splitIndex(name string) (string, []int) {
	i := strings.IndexByte(name, '[')
	if i < 0 {
		return name, nil
	}
	base, rest := name[:i], name[i:]
	var ix []int
	for len(rest) > 0 && rest[0] == '[' {
		j := strings.IndexByte(rest, ']')
		if j < 0 {
			return name, nil
		}
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(rest[1:j])
		if err != nil {
			return name, nil
		}
		ix = append(ix, n)
		rest = rest[j+1:]
	}
	return base, ix
}

// ObjectDelta is a decoded values block for CGObject: the changed fields of
// each struct, in read order. Nil means the struct did not change.
type ObjectDelta struct {
	Object     []Field
	Unit       []Field
	Player     []Field
	GameObject []Field
	Item       []Field
	// ActivePlayerRaw is the undecoded ActivePlayerData delta of the active
	// player (TypeID bit 7), nil when that bit is clear.
	ActivePlayerRaw []byte
	// TypeMask is the u32 of TypeID bits; bits the client ignores for this
	// object type are kept here and not decoded (they carry no data).
	TypeMask uint32
}

// ApplyTo updates the modelled UnitData fields from a delta.
func (u *UnitData) ApplyTo(fields []Field) {
	var s fieldSet
	for _, f := range fields {
		s.add(f)
	}
	u.apply(&s)
}

// deltaStep is one struct of an update chain: the TypeID bit that gates it.
type deltaStep struct {
	bit uint
	run func(d *rd, out *ObjectDelta)
}

// The update chains (E23, E31): a u32 TypeID mask, then each struct whose
// bit is set, in this order. The client tests only these bits per type.
var (
	stepObject = deltaStep{0, func(d *rd, o *ObjectDelta) { o.Object = d.readDelta(&objectDataDelta, nil) }}
	stepUnit   = deltaStep{5, func(d *rd, o *ObjectDelta) { o.Unit = d.readDelta(&unitDataDelta, unitDataPrelude) }}
	stepPlayer = deltaStep{6, func(d *rd, o *ObjectDelta) { o.Player = d.readDelta(&playerDataDelta, nil) }}
	// ActivePlayerData (0x10087b9e8) is not decoded. It is the last struct
	// of the chain and CGObject is the only fragment with data, so it is
	// the rest of the block: keep it raw, as the create does.
	stepActive = deltaStep{7, func(d *rd, o *ObjectDelta) {
		o.ActivePlayerRaw, _ = d.r.Bytes(d.r.Remaining())
		if o.ActivePlayerRaw == nil {
			o.ActivePlayerRaw = []byte{}
		}
	}}
	stepGameObject = deltaStep{8, func(d *rd, o *ObjectDelta) { o.GameObject = d.readDelta(&gameObjectDataDelta, nil) }}
	stepItem       = deltaStep{1, func(d *rd, o *ObjectDelta) { o.Item = d.readDelta(&itemDataDelta, nil) }}
)

var updateChains = map[ObjectType][]deltaStep{
	TypeActivePlayer: {stepObject, stepUnit, stepPlayer, stepActive}, // 0x101725e3c
	TypePlayer:       {stepObject, stepUnit, stepPlayer},             // 0x1018cb4c8
	TypeUnit:         {stepObject, stepUnit},                         // 0x1019ea398
	TypeGameObject:   {stepObject, stepGameObject},                   // 0x1017ffd18
	TypeItem:         {stepObject, stepItem},                         // after 0x10183d678
}

// DecodeValues decodes a values block for an object of type t whose
// fragments are CGObject and tags (as every decoded create has).
//
// On an error past the header, the returned delta still holds the structs
// that decoded completely before the failure (the chain reads them in
// order, so they are exact); the caller may apply them.
func DecodeValues(t ObjectType, v *ValuesBlock) (*ObjectDelta, error) {
	d := &rd{r: codec.NewReader(v.Data)}
	_ = d.u8() // owner: the client uses it only for the fragment list
	if d.u8() != 0 {
		kind := d.u8()
		if d.err == nil && kind == 1 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: partial fragment-id update (0x102cde940)", ErrUnsupported)
		}
		for d.err == nil {
			id := d.u8()
			if d.err != nil || id == FragmentEnd {
				break
			}
			if id != FragmentCGObject && !isTagFragment(id) {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: entity fragment %d", ErrUnsupported, id)
			}
		}
	}
	changed := d.u8() // CGObject: bit 0 active, bit 1 contents changed
	if d.err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: values header: %v", ErrMalformed, d.err)
	}
	if changed&1 == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: values block deactivating CGObject", ErrUnsupported)
	}
	if changed&^3 != 0 {
		// CGObject has the lowest id of the updateable fragments, so its
		// bits are 0 and 1; higher bits belong to another fragment (FVendor_C
		// is bit 2 on a vendor), whose list this function is not given.
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: change mask %#02x has bits for fragments after CGObject", ErrUnsupported, changed)
	}
	out := &ObjectDelta{}
	if changed&2 != 0 {
		out.TypeMask = d.u32()
		chain, ok := updateChains[t]
		if !ok {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: values of object type %d", ErrUnsupported, t)
		}
		for _, st := range chain {
			if d.err != nil {
				break
			}
			if out.TypeMask&(1<<st.bit) != 0 {
				st.run(d, out)
			}
		}
	}
	if d.err != nil {
		return out, d.err
	}
	if d.r.Remaining() != 0 {
		return out, fmt.Errorf("%w: %d bytes after the values", ErrMalformed, d.r.Remaining())
	}
	return out, nil
}
```

`protocol/updateobject/fields_test.go`:

```go
package updateobject

import (
	"bytes"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/codec"
)

func sampleFields() Fields {
	return Fields{
		Object: map[string]any{"EntryID": int32(0), "Scale": float32(1)},
		Unit: map[string]any{
			"DisplayID": int32(49), "Race": uint8(1), "ClassId": uint8(1), "Sex": uint8(0), "DisplayPower": uint8(1),
			"Health": int64(250), "MaxHealth": int64(300), "Level": int32(12), "FactionTemplate": int32(1),
			"Power[0]": int32(40), "MaxPower[0]": int32(100), "Target": GUID{Lo: 0x77, Hi: 0x2000000000000000},
			"PassiveSpells.size": uint32(1), "PassiveSpells.SpellID[0]": int32(668),
		},
		Player: map[string]any{"Name.len": uint64(4), "Name": "Jack", "PlayerFlags": uint32(8)},
	}
}

func TestDecodeFieldsChains(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name  string
		typ   ObjectType
		flags uint8
	}{
		{"unit, no flags", TypeUnit, 0},
		{"unit, empath", TypeUnit, FlagEmpath},
		{"player, other", TypePlayer, 0},
		{"player, party", TypePlayer, FlagPartyMember},
		{"active player, self", TypeActivePlayer, FlagOwner | FlagPartyMember},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := sampleFields()
			f.ActivePlayerRaw = []byte{1, 2, 3, 4}
			data, err := BuildFragmentData(tc.typ, tc.flags, f)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			c := &CreateBlock{ObjectType: tc.typ, FieldFlags: tc.flags, Fragments: []uint8{FragmentCGObject, FragmentTagUnit, FragmentTagPlayer}, FragmentData: data}
			of, err := c.DecodeFields()
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			u := of.Unit
			if u.Health != 250 || u.MaxHealth != 300 || u.Level != 12 || u.ClassID != 1 || u.Race != 1 ||
				u.Power[0] != 40 || u.MaxPower[0] != 100 || u.Target != (GUID{Lo: 0x77, Hi: 0x2000000000000000}) {
				t.Fatalf("unit %+v", u)
			}
			if of.Object.Scale != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("object %+v", of.Object)
			}
			if v, _ := (&fieldSet{list: u.Fields, index: indexOf(u.Fields)}).get("PassiveSpells.SpellID[0]"); v != int32(668) {
				t.Fatalf("unmodelled field lost: %v", v)
			}
			switch tc.typ {
			case TypeUnit:
				if of.Player != nil || of.ActivePlayer != nil {
					t.Fatal("unit decoded player parts")
				}
			case TypePlayer:
				if of.Player.Name != "Jack" || of.ActivePlayer != nil {
					t.Fatalf("player %+v", of.Player)
				}
			case TypeActivePlayer:
				if of.Player.Name != "Jack" || !bytes.Equal(of.ActivePlayer.Raw, []byte{1, 2, 3, 4}) {
					t.Fatalf("active player %+v %+v", of.Player, of.ActivePlayer)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func indexOf(fs []Field) map[string]int {
	m := map[string]int{}
	for i, f := range fs {
		m[f.Name] = i
	}
	return m
}

func TestDecodeFieldsRefuses(t *testing.T) {
	data, err := BuildFragmentData(TypeUnit, 0, sampleFields())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	tests := []struct {
		name string
		c    CreateBlock
		want error
	}{
		{"unknown fragment", CreateBlock{ObjectType: TypeUnit, Fragments: []uint8{FragmentCGObject, 20}, FragmentData: data}, ErrUnsupported},
		{"corpse fields", CreateBlock{ObjectType: TypeCorpse, Fragments: []uint8{FragmentCGObject}, FragmentData: []byte{1, 0}}, ErrUnsupported},
		{"trailing bytes", CreateBlock{ObjectType: TypeUnit, Fragments: []uint8{FragmentCGObject}, FragmentData: append(append([]byte(nil), data...), 0)}, ErrMalformed},
		{"truncated", CreateBlock{ObjectType: TypeUnit, Fragments: []uint8{FragmentCGObject}, FragmentData: data[:len(data)-1]}, codec.ErrUnderflow},
		{"data without CGObject", CreateBlock{ObjectType: TypeUnit, Fragments: []uint8{FragmentTagUnit}, FragmentData: []byte{1}}, ErrMalformed},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		if _, err := tc.c.DecodeFields(); !errors.Is(err, tc.want) {
			t.Errorf("%s: %v, want %v", tc.name, err, tc.want)
		}
	}
	inactive := CreateBlock{ObjectType: TypeUnit, Fragments: []uint8{FragmentCGObject}, FragmentData: []byte{0}}
	if of, err := inactive.DecodeFields(); err != nil || of.Unit != nil {
		t.Errorf("inactive CGObject: %+v, %v", of, err)
	}
}

func TestDecodeValues(t *testing.T) {
	data, err := BuildValues(nil, map[string]any{"Health": int64(100), "MaxPower[0]": int32(120), "Target": GUID{Lo: 5}}, map[string]any{"PlayerFlags": uint32(2)})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, typ := range []ObjectType{TypeActivePlayer, TypePlayer} {
		d, err := DecodeValues(typ, &ValuesBlock{Data: data})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		u := &UnitData{}
		u.ApplyTo(d.Unit)
		if u.Health != 100 || u.MaxPower[0] != 120 || u.Target != (GUID{Lo: 5}) || d.Object != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%d: unit %+v", typ, u)
		}
		if len(d.Player) != 1 || d.Player[0].Value != uint32(2) {
			t.Fatalf("%d: player %+v", typ, d.Player)
		}
	}
	// A unit has no PlayerData: the client ignores bit 6, so the player
	// delta's bytes are left over.
	if _, err := DecodeValues(TypeUnit, &ValuesBlock{Data: data}); !errors.Is(err, ErrMalformed) {
		t.Errorf("unit with player delta: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestDecodeValuesRefuses(t *testing.T) {
	w := codec.NewWriter()
	w.Uint8(0)
	w.Uint8(0)
	w.Uint8(3)
	w.Uint32(1 << 7) // ActivePlayerData
	ap := w.Bytes()

	w = codec.NewWriter()
	w.Uint8(0)
	w.Uint8(0)
	w.Uint8(3)
	w.Uint32(1 << 6)
	_ = w.Bits(1, 11)      // PlayerData: block 0 present
	_ = w.Bits(1|1<<3, 32) // group 0, Customizations (a list, not decoded)
	list := w.Bytes()

	tests := []struct {
		name string
		typ  ObjectType
		data []byte
		want error
	}{
		{"list bit", TypePlayer, list, ErrUnsupported},
		{"partial fragment ids", TypeUnit, []byte{0, 1, 1}, ErrUnsupported},
		{"deactivate", TypeUnit, []byte{0, 0, 0}, ErrUnsupported},
		{"corpse", TypeCorpse, []byte{0, 0, 3, 1, 0, 0, 0}, ErrUnsupported},
		{"short", TypeUnit, []byte{0, 0}, ErrMalformed},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		if _, err := DecodeValues(tc.typ, &ValuesBlock{Data: tc.data}); !errors.Is(err, tc.want) {
			t.Errorf("%s: %v, want %v", tc.name, err, tc.want)
		}
	}
	// The active player's ActivePlayerData delta ends the block and is kept
	// raw.
	apRaw := append(append([]byte{}, ap...), 0xAA, 0xBB)
	if d, err := DecodeValues(TypeActivePlayer, &ValuesBlock{Data: apRaw}); err != nil || string(d.ActivePlayerRaw) != "\xaa\xbb" {
		t.Errorf("active player delta: %+v, %v", d, err)
	}
	// For a non-active player bit 7 carries no data: the client ignores it.
	if _, err := DecodeValues(TypePlayer, &ValuesBlock{Data: ap}); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("player with bit 7: %v", err)
	}
}

```

`protocol/updateobject/layout.go`:

```go
package updateobject

import (
	"fmt"

	"strconv"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/codec"
)

// A layout is a small program that describes one update-field struct's create
// data in the order the client reads it. It is interpreted by readLayout and
// writeLayout, so the decoder and the fixture encoder cannot drift apart.
//
// Ops:
//   - a value of a fixed width (u8 ... guid), byte aligned
//   - bit / bits(n): a bit field; a run of them forms one byte-aligned group
//   - when(mask): body only if the visibility flags share a bit with mask
//     (the fork's EnumFlag::HasFlag; the client tests the flags argument)
//   - repeat(n): body n times, names suffixed with [i]
//   - each(count): body once per element of an earlier count field
//   - opt(bit): body only if an earlier bit field is set
//   - cstr(len): a sized C string (client 0x1006c83a0): the length counts
//     the NUL, and a length of 0 or 1 reads nothing
//   - unsupported: a valid part not decoded yet; reading it fails
type opKind uint8

const (
	opValue opKind = iota
	opBit
	opBits
	opWhen
	opRepeat
	opEach
	opOpt
	opString  // bytes whose length is an earlier bits/count field
	opCString // a sized C string: the length counts the NUL; 0 or 1 reads nothing
	opFlush   // end the current bit group (the fork's FlushBits)
	opUnsupported
)

// Width is a field's wire type.
type Width uint8

// Wire widths.
const (
	WU8 Width = iota + 1
	WI8
	WU16
	WI16
	WU32
	WI32
	WU64
	WI64
	WF32
	WGUID
	WBit
	WBits
	WString
)

func (w Width) String() string {
	return [...]string{"?", "u8", "i8", "u16", "i16", "u32", "i32", "u64", "i64", "f32", "guid", "bit", "bits", "string"}[w]
}

type op struct {
	kind  opKind
	name  string
	width Width
	n     int    // bits width, repeat count
	mask  uint8  // when
	ref   string // each/opt/string: the field it depends on
	body  []op
	why   string // unsupported: what is missing
}

func val(name string, w Width) op      { return op{kind: opValue, name: name, width: w} }
func bit(name string) op               { return op{kind: opBit, name: name, width: WBit} }
func bitsN(name string, n int) op      { return op{kind: opBits, name: name, width: WBits, n: n} }
func when(mask uint8, body ...op) op   { return op{kind: opWhen, mask: mask, body: body} }
func repeat(n int, body ...op) op      { return op{kind: opRepeat, n: n, body: body} }
func each(count string, body ...op) op { return op{kind: opEach, ref: count, body: body} }
func opt(flag string, body ...op) op   { return op{kind: opOpt, ref: flag, body: body} }
func str(name, length string) op       { return op{kind: opString, name: name, width: WString, ref: length} }
func cstr(name, length string) op {
	return op{kind: opCString, name: name, width: WString, ref: length}
}
func flush() op                 { return op{kind: opFlush} }
func unsupported(why string) op { return op{kind: opUnsupported, why: why} }
func u8(name string) op         { return val(name, WU8) }
func i8(name string) op         { return val(name, WI8) }
func u16(name string) op        { return val(name, WU16) }
func i16(name string) op        { return val(name, WI16) }
func u32(name string) op        { return val(name, WU32) }
func i32(name string) op        { return val(name, WI32) }
func u64(name string) op        { return val(name, WU64) }
func i64(name string) op        { return val(name, WI64) }
func f32(name string) op        { return val(name, WF32) }
func guid(name string) op       { return val(name, WGUID) }
func ops(o ...op) []op          { return o }
func prefixed(prefix string, o []op) []op {
	return renamed(o, func(s string) string { return prefix + s })
}

func renamed(o []op, f func(string) string) []op {
	out := make([]op, len(o))
	for i, x := range o {
		x.name = mapName(x.name, f)
		x.ref = mapName(x.ref, f)
		x.body = renamed(x.body, f)
		out[i] = x
	}
	return out
}

func mapName(s string, f func(string) string) string {
	if s == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return f(s)
}

// Field is one decoded update field. Value holds the Go type of its width:
// uint8, int8, uint16, int16, uint32, int32, uint64, int64, float32, GUID,
// bool (bit), uint64 (bits) or string.
type Field struct {
	Name  string
	Width Width
	Value any
}

func (f Field) String() string { return fmt.Sprintf("%s(%s)=%v", f.Name, f.Width, f.Value) }

// fieldSet indexes decoded fields by name.
type fieldSet struct {
	list  []Field
	index map[string]int
}

func (s *fieldSet) add(f Field) {
	if s.index == nil {
		s.index = make(map[string]int)
	}
	s.index[f.Name] = len(s.list)
	s.list = append(s.list, f)
}

func (s *fieldSet) get(name string) (any, bool) {
	i, ok := s.index[name]
	if !ok {
		return nil, false
	}
	return s.list[i].Value, true
}

// count returns an integer field's value, for each/string.
func (s *fieldSet) count(name string) (int, error) {
	v, ok := s.get(name)
	if !ok {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("updateobject: layout refers to %q before reading it", name)
	}
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case nil:
		return 0, nil
	case uint8:
		return int(x), nil
	case uint16:
		return int(x), nil
	case uint32:
		return int(x), nil
	case uint64:
		return int(x), nil
	case int32:
		if x < 0 {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("%w: negative count %s=%d", ErrMalformed, name, x)
		}
		return int(x), nil
	case bool:
		if x {
			return 1, nil
		}
		return 0, nil
	}
	return 0, fmt.Errorf("updateobject: %q is not a count", name)
}

func minBytes(w Width) int {
	switch w {
	case WU8, WI8:
		return 1
	case WU16, WI16, WGUID:
		return 2
	case WU32, WI32, WF32:
		return 4
	case WU64, WI64:
		return 8
	}
	return 0
}

// bodyMin is a lower bound on the bytes one iteration of body reads, used to
// reject absurd counts before looping.
func bodyMin(body []op, flags uint8) int {
	n := 0
	for _, o := range body {
		switch o.kind {
		case opValue:
			n += minBytes(o.width)
		case opRepeat:
			n += o.n * bodyMin(o.body, flags)
		case opWhen:
			if flags&o.mask != 0 {
				n += bodyMin(o.body, flags)
			}
		}
	}
	return n
}

// readLayout runs prog over d with the given visibility flags.
func (d *rd) readLayout(prog []op, flags uint8, out *fieldSet) {
	d.runOps(prog, flags, out, "")
}

func idx(suffix string, i int) string { return suffix + "[" + strconv.Itoa(i) + "]" }

// traceRead records a primitive read for TestLayoutsAgainstClient: the
// position and the client getter it corresponds to (1, 2, 4, 8, f, G, D).
func (d *rd) traceRead(w string, n int) {
	if d.trace != nil && d.err == nil {
		*d.trace = append(*d.trace, traceEnt{Pos: d.r.Pos(), W: w, N: n})
	}
}

type traceEnt struct {
	Pos int
	W   string
	N   int
}

func getterOf(w Width) string {
	switch w {
	case WU8, WI8:
		return "1"
	case WU16, WI16:
		return "2"
	case WU32, WI32:
		return "4"
	case WU64, WI64:
		return "8"
	case WF32:
		return "f"
	case WGUID:
		return "G"
	}
	return "?"
}

// endsBitGroup reports whether o is a byte-sized read, which closes a run of
// bit fields. Structural ops (when, repeat, each, opt) do not: a bit inside a
// when belongs to the surrounding group.
func endsBitGroup(o op) bool {
	return o.kind == opValue || o.kind == opString || o.kind == opCString || o.kind == opUnsupported || o.kind == opFlush
}

func (d *rd) runOps(prog []op, flags uint8, out *fieldSet, suffix string) {
	for _, o := range prog {
		if d.err != nil {
			return
		}
		if endsBitGroup(o) {
			d.inBits = false
		}
		switch o.kind {
		case opValue:
			d.traceRead(getterOf(o.width), 0)
			out.add(Field{Name: o.name + suffix, Width: o.width, Value: d.value(o.width)})
		case opBit, opBits:
			if !d.inBits {
				d.group()
				d.inBits = true
			}
			if o.kind == opBit {
				// The client reads a bit group a byte at a time.
				if d.r.Aligned() {
					d.traceRead("1", 0)
				}
				out.add(Field{Name: o.name + suffix, Width: WBit, Value: d.bit()})
			} else {
				v := d.bitsTraced(uint(o.n))
				out.add(Field{Name: o.name + suffix, Width: WBits, Value: v})
			}
		case opWhen:
			if flags&o.mask != 0 {
				d.runOps(o.body, flags, out, suffix)
			}
		case opRepeat:
			for i := 0; i < o.n; i++ {
				d.runOps(o.body, flags, out, idx(suffix, i))
			}
		case opEach:
			n, err := out.count(o.ref + suffix)
			if err != nil {
				d.fail(err)
				return
			}
			if m := bodyMin(o.body, flags); m > 0 {
				n = d.count(uint32(n), m)
			}
			for i := 0; i < n && d.err == nil; i++ {
				d.runOps(o.body, flags, out, idx(suffix, i))
			}
		case opOpt:
			n, err := out.count(o.ref + suffix)
			if err != nil {
				d.fail(err)
				return
			}
			if n != 0 {
				d.runOps(o.body, flags, out, suffix)
			}
		case opString:
			n, err := out.count(o.ref + suffix)
			if err != nil {
				d.fail(err)
				return
			}
			d.traceRead("D", n)
			b, err := d.r.Bytes(n)
			if err != nil {
				d.fail(err)
				return
			}
			out.add(Field{Name: o.name + suffix, Width: WString, Value: string(b)})
		case opCString:
			n, err := out.count(o.ref + suffix)
			if err != nil {
				d.fail(err)
				return
			}
			if n < 2 {
				out.add(Field{Name: o.name + suffix, Width: WString, Value: ""})
				continue
			}
			d.traceRead("D", n)
			b, err := d.r.Bytes(n)
			if err != nil {
				d.fail(err)
				return
			}
			// The client keeps the string only if it ends in a NUL.
			v := ""
			if b[n-1] == 0 {
				v = string(b[:n-1])
			}
			out.add(Field{Name: o.name + suffix, Width: WString, Value: v})
		case opUnsupported:
			d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrUnsupported, o.why))
			return
		}
	}
}

// bitsTraced reads n bits, tracing each new byte the read starts.
func (d *rd) bitsTraced(n uint) uint64 {
	var v uint64
	for i := uint(0); i < n; i++ {
		if d.r.Aligned() {
			d.traceRead("1", 0)
		}
		b := d.bit()
		v <<= 1
		if b {
			v |= 1
		}
	}
	return v
}

func (d *rd) value(w Width) any {
	switch w {
	case WU8:
		return d.u8()
	case WI8:
		return int8(d.u8())
	case WU16:
		return d.u16()
	case WI16:
		return int16(d.u16())
	case WU32:
		return d.u32()
	case WI32:
		return d.i32()
	case WU64:
		return d.u64()
	case WI64:
		return int64(d.u64())
	case WF32:
		return d.f32()
	case WGUID:
		return d.guid()
	}
	d.fail(fmt.Errorf("updateobject: bad width %d", w))
	return nil
}

// valueSource supplies field values to writeLayout by full name (with [i]
// suffixes); nil means zero.
type valueSource func(name string, w Width) any

// mapValues is a valueSource over a map.
func mapValues(m map[string]any) valueSource {
	return func(name string, _ Width) any { return m[name] }
}

// writeLayout is readLayout's inverse. Counts and presence bits come from
// the value source like any other field.
func writeLayout(w *codec.Writer, prog []op, flags uint8, vals valueSource) error {
	// Values are fetched once per name, so a count and its loop agree.
	seen := map[string]any{}
	memo := func(name string, wd Width) any {
		if v, ok := seen[name]; ok {
			return v
		}
		v := vals(name, wd)
		seen[name] = v
		return v
	}
	inBits := false
	return writeOps(w, prog, flags, memo, "", &inBits)
}

func writeOps(w *codec.Writer, prog []op, flags uint8, src valueSource, suffix string, inBits *bool) error {
	get := src
	lookupCount := func(name string) (int, error) {
		fs := fieldSet{}
		fs.add(Field{Name: name, Value: src(name, 0)})
		return fs.count(name)
	}
	for _, o := range prog {
		if endsBitGroup(o) {
			*inBits = false
		}
		switch o.kind {
		case opValue:
			if err := writeValue(w, o.width, get(o.name+suffix, o.width)); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", o.name+suffix, err)
			}
		case opBit, opBits:
			if !*inBits {
				w.FlushBits()
				*inBits = true
			}
			v := get(o.name+suffix, o.width)
			if o.kind == opBit {
				b, _ := v.(bool)
				w.Bit(b)
			} else {
				u, err := toU64(v)
				if err != nil {
					return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", o.name+suffix, err)
				}
				if err := w.Bits(u, uint(o.n)); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		case opWhen:
			if flags&o.mask != 0 {
				if err := writeOps(w, o.body, flags, src, suffix, inBits); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		case opRepeat:
			for i := 0; i < o.n; i++ {
				if err := writeOps(w, o.body, flags, src, idx(suffix, i), inBits); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		case opEach, opOpt:
			n, err := lookupCount(o.ref + suffix)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if o.kind == opOpt {
				if n != 0 {
					if err := writeOps(w, o.body, flags, src, suffix, inBits); err != nil {
						return err
					}
				}
				continue
			}
			for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
				if err := writeOps(w, o.body, flags, src, idx(suffix, i), inBits); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		case opString:
			s, _ := get(o.name+suffix, o.width).(string)
			w.RawBytes([]byte(s))
		case opCString:
			n, err := lookupCount(o.ref + suffix)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			s, _ := get(o.name+suffix, o.width).(string)
			if n >= 2 {
				if len(s)+1 != n {
					return fmt.Errorf("%s: length %d does not fit %q and its NUL", o.name+suffix, n, s)
				}
				w.RawBytes(append([]byte(s), 0))
			}
		case opUnsupported:
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrUnsupported, o.why)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func toU64(v any) (uint64, error) {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case nil:
		return 0, nil
	case uint8:
		return uint64(x), nil
	case int8:
		return uint64(x), nil
	case uint16:
		return uint64(x), nil
	case int16:
		return uint64(x), nil
	case uint32:
		return uint64(x), nil
	case int32:
		return uint64(x), nil
	case uint64:
		return x, nil
	case int64:
		return uint64(x), nil
	case int:
		return uint64(x), nil
	case bool:
		if x {
			return 1, nil
		}
		return 0, nil
	}
	return 0, fmt.Errorf("cannot write %T as an integer", v)
}

func writeValue(w *codec.Writer, wd Width, v any) error {
	switch wd {
	case WF32:
		switch x := v.(type) {
		case nil:
			w.Float32(0)
		case float32:
			w.Float32(x)
		case float64:
			w.Float32(float32(x))
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("cannot write %T as f32", v)
		}
		return nil
	case WGUID:
		switch x := v.(type) {
		case nil:
			w.GUID(GUID{})
		case GUID:
			w.GUID(x)
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("cannot write %T as guid", v)
		}
		return nil
	}
	u, err := toU64(v)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	switch wd {
	case WU8, WI8:
		w.Uint8(uint8(u))
	case WU16, WI16:
		w.Uint16(uint16(u))
	case WU32, WI32:
		w.Uint32(uint32(u))
	case WU64, WI64:
		w.Uint64(u)
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("bad width %v", wd)
	}
	return nil
}

// cat joins layout fragments.
func cat(parts ...[]op) []op {
	var out []op
	for _, p := range parts {
		out = append(out, p...)
	}
	return out
}

```

`protocol/updateobject/layouts.go`:

```go
package updateobject

// Create layouts of the update-field structs, in the client's read order.
//
// Each was checked by running the client's own reader in an emulator
// (tools/ufemu.py) over bytes this package encodes, for every visibility
// flag set and with non-zero counts and set presence bits; the recorded runs
// are in testdata/ufemu/ and replayed by TestLayoutsAgainstClient. The
// in-memory offset each field is stored at is given as +0x…, so a field can
// be named from research/update_fields.json (which keys names by reader
// address) or, where the fork's order and the client's disagree, left as
// Unk_<offset>. Names follow the TrinityCore "forever" fork's UpdateFields.h.

// ObjectData, reader 0x1008ce2b8.
var objectDataCreate = ops(
	i32("EntryID"),      // +0x0
	u32("DynamicFlags"), // +0x4
	f32("Scale"),        // +0x8
)

// visibleItem is VisibleItem (client reader 0x1008e2858), used by UnitData
// (3 virtual items) and PlayerData (19 visible items).
var visibleItem = ops(
	i32("ItemID"),                            // +0x0
	i32("SecondaryItemModifiedAppearanceID"), // +0x4
	i32("ConditionalItemAppearanceID"),       // +0x8
	i32("Unk_0xC"),                           // +0xC
	u16("ItemAppearanceModID"),               // +0x10
	u16("ItemVisual"),                        // +0x12
	u32("ItemModifiedAppearanceID"),          // +0x18
	u8("TransmogSlotOption"),                 // +0x1C
	u8("SheatheCategory"),                    // +0x1D
	bit("HasTransmog"),                       // one byte at +0x14
	bit("HasIllusion"),
)

// UnitData, reader 0x1008e3fa0.
var unitDataCreate = ops(
	i32("DisplayID"),          // +0x0
	u32("NpcFlags"),           // +0x4
	u32("NpcFlags2"),          // +0x8
	u32("StateSpellVisualID"), // +0xC
	u32("StateAnimID"),        // +0x10
	u32("StateAnimKitID"),     // +0x14
	u32("StateWorldEffectIDs.size"),
	u32("StateWorldEffectsQuestObjectiveID"), // +0x30
	i32("SpellOverrideNameID"),               // +0x34
	each("StateWorldEffectIDs.size", u32("StateWorldEffectIDs")),
	guid("Charm"),  // +0x38
	guid("Summon"), // +0x48
	when(FlagOwner, guid("Critter")),
	guid("CharmedBy"),              // +0x68
	guid("SummonedBy"),             // +0x78
	guid("CreatedBy"),              // +0x88
	guid("DemonCreator"),           // +0x98
	guid("LookAtControllerTarget"), // +0xA8
	guid("Target"),                 // +0xB8
	guid("BattlePetCompanionGUID"), // +0xC8
	u64("BattlePetDBID"),           // +0xD8
	guid("BattlePetAttachedToDecorGUID"),
	guid("BattlePetDecorHouseGUID"),
	i32("ChannelData.SpellID"),                         // +0x100
	i32("ChannelData.SpellVisual.SpellXSpellVisualID"), // +0x104
	i32("ChannelData.SpellVisual.ScriptVisualID"),      // +0x108
	u32("ChannelData.StartTimeMs"),                     // +0x10C
	u32("ChannelData.Duration"),                        // +0x110
	i8("SpellEmpowerStage"),                            // +0x114
	u32("SummonedByHomeRealm"),                         // +0x118
	u8("Race"),                                         // +0x11C
	u8("ClassId"),                                      // +0x11D
	u8("PlayerClassId"),                                // +0x11E
	u8("Sex"),                                          // +0x11F
	u8("CreatureType"),                                 // +0x120
	u8("DisplayPower"),                                 // +0x121
	u32("OverrideDisplayPowerID"),                      // +0x124
	i64("Health"),                                      // +0x128
	repeat(10, i32("Power"), i32("MaxPower")),          // +0x3C8, +0x3F0
	when(FlagOwner|FlagUnitAll, repeat(10,
		f32("PowerRegenFlatModifier"),            // +0x418
		f32("PowerRegenInterruptedFlatModifier"), // +0x440
	)),
	i64("MaxHealth"),          // +0x130
	i32("Level"),              // +0x138
	i32("EffectiveLevel"),     // +0x13C
	i32("ContentTuningID"),    // +0x140
	i32("ScalingLevelMin"),    // +0x144
	i32("ScalingLevelMax"),    // +0x148
	i32("ScalingLevelDelta"),  // +0x14C
	u8("ScalingFactionGroup"), // +0x150
	i32("FactionTemplate"),    // +0x154
	repeat(3, prefixed("VirtualItems.", visibleItem)...), // +0x468, 0x20 each
	u32("Flags"),                  // +0x158
	u32("Flags2"),                 // +0x15C
	u32("Flags3"),                 // +0x160
	u32("Flags4"),                 // +0x164
	u32("AuraState"),              // +0x168
	u32("AttackRoundBaseTime[0]"), // +0x4C8
	u32("AttackRoundBaseTime[1]"), // +0x4CC
	when(FlagOwner, u32("RangedAttackRoundBaseTime")), // +0x16C
	f32("BoundingRadius"),                             // +0x170
	f32("CombatReach"),                                // +0x174
	f32("DisplayScale"),                               // +0x178
	i32("CreatureFamily"),                             // +0x17C
	u8("OverrideCreatureType"),                        // +0x180
	i32("NativeDisplayID"),                            // +0x184
	f32("NativeXDisplayScale"),                        // +0x188
	i32("MountDisplayID"),                             // +0x18C
	i32("CosmeticMountDisplayID"),                     // +0x190
```
