`protocol/updateobject/lists70755_test.go`:

```go
package updateobject

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/codec"
)

// Synthetic deltas for the UnitData, GameObjectData and ItemData nested
// parts (delta_lists.go); none occurs in the captures. The client's readers
// run over them in the emulator with the PlayerData ones
// (nested70755_test.go).

// bw is a writer that knows its bit position, to mirror the client's
// choice between whole u32 mask words and 32-bit reads.
type bw struct {
	w    *codec.Writer
	bits int // bits used in the current byte, 0..7
}

func (b *bw) Bits(v uint64, n int) {
	_ = b.w.Bits(v, uint(n))
	b.bits = (b.bits + n) % 8
}
func (b *bw) Bit(v bool) {
	x := uint64(0)
	if v {
		x = 1
	}
	b.Bits(x, 1)
}
func (b *bw) Flush()            { b.w.FlushBits(); b.bits = 0 }
func (b *bw) U8(v uint8)        { b.w.Uint8(v); b.bits = 0 }
func (b *bw) U16(v uint16)      { b.w.Uint16(v); b.bits = 0 }
func (b *bw) U32(v uint32)      { b.w.Uint32(v); b.bits = 0 }
func (b *bw) U64(v uint64)      { b.w.Uint64(v); b.bits = 0 }
func (b *bw) Raw(p []byte)      { b.w.RawBytes(p); b.bits = 0 }
func (b *bw) GUID(g codec.GUID) { b.w.GUID(g); b.bits = 0 }
func (b *bw) aligned() bool     { return b.bits == 0 }

// mask writes l's change mask for bits and their group bits.
func (b *bw) mask(l *deltaLayout, bits []int) {
	n := l.blocks
	if n == 0 {
		n = 1
	}
	m := make(mask, n)
	set := func(x int) { m[x/32] |= 1 << uint(x%32) }
	for _, x := range bits {
		set(x)
		if g, ok := l.groupOf(x); ok {
			set(g)
		}
	}
	if l.blocks == 0 {
		b.Bits(uint64(m[0]), l.plainBits)
		return
	}
	var present uint64
	for k := range m {
		if m[k] != 0 {
			present |= 1 << uint(k)
		}
	}
	b.Bits(present, l.blocks)
	for k := range m {
		if m[k] != 0 {
			b.Bits(uint64(m[k]), 32)
		}
	}
}

// dynMask writes a dynamic list's size and mask (readDynMask's mirror).
func (b *bw) dynMask(n int, changed []int) {
	b.Bits(uint64(n), 32)
	b.dynMaskWords(n, changed)
}

func (b *bw) dynMaskWords(n int, changed []int) {
	words := (n + 31) / 32
	m := make([]uint32, words)
	for _, i := range changed {
		m[i/32] |= 1 << uint(i%32)
	}
	rem, k := n, 0
	if n > 32 && words > 0 {
		aligned := b.aligned()
		for k < words {
			prev := rem
			if aligned {
				b.U32(m[k])
			} else {
				b.Bits(uint64(m[k]), 32)
			}
			k++
			rem = prev - 32
			if prev < 65 {
				break
			}
		}
	}
	if rem != 0 && k < words {
		b.Bits(uint64(m[k]), rem)
	}
}

func (b *bw) visibleItem(c *counter, m uint32) {
	b.Flush()
	b.Bits(uint64(m), 12)
	if m&1 != 0 {
		if m&2 != 0 {
			b.Bit(true)
		}
		if m&4 != 0 {
			b.Bit(true)
		}
	}
	b.Flush()
	if m&1 == 0 {
		return
	}
	for i, n := range []int{4, 4, 4, 4, 2, 2, 4, 1, 1} {
		if m&(1<<uint(i+3)) != 0 {
			b.val(c, n)
		}
	}
}

func (b *bw) val(c *counter, n int) {
	switch n {
	case 1:
		b.U8(uint8(c.next()))
	case 2:
		b.U16(uint16(c.next()))
	case 4:
		b.U32(c.next())
	case 8:
		b.U64(uint64(c.next())<<32 | uint64(c.next()))
	}
}

func build(f func(b *bw)) []byte {
	b := &bw{w: codec.NewWriter()}
	f(b)
	return b.w.Bytes()
}

// unitPrelude writes UnitData's bits after the mask.
func (b *bw) unitPrelude(full bool, f314 *bool, swe []uint32) {
	b.Flush()
	b.Bit(full)
	if f314 != nil {
		b.Bit(*f314)
	}
	if swe != nil {
		b.Bits(uint64(len(swe)), 32)
		for _, v := range swe {
			b.U32(v)
		}
	}
}

func syntheticListDeltas(t *testing.T) []nestedCase {
	var c counter
	ud, gd, id := &unitDataDelta, &gameObjectDataDelta, &itemDataDelta
	yes := true
	cases := []nestedCase{
		{name: "UnitData/synthetic/lists-full-flag", b: build(func(b *bw) {
			b.mask(ud, []int{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 143, 151, 194, 196})
			b.unitPrelude(true, &yes, []uint32{c.next(), c.next(), c.next()})
			b.Flush()
			b.dynMask(40, []int{0, 33, 39}) // aligned: a whole word, then 8 bits
			b.dynMask(5, []int{1, 4})       // unaligned now
			b.dynMask(70, []int{0, 69})     // unaligned: 32-bit words as bits
			for range 3 {
				b.U32(c.next())
				b.U32(c.next())
			}
			b.U32(c.next())
			b.U32(c.next())
			b.GUID(codec.GUID{Lo: uint64(c.next()), Hi: uint64(c.next()) << 32})
			b.GUID(codec.GUID{Lo: 0x1122334455, Hi: 0x0801180000000000})
			b.U32(c.next()) // DisplayID (6)
			b.U32(2)        // bit 143, full map: count, pairs
			for range 2 {
				b.U32(c.next())
				b.U32(c.next())
			}
			b.U8(0x80) // HasAssistActionData
			b.Flush()
			b.Bits(0xf, 4) // Type, VirtualRealmAddress, name
			b.Flush()
			b.U8(uint8(c.next()))
			b.U32(c.next())
			b.U8(3 << 2)
			b.Raw([]byte("Bob"))
			b.visibleItem(&c, 0xfff)
			b.visibleItem(&c, 0x0e9)
		})},
		{name: "UnitData/synthetic/lists-changes", b: build(func(b *bw) {
			b.mask(ud, []int{3, 4, 5, 143, 151, 195})
			b.unitPrelude(false, nil, nil)
			b.Flush()
			b.dynMask(64, []int{31, 32, 63}) // a word, then 32 bits
			b.dynMask(0, nil)
			b.dynMask(33, []int{32})
			for range 3 {
				b.U32(c.next())
				b.U32(c.next())
			}
			b.GUID(codec.GUID{Lo: 7})
			b.U8(0) // map: changes
			b.U16(3)
			for _, st := range []uint8{1, 2, 0} {
				b.U32(c.next())
				b.U8(st)
				if st != MapDeleted {
					b.U32(c.next())
				}
			}
			b.U8(0) // no AssistActionData: bit 151 reads nothing
			b.visibleItem(&c, 0x006)
		})},
		{name: "UnitData/synthetic/assist-name-only", b: build(func(b *bw) {
			b.mask(ud, []int{151})
			b.unitPrelude(false, nil, nil)
			b.U8(0x80)
			b.Flush()
			b.Bits(0x5, 4)
			b.Flush()
			b.U8(0)
		})},
		{name: "GameObjectData/synthetic/lists-assist", b: build(func(b *bw) {
			b.mask(gd, []int{1, 2, 3, 4, 27})
			b.Bits(2, 32) // StateWorldEffectIDs, in the mask's stream
			b.U32(c.next())
			b.U32(c.next())
			b.Flush()
			b.dynMask(3, []int{0, 2})
			b.dynMask(40, []int{39})
			b.U32(c.next())
			b.U32(c.next())
			b.U32(c.next())
			b.U32(c.next()) // DisplayID (4)
			b.U8(0x80)
			b.Flush()
			b.Bits(3, 6)
			b.Bits(5, 11)
			b.Flush()
			b.U32(c.next())
			b.U8(1)
			b.U64(uint64(c.next()))
			b.U32(c.next())
			b.Raw([]byte("Ann"))
			b.Raw([]byte("Wolf\x00"))
		})},
		{name: "GameObjectData/synthetic/no-assist", b: build(func(b *bw) {
			b.mask(gd, []int{1, 27})
			b.Bits(0, 32)
			b.U8(0)
		})},
		{name: "ItemData/synthetic/nested", b: build(func(b *bw) {
			b.mask(id, []int{1, 2, 7, 17, 19, 22, 28, 41})
			b.dynMask(2, []int{0, 1})
			b.dynMask(33, []int{0, 32})
			for range 2 {
				b.U16(uint16(c.next()))
				b.U8(uint8(c.next()))
				b.U8(uint8(c.next()))
			}
			for _, gm := range []uint32{0x7fffffff, 1 | 1<<3 | 1<<19} {
				b.Flush()
				b.Bit(true)
				b.Bits(uint64(gm), 32)
				b.Flush()
				if gm&1 != 0 {
					if gm&2 != 0 {
						b.U32(c.next())
					}
					if gm&4 != 0 {
						b.U8(uint8(c.next()))
					}
				}
				for j := range 16 {
					if gm&8 != 0 && gm&(1<<uint(4+j)) != 0 {
						b.U16(uint16(c.next()))
					}
				}
			}
			b.U32(c.next()) // StackCount (7)
			b.U8(0x80 | 5)  // Modifiers: 5, mask of 5 bits
			b.Flush()
			b.dynMaskWords(5, []int{0, 4})
			for range 2 {
				b.U8(uint8(c.next()))
				b.U32(c.next())
			}
			b.U32(c.next()) // ItemBonusKey: ItemID, 2 bonus lists, 1 modification
			b.U32(2)
			b.U32(1)
			b.U32(c.next())
			b.U32(c.next())
			b.U8(uint8(c.next()))
			b.U32(c.next())
			b.U32(c.next()) // SpellCharges[0] (22)
			b.Flush()
			b.Bits(0x1f, 5) // Enchantment[0]: all
			b.Flush()
			b.U32(c.next())
			b.U32(c.next())
			b.U16(uint16(c.next()))
			b.U16(uint16(c.next()))
			b.Bits(0x11, 5) // Enchantment[13]: Inactive
			b.Flush()
			b.U16(uint16(c.next()))
		})},
		{name: "ItemData/synthetic/quiet", b: build(func(b *bw) {
			b.mask(id, []int{2, 17, 30})
			b.dynMask(1, []int{0})
			b.Flush()
			b.Bit(false) // gem: no mask block
			b.Flush()
			b.U8(0x05) // Modifiers: top bit clear, nothing more
			b.Bits(0x1e, 5)
			b.Flush()
		})},
		{name: "ItemData/synthetic/modifiers-100", b: build(func(b *bw) {
			b.mask(id, []int{17})
			b.U8(0x80 | 100)
			b.Flush()
			b.dynMaskWords(100, []int{0, 50, 99})
			for range 3 {
				b.U8(uint8(c.next()))
				b.U32(c.next())
			}
		})},
	}
	return cases
}

// TestListDeltasDecode checks decoded values of the synthetic cases (their
// reads are checked against the client in TestNestedAgainstClient).
func TestListDeltasDecode(t *testing.T) {
	byName := map[string][]byte{}
	for _, c := range syntheticListDeltas(t) {
		byName[c.name] = c.b
	}
	dec := func(name string, l *deltaLayout) map[string]any {
		d := &rd{r: codec.NewReader(byName[name])}
		fs := d.readDelta(l, nil)
		if d.err != nil || d.r.Remaining() != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v, %d left", name, d.err, d.r.Remaining())
		}
		return fieldMap(fs)
	}
	u := dec("UnitData/synthetic/lists-full-flag", &unitDataDelta)
	if u["AssistActionData.PlayerName"] != "Bob" || u["StateWorldEffectIDs.size"] != uint32(3) ||
		u["ChannelObjects[69]"] != (GUID{Lo: 0x1122334455, Hi: 0x0801180000000000}) || u["Unk_0x368.size"] != uint32(2) {
		t.Errorf("unit: %v", u)
	}
	g := dec("GameObjectData/synthetic/lists-assist", &gameObjectDataDelta)
	if g["AssistActionData.PlayerName"] != "Ann" || g["AssistActionData.MonsterName"] != "Wolf" || g["WorldEffects.size"] != uint32(40) {
		t.Errorf("game object: %v", g)
	}
	d := &rd{r: codec.NewReader(byName["ItemData/synthetic/nested"])}
	fs := d.readDelta(&itemDataDelta, nil)
	if d.err != nil {
		t.Fatal(d.err)
	}
	it := &ItemData{}
	it.ApplyTo(fs)
	if e := it.Enchantments[0]; e.ID == 0 || e.Duration == 0 || e.Charges == 0 || e.Inactive == 0 {
		t.Errorf("enchantment 0: %+v", e)
	}
	if e := it.Enchantments[13]; e.ID != 0 || e.Inactive == 0 {
		t.Errorf("enchantment 13: %+v", e)
	}
	i := fieldMap(fs)
	if i["ItemBonusKey.BonusListIDs.size"] != uint32(2) || i["Modifiers.size"] != uint64(5) || i["Gems.BonusListIDs[32][15]"] == nil {
		t.Errorf("item: %v", i)
	}
}
```

`protocol/updateobject/livemove.go`:

```go
package updateobject

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/codec"
)

// MonsterMove is SMSG_ON_MONSTER_MOVE: a unit starts (or stops) a spline.
// Layout from the fork's MonsterMove::Write / MovementSpline (checked
// against retail 12.1.5 captures: every message consumes exactly).
type MonsterMove struct {
	Mover    GUID
	SplineID uint32
	Flags    uint32
	Face     uint8
	Elapsed  int32
	MoveTime uint32 // ms for the whole path
	// Points are the path's full points. In the packed mode (most ground
	// moves) this is just the destination; the middle points are deltas.
	Points []Vec3
	// Start is where the unit is when the spline begins.
	Start Vec3
}

// Dest is where the move ends: the last point, or Start when it is a stop.
func (m *MonsterMove) Dest() Vec3 {
	if len(m.Points) == 0 {
		return m.Start
	}
	return m.Points[len(m.Points)-1]
}

// DecodeMonsterMove reads an SMSG_ON_MONSTER_MOVE body.
func DecodeMonsterMove(b []byte) (*MonsterMove, error) {
	d := &rd{r: codec.NewReader(b)}
	m := &MonsterMove{Mover: d.guid()}
	m.SplineID = d.u32()
	m.Flags = d.u32()
	m.Face = d.u8()
	m.Elapsed = d.i32()
	m.MoveTime = d.u32()
	_ = d.u32()  // FadeObjectTime
	_ = d.u8()   // Mode
	_ = d.guid() // TransportGUID
	_ = d.u8()   // VehicleSeat
	switch m.Face {
	case 1: // FACING_SPOT
		d.vec3()
	case 2: // FACING_TARGET
		d.f32()
		d.guid()
	case 3: // FACING_ANGLE
		d.f32()
	}
	d.group()
	nPoints := int(d.bits(16))
	d.bit() // VehicleExitVoluntary
	d.bit() // TaxiSmoothing
	nPacked := int(d.bits(16))
	hasFilter, hasSpellFx, hasJump, hasTurn, hasAnimTier, hasVisual := d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit()
	if d.err != nil {
		return nil, d.err
	}
	if nPoints*12+nPacked*4 > d.r.Remaining() {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %d points, %d packed, %d bytes", ErrMalformed, nPoints, nPacked, d.r.Remaining())
	}
	m.Points = make([]Vec3, nPoints)
	for i := range m.Points {
		m.Points[i] = d.vec3()
	}
	for i := 0; i < nPacked; i++ {
		d.u32()
	}
	if hasFilter {
		d.group()
		n := d.u32()
		d.f32() // BaseSpeed
		d.u16() // StartOffset
		d.f32() // DistToPrevFilterKey
		d.u16() // AddedToStart
		for i := 0; i < d.count(n, 4); i++ {
			d.u16()
			d.u16()
		}
		d.group()
		d.bits(2) // FilterFlags
	}
	if hasSpellFx {
		d.guid()
		d.u32()
		d.u32()
		d.u32()
	}
	if hasJump {
		d.f32()
		d.u32()
		d.u32()
	}
	if hasTurn {
		d.f32()
		d.f32()
		d.f32()
	}
	if hasAnimTier {
		d.i32()
		d.u8()
		d.u32()
		d.u32()
	}
	_ = hasVisual // trailing, not needed: Start is read from the end
	if d.err != nil {
		return nil, d.err
	}
	// Pos is the last 12 bytes (the fork writes it after the spline and
	// the two/three trailing bits flushed into one byte before it).
	if len(b) < 12 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: short", ErrMalformed)
	}
	t := &rd{r: codec.NewReader(b[len(b)-12:])}
	m.Start = t.vec3()
	return m, nil
}

// DecodeMoveUpdate reads an SMSG_MOVE_UPDATE body (one MovementInfo: the
// mover's GUID, position and facing).
func DecodeMoveUpdate(b []byte) (*MovementInfo, error) {
	d := &rd{r: codec.NewReader(b)}
	m := d.movementInfo()
	if d.err != nil {
		return nil, d.err
	}
	return &m, nil
}
```

`protocol/updateobject/movement.go`:

```go
// Package updateobject decodes SMSG_UPDATE_OBJECT (0x5E0000) for build
// 1.60.1.70707.
//
// Every layout here was read off the client's own decoders (addresses in the
// comments, write-up in docs/EVIDENCE.md E21). Field names follow the
// TrinityCore "forever" fork where the two agree; where they differ the client
// wins and the difference is noted. Anything the client can send but we have
// not decoded returns ErrUnsupported instead of a guess.
package updateobject

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"math"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/codec"
)

// ErrUnsupported marks a valid but not yet decoded part of the message.
var ErrUnsupported = errors.New("updateobject: unsupported")

// GUID is the client's 128-bit object GUID.
type GUID = codec.GUID

// Vec3 is a position or direction.
type Vec3 struct{ X, Y, Z float32 }

// Pos4 is a position with facing.
type Pos4 struct{ X, Y, Z, O float32 }

// CreateMovement is the movement block of a create-object block: 21 flag bits,
// a pause-time count and then the optional sections in flag order (client
// 0x10085e31c). A nil pointer means the flag was clear.
type CreateMovement struct {
	HasEntityPosition bool
	NoBirthAnim       bool
	EnablePortals     bool
	PlayHoverAnim     bool
	ThisIsYou         bool

	Movement     *MovementUpdate // MovementUpdate: units
	Transport    *TransportInfo  // MovementTransport
	Stationary   *Pos4
	CombatVictim *GUID
	ServerTime   *uint32
	Vehicle      *VehicleCreate
	AnimKit      *AnimKitCreate
	Rotation     *uint64 // packed local rotation
	GameObject   *GameObjectCreate
	SmoothPhase  *SmoothPhasing
	SceneObject  *SceneObjectCreate
	ActivePlayer *ActivePlayerCreate
	Conversation *ConversationCreate
	Room         *GUID // housing room (client only; the fork never sets it)
	Decor        *GUID // housing decor (client only)
	MeshObject   *MeshObjectCreate
	PauseTimes   []uint32 // game objects
}

// MovementUpdate is a unit's movement state (client 0x1008597e8).
type MovementUpdate struct {
	Info           MovementInfo
	Speeds         [9]float32 // walk, run, run back, swim, swim back, flight, flight back, turn rate, pitch rate
	ForcesModMag   float32    // MovementForcesModMagnitude
	AdvFlying      [17]float32
	MovementForces []MovementForce
	Spline         *CreateSpline
}

// Speed names in MovementUpdate.Speeds order.
var SpeedNames = [9]string{"walk", "run", "run_back", "swim", "swim_back", "flight", "flight_back", "turn_rate", "pitch_rate"}

// MovementInfo is the common movement status (client 0x1008572ec), also used
// by the CMSG move messages.
type MovementInfo struct {
	Mover                GUID
	Flags                uint64
	MoveTime             uint32
	Position             Pos4
	Pitch                float32
	StepUpStartElevation float32
	MoveIndex            uint32
	GravityModifier      float32
	RemoveForcesIDs      []GUID
	HeightChangeFailed   bool
	RemoteTimeValid      bool
	HasSpline            bool // the unit follows a spline (data in MovementUpdate.Spline)
	StandingOnGameObject *GUID
	Transport            *TransportInfo
	Fall                 *FallInfo
	Inertia              *Inertia
	AdvFlying            *AdvFlyingState
	DriveStatus          *DriveStatus
}

// TransportInfo places an object on a transport (client 0x100856c74).
type TransportInfo struct {
	GUID         GUID
	Offset       Pos4
	Seat         int8
	MoveTime     uint32
	PrevMoveTime *uint32
	VehicleRecID *int32
}

// FallInfo is jump/fall state (client 0x100857114).
type FallInfo struct {
	Time         uint32
	JumpVelocity float32
	Direction    *FallDirection
}

// FallDirection is the horizontal part of a jump.
type FallDirection struct{ Sin, Cos, Speed float32 }

// Inertia is an inertial force on the mover.
type Inertia struct {
	ID       int32
	Force    Vec3
	Lifetime uint32
}

// AdvFlyingState is dragonriding-style flight velocity.
type AdvFlyingState struct{ ForwardVelocity, UpVelocity float32 }

// DriveStatus is vehicle drive state.
type DriveStatus struct {
	Speed, MovementAngle   float32
	Accelerating, Drifting bool
}

// MovementForce is one movement force (client 0x10085942c).
type MovementForce struct {
	ID              GUID
	Origin          Vec3
	Direction       Vec3
	TransportID     uint32
	Magnitude       float32
	MovementForceID int32
	DurationMs      int32
	EndTimestamp    uint32
	Flags           uint32
	Type            uint8 // 2 bits
}

// CreateSpline is the spline block of a create (client 0x1008589bc).
type CreateSpline struct {
	ID          uint32
	Destination Vec3
	Move        *SplineMove
}

// SplineMove is an active spline (client 0x100858054).
type SplineMove struct {
	Flags                uint32
	Face                 uint8 // 1 spot, 2 target, 3 angle
	Elapsed              int32
	Duration             uint32
	DurationModifier     float32
	NextDurationModifier float32
	FaceSpot             Vec3
	FaceGUID             GUID
	FaceDirection        float32
	FadeObjectTime       *uint32
	Points               []Vec3
	Filter               *SplineFilter
	SpellEffect          *SplineSpellEffect
	Jump                 *SplineJump
	Turn                 *SplineTurn
	AnimTier             *SplineAnimTier
	SpellVisual          *[16]SplineSpellVisualNode
}

// SplineFilter is the 70707 filter: count, count x (f, f), 2 flag bits
// (client 0x100857ed8; the fork's MonsterSplineFilter is a different shape).
type SplineFilter struct {
	Keys  [][2]float32
	Flags uint8
}

// SplineSpellEffect is spell-driven spline data.
type SplineSpellEffect struct {
	Target                                           GUID
	SpellVisualID, ProgressCurveID, ParabolicCurveID uint32
	JumpGravity                                      float32
}

// SplineJump is parabolic spline data.
type SplineJump struct {
	JumpGravity         float32
	StartTime, Duration uint32
}

// SplineTurn is turning spline data.
type SplineTurn struct{ StartFacing, TotalTurnRads, RadsPerSec float32 }

// SplineAnimTier is an anim-tier transition.
type SplineAnimTier struct {
	TierTransitionID         int32
	AnimTier                 uint8
	StartTime, ExtraDuration uint32
}

// SplineSpellVisualNode is one of 16 spell-visual nodes.
type SplineSpellVisualNode struct {
	SpellID                             int32
	SpellXSpellVisualID, ScriptVisualID uint32
	StartNodeIndex                      uint32
}

// VehicleCreate is the vehicle section.
type VehicleCreate struct {
	RecID            int32
	InitialRawFacing float32
}

// AnimKitCreate is the anim-kit section.
type AnimKitCreate struct{ AI, Movement, Melee uint16 }

// GameObjectCreate is the game-object section (client 0x10085db54). The client
// reads Unknown before the transport part; the fork writes it after, but the
// fork never sets it.
type GameObjectCreate struct {
	WorldEffectID uint32
	Unknown       *uint32
	Transport     *GameObjectTransport
	PathProgress  *float32
}

// GameObjectTransport is a moving transport's timing.
type GameObjectTransport struct {
	TimeOffset, NextStopTimestamp uint32
	HasNextStop, Stopped, Bit3    bool
}

// SmoothPhasing replaces one object with another across a phase change.
type SmoothPhasing struct {
	ReplaceActive, StopAnimKits bool
	ReplaceObject               *GUID
}

// SceneObjectCreate is the scene-object section (client 0x10085df28).
type SceneObjectCreate struct {
	LocalScriptData *string // 7-bit length
}

// ActivePlayerCreate is the active-player section (client 0x10085e020).
type ActivePlayerCreate struct {
	SceneInstanceIDs []uint32 // nil: absent
	Runes            *RuneState
}

// RuneState is death-knight rune state.
type RuneState struct {
	Start, Count uint8
	Cooldowns    []uint8
}

// ConversationCreate is the conversation section.
type ConversationCreate struct{ TextureKitID *uint32 }

// MeshObjectCreate is the mesh-object section (client 0x10085e210). Field
// meanings are unknown; widths are observed.
type MeshObjectCreate struct {
	GUID   GUID
	Floats [8]float32
	Byte   uint8
}

// rd wraps a codec.Reader and keeps the first error, so decoders read
// straight through and check once.
type rd struct {
	r      *codec.Reader
	err    error
	trace  *[]traceEnt // TestLayoutsAgainstClient only
	inBits bool        // inside a run of bit fields (layout.go)
	// fullNested is PlayerData's flag after its change mask (0x1008d4e40
	// keeps it at [sp+0x38]): set, the quest log entries and the
	// QuestLogQuestIdToIndex map come as full values, not nested deltas.
	fullNested bool
}

func (d *rd) fail(err error) {
	if d.err == nil {
		d.err = err
	}
}

// group starts a new flag group. Every group starts on a byte boundary: the
// client reads each one as a whole byte (u8 getter, then lsr/ubfx), and the
// fork's writer flushes after each.
func (d *rd) group() { d.r.ResetBits() }

func (d *rd) bit() bool {
	if d.err != nil {
		return false
	}
	v, err := d.r.Bit()
	d.fail(err)
	return v
}
func (d *rd) bits(n uint) uint64 {
	if d.err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	v, err := d.r.Bits(n)
	d.fail(err)
	return v
}
func (d *rd) u8() uint8 {
	if d.err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	v, err := d.r.Uint8()
	d.fail(err)
	return v
}
func (d *rd) u16() uint16 {
	if d.err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	v, err := d.r.Uint16()
	d.fail(err)
	return v
}
func (d *rd) u32() uint32 {
	if d.err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	v, err := d.r.Uint32()
	d.fail(err)
	return v
}
func (d *rd) i32() int32 { return int32(d.u32()) }
func (d *rd) u64() uint64 {
	if d.err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	v, err := d.r.Uint64()
	d.fail(err)
	return v
}
func (d *rd) f32() float32 {
	if d.err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	v, err := d.r.Float32()
	d.fail(err)
	return v
}
func (d *rd) guid() GUID {
	if d.err != nil {
		return GUID{}
	}
	v, err := d.r.GUID()
	d.fail(err)
	return v
}
func (d *rd) vec3() Vec3 { return Vec3{d.f32(), d.f32(), d.f32()} }
func (d *rd) pos4() Pos4 { return Pos4{d.f32(), d.f32(), d.f32(), d.f32()} }

// count guards a length prefix against the bytes left (each element at least
// min bytes) so corrupt input cannot allocate unbounded memory.
func (d *rd) count(n uint32, min int) int {
	if d.err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	if min > 0 && int64(n)*int64(min) > int64(d.r.Remaining()) {
		d.fail(fmt.Errorf("updateobject: count %d exceeds remaining %d bytes: %w", n, d.r.Remaining(), codec.ErrUnderflow))
		return 0
	}
	return int(n)
}

func ptr[T any](v T) *T { return &v }

// DecodeCreateMovement reads a create block's movement section.
func DecodeCreateMovement(r *codec.Reader) (*CreateMovement, error) {
	d := &rd{r: r}
	m := d.createMovement()
	if d.err != nil {
		return nil, d.err
	}
	return m, nil
}

func (d *rd) createMovement() *CreateMovement {
	m := &CreateMovement{}
	d.group()
	m.HasEntityPosition = d.bit()
	m.NoBirthAnim = d.bit()
	m.EnablePortals = d.bit()
	m.PlayHoverAnim = d.bit()
	m.ThisIsYou = d.bit()
	hasMove, hasTransport, hasStationary := d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit()
	hasVictim, hasServerTime, hasVehicle, hasAnimKit := d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit()
	hasRotation, hasGO, hasSmooth, hasScene := d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit()
	hasActive, hasConv, hasRoom, hasDecor, hasMesh := d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit()
	nPause := d.u32()

	if hasMove {
		m.Movement = d.movementUpdate()
	}
	if hasTransport {
		m.Transport = d.transport()
	}
	if hasStationary {
		m.Stationary = ptr(d.pos4())
	}
	if hasVictim {
		m.CombatVictim = ptr(d.guid())
	}
	if hasServerTime {
		m.ServerTime = ptr(d.u32())
	}
	if hasVehicle {
		m.Vehicle = &VehicleCreate{RecID: d.i32(), InitialRawFacing: d.f32()}
	}
	if hasAnimKit {
		m.AnimKit = &AnimKitCreate{AI: d.u16(), Movement: d.u16(), Melee: d.u16()}
	}
	if hasRotation {
		m.Rotation = ptr(d.u64())
	}
	if hasGO {
		g := &GameObjectCreate{WorldEffectID: d.u32()}
		d.group()
		hasUnk, isTransport, hasPath := d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit()
		if hasUnk {
			g.Unknown = ptr(d.u32())
		}
		if isTransport {
			t := &GameObjectTransport{TimeOffset: d.u32(), NextStopTimestamp: d.u32()}
			d.group()
			t.HasNextStop, t.Stopped, t.Bit3 = d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit()
			g.Transport = t
		}
		if hasPath {
			g.PathProgress = ptr(d.f32())
		}
		m.GameObject = g
	}
	if hasSmooth {
		d.group()
		s := &SmoothPhasing{ReplaceActive: d.bit(), StopAnimKits: d.bit()}
		if d.bit() {
			s.ReplaceObject = ptr(d.guid())
		}
		m.SmoothPhase = s
	}
	if hasScene {
		s := &SceneObjectCreate{}
		d.group()
		hasScript, hasPetBattle := d.bit(), d.bit()
		if hasScript {
			d.group()
			n := int(d.bits(7))
			if b, err := d.r.Bytes(n); err != nil {
				d.fail(err)
			} else {
				s.LocalScriptData = ptr(string(b))
			}
		}
		if hasPetBattle {
			d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: scene object pet battle full update (client 0x1008611b0)", ErrUnsupported))
		}
		m.SceneObject = s
	}
	if hasActive {
		a := &ActivePlayerCreate{}
		d.group()
		hasScenes, hasRunes := d.bit(), d.bit()
		if hasScenes {
			n := d.count(d.u32(), 4)
			a.SceneInstanceIDs = make([]uint32, n)
			for i := range a.SceneInstanceIDs {
				a.SceneInstanceIDs[i] = d.u32()
			}
		}
		if hasRunes {
			rs := &RuneState{Start: d.u8(), Count: d.u8()}
			rs.Cooldowns = make([]uint8, d.count(d.u32(), 1))
			for i := range rs.Cooldowns {
				rs.Cooldowns[i] = d.u8()
			}
			a.Runes = rs
		}
		m.ActivePlayer = a
	}
	if hasConv {
		c := &ConversationCreate{}
		d.group()
		if d.bit() {
			c.TextureKitID = ptr(d.u32())
		}
		m.Conversation = c
	}
	if hasRoom {
		m.Room = ptr(d.guid())
	}
	if hasDecor {
		m.Decor = ptr(d.guid())
	}
	if hasMesh {
		me := &MeshObjectCreate{GUID: d.guid()}
		for i := range me.Floats {
			me.Floats[i] = d.f32()
		}
		me.Byte = d.u8()
		m.MeshObject = me
	}
	if n := d.count(nPause, 4); n > 0 {
		m.PauseTimes = make([]uint32, n)
		for i := range m.PauseTimes {
			m.PauseTimes[i] = d.u32()
		}
	}
	return m
}

func (d *rd) movementUpdate() *MovementUpdate {
	u := &MovementUpdate{Info: d.movementInfo()}
	for i := range u.Speeds {
		u.Speeds[i] = d.f32()
	}
	nForces := d.u32()
	u.ForcesModMag = d.f32()
	for i := range u.AdvFlying {
		u.AdvFlying[i] = d.f32()
	}
	if n := d.count(nForces, 50); n > 0 {
		u.MovementForces = make([]MovementForce, n)
		for i := range u.MovementForces {
			f := &u.MovementForces[i]
			f.ID = d.guid()
			f.Origin = d.vec3()
			f.Direction = d.vec3()
			f.TransportID = d.u32()
			f.Magnitude = d.f32()
			f.MovementForceID = d.i32()
			f.DurationMs = d.i32()
			f.EndTimestamp = d.u32()
			f.Flags = d.u32()
			d.group()
			f.Type = uint8(d.bits(2))
		}
	}
	d.group()
	if d.bit() {
		u.Spline = d.createSpline()
	}
	return u
}

func (d *rd) movementInfo() MovementInfo {
	var m MovementInfo
	m.Mover = d.guid()
	m.Flags = d.u64()
	m.MoveTime = d.u32()
	m.Position = d.pos4()
	m.Pitch = d.f32()
	m.StepUpStartElevation = d.f32()
	nRemove := d.u32()
	m.MoveIndex = d.u32()
	m.GravityModifier = d.f32()
	if n := d.count(nRemove, 2); n > 0 {
		m.RemoveForcesIDs = make([]GUID, n)
		for i := range m.RemoveForcesIDs {
			m.RemoveForcesIDs[i] = d.guid()
		}
	}
	d.group()
	hasStanding, hasTransport, hasFall := d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit()
	m.HasSpline = d.bit()
	m.HeightChangeFailed = d.bit()
	m.RemoteTimeValid = d.bit()
	hasInertia, hasAdv, hasDrive := d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit()
	if hasStanding {
		m.StandingOnGameObject = ptr(d.guid())
	}
	if hasTransport {
		m.Transport = d.transport()
	}
	if hasFall {
		f := &FallInfo{Time: d.u32(), JumpVelocity: d.f32()}
		d.group()
		if d.bit() {
			f.Direction = &FallDirection{Sin: d.f32(), Cos: d.f32(), Speed: d.f32()}
		}
		m.Fall = f
	}
	if hasInertia {
		m.Inertia = &Inertia{ID: d.i32(), Force: d.vec3(), Lifetime: d.u32()}
	}
	if hasAdv {
		m.AdvFlying = &AdvFlyingState{ForwardVelocity: d.f32(), UpVelocity: d.f32()}
	}
	if hasDrive {
		ds := &DriveStatus{Speed: d.f32(), MovementAngle: d.f32()}
		d.group()
		ds.Accelerating, ds.Drifting = d.bit(), d.bit()
		m.DriveStatus = ds
	}
	return m
}

func (d *rd) transport() *TransportInfo {
	t := &TransportInfo{GUID: d.guid(), Offset: d.pos4(), Seat: int8(d.u8()), MoveTime: d.u32()}
	d.group()
	hasPrev, hasVehicle := d.bit(), d.bit()
	if hasPrev {
		t.PrevMoveTime = ptr(d.u32())
	}
	if hasVehicle {
		t.VehicleRecID = ptr(d.i32())
	}
	return t
}

func (d *rd) createSpline() *CreateSpline {
	s := &CreateSpline{ID: d.u32(), Destination: d.vec3()}
	d.group()
	if !d.bit() {
		return s
	}
	m := &SplineMove{}
	m.Flags = d.u32()
	m.Face = d.u8()
	m.Elapsed = d.i32()
	m.Duration = d.u32()
	m.DurationModifier = d.f32()
	m.NextDurationModifier = d.f32()
	switch m.Face {
	case 1:
		m.FaceSpot = d.vec3()
	case 2:
		m.FaceGUID = d.guid()
	case 3:
		m.FaceDirection = d.f32()
	}
	d.group()
	hasFade := d.bit()
	nPoints := uint32(d.bits(16))
	hasFilter, hasSpell, hasJump, hasTurn, hasAnim, hasVisual := d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit(), d.bit()
	if hasFade {
		m.FadeObjectTime = ptr(d.u32())
	}
	if n := d.count(nPoints, 12); n > 0 {
		m.Points = make([]Vec3, n)
		for i := range m.Points {
			m.Points[i] = d.vec3()
		}
	}
	if hasFilter {
		f := &SplineFilter{}
		f.Keys = make([][2]float32, d.count(d.u32(), 8))
		for i := range f.Keys {
			f.Keys[i] = [2]float32{d.f32(), d.f32()}
		}
		d.group()
		f.Flags = uint8(d.bits(2))
		m.Filter = f
	}
	if hasSpell {
		m.SpellEffect = &SplineSpellEffect{Target: d.guid(), SpellVisualID: d.u32(), ProgressCurveID: d.u32(),
			ParabolicCurveID: d.u32(), JumpGravity: d.f32()}
	}
	if hasJump {
		m.Jump = &SplineJump{JumpGravity: d.f32(), StartTime: d.u32(), Duration: d.u32()}
	}
	if hasTurn {
		m.Turn = &SplineTurn{StartFacing: d.f32(), TotalTurnRads: d.f32(), RadsPerSec: d.f32()}
	}
	if hasAnim {
		m.AnimTier = &SplineAnimTier{TierTransitionID: d.i32(), AnimTier: d.u8(), StartTime: d.u32(), ExtraDuration: d.u32()}
	}
	if hasVisual {
		var v [16]SplineSpellVisualNode
		for i := range v {
			v[i] = SplineSpellVisualNode{SpellID: d.i32(), SpellXSpellVisualID: d.u32(), ScriptVisualID: d.u32(), StartNodeIndex: d.u32()}
		}
		m.SpellVisual = &v
	}
	s.Move = m
	return s
}

// Quat is a rotation quaternion.
type Quat struct{ X, Y, Z, W float32 }

// UnpackRotation decodes the create block's packed local rotation (flag
// Rotation, a u64): x in the top 22 bits, y in the next 21, z in the low 21,
// each signed and scaled by 2^21 (x) or 2^20 (y, z); w is non-negative and
// follows from |q| = 1. This is the fork's GameObject::UpdatePackedRotation
// inverted [public].
func UnpackRotation(p uint64) Quat {
	v := int64(p)
	x := float64(v>>42) / (1 << 21)
	y := float64(v<<22>>43) / (1 << 20)
	z := float64(v<<43>>43) / (1 << 20)
	w2 := 1 - (x*x + y*y + z*z)
	var w float64
	if w2 > 0 {
		w = math.Sqrt(w2)
	}
	return Quat{X: float32(x), Y: float32(y), Z: float32(z), W: float32(w)}
}

```

`protocol/updateobject/movement_encode.go`:

```go
package updateobject

import "github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/codec"

// Each flag group below starts with w.FlushBits(): groups are byte aligned
// (see rd.group).

// EncodeCreateMovement writes m in the layout DecodeCreateMovement reads. It
// exists to build fixtures; presence flags are derived from nil pointers.
func EncodeCreateMovement(w *codec.Writer, m *CreateMovement) {
	w.FlushBits()
	for _, b := range []bool{
		m.HasEntityPosition, m.NoBirthAnim, m.EnablePortals, m.PlayHoverAnim, m.ThisIsYou,
		m.Movement != nil, m.Transport != nil, m.Stationary != nil,
		m.CombatVictim != nil, m.ServerTime != nil, m.Vehicle != nil, m.AnimKit != nil,
		m.Rotation != nil, m.GameObject != nil, m.SmoothPhase != nil, m.SceneObject != nil,
		m.ActivePlayer != nil, m.Conversation != nil, m.Room != nil, m.Decor != nil, m.MeshObject != nil,
	} {
		w.Bit(b)
	}
	w.Uint32(uint32(len(m.PauseTimes)))
	if m.Movement != nil {
		encMovementUpdate(w, m.Movement)
	}
	if m.Transport != nil {
		encTransport(w, m.Transport)
	}
	if p := m.Stationary; p != nil {
		encPos4(w, *p)
	}
	if m.CombatVictim != nil {
		w.GUID(*m.CombatVictim)
	}
	if m.ServerTime != nil {
		w.Uint32(*m.ServerTime)
	}
	if v := m.Vehicle; v != nil {
		w.Int32(v.RecID)
		w.Float32(v.InitialRawFacing)
	}
	if a := m.AnimKit; a != nil {
		w.Uint16(a.AI)
		w.Uint16(a.Movement)
		w.Uint16(a.Melee)
	}
	if m.Rotation != nil {
		w.Uint64(*m.Rotation)
	}
	if g := m.GameObject; g != nil {
		w.Uint32(g.WorldEffectID)
		w.FlushBits()
		w.Bit(g.Unknown != nil)
		w.Bit(g.Transport != nil)
		w.Bit(g.PathProgress != nil)
		if g.Unknown != nil {
			w.Uint32(*g.Unknown)
		}
		if t := g.Transport; t != nil {
			w.Uint32(t.TimeOffset)
			w.Uint32(t.NextStopTimestamp)
			w.FlushBits()
			w.Bit(t.HasNextStop)
			w.Bit(t.Stopped)
			w.Bit(t.Bit3)
		}
		if g.PathProgress != nil {
			w.Float32(*g.PathProgress)
		}
	}
	if s := m.SmoothPhase; s != nil {
		w.FlushBits()
		w.Bit(s.ReplaceActive)
		w.Bit(s.StopAnimKits)
		w.Bit(s.ReplaceObject != nil)
		if s.ReplaceObject != nil {
			w.GUID(*s.ReplaceObject)
		}
	}
	if s := m.SceneObject; s != nil {
		w.FlushBits()
		w.Bit(s.LocalScriptData != nil)
		w.Bit(false) // pet battle full update: not supported
		if s.LocalScriptData != nil {
			w.FlushBits()
			_ = w.Bits(uint64(len(*s.LocalScriptData)), 7)
			w.RawBytes([]byte(*s.LocalScriptData))
		}
	}
	if a := m.ActivePlayer; a != nil {
		w.FlushBits()
		w.Bit(a.SceneInstanceIDs != nil)
		w.Bit(a.Runes != nil)
		if a.SceneInstanceIDs != nil {
			w.Uint32(uint32(len(a.SceneInstanceIDs)))
			for _, id := range a.SceneInstanceIDs {
				w.Uint32(id)
			}
		}
		if r := a.Runes; r != nil {
			w.Uint8(r.Start)
			w.Uint8(r.Count)
			w.Uint32(uint32(len(r.Cooldowns)))
			for _, c := range r.Cooldowns {
				w.Uint8(c)
			}
		}
	}
	if c := m.Conversation; c != nil {
		w.FlushBits()
		w.Bit(c.TextureKitID != nil)
		if c.TextureKitID != nil {
			w.Uint32(*c.TextureKitID)
		}
	}
	if m.Room != nil {
		w.GUID(*m.Room)
	}
	if m.Decor != nil {
		w.GUID(*m.Decor)
	}
	if me := m.MeshObject; me != nil {
		w.GUID(me.GUID)
		for _, f := range me.Floats {
			w.Float32(f)
		}
		w.Uint8(me.Byte)
	}
	for _, p := range m.PauseTimes {
		w.Uint32(p)
	}
	w.FlushBits()
}

func encVec3(w *codec.Writer, v Vec3) {
	w.Float32(v.X)
	w.Float32(v.Y)
	w.Float32(v.Z)
}

func encPos4(w *codec.Writer, p Pos4) {
	w.Float32(p.X)
	w.Float32(p.Y)
	w.Float32(p.Z)
	w.Float32(p.O)
}

func encMovementUpdate(w *codec.Writer, u *MovementUpdate) {
	encMovementInfo(w, &u.Info)
	for _, s := range u.Speeds {
		w.Float32(s)
	}
	w.Uint32(uint32(len(u.MovementForces)))
	w.Float32(u.ForcesModMag)
	for _, f := range u.AdvFlying {
		w.Float32(f)
	}
	for _, f := range u.MovementForces {
		w.GUID(f.ID)
		encVec3(w, f.Origin)
		encVec3(w, f.Direction)
		w.Uint32(f.TransportID)
		w.Float32(f.Magnitude)
		w.Int32(f.MovementForceID)
		w.Int32(f.DurationMs)
		w.Uint32(f.EndTimestamp)
		w.Uint32(f.Flags)
		w.FlushBits()
		_ = w.Bits(uint64(f.Type), 2)
	}
	w.FlushBits()
	w.Bit(u.Spline != nil)
	if u.Spline != nil {
		encCreateSpline(w, u.Spline)
	}
}

func encMovementInfo(w *codec.Writer, m *MovementInfo) {
	w.GUID(m.Mover)
	w.Uint64(m.Flags)
	w.Uint32(m.MoveTime)
	encPos4(w, m.Position)
	w.Float32(m.Pitch)
	w.Float32(m.StepUpStartElevation)
	w.Uint32(uint32(len(m.RemoveForcesIDs)))
	w.Uint32(m.MoveIndex)
	w.Float32(m.GravityModifier)
	for _, g := range m.RemoveForcesIDs {
		w.GUID(g)
	}
	w.FlushBits()
	w.Bit(m.StandingOnGameObject != nil)
	w.Bit(m.Transport != nil)
	w.Bit(m.Fall != nil)
	w.Bit(m.HasSpline)
	w.Bit(m.HeightChangeFailed)
	w.Bit(m.RemoteTimeValid)
	w.Bit(m.Inertia != nil)
	w.Bit(m.AdvFlying != nil)
	w.Bit(m.DriveStatus != nil)
	if m.StandingOnGameObject != nil {
		w.GUID(*m.StandingOnGameObject)
	}
	if m.Transport != nil {
		encTransport(w, m.Transport)
	}
	if f := m.Fall; f != nil {
		w.Uint32(f.Time)
		w.Float32(f.JumpVelocity)
		w.FlushBits()
		w.Bit(f.Direction != nil)
		if f.Direction != nil {
			w.Float32(f.Direction.Sin)
			w.Float32(f.Direction.Cos)
			w.Float32(f.Direction.Speed)
		}
	}
	if in := m.Inertia; in != nil {
		w.Int32(in.ID)
		encVec3(w, in.Force)
		w.Uint32(in.Lifetime)
	}
	if a := m.AdvFlying; a != nil {
		w.Float32(a.ForwardVelocity)
		w.Float32(a.UpVelocity)
	}
	if ds := m.DriveStatus; ds != nil {
		w.Float32(ds.Speed)
		w.Float32(ds.MovementAngle)
		w.FlushBits()
		w.Bit(ds.Accelerating)
		w.Bit(ds.Drifting)
	}
}

func encTransport(w *codec.Writer, t *TransportInfo) {
	w.GUID(t.GUID)
	encPos4(w, t.Offset)
	w.Uint8(uint8(t.Seat))
	w.Uint32(t.MoveTime)
	w.FlushBits()
	w.Bit(t.PrevMoveTime != nil)
	w.Bit(t.VehicleRecID != nil)
	if t.PrevMoveTime != nil {
		w.Uint32(*t.PrevMoveTime)
	}
	if t.VehicleRecID != nil {
		w.Int32(*t.VehicleRecID)
	}
}

func encCreateSpline(w *codec.Writer, s *CreateSpline) {
	w.Uint32(s.ID)
	encVec3(w, s.Destination)
	w.FlushBits()
	w.Bit(s.Move != nil)
	m := s.Move
	if m == nil {
		return
	}
	w.Uint32(m.Flags)
	w.Uint8(m.Face)
	w.Int32(m.Elapsed)
	w.Uint32(m.Duration)
	w.Float32(m.DurationModifier)
	w.Float32(m.NextDurationModifier)
	switch m.Face {
	case 1:
		encVec3(w, m.FaceSpot)
	case 2:
		w.GUID(m.FaceGUID)
	case 3:
		w.Float32(m.FaceDirection)
	}
	w.FlushBits()
	w.Bit(m.FadeObjectTime != nil)
	_ = w.Bits(uint64(len(m.Points)), 16)
	w.Bit(m.Filter != nil)
	w.Bit(m.SpellEffect != nil)
	w.Bit(m.Jump != nil)
	w.Bit(m.Turn != nil)
	w.Bit(m.AnimTier != nil)
	w.Bit(m.SpellVisual != nil)
	if m.FadeObjectTime != nil {
		w.Uint32(*m.FadeObjectTime)
	}
	for _, p := range m.Points {
		encVec3(w, p)
	}
	if f := m.Filter; f != nil {
		w.Uint32(uint32(len(f.Keys)))
		for _, k := range f.Keys {
			w.Float32(k[0])
			w.Float32(k[1])
		}
		w.FlushBits()
		_ = w.Bits(uint64(f.Flags), 2)
	}
	if e := m.SpellEffect; e != nil {
		w.GUID(e.Target)
		w.Uint32(e.SpellVisualID)
		w.Uint32(e.ProgressCurveID)
		w.Uint32(e.ParabolicCurveID)
		w.Float32(e.JumpGravity)
	}
	if j := m.Jump; j != nil {
		w.Float32(j.JumpGravity)
		w.Uint32(j.StartTime)
		w.Uint32(j.Duration)
	}
	if t := m.Turn; t != nil {
		w.Float32(t.StartFacing)
		w.Float32(t.TotalTurnRads)
		w.Float32(t.RadsPerSec)
	}
	if a := m.AnimTier; a != nil {
		w.Int32(a.TierTransitionID)
		w.Uint8(a.AnimTier)
		w.Uint32(a.StartTime)
		w.Uint32(a.ExtraDuration)
	}
	if v := m.SpellVisual; v != nil {
		for _, n := range v {
			w.Int32(n.SpellID)
			w.Uint32(n.SpellXSpellVisualID)
			w.Uint32(n.ScriptVisualID)
			w.Uint32(n.StartNodeIndex)
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package updateobject

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
	"math"
	"reflect"
	"testing"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/codec"
)

// raw builds bytes by hand, independently of codec.Writer.
type raw []byte

func (b raw) u8(v uint8) raw   { return append(b, v) }
func (b raw) u32(v uint32) raw { return binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint32(b, v) }
func (b raw) u64(v uint64) raw { return binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint64(b, v) }
func (b raw) f(v ...float32) raw {
	for _, x := range v {
		b = b.u32(math.Float32bits(x))
	}
	return b
}

// TestActivePlayerGolden decodes a hand-assembled movement block for the
// player's own character, laid out from the client readers:
// flags 0x10085e31c, MovementInfo 0x1008572ec, MovementUpdate 0x1008597e8,
// active player 0x10085e020.
func TestActivePlayerGolden(t *testing.T) {
	speeds := []float32{2.5, 7, 4.5, 4.722222, 2.5, 7, 4.5, 3.141594, 3.141594}
	adv := make([]float32, 17)
	for i := range adv {
		adv[i] = float32(i) + 0.5
	}
	b := raw{}.
		u8(0b0000_1100). // ThisIsYou (bit 3), MovementUpdate (bit 2)
		u8(0).
		u8(0b1000_0000).                     // ActivePlayer (first flag of byte 2)
		u32(0).                              // pause times
		u8(0x01).u8(0x80).u8(0x2A).u8(0x08). // mover GUID: mask 0x8001, Lo byte0, Hi byte7
		u64(0).u32(1000).
		f(-8949.95, -132.493, 83.5312, 0.5). // Elwynn: Northshire
		f(0, 0).                             // pitch, step-up elevation
		u32(0).u32(7).f(1).                  // remove-forces count, move index, gravity
		u8(0).u8(0).                         // 9 movement-info flags, none set
		f(speeds...).
		u32(0).f(1). // forces count, mod magnitude
		f(adv...).
		u8(0). // HasSpline
		u8(0)  // active player: no scenes, no runes

	r := codec.NewReader(b)
	m, err := DecodeCreateMovement(r)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if r.Remaining() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("%d bytes left over", r.Remaining())
	}
	if !m.ThisIsYou || m.Movement == nil || m.ActivePlayer == nil || m.Stationary != nil || m.HasEntityPosition {
		t.Fatalf("flags decoded wrong: %+v", m)
	}
	mi := m.Movement.Info
	if want := (GUID{Lo: 0x2A, Hi: 0x0800000000000000}); mi.Mover != want {
		t.Fatalf("mover %v, want %v", mi.Mover, want)
	}
	if want := (Pos4{-8949.95, -132.493, 83.5312, 0.5}); mi.Position != want {
		t.Fatalf("position %+v", mi.Position)
	}
	if mi.MoveTime != 1000 || mi.MoveIndex != 7 || mi.GravityModifier != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("movement info %+v", mi)
	}
	if m.Movement.Speeds[1] != 7 || m.Movement.AdvFlying[16] != 16.5 || m.Movement.ForcesModMag != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("speeds/adv %+v", m.Movement)
	}

	// The encoder must produce the same bytes.
	w := codec.NewWriter()
	EncodeCreateMovement(w, m)
	if string(w.Bytes()) != string(b) {
		t.Fatalf("re-encoded\n %x\nwant\n %x", w.Bytes(), []byte(b))
	}
}

func TestRoundTripEverySection(t *testing.T) {
	want := everything()
	w := codec.NewWriter()
	EncodeCreateMovement(w, want)
	r := codec.NewReader(w.Bytes())
	got, err := DecodeCreateMovement(r)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if r.Remaining() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("%d bytes left over", r.Remaining())
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("round trip differs\n got %+v\nwant %+v", got, want)
	}
}

func TestEveryTruncationFails(t *testing.T) {
	w := codec.NewWriter()
	EncodeCreateMovement(w, everything())
	full := w.Bytes()
	for n := 0; n < len(full); n++ {
		if _, err := DecodeCreateMovement(codec.NewReader(full[:n])); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("prefix of %d/%d bytes decoded without error", n, len(full))
		}
	}
}

func TestHugeCountsAreRejected(t *testing.T) {
	b := raw{}.u8(0).u8(0).u8(0).u32(0xFFFFFFFF) // 4 billion pause times, no data
	if _, err := DecodeCreateMovement(codec.NewReader(b)); !errors.Is(err, codec.ErrUnderflow) {
		t.Fatalf("want ErrUnderflow, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestPetBattleIsUnsupported(t *testing.T) {

// TestGameObjectClientOrder pins the one place the client and the fork
// disagree: 0x10085db54 reads the first-flag u32 before the transport part.
// It also crosses two adjacent flag groups (the transport's 3 bits, then
// SmoothPhasing's), which must sit in separate bytes.
func TestGameObjectClientOrder(t *testing.T) {
	b := raw{}.
		u8(0).u8(0b0000_0110).u8(0). // GameObject (bit 2), SmoothPhasing (bit 1) of byte 1
		u32(0).
		u32(77).           // WorldEffectID
		u8(0b1100_0000).   // Unknown, IsTransport
		u32(5).            // Unknown: read first
		u32(100).u32(200). // TimeOffset, NextStopTimestamp
		u8(0b0100_0000).   // Stopped
		u8(0b1000_0000)    // SmoothPhasing: ReplaceActive
	r := codec.NewReader(b)
	m, err := DecodeCreateMovement(r)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	g := m.GameObject
	if g == nil || g.WorldEffectID != 77 || g.Unknown == nil || *g.Unknown != 5 || g.Transport == nil ||
		g.Transport.TimeOffset != 100 || g.Transport.NextStopTimestamp != 200 || !g.Transport.Stopped || g.PathProgress != nil {
		t.Fatalf("game object %+v", g)
	}
	if m.SmoothPhase == nil || !m.SmoothPhase.ReplaceActive || r.Remaining() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("smooth phasing %+v, %d left", m.SmoothPhase, r.Remaining())
	}
	w := codec.NewWriter()
	EncodeCreateMovement(w, m)
	if string(w.Bytes()) != string(b) {
		t.Fatalf("re-encoded %x, want %x", w.Bytes(), []byte(b))
	}
}
```

`protocol/updateobject/nested70755_test.go`:

```go
package updateobject

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/codec"
	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/pktlog"
)

// The nested delta parts (delta_nested.go), checked against the client's
// own readers run in the emulator (tools/ufemu.py) over real captured bytes
// and over synthetic ones that reach the paths the captures do not.
//
// Every PlayerData delta of both 70755 captures is cut from its mask to the
// end of the block and run through 0x1008d4e40; the recorded run keeps the
// bytes the client consumed, its reads, and nothing else
// (testdata/ufemu/nested.json). Regenerate:
//
//	NESTED_CASES=/tmp/nested-cases.json go test ./protocol/updateobject -run TestWriteNestedCases
//	python3 tools/ufemu.py artifacts/WoWForever-arm64.decrypted \
//	    --cases /tmp/nested-cases.json --out /tmp/nested-results.json
//	NESTED_RESULTS=/tmp/nested-results.json go test ./protocol/updateobject -run TestPackNestedResults

// captures are the frozen sessions, outside the repository; tests that
// need them skip when they are absent.
var captures = []struct{ name, path string }{
	{"live", "~/wow/server/wow-forever-tc/captures/2026-11-05-live-goldshire-70755.pkt"},
	{"old", "~/wow/server/wow-forever-tc/captures/2026-11-04-goldshire-70755.pkt"},
}

const forkUpdateObject = 0x5c0000 // the fork's numbering in its logs

func capturePath(p string) string {
	if strings.HasPrefix(p, "~/") {
		h, _ := os.UserHomeDir()
		return filepath.Join(h, p[2:])
	}
	return p
}

func loadCapture(t *testing.T, p string) *pktlog.Log {
	t.Helper()
	l, err := pktlog.ReadPKTFile(capturePath(p))
	if err != nil {
		if os.IsNotExist(err) || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "no such file") {
			t.Skipf("capture absent: %s", p)
		}
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return l
}

type valuesAt struct {
	pkt, blk int
	typ      ObjectType
	data     []byte
}

// captureValues walks a log's SMSG_UPDATE_OBJECTs, tracking create types,
// and yields every values block.
func captureValues(t *testing.T, l *pktlog.Log, f func(valuesAt)) {
	t.Helper()
	types := map[GUID]ObjectType{}
	for _, p := range l.Packets {
		if p.Dir != pktlog.S2C || p.Opcode != forkUpdateObject {
			continue
		}
		u, err := Decode(p.Body)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("pkt %d: %v", p.Index, err)
		}
		for bi, bl := range u.Blocks {
			switch {
			case bl.Create != nil:
				types[bl.GUID] = bl.Create.ObjectType
			case bl.Values != nil:
				f(valuesAt{p.Index, bi, types[bl.GUID], bl.Values.Data})
			}
		}
	}
}

// structDeltas returns, for each struct delta in a values block, the
// bytes from that struct's mask to the end of the block, by the client's
// delta reader. The client's reader stops where its struct ends.
func structDeltas(typ ObjectType, data []byte) map[string][]byte {
	chain, ok := updateChains[typ]
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	d := &rd{r: codec.NewReader(data)}
	d.u8()
	if d.u8() != 0 {
		d.u8()
		for d.err == nil && d.u8() != FragmentEnd {
		}
	}
	if d.u8()&2 == 0 || d.err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	tm := d.u32()
	out := map[string][]byte{}
	var o ObjectDelta
	for _, st := range chain {
		if tm&(1<<st.bit) == 0 || d.err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if r, ok := deltaReaders[st.bit]; ok {
			out[r] = data[d.r.Pos():]
		}
		st.run(d, &o)
	}
	return out
}

// deltaReaders are the client's delta readers by TypeID bit.
var deltaReaders = map[uint]string{0: "0x1008ce4bc", 5: "0x1008e93e0", 6: "0x1008d4e40", 8: "0x1008b6b60", 1: "0x1008c9ec0"}

var deltaLayoutOf = map[string]*deltaLayout{"0x1008ce4bc": &objectDataDelta, "0x1008e93e0": &unitDataDelta,
	"0x1008d4e40": &playerDataDelta, "0x1008b6b60": &gameObjectDataDelta, "0x1008c9ec0": &itemDataDelta}

type nestedCase struct {
	name   string
	b      []byte
	reader string // empty: PlayerData, 0x1008d4e40
}

func nestedCases(t *testing.T) []nestedCase {
	var out []nestedCase
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, c := range captures {
		l := loadCapture(t, c.path)
		captureValues(t, l, func(v valuesAt) {
			for r, b := range structDeltas(v.typ, v.data) {
				if r == "0x1008ce4bc" {
					continue // ObjectData: plain fields only
				}
				// Identical deltas (health ticks) are run once.
				if k := r + string(b); !seen[k] {
					seen[k] = true
					out = append(out, nestedCase{fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s/%d.%d", deltaLayoutOf[r].name, c.name, v.pkt, v.blk), b, r})
				}
			}
		})
	}
	out = append(out, syntheticPlayerDeltas(t)...)
	return append(out, syntheticListDeltas(t)...)
}

// readerVA is the case's delta reader: given, or by the struct name the
// case's name starts with.
func (c nestedCase) readerVA() string {
	if c.reader != "" {
		return c.reader
	}
	for r, l := range deltaLayoutOf {
		if strings.HasPrefix(c.name, l.name+"/") {
			return r
		}
	}
	panic("no reader for " + c.name)
}

func TestWriteNestedCases(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Getenv("NESTED_CASES")
	if path == "" {
		t.Skip("set NESTED_CASES to write the emulator cases")
	}
	var out []ufemuCase
	for _, c := range nestedCases(t) {
		r := c.readerVA()
		out = append(out, ufemuCase{Name: c.name, Reader: r, Flags: "0", Hex: hex.EncodeToString(c.b), Delta: true,
			Init: readerInit[createReaderOf[r]]})
	}
	b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", " ")
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, b, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("%d cases", len(out))
}

// nestedRun is one recorded client run, compact: the bytes it consumed and
// its reads as "pos:getter" (D reads as "pos:D/n").
type nestedRun struct {
	Name   string `json:"name"`
	Reader string `json:"reader"`
	Hex    string `json:"hex"`
	Reads  string `json:"reads"`
}

func TestPackNestedResults(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Getenv("NESTED_RESULTS")
	if path == "" {
		t.Skip("set NESTED_RESULTS to pack the emulator results")
	}
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var rs []ufemuResult
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &rs); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var out []nestedRun
	for _, r := range rs {
		if r.Error != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: client run failed: %s", r.Name, *r.Error)
		}
		var rd []string
		for _, e := range normClient(r.Reads) {
			rd = append(rd, e.String())
		}
		out = append(out, nestedRun{r.Name, r.Reader, r.Hex[:2*r.Consumed], strings.Join(rd, " ")})
	}
	j, _ := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", "")
	if err := os.WriteFile("testdata/ufemu/nested.json", append(j, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func (e traceEnt) String() string {
	s := strconv.Itoa(e.Pos) + ":" + e.W
	if e.N != 0 {
		s += "/" + strconv.Itoa(e.N)
	}
	return s
}

// TestNestedAgainstClient: for every recorded run, our PlayerData delta
// decoder makes the client's reads, at the same positions, and stops where
// the client stopped.
func TestNestedAgainstClient(t *testing.T) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile("testdata/ufemu/nested.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var runs []nestedRun
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &runs); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(runs) < 100 {
		t.Fatalf("%d recorded runs", len(runs))
	}
	for _, r := range runs {
		data, _ := hex.DecodeString(r.Hex)
		var tr []traceEnt
		d := &rd{r: codec.NewReader(data), trace: &tr}
		l := deltaLayoutOf[r.Reader]
		if l == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: reader %s", r.Name, r.Reader)
		}
		d.readDelta(l, nil)
		if d.err != nil {
			t.Errorf("%s: %v", r.Name, d.err)
			continue
		}
		var got []string
		for _, e := range tr {
			got = append(got, e.String())
		}
		if g := strings.Join(got, " "); g != r.Reads {
			t.Errorf("%s: reads differ\n client %s\n ours   %s", r.Name, r.Reads, g)
		}
		if d.r.Remaining() != 0 {
			t.Errorf("%s: the client consumed %d bytes, we %d", r.Name, len(data), d.r.Pos())
		}
	}
}

// pdDelta builds a PlayerData delta: the mask for bits (plus their group
// bits), the full-values flag, group 0's bits 1 and 2, then body.
func pdDelta(bits []int, full bool, b1, b2 bool, body func(w *codec.Writer)) []byte {
	l := &playerDataDelta
	m := make(mask, l.blocks)
	set := func(b int) { m[b/32] |= 1 << uint(b%32) }
	for _, b := range bits {
		set(b)
		if g, ok := l.groupOf(b); ok {
			set(g)
		}
	}
	w := codec.NewWriter()
	var present uint64
	for k := range m {
		if m[k] != 0 {
			present |= 1 << uint(k)
		}
	}
	_ = w.Bits(present, uint(l.blocks))
	for k := range m {
		if m[k] != 0 {
			_ = w.Bits(uint64(m[k]), 32)
		}
	}
	w.Bit(full)
	if l.effective(m, 1) {
		w.Bit(b1)
	}
	if l.effective(m, 2) {
		w.Bit(b2)
	}
	w.FlushBits()
	body(w)
	return w.Bytes()
}

// counter hands out distinct values.
type counter uint32

func (c *counter) next() uint32 { *c++; return uint32(*c)*0x01010101 ^ 0x00804020 }

func writeQuestLogFull(w *codec.Writer, c *counter) {
	w.Uint32(c.next())
	w.Uint16(uint16(c.next()))
	for j := 0; j < 24; j++ {
		w.Uint16(uint16(c.next()))
	}
	w.Uint64(uint64(c.next())<<32 | uint64(c.next()))
	w.Uint32(c.next())
	w.Uint32(c.next())
}

// writeQuestLogDelta writes a QuestLog nested delta with mask m (block 0).
func writeQuestLogDelta(w *codec.Writer, c *counter, m uint32) {
	w.FlushBits()
	w.Bit(m != 0)
	if m != 0 {
		_ = w.Bits(uint64(m), 32)
	}
	w.FlushBits()
	if m&1 != 0 {
		for b, n := range []int{4, 2, 8, 4, 4} {
			if m&(1<<uint(b+1)) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			switch n {
			case 2:
				w.Uint16(uint16(c.next()))
			case 4:
				w.Uint32(c.next())
			case 8:
				w.Uint64(uint64(c.next())<<32 | uint64(c.next()))
			}
		}
	}
	if m&(1<<6) != 0 {
		for j := 0; j < 24; j++ {
			if m&(1<<uint(7+j)) != 0 {
				w.Uint16(uint16(c.next()))
			}
		}
	}
}

func writeVisibleItemDelta(w *codec.Writer, c *counter, m uint32) {
	w.FlushBits()
	_ = w.Bits(uint64(m), 12)
	if m&1 != 0 {
		if m&2 != 0 {
			w.Bit(true)
		}
		if m&4 != 0 {
			w.Bit(false)
		}
	}
	w.FlushBits()
	if m&1 == 0 {
		return
	}
	for b, n := range []int{4, 4, 4, 4, 2, 2, 4, 1, 1} {
		if m&(1<<uint(b+3)) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		switch n {
		case 1:
			w.Uint8(uint8(c.next()))
		case 2:
			w.Uint16(uint16(c.next()))
		case 4:
			w.Uint32(c.next())
		}
	}
}

func writeForcedReactionDelta(w *codec.Writer, c *counter, m uint32) {
	w.FlushBits()
	_ = w.Bits(uint64(m), 3)
	w.FlushBits()
	if m&1 != 0 {
		if m&2 != 0 {
			w.Uint32(c.next())
		}
		if m&4 != 0 {
			w.Uint32(c.next())
		}
	}
}

// syntheticPlayerDeltas reach the paths the captures do not: the
// full-values flag, the map's own full byte, deleted map entries, every
// QuestLog, VisibleItem and ForcedReaction bit, masks with group 0 clear,
// and bits 1 and 2. Each also carries a plain field on either side.
func syntheticPlayerDeltas(t *testing.T) []nestedCase {
	var c counter
	all31 := uint32(0x7fffffff)
	return []nestedCase{
		{name: "PlayerData/synthetic/full-flag", b: pdDelta([]int{1, 2, 25, 26, 27, 58, 59, 232, 234}, true, true, false, func(w *codec.Writer) {
			w.Uint32(c.next()) // GuildTimeStamp (25)
			w.Uint32(3)        // QuestLogQuestIdToIndex: count, no full byte
			for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
				w.Uint32(c.next())
				w.Uint32(uint32(i))
			}
			w.Uint32(c.next()) // PlayerTitle (27)
			writeQuestLogFull(w, &c)
			writeQuestLogFull(w, &c)
			writeQuestLogFull(w, &c)
			writeVisibleItemDelta(w, &c, 0xfff) // VisibleItems ignore the flag
		})},
		{name: "PlayerData/synthetic/map-full-byte", b: pdDelta([]int{26, 60, 234, 252, 261, 292}, false, false, false, func(w *codec.Writer) {
			w.Uint8(1)
			w.Uint32(2)
			for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
				w.Uint32(c.next())
				w.Uint32(c.next())
			}
			writeQuestLogDelta(w, &c, all31)
			writeVisibleItemDelta(w, &c, 0xfff)
			writeVisibleItemDelta(w, &c, 0x0f9) // bits 0, 3..7
			writeForcedReactionDelta(w, &c, 7)
			writeForcedReactionDelta(w, &c, 5)
		})},
		{name: "PlayerData/synthetic/map-changes", b: pdDelta([]int{2, 26, 61, 62, 63, 64, 240, 241, 254, 270}, false, false, true, func(w *codec.Writer) {
			w.Uint8(0)
			w.Uint16(4)
			for _, st := range []uint8{1, 2, 0, 2} {
				w.Uint32(c.next())
				w.Uint8(st)
				if st != MapDeleted {
					w.Uint32(c.next())
				}
			}
			writeQuestLogDelta(w, &c, 0)               // block-present bit clear
			writeQuestLogDelta(w, &c, 0x3e)            // group 0 clear: nothing
			writeQuestLogDelta(w, &c, 1<<6|1<<7|1<<30) // progress only
			writeQuestLogDelta(w, &c, 1|1<<5|1<<3)     // EndTime, EnabledObjectivesMask
			writeVisibleItemDelta(w, &c, 0xffe)        // group 0 clear: nothing
			writeVisibleItemDelta(w, &c, 1|1<<6|1<<11) // Unk_0xC, SheatheCategory
			w.Uint32(c.next())                         // AvgItemLevel[0] (254)
			writeForcedReactionDelta(w, &c, 6)         // group 0 clear
		})},
	}
}

// TestCapturesDecodeEverything: every create and every values block of both
// frozen sessions decodes (the 29-minute live one: combat, loot, quests,
// spawns, despawns), each values block to its last byte.
func TestCapturesDecodeEverything(t *testing.T) {
	for _, c := range captures {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			l := loadCapture(t, c.path)
			types := map[GUID]ObjectType{}
			var creates, values int
			for _, p := range l.Packets {
				if p.Dir != pktlog.S2C || p.Opcode != forkUpdateObject {
					continue
				}
				u, err := Decode(p.Body)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("pkt %d: %v", p.Index, err)
				}
				for _, bl := range u.Blocks {
					switch {
					case bl.Create != nil:
						creates++
						types[bl.GUID] = bl.Create.ObjectType
						if _, err := bl.Create.DecodeFields(); err != nil {
							t.Errorf("pkt %d create %v: %v", p.Index, bl.GUID, err)
						}
					case bl.Values != nil:
						values++
						if _, err := DecodeValues(types[bl.GUID], bl.Values); err != nil {
							t.Errorf("pkt %d values %v (type %d): %v", p.Index, bl.GUID, types[bl.GUID], err)
						}
					}
				}
			}
			t.Logf("%d creates, %d values blocks", creates, values)
			if values == 0 {
				t.Fatal("no values blocks")
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestLive70755QuestProgress: the two packets the live session used to skip
// (testdata/live70755/README.md). 9968 accepts quest 179 into quest log
// slot 1; 18314 moves its objective 4 to 2.
func TestLive70755QuestProgress(t *testing.T) {
	block := func(pkt string, i int) *ValuesBlock {
		b, err := os.ReadFile("testdata/live70755/" + pkt + "_SMSG_UPDATE_OBJECT.bin")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		u, err := Decode(b)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		self := GUID{Hi: 0x0801180000000000, Lo: 3}
		if u.Blocks[i].GUID != self || u.Blocks[i].Values == nil {
			t.Fatalf("pkt %s block %d: %+v", pkt, i, u.Blocks[i])
		}
		return u.Blocks[i].Values
	}
	p := &PlayerData{}
	d, err := DecodeValues(TypeActivePlayer, block("09968", 0))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(d.ActivePlayerRaw) != 23 {
		t.Errorf("%d ActivePlayerData bytes, want 23 (the client's PlayerData reader stops 23 bytes short)", len(d.ActivePlayerRaw))
	}
	p.ApplyTo(d.Player)
	if len(p.QuestLogQuestIDToIndex) != 1 || p.QuestLogQuestIDToIndex[179] != 1 {
		t.Errorf("QuestLogQuestIdToIndex %v", p.QuestLogQuestIDToIndex)
	}
	if q := p.QuestLog[1]; q.QuestID != 179 || q.ObjectiveProgress != [24]int16{} {
		t.Errorf("QuestLog[1] %+v", q)
	}
	d, err = DecodeValues(TypeActivePlayer, block("18314", 1))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(d.Player) != 1 || d.Player[0].Name != "QuestLog.ObjectiveProgress[1][4]" {
		t.Fatalf("player %v", d.Player)
	}
	p.ApplyTo(d.Player)
	if q := p.QuestLog[1]; q.QuestID != 179 || q.ObjectiveProgress[4] != 2 {
		t.Errorf("QuestLog[1] %+v", q)
	}
}

// TestQuestIDToIndexChanges: the map's change states, from the synthetic
// client-checked case: 1 and 0 set, 2 deletes (and reads no value).
func TestQuestIDToIndexChanges(t *testing.T) {
	p := &PlayerData{QuestLogQuestIDToIndex: map[int32]int32{9: 4}}
	p.ApplyTo([]Field{
		{"QuestLogQuestIdToIndex.Full", WU8, uint8(0)},
		{"QuestLogQuestIdToIndex.changes", WU16, uint16(3)},
		{"QuestLogQuestIdToIndex.Key", WI32, int32(5)}, {"QuestLogQuestIdToIndex.State", WU8, uint8(1)}, {"QuestLogQuestIdToIndex.Value", WI32, int32(2)},
		{"QuestLogQuestIdToIndex.Key", WI32, int32(9)}, {"QuestLogQuestIdToIndex.State", WU8, uint8(2)},
		{"QuestLogQuestIdToIndex.Key", WI32, int32(7)}, {"QuestLogQuestIdToIndex.State", WU8, uint8(0)}, {"QuestLogQuestIdToIndex.Value", WI32, int32(3)},
	})
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(p.QuestLogQuestIDToIndex, map[int32]int32{5: 2, 7: 3}) {
		t.Errorf("%v", p.QuestLogQuestIDToIndex)
	}
	p.ApplyTo([]Field{{"QuestLogQuestIdToIndex.size", WU32, uint32(1)},
		{"QuestLogQuestIdToIndex.Key", WI32, int32(1)}, {"QuestLogQuestIdToIndex.Value", WI32, int32(0)}})
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(p.QuestLogQuestIDToIndex, map[int32]int32{1: 0}) {
		t.Errorf("full: %v", p.QuestLogQuestIDToIndex)
	}
}
```

`protocol/updateobject/packet.go`:

```go
package updateobject

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/codec"
)

// Outer framing of SMSG_UPDATE_OBJECT, read off the client (docs/EVIDENCE.md
// E23):
//
//	0x1007fb750  message reader: u16 map, u32 block count, u8 flags
//	             (bit 7 -> +0x250, bit 6 HasRemovedObjects), [u16 destroy
//	             count, u32 GUID count, GUIDs], u32 blob size, blob
//	0x102cd65e8  pass 1 over the blob: u8 block type; types 0..2 then a GUID;
//	             any other type fails the whole message
//	0x102cd6d70  create block (types 1 and 2): u8 object type, movement
//	             (0x10085e31c), then 0x102cddad0
//	0x102cddad0  u32 size, u8 field flags, fragment ids (0x102cddf48),
//	             fragment data; the size must match what was read
//	0x102cd7480  values block (type 0): u32 size; unknown objects are skipped
//	             by that size, known ones go to 0x102cde4a8

// ErrMalformed marks input the client itself would reject.
var ErrMalformed = errors.New("updateobject: malformed")

// BlockType is the u8 that starts every block in the blob.
type BlockType uint8

// Block types. The client accepts exactly these three (0x102cd65e8).
const (
	BlockValues        BlockType = 0 // UPDATETYPE_VALUES
	BlockCreateObject  BlockType = 1 // UPDATETYPE_CREATE_OBJECT
	BlockCreateObject2 BlockType = 2 // UPDATETYPE_CREATE_OBJECT2 (newly spawned)
)

// ObjectType is the create block's u8 object type. The client switches on it
// at 0x1010a9600 (1..14); the numbering is the fork's TypeID.
type ObjectType uint8

// Object types.
const (
	TypeObject               ObjectType = 0
	TypeItem                 ObjectType = 1
	TypeContainer            ObjectType = 2
	TypeAzeriteEmpoweredItem ObjectType = 3
	TypeAzeriteItem          ObjectType = 4
	TypeUnit                 ObjectType = 5
	TypePlayer               ObjectType = 6
	TypeActivePlayer         ObjectType = 7
	TypeGameObject           ObjectType = 8
	TypeDynamicObject        ObjectType = 9
	TypeCorpse               ObjectType = 10
	TypeAreaTrigger          ObjectType = 11
	TypeSceneObject          ObjectType = 12
	TypeConversation         ObjectType = 13
	TypeMeshObject           ObjectType = 14
)

// Entity fragment ids as they appear on the wire. The 70707 registry
// (0x103832fa0, 0xb0 bytes per id, filled by per-fragment registration
// functions such as 0x102cf5a00 for CGObject) numbers them one above the
// retail ids; tag ids (200+) are unchanged.
const (
	FragmentCGObject  uint8 = 3   // updateable, indirect (registry kind 1)
	FragmentTagUnit   uint8 = 204 // tag: no data
	FragmentTagPlayer uint8 = 205 // tag: no data
	FragmentEnd       uint8 = 255
)

// UpdateObject is one SMSG_UPDATE_OBJECT message.
type UpdateObject struct {
	MapID uint16
	// Flag7 is bit 7 of the flag byte (client +0x250, passed on to the
	// apply step 0x102cd6108). The fork always sets it and calls it "unk".
	Flag7   bool
	Removed *RemovedObjects // bit 6 of the flag byte
	Blocks  []Block
}

// RemovedObjects lists objects to drop. The client marks the first
// DestroyCount GUIDs as destroyed and the rest as out of range (0x102cd627c
// compares the index against the u16).
type RemovedObjects struct {
	Destroyed  []GUID
	OutOfRange []GUID
}

// Block is one entry of the blob. Exactly one of Create and Values is set.
type Block struct {
	Type   BlockType
	GUID   GUID
	Create *CreateBlock
	Values *ValuesBlock
}

// CreateBlock is a create-object block (types 1 and 2).
type CreateBlock struct {
	ObjectType ObjectType
	Movement   *CreateMovement
	// FieldFlags is the visibility byte (UpdateFieldFlag: 0x01 owner, 0x02
	// party member, 0x04 unit-all, 0x08 empath). The client hands the field
	// readers FieldFlags|0x20, where 0x20 means "create".
	FieldFlags uint8
	// Fragments are the entity fragment ids, without the 255 terminator.
	Fragments []uint8
	// FragmentData is everything after the fragment list, up to the block
	// size. DecodeFields interprets it.
	FragmentData []byte
}

// ValuesBlock is a values (delta) block. Its contents depend on the object's
// type, which only the earlier create carries, so it is decoded in a second
// step by DecodeValues.
type ValuesBlock struct {
	Data []byte // the size-delimited body, without the u32 size
}

// Field visibility flags (UpdateFieldFlag) and the create bit the client adds.
const (
	FlagOwner       uint8 = 0x01
	FlagPartyMember uint8 = 0x02
	FlagUnitAll     uint8 = 0x04
	FlagEmpath      uint8 = 0x08
	flagCreate      uint8 = 0x20
)

// Decode reads a whole SMSG_UPDATE_OBJECT body.
func Decode(b []byte) (*UpdateObject, error) {
	r := codec.NewReader(b)
	d := &rd{r: r}
	u := d.updateObject()
	if d.err != nil {
		return nil, d.err
	}
	if r.Remaining() != 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %d bytes after the blob", ErrMalformed, r.Remaining())
	}
	return u, nil
}

func (d *rd) updateObject() *UpdateObject {
	u := &UpdateObject{MapID: d.u16()}
	nBlocks := d.u32()
	d.group()
	u.Flag7 = d.bit()
	hasRemoved := d.bit()
	if hasRemoved {
		nDestroy := d.u16()
		n := d.count(d.u32(), 2)
		if d.err == nil && int(nDestroy) > n {
			d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: destroy count %d > GUID count %d", ErrMalformed, nDestroy, n))
		}
		rm := &RemovedObjects{}
		for i := 0; i < n && d.err == nil; i++ {
			g := d.guid()
			if i < int(nDestroy) {
				rm.Destroyed = append(rm.Destroyed, g)
			} else {
				rm.OutOfRange = append(rm.OutOfRange, g)
			}
		}
		u.Removed = rm
	}
	size := d.u32()
	if d.err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	blob, err := d.r.Bytes(int(size))
	if err != nil {
		d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: blob size %d: %v", ErrMalformed, size, err))
		return nil
	}
	// Every block is at least 4 bytes (type, GUID mask), so a corrupt count
	// cannot allocate much.
	if int64(nBlocks)*4 > int64(len(blob)) {
		d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: %d blocks in a %d-byte blob", ErrMalformed, nBlocks, len(blob)))
		return nil
	}
	br := &rd{r: codec.NewReader(blob)}
	u.Blocks = make([]Block, 0, nBlocks)
	for i := uint32(0); i < nBlocks; i++ {
		blk := br.block()
		if br.err != nil {
			d.fail(fmt.Errorf("block %d: %w", i, br.err))
			return nil
		}
		u.Blocks = append(u.Blocks, blk)
	}
	if br.r.Remaining() != 0 {
		d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: %d bytes after %d blocks", ErrMalformed, br.r.Remaining(), nBlocks))
	}
	return u
}

func (d *rd) block() Block {
	b := Block{Type: BlockType(d.u8())}
	if d.err != nil {
		return b
	}
	switch b.Type {
	case BlockValues:
		b.GUID = d.guid()
		b.Values = &ValuesBlock{Data: d.sized()}
	case BlockCreateObject, BlockCreateObject2:
		b.GUID = d.guid()
		b.Create = d.createBlock()
	default:
		d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: block type %d (client accepts 0..2)", ErrMalformed, b.Type))
	}
	return b
}

// sized reads a u32 size and that many bytes.
func (d *rd) sized() []byte {
	n := d.u32()
	if d.err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	b, err := d.r.Bytes(int(n))
	if err != nil {
		d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: size %d: %v", ErrMalformed, n, err))
	}
	return b
}

func (d *rd) createBlock() *CreateBlock {
	c := &CreateBlock{ObjectType: ObjectType(d.u8())}
	if d.err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	c.Movement = d.createMovement()
	body := d.sized()
	if d.err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	br := &rd{r: codec.NewReader(body)}
	c.FieldFlags = br.u8()
	for br.err == nil {
		id := br.u8()
		if br.err != nil || id == FragmentEnd {
			break
		}
		c.Fragments = append(c.Fragments, id)
	}
	if br.err != nil {
		d.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: fragment list: %v", ErrMalformed, br.err))
		return nil
	}
	c.FragmentData = body[br.r.Pos():]
	return c
}

// Encode writes u in the layout Decode reads. It exists to build fixtures.
func Encode(u *UpdateObject) []byte {
	w := codec.NewWriter()
	w.Uint16(u.MapID)
	var nBlocks uint32
	nBlocks = uint32(len(u.Blocks))
	w.Uint32(nBlocks)
	w.FlushBits()
	w.Bit(u.Flag7)
	w.Bit(u.Removed != nil)
	if rm := u.Removed; rm != nil {
		w.Uint16(uint16(len(rm.Destroyed)))
		w.Uint32(uint32(len(rm.Destroyed) + len(rm.OutOfRange)))
		for _, g := range rm.Destroyed {
			w.GUID(g)
		}
		for _, g := range rm.OutOfRange {
			w.GUID(g)
		}
	}
	blob := codec.NewWriter()
	for i := range u.Blocks {
		encBlock(blob, &u.Blocks[i])
	}
	w.Uint32(uint32(blob.Len()))
	w.RawBytes(blob.Bytes())
	return w.Bytes()
}

func encBlock(w *codec.Writer, b *Block) {
	w.Uint8(uint8(b.Type))
	w.GUID(b.GUID)
	switch {
	case b.Create != nil:
		c := b.Create
		w.Uint8(uint8(c.ObjectType))
		EncodeCreateMovement(w, c.Movement)
		body := codec.NewWriter()
		body.Uint8(c.FieldFlags)
		for _, id := range c.Fragments {
			body.Uint8(id)
		}
		body.Uint8(FragmentEnd)
		body.RawBytes(c.FragmentData)
		w.Uint32(uint32(body.Len()))
		w.RawBytes(body.Bytes())
	case b.Values != nil:
		w.Uint32(uint32(len(b.Values.Data)))
		w.RawBytes(b.Values.Data)
	}
}
```

`protocol/updateobject/packet_test.go`:

```go
package updateobject

import (
	"bytes"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/codec"
)

func stationaryMovement() *CreateMovement {
	return &CreateMovement{Stationary: &Pos4{X: 1, Y: 2, Z: 3, O: 0.5}}
}

// TestOuterHeaderBytes checks the outer header against bytes assembled by
// hand from the client reader 0x1007fb750.
func TestOuterHeaderBytes(t *testing.T) {
	b := raw{}.
		u8(0x2A).u8(0x00).          // u16 map 42
		u32(0).                     // no blocks
		u8(0b1100_0000).            // bit 7 (Flag7), bit 6 HasRemovedObjects
		u8(0x01).u8(0x00).          // u16 destroy count 1
		u32(2).                     // two GUIDs
		u8(0x01).u8(0x00).u8(0x07). // GUID mask 0x0001, Lo=7
		u8(0x00).u8(0x01).u8(0x09). // GUID mask 0x0100, Hi=9
		u32(0)                      // empty blob
	u, err := Decode(b)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if u.MapID != 42 || !u.Flag7 || u.Removed == nil {
		t.Fatalf("header %+v", u)
	}
	if len(u.Removed.Destroyed) != 1 || u.Removed.Destroyed[0] != (GUID{Lo: 7}) ||
		len(u.Removed.OutOfRange) != 1 || u.Removed.OutOfRange[0] != (GUID{Hi: 9}) {
		t.Fatalf("removed %+v", u.Removed)
	}
	if got := Encode(u); !bytes.Equal(got, b) {
		t.Fatalf("encode\n got %x\nwant %x", got, []byte(b))
	}
}

func framingVariants() map[string]*UpdateObject {
	create := func(typ BlockType, ot ObjectType, data []byte, frags ...uint8) Block {
		return Block{Type: typ, GUID: GUID{Lo: 0x1234, Hi: 0x0800000000000000}, Create: &CreateBlock{
			ObjectType: ot, Movement: stationaryMovement(), FieldFlags: FlagOwner, Fragments: frags, FragmentData: data,
		}}
	}
	return map[string]*UpdateObject{
		"empty":        {MapID: 0},
		"removed only": {MapID: 1, Flag7: true, Removed: &RemovedObjects{Destroyed: []GUID{{Lo: 1}}, OutOfRange: []GUID{{Lo: 2}, {Hi: 3}}}},
		"destroy only": {MapID: 1, Removed: &RemovedObjects{Destroyed: []GUID{{Lo: 1}}}},
		"values":       {MapID: 2, Blocks: []Block{{Type: BlockValues, GUID: GUID{Lo: 5}, Values: &ValuesBlock{Data: []byte{0, 0, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0}}}}},
		"create1":      {MapID: 3, Blocks: []Block{create(BlockCreateObject, TypeUnit, []byte{9, 9}, FragmentCGObject, FragmentTagUnit)}},
		"create2":      {MapID: 3, Blocks: []Block{create(BlockCreateObject2, TypeGameObject, nil)}},
		"mixed":        {MapID: 4, Flag7: true, Removed: &RemovedObjects{OutOfRange: []GUID{{Lo: 8}}}, Blocks: []Block{create(BlockCreateObject, TypeUnit, []byte{1}, FragmentCGObject), {Type: BlockValues, GUID: GUID{Lo: 6}, Values: &ValuesBlock{}}}},
		"no fragments": {MapID: 5, Blocks: []Block{create(BlockCreateObject2, TypeItem, nil)}},
	}
}

func TestFramingRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	for name, u := range framingVariants() {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			b := Encode(u)
			got, err := Decode(b)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if again := Encode(got); !bytes.Equal(again, b) {
				t.Fatalf("re-encode differs\n got %x\nwant %x", again, b)
			}
			if len(got.Blocks) != len(u.Blocks) || got.MapID != u.MapID || got.Flag7 != u.Flag7 || (got.Removed == nil) != (u.Removed == nil) {
				t.Fatalf("decoded %+v", got)
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestFramingMalformed truncates and corrupts every variant: decoding must
// fail cleanly, never panic or over-allocate.
func TestFramingMalformed(t *testing.T) {
	for name, u := range framingVariants() {
		b := Encode(u)
		for n := 0; n < len(b); n++ {
			if _, err := Decode(b[:n]); err == nil {
				t.Errorf("%s: truncated to %d of %d bytes decoded", name, n, len(b))
			}
		}
		if _, err := Decode(append(append([]byte(nil), b...), 0)); err == nil {
			t.Errorf("%s: trailing byte accepted", name)
		}
	}
	cases := map[string][]byte{
		"bad block type": raw{}.u8(0).u8(0).u32(1).u8(0).u32(3).u8(3).u8(0).u8(0),
		"huge count":     raw{}.u8(0).u8(0).u32(0xFFFFFFFF).u8(0).u32(4).u8(0).u8(0).u8(0).u8(0),
		"destroy > all":  raw{}.u8(0).u8(0).u32(0).u8(0x40).u8(2).u8(0).u32(1).u8(0).u8(0).u32(0),
		"huge guid list": raw{}.u8(0).u8(0).u32(0).u8(0x40).u8(0).u8(0).u32(0x7FFFFFFF),
		"huge blob":      raw{}.u8(0).u8(0).u32(0).u8(0).u32(0xFFFFFFF0),
		"short create":   raw{}.u8(0).u8(0).u32(1).u8(0).u32(4).u8(1).u8(0).u8(0).u8(5),
		"no fragment end": func() []byte {
			blk := codec.NewWriter()
			blk.Uint8(1)
			blk.GUID(GUID{Lo: 1})
			blk.Uint8(uint8(TypeUnit))
			EncodeCreateMovement(blk, &CreateMovement{})
			blk.Uint32(2)
			blk.Uint8(0)
			blk.Uint8(FragmentCGObject) // no 255
			w := codec.NewWriter()
			w.Uint16(0)
			w.Uint32(1)
			w.Uint8(0)
			w.Uint32(uint32(blk.Len()))
			w.RawBytes(blk.Bytes())
			return w.Bytes()
		}(),
	}
	for name, b := range cases {
		_, err := Decode(b)
		if err == nil {
			t.Errorf("%s: decoded", name)
		}
		if errors.Is(err, ErrUnsupported) {
			t.Errorf("%s: malformed input reported as unsupported: %v", name, err)
		}
	}
	if _, err := Decode(cases["bad block type"]); !errors.Is(err, ErrMalformed) {
		t.Errorf("bad block type: %v, want ErrMalformed", err)
	}
}

func FuzzDecode(f *testing.F) {
	for _, u := range framingVariants() {
		f.Add(Encode(u))
	}
	f.Fuzz(func(t *testing.T, b []byte) {
		u, err := Decode(b)
		if err != nil {
			return
		}
		// Whatever decodes must re-encode to something that decodes (the
		// bytes may differ: padding bits and zero GUID bytes are not kept).
		if _, err := Decode(Encode(u)); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("re-encoded message does not decode: %v", err)
		}
		for _, blk := range u.Blocks {
			if blk.Create != nil {
				_, _ = blk.Create.DecodeFields()
			}
			if blk.Values != nil {
				_, _ = DecodeValues(TypeActivePlayer, blk.Values)
			}
		}
	})
}
```
