```go
	jsonl := flag.String("jsonl", "", "replay worlddecrypt output instead (comma-separated conn-*.jsonl)")
	pkt := flag.String("pkt", "", "a TrinityCore World.pkt (the local fork), with -follow to tail it")
	opcodesH := flag.String("opcodes-h", filepath.Join(envOr("WOW_TC", filepath.Join(os.Getenv("HOME"), "wow/server/wow-forever-tc")), "TrinityCore/src/server/game/Server/Protocol/Opcodes.h"), "the fork's Opcodes.h (names a World.pkt's numbers)")
	speed := flag.Float64("speed", 1, "replay speed (0: as fast as possible)")
	build := flag.Int("build", 70783, "client build (opcode names)")
	addr := flag.String("addr", "127.0.0.1:8791", "where to serve the radar")
	radius := flag.Float64("radius", 250, "yards around us to send to the page")
	nodesPath := flag.String("nodes", "nodes.json", "herb and ore spawn points (tools/nodes-export.py); \"\" for none")
	nodeRadius := flag.Float64("node-radius", 400, "yards around us to list node spots")
	vis := flag.Float64("vis", 90, "yards inside which the server shows every node that is up")
	seen := flag.String("seen", filepath.Join(os.Getenv("HOME"), ".config/wow-radar/seen.json"), "where gathered/empty times and respawns are kept between sessions (live only); \"\" for nowhere")
	fdb := flag.String("db", "", "forever.db for creature, object and quest names (default with -pkt or a Forever -build: $WOW_FOREVER_DB, else ~/wow/host/data/forever.db; \"-\" for none)")
	wdb := flag.String("wdb", filepath.Join(envOr("WOW_RETAIL_DIR", "/Applications/World of Warcraft/_retail_"), "Cache/WDB/enUS"), "the client's name caches")
	flag.Parse()

	sp := *speed
	if sp <= 0 {
		sp = 1
	}
	w := newWorld(sp)
	w.vis = *vis
	if *nodesPath != "" {
		if err := w.nodes.load(*nodesPath); err != nil {
			log.Printf("nodes: %v (run tools/nodes-export.py)", err)
		} else {
			log.Printf("nodes: %d spots, %d node entries from %s", len(w.nodes.spots), len(w.nodes.entries), *nodesPath)
		}
	}
	if *pkt != "" || *jsonl != "" || !*follow {
		*seen = "" // replays have their own clocks: keep them out of the live history
	}
	if *seen != "" {
		os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(*seen), 0o755)
		w.nodes.loadSeen(*seen)
		go func() {
			for range time.Tick(30 * time.Second) {
				w.mu.Lock()
				w.nodes.save(*seen)
				w.mu.Unlock()
			}
		}()
	}
	log.Printf("names: %d creatures, %d game objects from %s",
		loadWDB(filepath.Join(*wdb, "creaturecache.wdb"), w.names),
		loadWDB(filepath.Join(*wdb, "gameobjectcache.wdb"), w.goNames), *wdb)

	if *fdb == "" && (*pkt != "" || *build != 70783) {
		*fdb = envOr("WOW_FOREVER_DB", filepath.Join(os.Getenv("HOME"), "wow/host/data/forever.db"))
	}
	if *fdb != "" && *fdb != "-" {
		if n, o, q, err := loadForeverDB(*fdb, w); err != nil {
			log.Printf("forever.db: %v", err)
		} else {
			log.Printf("forever.db: %d creatures, %d game objects, %d quests from %s", n, o, q, *fdb)
		}
	}
	sub, _ := fs.Sub(web, "web")
	http.Handle("/", http.FileServer(http.FS(sub)))
	http.HandleFunc("/state", func(rw http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		rw.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		rw.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		json.NewEncoder(rw).Encode(w.snapshot(*radius, *nodeRadius))
	})
	http.HandleFunc("/mcp", mcpHandler(w, *nodeRadius))
	go func() { log.Fatal(http.ListenAndServe(*addr, nil)) }()
	log.Printf("radar on http://%s", *addr)

	switch {
	case *pkt != "":
		readPKT(w, *pkt, *opcodesH, *follow, *speed)
	case *jsonl != "":
		replay(w, strings.Split(*jsonl, ","), *speed)
		log.Printf("replay done: %v", w.stats)
		select {}
	default:
		if *run != "" {
			*pcap = filepath.Join(*run, "world.pcap")
			for said := false; ; said = true {
				m, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(*run, "bnet", "*", "secrets.jsonl"))
				if _, err := os.Stat(*pcap); err == nil && len(m) > 0 {
					*secrets = m[len(m)-1]
					break
				}
				if !said {
					log.Printf("waiting for %s and the relay's secrets (log in now)", *pcap)
				}
				time.Sleep(500 * time.Millisecond)
			}
		}
		if *pcap == "" || *secrets == "" {
			log.Fatal("need -run, -pcap with -secrets, or -jsonl")
		}
		live(w, *pcap, *secrets, *build, *follow)
	}
}

func live(w *world, pcap, secrets string, build int, follow bool) {
	t, err := worldstream.OpenTail(pcap)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	d := worldstream.New(build, secrets)
	last := time.Now()
	for {
		segs, err := t.Next()
		if err != nil {
			log.Fatal(err)
		}
		for _, s := range segs {
			for _, m := range d.Feed(s) {
				w.handle(msg{m.T, m.Dir == opcodes.ClientToServer, m.Opcode, m.Short(), m.Body})
			}
		}
		if len(segs) == 0 {
			if !follow {
				log.Printf("capture read: %v", w.stats)
				select {}
			}
			time.Sleep(30 * time.Millisecond)
		}
		if time.Since(last) > 10*time.Second {
			last = time.Now()
			w.mu.Lock()
			log.Printf("%d objects, %v", len(w.ents), w.stats)
			w.mu.Unlock()
		}
	}
}

var opLine = regexp.MustCompile(`\b([CS])(MSG_\w+)\s*=\s*(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)`)

// readPKT feeds a fork World.pkt: replayed at -speed, or tailed with -follow.
func readPKT(w *world, path, opcodesH string, follow bool, speed float64) {
	names := map[uint64]string{}
	// a live capture saved as .pkt names its numbers in <name>-opcodes.tsv
	// (dir, opcode, hex, name); the fork's come from Opcodes.h
	if tsv, err := os.ReadFile(strings.TrimSuffix(path, ".pkt") + "-opcodes.tsv"); err == nil {
		for _, l := range strings.Split(string(tsv), "\n") {
			f := strings.Split(l, "\t")
			if len(f) < 4 {
				continue
			}
			v, err := strconv.ParseUint(f[1], 10, 32)
			if err != nil {
				continue
			}
			if f[0] == "C" {
				v |= 1 << 32
			}
			names[v] = f[3]
		}
		log.Printf("opcode names from %s-opcodes.tsv", strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), ".pkt"))
	}
	b, err := os.ReadFile(opcodesH)
	if err != nil && len(names) == 0 {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, m := range opLine.FindAllStringSubmatch(string(b), -1) {
		v, _ := strconv.ParseUint(m[3], 0, 32)
		k := v
		if m[1] == "C" {
			k |= 1 << 32
		}
		if names[k] == "" {
			names[k] = m[1] + m[2]
		}
	}
	t, err := pktlog.OpenTail(path)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	base := time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	start := time.Now()
	var t0 time.Time
	for {
		ps, err := t.Next()
		if err != nil {
			log.Fatal(err)
		}
		for _, p := range ps {
			c2s := p.Dir == pktlog.C2S
			k := uint64(p.Opcode)
			if c2s {
				k |= 1 << 32
			}
			m := msg{base.Add(time.Duration(p.TicksMs) * time.Millisecond), c2s, p.Opcode, names[k], p.Body}
			if t0.IsZero() {
				t0 = m.T
			}
			if !follow && speed > 0 {
				if d := time.Until(start.Add(time.Duration(float64(m.T.Sub(t0)) / speed))); d > 0 {
					time.Sleep(d)
				}
			}
			w.handle(m)
		}
		if len(ps) == 0 {
			if !follow {
				log.Printf("log read: %v", w.stats)
				select {}
			}
			time.Sleep(30 * time.Millisecond)
		}
	}
}

func replay(w *world, files []string, speed float64) {
	var all []msg
	for _, f := range files {
		fh, err := os.Open(f)
		if err != nil {
			log.Fatal(err)
		}
		sc := bufio.NewScanner(fh)
		sc.Buffer(make([]byte, 64<<20), 64<<20)
		for sc.Scan() {
			var j struct{ T, Dir, Opcode, Name, Body string }
			if json.Unmarshal(sc.Bytes(), &j) != nil {
				continue
			}
			t, err := time.Parse("15:04:05.000", j.T)
			if err != nil {
				continue
			}
			var op uint32
			fmt.Sscanf(j.Opcode, "0x%x", &op)
			b, _ := hex.DecodeString(j.Body)
			name := ""
			if s := shortName(j.Name); s != "" {
				name = s
			}
			all = append(all, msg{t, j.Dir == "c2s", op, name, b})
		}
		fh.Close()
	}
	sort.SliceStable(all, func(i, j int) bool { return all[i].T.Before(all[j].T) })
	log.Printf("replaying %d messages from %s to %s", len(all), all[0].T.Format("15:04:05"), all[len(all)-1].T.Format("15:04:05"))
	start, t0 := time.Now(), all[0].T
	for _, m := range all {
		if speed > 0 {
			due := start.Add(time.Duration(float64(m.T.Sub(t0)) / speed))
			if d := time.Until(due); d > 0 {
				time.Sleep(d)
			}
		}
		w.handle(m)
	}
}

func shortName(s string) string {
	i := strings.Index(s, "MSG_")
	if i < 1 {
		return ""
	}
	j := i + 4
	for j < len(s) && (s[j] == '_' || s[j] >= 'A' && s[j] <= 'Z' || s[j] >= '0' && s[j] <= '9') {
		j++
	}
	return s[i-1 : j]
}

// envOr is the environment variable k, or def when it is unset.
func envOr(k, def string) string {
	if v := os.Getenv(k); v != "" {
		return v
	}
	return def
}
```

`radar/mcp.go`:

```go
package main

// The radar's world model as an MCP server: POST /mcp, JSON-RPC 2.0 over
// Claude Code's "http" transport (one request per POST, a JSON answer back).
// Everything is read-only and comes from the same snapshot the page draws.
//
//	claude mcp add --transport http wow-radar http://127.0.0.1:8791/mcp

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"net/http"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

const mcpProtocol = "2025-06-18"

type rpcReq struct {
	JSONRPC string          `json:"jsonrpc"`
	ID      json.RawMessage `json:"id,omitempty"`
	Method  string          `json:"method"`
	Params  json.RawMessage `json:"params,omitempty"`
}

type rpcErr struct {
	Code    int    `json:"code"`
	Message string `json:"message"`
}

type mcpTool struct {
	Name        string         `json:"name"`
	Description string         `json:"description"`
	InputSchema map[string]any `json:"inputSchema"`
}

func schema(props map[string]any, required ...string) map[string]any {
	s := map[string]any{"type": "object", "properties": props}
	if len(required) > 0 {
		s["required"] = required
	}
	return s
}

var (
	pRadius = map[string]any{"type": "number", "description": "yards around the player (default 100)"}
	pKind   = map[string]any{"type": "string", "enum": []string{"unit", "player", "gameobject", "corpse"}, "description": "only this kind"}
	pLimit  = map[string]any{"type": "integer", "description": "most objects to return, nearest first (default 40)"}
)

var mcpTools = []mcpTool{
	{"radar_self", "The player right now: map, position, facing, level, health, the quest log (quest ids with objective progress), and any enemy players closing in.", schema(map[string]any{})},
	{"radar_around", "Everything the server shows around the player, nearest first: creatures, players, game objects with name, level, health %, dead, moving (with destination and ETA), quest-giver status and distance in yards.", schema(map[string]any{"radius": pRadius, "kind": pKind, "limit": pLimit, "alive": map[string]any{"type": "boolean", "description": "skip dead units"}})},
	{"radar_find", "Find tracked objects by name (case-insensitive substring), nearest first, anywhere the server has shown them.", schema(map[string]any{"name": map[string]any{"type": "string"}, "kind": pKind, "limit": pLimit}, "name")},
	{"radar_quest_givers", "NPCs nearby with a quest-giver icon: available (!), turnin (?), trivial or future.", schema(map[string]any{"radius": pRadius})},
	{"radar_nodes", "Herb and ore spots near the player with their state (up, empty, gone, seen, unknown) and respawn estimates.", schema(map[string]any{"radius": pRadius})},
	{"radar_status", "Is the stream live: the stream clock, how many objects are tracked, and message counters.", schema(map[string]any{})},
}

const mcpInstructions = "Live WoW world around the player's character, decoded from the game's own network traffic by wow-radar " +
	"(no addon, read-only). Start with radar_self, then radar_around. Distances are yards; positions are world x,y,z. " +
	"If radar_status shows no self, the capture hasn't seen world entry yet."

type around struct {
	GUID    string    `json:"guid"`
	Kind    string    `json:"kind"`
	Name    string    `json:"name,omitempty"`
	Entry   uint32    `json:"entry,omitempty"`
	Level   uint8     `json:"level,omitempty"`
	HPPct   *int      `json:"hp_pct,omitempty"`
	HP      int64     `json:"hp,omitempty"`
	Dead    bool      `json:"dead,omitempty"`
	Dist    float64   `json:"dist"`
	X       float32   `json:"x"`
	Y       float32   `json:"y"`
	Z       float32   `json:"z"`
	Moving  bool      `json:"moving,omitempty"`
	To      []float32 `json:"to,omitempty"`
	ETA     float64   `json:"eta_s,omitempty"`
	QGiver  string    `json:"quest_giver,omitempty"`
	Hostile bool      `json:"enemy_player,omitempty"`
	Race    uint8     `json:"race,omitempty"`
	Class   uint8     `json:"class,omitempty"`
}

func round1(v float64) float64 { return math.Round(v*10) / 10 }

func toAround(e ent, self *ent) around {
	a := around{GUID: e.GUID, Kind: e.Kind, Name: e.Name, Entry: e.Entry, Level: e.Level, HP: e.HP, Dead: e.Dead,
		X: e.X, Y: e.Y, Z: e.Z, Moving: e.Moving, QGiver: e.QGiver, Hostile: e.Hostile, Race: e.Race, Class: e.Class}
	if e.MaxHP > 0 {
		p := int(math.Round(100 * float64(e.HP) / float64(e.MaxHP)))
		a.HPPct = &p
	}
	if e.Moving {
		a.To = []float32{e.ToX, e.ToY, e.ToZ}
		a.ETA = round1(e.ETA)
	}
	if self != nil {
		a.Dist = round1(math.Sqrt(sq(e.X-self.X) + sq(e.Y-self.Y) + sq(e.Z-self.Z)))
	}
	return a
}

func sq(v float32) float64 { return float64(v) * float64(v) }

// pick filters a snapshot's objects, nearest first.
func pick(s snapshot, kind, name string, alive bool, limit int, keep func(ent) bool) []around {
	out := []around{}
	name = strings.ToLower(name)
	for _, e := range s.Objects {
		if kind != "" && e.Kind != kind || alive && e.Dead ||
			name != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(e.Name), name) || keep != nil && !keep(e) {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, toAround(e, s.Self))
	}
	sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Dist < out[j].Dist })
	if limit <= 0 {
		limit = 40
	}
	if len(out) > limit {
		out = out[:limit]
	}
	return out
}

type mcpArgs struct {
	Radius float64 `json:"radius"`
	Kind   string  `json:"kind"`
	Limit  int     `json:"limit"`
	Alive  bool    `json:"alive"`
	Name   string  `json:"name"`
}

func (w *world) callTool(name string, a mcpArgs, nodeRadius float64) (any, error) {
	r := a.Radius
	if r <= 0 {
		r = 100
	}
	switch name {
	case "radar_self":
		s := w.snapshot(0, 0)
		if s.Self == nil {
			return map[string]any{"self": nil, "note": "no world entry seen yet"}, nil
		}
		me := toAround(*s.Self, nil)
		type questOut struct {
			ID       int32   `json:"id"`
			Progress []int32 `json:"progress,omitempty"`
			*questInfo
		}
		qs := []questOut{}
		for _, q := range s.Quests {
			qs = append(qs, questOut{q.ID, q.P, questNames[q.ID]})
		}
		return map[string]any{"map": s.Map, "clock": s.Clock, "self": me, "facing": s.Self.O, "level": s.Level,
			"race": s.Race, "quests": qs, "threats": s.Threats}, nil
	case "radar_around":
		s := w.snapshot(r, 0)
		return map[string]any{"map": s.Map, "clock": s.Clock, "radius": r, "objects": pick(s, a.Kind, "", a.Alive, a.Limit, nil)}, nil
	case "radar_find":
		if a.Name == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("radar_find needs a name")
		}
		s := w.snapshot(math.Inf(1), 0)
		return map[string]any{"clock": s.Clock, "matches": pick(s, a.Kind, a.Name, false, a.Limit, nil)}, nil
	case "radar_quest_givers":
		s := w.snapshot(r, 0)
		return map[string]any{"clock": s.Clock, "givers": pick(s, "unit", "", true, 100, func(e ent) bool { return e.QGiver != "" })}, nil
	case "radar_nodes":
		if a.Radius <= 0 {
			r = nodeRadius
		}
		s := w.snapshot(0, r)
		return map[string]any{"clock": s.Clock, "nodes": s.Nodes}, nil
	case "radar_status":
		s := w.snapshot(math.Inf(1), 0)
		return map[string]any{"clock": s.Clock, "map": s.Map, "has_self": s.Self != nil, "objects": len(s.Objects), "stats": s.Stats}, nil
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown tool %q", name)
}

func mcpHandler(w *world, nodeRadius float64) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(rw http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
			rw.Header().Set("Allow", "POST")
			http.Error(rw, "POST JSON-RPC here", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
			return
		}
		var req rpcReq
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
			writeRPC(rw, nil, nil, &rpcErr{-32700, "parse error: " + err.Error()})
			return
		}
		if len(req.ID) == 0 { // a notification
			rw.WriteHeader(http.StatusAccepted)
			return
		}
		switch req.Method {
		case "initialize":
			var p struct {
				ProtocolVersion string `json:"protocolVersion"`
			}
			_ = json.Unmarshal(req.Params, &p)
			v := p.ProtocolVersion
			if v == "" {
				v = mcpProtocol
			}
			writeRPC(rw, req.ID, map[string]any{"protocolVersion": v, "capabilities": map[string]any{"tools": map[string]any{}},
				"serverInfo": map[string]any{"name": "wow-radar", "version": "0.1"}, "instructions": mcpInstructions}, nil)
		case "ping":
			writeRPC(rw, req.ID, map[string]any{}, nil)
		case "tools/list":
			writeRPC(rw, req.ID, map[string]any{"tools": mcpTools}, nil)
		case "tools/call":
			var p struct {
				Name      string  `json:"name"`
				Arguments mcpArgs `json:"arguments"`
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal(req.Params, &p); err != nil {
				writeRPC(rw, req.ID, nil, &rpcErr{-32602, err.Error()})
				return
			}
			out, err := w.callTool(p.Name, p.Arguments, nodeRadius)
			if err != nil {
				writeRPC(rw, req.ID, map[string]any{"isError": true, "content": []map[string]any{{"type": "text", "text": err.Error()}}}, nil)
				return
			}
			b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", " ")
			writeRPC(rw, req.ID, map[string]any{"content": []map[string]any{{"type": "text", "text": string(b)}}}, nil)
		default:
			writeRPC(rw, req.ID, nil, &rpcErr{-32601, "method not found: " + req.Method})
		}
	}
}

func writeRPC(rw http.ResponseWriter, id json.RawMessage, result any, e *rpcErr) {
	rw.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	resp := map[string]any{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": id}
	if id == nil {
		resp["id"] = nil
	}
	if e != nil {
		resp["error"] = e
	} else {
		resp["result"] = result
	}
	json.NewEncoder(rw).Encode(resp)
}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/codec"
)

func rpc(t *testing.T, h http.Handler, body string) (int, map[string]any) {
	t.Helper()
	rr := httptest.NewRecorder()
	h.ServeHTTP(rr, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/mcp", strings.NewReader(body)))
	var out map[string]any
	if rr.Body.Len() > 0 {
		if err := json.Unmarshal(rr.Body.Bytes(), &out); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", rr.Body.String(), err)
		}
	}
	return rr.Code, out
}

func TestMCP(t *testing.T) {
	w := newWorld(1)
	me, rabbit, sten := codec.GUID{Lo: 3}, codec.GUID{Hi: 1, Lo: 1}, codec.GUID{Hi: 1, Lo: 2}
	w.self = me
	w.ents[me] = &ent{GUID: "me", Kind: "player", X: 0, Y: 0}
	w.ents[rabbit] = &ent{GUID: "r", Kind: "unit", Entry: 721, X: 3, Y: 4}
	w.ents[sten] = &ent{GUID: "s", Kind: "unit", Entry: 658, X: 300, Y: 0}
	w.names[721], w.names[658] = "Rabbit", "Sten Stoutarm"
	h := mcpHandler(w, 400)

	if code, _ := rpc(t, h, `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/initialized"}`); code != http.StatusAccepted {
		t.Fatalf("notification: %d", code)
	}
	_, init := rpc(t, h, `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-03-26"}}`)
	if v := init["result"].(map[string]any)["protocolVersion"]; v != "2025-03-26" {
		t.Fatalf("protocol %v", v)
	}
	_, list := rpc(t, h, `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list"}`)
	if n := len(list["result"].(map[string]any)["tools"].([]any)); n != len(mcpTools) {
		t.Fatalf("%d tools", n)
	}

	text := func(name, args string) string {
		_, r := rpc(t, h, `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"`+name+`","arguments":`+args+`}}`)
		return r["result"].(map[string]any)["content"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["text"].(string)
	}
	if s := text("radar_around", `{"radius":50}`); !strings.Contains(s, `"Rabbit"`) || !strings.Contains(s, `"dist": 5`) || strings.Contains(s, "Sten") {
		t.Fatalf("around: %s", s)
	}
	if s := text("radar_find", `{"name":"STEN"}`); !strings.Contains(s, `"dist": 300`) {
		t.Fatalf("find: %s", s)
	}
	_, bad := rpc(t, h, `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":4,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"nope"}}`)
	if bad["result"].(map[string]any)["isError"] != true {
		t.Fatalf("unknown tool: %v", bad)
	}
}
```

`radar/nodes.go`:

```go
package main

// Herb and ore nodes. Every node spawn point in forever.db (tools/nodes-export.py
// writes nodes.json with world coordinates) plus every node the server shows
// us becomes a spot, and each spot carries what we know about it:
//
//	up       the server is showing a node there now
//	empty    we are close enough that the server would show one, and it does not
//	gone     we saw it gathered (destroyed, or it vanished well inside view range)
//	seen     up when we last saw it, now out of view
//	unknown  never been near it
//
// A spot remembers when it was gathered and when we last saw it empty, and
// the time from gathered to up again at the same spot is measured, so the
// radar can count down to the respawn. With -seen (live only) that survives
// restarts.

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"math"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

var herbs = []string{
	"Peacebloom", "Silverleaf", "Earthroot", "Mageroyal", "Briarthorn", "Stranglekelp", "Bruiseweed",
	"Wild Steelbloom", "Grave Moss", "Kingsblood", "Liferoot", "Fadeleaf", "Goldthorn", "Khadgar's Whisker",
	"Wintersbite", "Firebloom", "Purple Lotus", "Arthas' Tears", "Sungrass", "Blindweed", "Ghost Mushroom",
	"Gromsblood", "Golden Sansam", "Dreamfoil", "Mountain Silversage", "Plaguebloom", "Icecap", "Black Lotus",
	"Swiftthistle", "Wildvine",
}

// nodeKind is "herb", "ore" or "" for a game object's name. Forever's own
// entries ("Wilted Peacebloom", "Poor Copper Vein") count.
func nodeKind(name string) string {
	switch {
	case name == "":
		return ""
	case strings.HasSuffix(name, " Vein"), strings.HasSuffix(name, " Deposit"):
		return "ore"
	}
	for _, h := range herbs {
		if strings.Contains(name, h) {
			return "herb"
		}
	}
	return ""
}

const (
	spotMatch = 8.0  // yards: a live node this close to a known spawn is that spawn
	cellSize  = 64.0 // the spot index's grid
)

type spot struct {
	Key     string    `json:"-"`
	Map     uint16    `json:"m"`
	X       float32   `json:"x"`
	Y       float32   `json:"y"`
	Z       float32   `json:"z,omitempty"`
	HasZ    bool      `json:"hz,omitempty"`
	Name    string    `json:"n"`
	Kind    string    `json:"k"`
	Gone    time.Time `json:"gone,omitempty"`    // gathered, as we watched
	Checked time.Time `json:"checked,omitempty"` // last seen empty
	Seen    time.Time `json:"seen,omitempty"`    // last seen up
	Respawn []float64 `json:"respawn,omitempty"` // measured gathered -> up again, seconds
	live    string    // the GUID of the node showing here now
	known   bool      // from nodes.json
}

type nodes struct {
	entries map[uint32]string
	spots   map[string]*spot
	cells   map[[3]int32][]*spot // map, cell x, cell y
	dirty   bool
}

func newNodes() *nodes {
	return &nodes{entries: map[uint32]string{}, spots: map[string]*spot{}, cells: map[[3]int32][]*spot{}}
}

func cellOf(m uint16, x, y float32) [3]int32 {
	return [3]int32{int32(m), int32(math.Floor(float64(x) / cellSize)), int32(math.Floor(float64(y) / cellSize))}
}

func spotKey(m uint16, x, y float32) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d:%.0f:%.0f", m, math.Round(float64(x)/2)*2, math.Round(float64(y)/2)*2)
}

func (n *nodes) add(s *spot) *spot {
	if s.Key == "" {
		s.Key = spotKey(s.Map, s.X, s.Y)
	}
	if old := n.spots[s.Key]; old != nil {
		return old
	}
	n.spots[s.Key] = s
	c := cellOf(s.Map, s.X, s.Y)
	n.cells[c] = append(n.cells[c], s)
	return s
}

// near calls fn for every spot within r yards of (x, y) on map m.
func (n *nodes) near(m uint16, x, y float32, r float64, fn func(s *spot, d float64)) {
	lo, hi := cellOf(m, x-float32(r), y-float32(r)), cellOf(m, x+float32(r), y+float32(r))
	for cx := lo[1]; cx <= hi[1]; cx++ {
		for cy := lo[2]; cy <= hi[2]; cy++ {
			for _, s := range n.cells[[3]int32{int32(m), cx, cy}] {
				if d := math.Hypot(float64(s.X-x), float64(s.Y-y)); d <= r {
					fn(s, d)
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

// load reads nodes.json (tools/nodes-export.py).
func (n *nodes) load(path string) error {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var f struct {
		Entries map[string]string `json:"entries"`
		Spawns  []struct {
			M uint16  `json:"m"`
			N string  `json:"n"`
			X float32 `json:"x"`
			Y float32 `json:"y"`
		} `json:"spawns"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &f); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for k, v := range f.Entries {
		var id uint32
		fmt.Sscan(k, &id)
		n.entries[id] = v
	}
	for _, s := range f.Spawns {
		n.add(&spot{Map: s.M, X: s.X, Y: s.Y, Name: s.N, Kind: nodeKind(s.N), known: true})
	}
	return nil
}

// loadSeen merges what earlier sessions learned (-seen).
func (n *nodes) loadSeen(path string) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	var saved []spot
	if json.Unmarshal(b, &saved) != nil {
		return
	}
	for i := range saved {
		s := saved[i]
		t := n.add(&s)
		if t != &s { // a known spawn: take the history
			t.Gone, t.Checked, t.Seen, t.Respawn = s.Gone, s.Checked, s.Seen, s.Respawn
			if s.HasZ {
				t.Z, t.HasZ = s.Z, true
			}
		}
	}
}

func (n *nodes) save(path string) {
	if !n.dirty || path == "" {
		return
	}
	var out []spot
	for _, s := range n.spots {
		if !s.Gone.IsZero() || !s.Checked.IsZero() || !s.Seen.IsZero() || !s.known {
			out = append(out, *s)
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Key < out[j].Key })
	b, _ := json.Marshal(out)
	if err := os.WriteFile(path+".tmp", b, 0o644); err == nil {
		os.Rename(path+".tmp", path)
		n.dirty = false
	} else {
		log.Printf("nodes: %v", err)
	}
}

// up: the server shows a node: match it to a spot and mark it up. A spot that
// was gathered and is up again gives one respawn measurement.
func (n *nodes) up(guid string, m uint16, name string, x, y, z float32, t time.Time) *spot {
	var best *spot
	bd := spotMatch
	n.near(m, x, y, spotMatch, func(s *spot, d float64) {
		if d < bd && (s.live == "" || s.live == guid) {
			best, bd = s, d
		}
	})
	if best == nil {
		best = n.add(&spot{Map: m, X: x, Y: y, Name: name, Kind: nodeKind(name)})
	}
	best.Name, best.Kind = name, nodeKind(name)
	best.Z, best.HasZ = z, true
	if !best.Gone.IsZero() {
		if d := t.Sub(best.Gone).Seconds(); d > 10 && d < 6*3600 {
			best.Respawn = append(best.Respawn, d)
			if len(best.Respawn) > 8 {
				best.Respawn = best.Respawn[1:]
			}
		}
		best.Gone = time.Time{}
	}
	best.live, best.Seen = guid, t
	n.dirty = true
	return best
}

// down: the node at s is no longer shown. gathered says it went while we were
// close enough that it can only have been gathered (or despawned).
func (n *nodes) down(s *spot, guid string, gathered bool, t time.Time) {
	if s == nil || s.live != guid {
		return
	}
	s.live = ""
	if gathered {
		s.Gone = t
	} else {
		s.Seen = t // still up as it left view
	}
	n.dirty = true
}

// respawnFor is the typical respawn of nodes of this name: the median of every
// measurement at any spot of that name, or 0 if none yet.
func (n *nodes) respawnFor(name string) float64 {
	var all []float64
	for _, s := range n.spots {
		if s.Name == name {
			all = append(all, s.Respawn...)
		}
	}
	if len(all) == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	sort.Float64s(all)
	return all[len(all)/2]
}

type nodeOut struct {
	Name  string  `json:"n"`
	Kind  string  `json:"k"`
	X     float32 `json:"x"`
	Y     float32 `json:"y"`
	Z     float32 `json:"z"`
	HasZ  bool    `json:"hz,omitempty"`
	State string  `json:"st"`            // up, empty, gone, seen, unknown
	Ago   float64 `json:"ago,omitempty"` // seconds since gathered (gone), last checked (empty) or last seen up (seen)
	ETA   float64 `json:"eta,omitempty"` // seconds to the expected respawn, if measured
	D     float64 `json:"d"`
}

// view lists the spots within r of us. Spots inside vis yards with no node
// showing are marked checked: the server would be showing one.
func (n *nodes) view(m uint16, x, y float32, r, vis float64, now time.Time) []nodeOut {
	var out []nodeOut
	resp := map[string]float64{}
	n.near(m, x, y, r, func(s *spot, d float64) {
		o := nodeOut{Name: s.Name, Kind: s.Kind, X: s.X, Y: s.Y, Z: s.Z, HasZ: s.HasZ, D: math.Round(d*10) / 10}
		switch {
		case s.live != "":
			o.State = "up"
		case d < vis && !now.IsZero():
			if s.Checked.Before(now.Add(-5 * time.Second)) {
				n.dirty = true
			}
			s.Checked = now
			o.State = "empty"
		case !s.Gone.IsZero():
			o.State = "gone"
		case s.Seen.After(s.Checked):
			o.State = "seen"
		case !s.Checked.IsZero():
			o.State = "empty"
		default:
			o.State = "unknown"
		}
		if o.State != "up" {
			from := s.Checked
			if o.State == "seen" {
				from = s.Seen
			}
			if !s.Gone.IsZero() {
				from = s.Gone
				if o.State == "empty" {
					o.State = "gone" // gathered and not back yet
				}
			}
			if !from.IsZero() {
				o.Ago = math.Round(now.Sub(from).Seconds())
			}
			if !s.Gone.IsZero() {
				rs, ok := resp[s.Name]
				if !ok {
					rs = n.respawnFor(s.Name)
					resp[s.Name] = rs
				}
				if rs > 0 {
					o.ETA = math.Max(0, math.Round(rs-now.Sub(s.Gone).Seconds()))
				}
			}
		}
		out = append(out, o)
	})
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].D < out[j].D })
	return out
}
```

`radar/nodes_test.go`:

```go
package main

import (
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestNodeKind(t *testing.T) {
	for name, want := range map[string]string{
		"Peacebloom": "herb", "Wilted Peacebloom": "herb", "Khadgar's Whisker": "herb",
		"Copper Vein": "ore", "Poor Copper Vein": "ore", "Ooze Covered Mithril Deposit": "ore",
		"Mailbox": "", "": "", "Old Lion Statue": "",
	} {
		if got := nodeKind(name); got != want {
			t.Errorf("nodeKind(%q) = %q, want %q", name, got, want)
		}
	}
}

func stateAt(n *nodes, x, y float32, now time.Time) nodeOut {
	for _, o := range n.view(0, x, y, 500, 90, now) {
		if o.D < 1 {
			return o
		}
	}
	return nodeOut{State: "missing"}
}

// A known spawn goes unknown -> up -> gone -> (respawn measured) -> up,
// and a second gather counts down from the measured respawn.
func TestSpotLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	n := newNodes()
	n.add(&spot{Map: 0, X: 100, Y: 100, Name: "Peacebloom", Kind: "herb", known: true})
	t0 := time.Date(2026, 11, 5, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	far := func(now time.Time) nodeOut { // looked at from 300 yd: outside view range
		o := n.view(0, 400, 100, 500, 90, now)
		return o[0]
	}
	if o := far(t0); o.State != "unknown" {
		t.Fatalf("before = %s, want unknown", o.State)
	}
	s := n.up("g1", 0, "Wilted Peacebloom", 103, 101, 50, t0) // 3 yd off: the same spot
	if !s.known || s.Name != "Wilted Peacebloom" {
		t.Fatalf("live node not matched to the known spawn: %+v", s)
	}
	if o := stateAt(n, 100, 100, t0); o.State != "up" {
		t.Fatalf("up = %s", o.State)
	}
	n.down(s, "g1", true, t0.Add(time.Minute))
	if o := far(t0.Add(2 * time.Minute)); o.State != "gone" || o.Ago != 60 || o.ETA != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("gone = %+v", o)
	}
	n.up("g2", 0, "Wilted Peacebloom", 103, 101, 50, t0.Add(6*time.Minute)) // back after 5 min
	if got := n.respawnFor("Wilted Peacebloom"); got != 300 {
		t.Fatalf("respawn = %v, want 300", got)
	}
	n.down(s, "g2", true, t0.Add(10*time.Minute))
	if o := far(t0.Add(12 * time.Minute)); o.State != "gone" || o.ETA != 180 {
		t.Fatalf("second gather = %+v, want gone with 180 s to go", o)
	}
}

// Out of range from far away is not a gather: the spot is "seen" (last up).
// Standing inside view range with nothing showing marks it empty.
func TestSeenAndEmpty(t *testing.T) {
	n := newNodes()
	t0 := time.Date(2026, 11, 5, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	s := n.up("g1", 0, "Copper Vein", 0, 0, 0, t0)
	n.down(s, "g1", false, t0.Add(time.Second))
	o := n.view(0, 200, 0, 500, 90, t0.Add(31*time.Second))[0]
	if o.State != "seen" || o.Ago != 30 {
		t.Fatalf("seen = %+v", o)
	}
	if o := n.view(0, 50, 0, 500, 90, t0.Add(40*time.Second))[0]; o.State != "empty" {
		t.Fatalf("inside view range = %+v, want empty", o)
	}
	if o := n.view(0, 200, 0, 500, 90, t0.Add(100*time.Second))[0]; o.State != "empty" || o.Ago != 60 {
		t.Fatalf("after = %+v, want empty checked 60 s ago", o)
	}
}

// What earlier sessions learned comes back onto the known spawns.
func TestSeenRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	path := t.TempDir() + "/seen.json"
	t0 := time.Date(2026, 11, 5, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	a := newNodes()
	a.add(&spot{Map: 0, X: 10, Y: 10, Name: "Tin Vein", Kind: "ore", known: true})
	s := a.up("g", 0, "Tin Vein", 10, 10, 5, t0)
	a.down(s, "g", true, t0.Add(time.Minute))
	a.save(path)
	b := newNodes()
	b.add(&spot{Map: 0, X: 10, Y: 10, Name: "Tin Vein", Kind: "ore", known: true})
	b.loadSeen(path)
	if len(b.spots) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("%d spots, want the one known spawn", len(b.spots))
	}
	for _, s := range b.spots {
		if !s.Gone.Equal(t0.Add(time.Minute)) || !s.HasZ {
			t.Fatalf("history lost: %+v", s)
		}
	}
}

```

`radar/overlay.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""radar overlay: a heading-up radar drawn over the game, fed by the radar (main.go).

A transparent, click-through window that follows the WoW window (shown only
while WoW is the front app) and draws, from the server's own positions:

  - a round radar that turns with you (up = where you face), rings every
    RANGE/4 yards: players as big blue arrows pointing where they face,
    creatures as small orange dots, moving ones with a line to where they
    are heading. Players beyond the ring sit on its edge, with their distance.
  - a list of the nearest players: name, distance, height difference, and
    an arrow toward them.

Levelling mode (the default on Forever, where the update fields decode):
  - creatures coloured by con (grey, green, yellow, orange, red against your level),
    friendlies faint, critters hidden; elites ringed silver, rares purple
  - your quest targets ringed gold with their count ("Tough Wolf Meat 3/8"): mobs you
    must kill, mobs that drop a quest item, objects to loot or use (from forever.db)
  - quest givers as the client draws them: yellow ! (new quest), yellow ? (turn in),
    grey ! (low level)
  - a list of the nearest quest targets and quest givers, with direction and distance
On retail (no levels or quest log yet) it falls back to the player radar.

Gathering and safety (both modes):
  - every herb (green diamond) and ore (copper square) spot: filled when up, hollow with a
    timer when gathered ("1:20" to the measured respawn, or "4m" since), faint when out of
    view; the nearest up ones listed under the radar, the nearest beyond the ring on its edge
  - enemy players (the other faction, Forever) in red with level and class, a warning line
    above the radar for anyone near or closing in, and a chime when one first gets there

Reads http://127.0.0.1:8791/state (start the radar first).

    python3 overlay.py
    python3 overlay.py --range 150 --players-only --corner bl

--range Y      yards to the radar's edge (default 200: about as far as the server sends)
--players-only no creatures
--objects      also game objects
--corner C     tr (default), tl, br, bl
--size PX      radar diameter (default 300)
--heads        experimental: arrows over players' heads, assuming a fixed chase camera (--cam-*).
               Off unless your camera matches: the network carries your facing, not the camera
               (E54; mirroring the camera from mouse input drifted too far to use).
--heads-only   just the head arrows
--always       show on the main screen even without a WoW window (to try it)
--nodes K      herb, ore or all (default); --no-nodes for none
--no-chime     no sound for enemy players
--shot F       save a PNG of the overlay to F (after --after S seconds), then quit
"""

import argparse
import json
import math
import threading
import time
import urllib.request

import AppKit
import objc
import Quartz
from Foundation import NSObject, NSTimer

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("--url", default="http://127.0.0.1:8791/state")
ap.add_argument("--range", type=float, help="yards to the radar's edge (default 100 levelling, 200 players)")
ap.add_argument("--mode", default="auto", choices=["auto", "level", "players"])
ap.add_argument("--as-level", type=int, help="con colours as if you were this level (preview)")
ap.add_argument("--db", default=__import__("os").environ.get("WOW_FOREVER_DB", __import__("os").path.expanduser("~/wow/host/data/forever.db")))
ap.add_argument("--players-only", action="store_true")
ap.add_argument("--objects", action="store_true")
ap.add_argument("--corner", default="tr", choices=["tr", "tl", "br", "bl"])
ap.add_argument("--size", type=float, default=300)
ap.add_argument("--heads", action="store_true", help="arrows over players' heads in the 3D view")
ap.add_argument("--heads-only", action="store_true", help="just the head arrows, no radar")
ap.add_argument("--cam-dist", type=float, default=39.0, help="camera zoom in yards (max zoom = 15 x cameraDistanceMaxZoomFactor)")
ap.add_argument("--cam-pitch", type=float, default=26.5, help="camera pitch, degrees down")
ap.add_argument("--cam-yaw", type=float, default=0.0, help="camera yaw relative to your facing, degrees (0: behind you)")
ap.add_argument("--vfov", type=float, default=53.5, help="vertical field of view, degrees")
ap.add_argument("--cam-height", type=float, default=2.7, help="camera target above your feet, yards")
ap.add_argument("--head", type=float, default=3.3, help="arrow height above a player's feet, yards")
ap.add_argument("--always", action="store_true")
ap.add_argument("--nodes", default="all", choices=["all", "herb", "ore"])
ap.add_argument("--no-nodes", action="store_true")
ap.add_argument("--no-chime", action="store_true")
ap.add_argument("--shot")
ap.add_argument("--after", type=float, default=4)
A = ap.parse_args()
RANGE_SET = A.range is not None

PLAYER = (0.30, 0.79, 0.94)
UNIT = (0.97, 0.55, 0.42)
GO = (0.48, 0.83, 0.54)
SELF = (1.0, 0.82, 0.40)
DIM = (0.55, 0.60, 0.65)
LABELS = 10  # the nearest players get a name on the radar and a row in the list

# --- levelling: forever.db joined with the radar's quest log --------------------------

GOLD = (1.0, 0.82, 0.25)
GREY = (0.6, 0.6, 0.6)
ALLIANCE = {1, 3, 4, 7, 11, 22, 25, 29, 30, 32, 34, 37, 52}


class DB:
    def __init__(self, path):
        import sqlite3
        self.ok = False
        try:
            c = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{path}?mode=ro", uri=True, check_same_thread=False)
        except Exception:
            return
        q = lambda sql: c.execute(sql).fetchall()
        self.npcs = {i: (n, lo, hi, rank or "", ra, rh, typ or "") for i, n, lo, hi, rank, ra, rh, typ in
                     q("select id, name, minlevel, maxlevel, rank, react_alliance, react_horde, type from npcs")}
        self.objects = dict(q("select id, name from objects"))
        self.items = dict(q("select id, name from items"))
        self.quests = {i: (n, et, ei) for i, n, et, ei in q("select id, name, end_type, end_id from quests")}
        self.objs = {}
        for quest, storage, typ, target, amount in q("select quest, storage, type, target, amount from tc_quest_objectives"):
            self.objs.setdefault(quest, []).append((storage, typ, target, amount))
        self.droppers = {}
        for npc, item in q("select npc, item from loot where kind = 'drop'"):
            self.droppers.setdefault(item, set()).add(npc)
        self.containers = {}
        for obj, item in q("select object, item from object_loot"):
            self.containers.setdefault(item, set()).add(obj)
        self.ok = True


DBX = DB(A.db)


def grey_level(lvl):
    if lvl <= 5:
        return 0
    if lvl <= 39:
        return lvl - lvl // 10 - 5
    if lvl <= 59:
        return lvl - lvl // 5 - 1
    return lvl - 9


def con(mob, me):
    d = mob - me
    if d >= 5:
        return (1.0, 0.15, 0.15)
    if d >= 3:
        return (1.0, 0.5, 0.15)
    if d >= -2:
        return (1.0, 0.9, 0.2)
    if mob > grey_level(me):
        return (0.25, 0.85, 0.3)
    return GREY


def quest_targets(quests):
    """npc entry / object entry -> (label, quest name) for every objective still open."""
    npc, obj = {}, {}
    if not DBX.ok:
        return npc, obj
    for q in quests:
        qname = DBX.quests.get(q["id"], ("Quest %d" % q["id"],))[0]
        prog = q.get("p") or []
        for storage, typ, target, amount in DBX.objs.get(q["id"], []):
            have = prog[storage] if storage < len(prog) else 0
            if amount and have >= amount:
                continue  # done
            cnt = f" {have}/{amount}" if amount > 1 else ""
            if typ == 0:  # kill
                npc[target] = (DBX.npcs.get(target, (f"#{target}",))[0] + cnt, qname)
            elif typ == 1:  # item: who drops it, what holds it
                item = DBX.items.get(target, f"item {target}")
                for n in DBX.droppers.get(target, ()):
                    npc.setdefault(n, (f"{item}{cnt}", qname))
                for o in DBX.containers.get(target, ()):
                    obj.setdefault(o, (f"{item}{cnt}", qname))
            elif typ == 2:  # use an object
                obj[target] = (DBX.objects.get(target, f"#{target}") + cnt, qname)
    return npc, obj


def bang(x, y, ch, rgb, size=15):
    t = text(ch, size, rgb, 1, AppKit.NSFontWeightHeavy)
    t.drawAtPoint_((x - t.size().width / 2, y - t.size().height / 2))


def ring(x, y, r, rgb, alpha=1.0, width=1.5):
    p = AppKit.NSBezierPath.bezierPathWithOvalInRect_(((x - r, y - r), (2 * r, 2 * r)))
    color(rgb, alpha).setStroke()
    p.setLineWidth_(width)
    p.stroke()


def draw_level(s, cx, cy, R, rng):
    me = s["self"]
    lvl = A.as_level or s.get("level") or 1
    side = "react_alliance" if (s.get("race") or 1) in ALLIANCE else "react_horde"
    tnpc, tobj = quest_targets(s.get("quests") or [])
    scale = R / rng
    ups = draw_nodes(s, cx, cy, R, rng)
    rows = []  # (distance, angle, rgb, title, sub)
    marks = []
    for o in s.get("objects") or []:
        d, dz, ang = rel(me, o)
        k, e = o["k"], o.get("e", 0)
        if k == "player":
            if d <= rng and not o.get("hostile"):
                x, y = to_screen(cx, cy, scale, d, ang)
                arrow(x, y, o["o"] - me["o"], 5, PLAYER, 0.6)
            continue
        if k == "unit":
            info = DBX.npcs.get(e) if DBX.ok else None
            name = o.get("n") or (info[0] if info else f"Creature {e}")
            target = tnpc.get(e)
            qs = o.get("qs")
            if o.get("dead") and not target:
                continue
            if target:
                rows.append((d, ang, GOLD, target[0], target[1]))
            elif qs in ("available", "turnin"):
                rows.append((d, ang, GOLD, name, "turn in" if qs == "turnin" else "new quest"))
            if d > rng:
                continue
            x, y = to_screen(cx, cy, scale, d, ang)
            react = (info[4] if side == "react_alliance" else info[5]) if info else "hostile"
            if qs:
                marks.append((x, y, "?" if qs == "turnin" else "!", GOLD if qs in ("available", "turnin") else GREY))
                continue
            if react == "friendly":
                dot(x, y, 1.6, GREY, 0.35)
                continue
            if info and info[6] == "critter" and not target:
                continue
            rgb = con(o.get("lvl") or (info[1] if info else lvl), lvl)
            if o.get("dead"):
                rgb = GREY
            r = 3.0
            # (forever.db's reactions say "neutral" for mobs that attack, so no hollow neutral style)
            dot(x, y, r, rgb, 0.95 if abs(dz) < 15 else 0.5)
            rank = info[3] if info else ""
            if "rare" in rank:
                ring(x, y, 6, (0.75, 0.45, 1.0), 1, 2)
            elif rank in ("elite", "boss"):
                ring(x, y, 6, (0.85, 0.85, 0.9), 0.9, 1.5)
            if target:
                ring(x, y, 7.5, GOLD, 1, 2)
            if o.get("m"):
                d2, _, a2 = rel(me, {"x": o["tx"], "y": o["ty"], "z": o["tz"]})
                x2, y2 = to_screen(cx, cy, scale, min(d2, rng), a2)
                p = AppKit.NSBezierPath.bezierPath()
                p.moveToPoint_((x, y))
                p.lineToPoint_((x2, y2))
                color(rgb, 0.4).setStroke()
                p.setLineWidth_(1)
                p.stroke()
        elif k == "gameobject":
            target = tobj.get(e)
            if not target:
                continue
            rows.append((d, ang, GOLD, target[0], target[1]))
            if d <= rng:
                x, y = to_screen(cx, cy, scale, d, ang)
                color(GOLD, 0.95).setFill()
                AppKit.NSBezierPath.bezierPathWithRect_(((x - 3, y - 3), (6, 6))).fill()
                ring(x, y, 7.5, GOLD, 1, 2)
    for x, y, ch, rgb in marks:  # quest givers on top
        bang(x, y, ch, rgb)
    draw_threats(s, cx, cy, R, rng)
    arrow(cx, cy, 0, 8, SELF)

    # the list: nearest quest targets and givers, one row per kind of thing
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: r[0])
    seen, out = set(), []
    for r in rows:
        if r[3] not in seen:
            seen.add(r[3])
            out.append(r)
    y = cy - R - 22
    hdr = text(f"LEVEL {lvl}   QUESTS {len(s.get('quests') or [])}", 11, DIM, 1, AppKit.NSFontWeightSemibold)
    hdr.drawAtPoint_((cx - R, y))
    if not out:
        y -= 18
        text("nothing for your quests nearby", 12, DIM).drawAtPoint_((cx - R, y))
    for d, ang, rgb, title_, sub in out[:7]:
        y -= 30
        a = text(f"{compass(ang)}  {title_}", 12.5, rgb, 1, AppKit.NSFontWeightSemibold)
        a.drawAtPoint_((cx - R, y + 12))
        dist = text(f"{d:.0f} yd", 12, (0.9, 0.93, 0.95))
        dist.drawAtPoint_((cx + R - dist.size().width, y + 12))
        text(sub, 10.5, DIM).drawAtPoint_((cx - R + 18, y))
    draw_node_list(ups, cx - R, y, R)


# --- gathering nodes and enemy players ----------------------------------------------

HERB = (0.35, 0.95, 0.45)
ORE = (0.95, 0.62, 0.30)
RED = (1.0, 0.28, 0.25)


def clock(sec):
    sec = int(sec)
    if sec >= 3600:
        return f"{sec // 3600}h"
    if sec >= 600:
        return f"{sec // 60}m"
    return f"{sec // 60}:{sec % 60:02d}"


def node_shape(x, y, kind, size, rgb, alpha, filled):
    p = AppKit.NSBezierPath.bezierPath()
    if kind == "herb":  # diamond
        p.moveToPoint_((x, y + size))
        p.lineToPoint_((x + size, y))
        p.lineToPoint_((x, y - size))
        p.lineToPoint_((x - size, y))
        p.closePath()
    else:
        s = size * 0.8
        p.appendBezierPathWithRect_(((x - s, y - s), (2 * s, 2 * s)))
    if filled:
        color(rgb, alpha).setFill()
        p.fill()
        color((0, 0, 0), 0.7 * alpha).setStroke()
        p.setLineWidth_(1)
    else:
        color(rgb, alpha).setStroke()
        p.setLineWidth_(1.4)
    p.stroke()


def draw_nodes(s, cx, cy, R, rng):
    """The node spots on the radar. Returns the nearest up ones for the list."""
    if A.no_nodes:
        return []
    me, scale = s["self"], R / rng
    ups, rim = [], 0
    for n in s.get("nodes") or []:
        if A.nodes != "all" and n["k"] != A.nodes:
            continue
        rgb = HERB if n["k"] == "herb" else ORE
        d, dz, ang = rel(me, dict(n, z=n["z"] if n.get("hz") else me["z"]))
        st = n["st"]
        if st == "up":
            ups.append((d, ang, n))
        if d > rng:
            if st == "up" and rim < 3:  # the nearest few beyond the ring, on its edge
                rim += 1
                x, y = to_screen(cx, cy, scale, rng, ang)
                node_shape(x, y, n["k"], 4, rgb, 0.75, True)
            continue
        x, y = to_screen(cx, cy, scale, d, ang)
        if st == "up":
            node_shape(x, y, n["k"], 5, rgb, 1.0 if abs(dz) < 15 else 0.6, True)
        elif st == "gone":
            node_shape(x, y, n["k"], 4.5, rgb, 0.8, False)
            label = clock(n["eta"]) if n.get("eta") else (clock(n["ago"]) + " ago" if n.get("ago") else "")
            if label:
                text(label, 9.5, rgb, 0.9).drawAtPoint_((x + 6, y - 6))
        elif st == "seen":
            node_shape(x, y, n["k"], 4, rgb, 0.55, False)
        elif st == "empty":
            node_shape(x, y, n["k"], 3, rgb, 0.25, False)
        else:  # unknown
            dot(x, y, 1.3, rgb, 0.35)
    return ups


def draw_node_list(ups, x0, y, R):
    if A.no_nodes:
        return y
    y -= 26
    text(f"NODES UP  {len(ups)}", 11, DIM, 1, AppKit.NSFontWeightSemibold).drawAtPoint_((x0, y))
    for d, ang, n in ups[:3]:
        y -= 18
        rgb = HERB if n["k"] == "herb" else ORE
        text(f"{compass(ang)}  {n['n']}", 12.5, rgb, 1, AppKit.NSFontWeightSemibold).drawAtPoint_((x0, y))
        dist = text(f"{d:.0f} yd", 12, (0.9, 0.93, 0.95))
        dist.drawAtPoint_((x0 + 2 * R - dist.size().width, y))
    return y


warned = {"guids": set(), "chimed": 0.0}


def draw_threats(s, cx, cy, R, rng):
    """Enemy players in red on the radar, the nearest warning above it, a chime on a new one."""
    me, scale = s["self"], R / rng
    th = s.get("threats") or []
    by = {t["g"]: t for t in th}
    for o in s.get("objects") or []:
        t = by.get(o["g"])
        if not t:
            continue
        d, dz, ang = rel(me, o)
        x, y = to_screen(cx, cy, scale, min(d, rng), ang)
        arrow(x, y, o["o"] - me["o"], 9 if t.get("warn") else 7, RED, 1 if d <= rng else 0.6)
        lbl = f"{t.get('lvl') or '?'} {t.get('cls') or ''}".strip()
        text(f"{lbl} {d:.0f}", 10.5, RED, 0.95, AppKit.NSFontWeightSemibold).drawAtPoint_((x + 9, y - 6))
    warn = [t for t in th if t.get("warn")]
    now = set(t["g"] for t in warn)
    new = now - warned["guids"]
    warned["guids"] = now
    if new and not A.no_chime and time.monotonic() - warned["chimed"] > 8:
        warned["chimed"] = time.monotonic()
        snd = AppKit.NSSound.soundNamed_("Sosumi")
        if snd:
            snd.play()
    if warn:
        t = warn[0]
        d, dz, ang = rel(me, next((o for o in s["objects"] if o["g"] == t["g"]), me))
        who = " ".join(str(v) for v in (t.get("lvl") or "?", t.get("race") or "", t.get("cls") or "") if v)
        move = f"closing {t['close']:.0f} yd/s" if t.get("close", 0) > 1 else ("moving away" if t.get("close", 0) < -1 else "")
        more = f"   +{len(warn) - 1}" if len(warn) > 1 else ""
        line = text(f"⚠  {who}  {compass(ang)} {t['d']:.0f} yd  {move}{more}", 13, RED, 1, AppKit.NSFontWeightBold)
        line.drawAtPoint_((cx - line.size().width / 2, cy + R + 8))


lock = threading.Lock()
state = {"snap": None, "err": None, "at": 0.0}


def poller():
    while True:
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(A.url, timeout=1) as r:
                s = json.load(r)
            with lock:
                state["snap"], state["err"], state["at"] = s, None, time.monotonic()
        except Exception as e:  # the radar restarts: keep trying
            with lock:
                state["err"] = str(e)
        time.sleep(0.1)


def font(size, weight=AppKit.NSFontWeightMedium):
    return AppKit.NSFont.monospacedDigitSystemFontOfSize_weight_(size, weight)


def text(s, size, rgb, alpha=1.0, weight=AppKit.NSFontWeightMedium):
    shadow = AppKit.NSShadow.alloc().init()
    shadow.setShadowOffset_((0, -1))
    shadow.setShadowBlurRadius_(2)
    shadow.setShadowColor_(AppKit.NSColor.colorWithWhite_alpha_(0, 0.9))
    attrs = {
        AppKit.NSFontAttributeName: font(size, weight),
        AppKit.NSForegroundColorAttributeName: AppKit.NSColor.colorWithRed_green_blue_alpha_(*rgb, alpha),
        AppKit.NSShadowAttributeName: shadow,
    }
    return AppKit.NSAttributedString.alloc().initWithString_attributes_(s, attrs)


def color(rgb, alpha=1.0):
    return AppKit.NSColor.colorWithRed_green_blue_alpha_(*rgb, alpha)


def rel(me, o):
    """Distance, height difference and angle from our facing (CCW, radians)."""
    dx, dy = o["x"] - me["x"], o["y"] - me["y"]
    d = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    return d, o["z"] - me["z"], math.atan2(dy, dx) - me["o"]


def to_screen(cx, cy, scale, d, ang):
    # heading-up: forward is up, counter-clockwise (toward WoW's +Y, west when facing north) is left
    return cx - d * scale * math.sin(ang), cy + d * scale * math.cos(ang)


def arrow(cx, cy, ang, size, rgb, alpha=1.0):
    """A filled arrowhead at (cx, cy) pointing at screen angle ang (0 = up, CCW positive)."""
    p = AppKit.NSBezierPath.bezierPath()
    pts = [(0, size), (-size * 0.6, -size * 0.6), (0, -size * 0.25), (size * 0.6, -size * 0.6)]
    s, c = math.sin(ang), math.cos(ang)
    for i, (x, y) in enumerate(pts):
        X, Y = cx + x * c - y * s, cy + x * s + y * c
        (p.moveToPoint_ if i == 0 else p.lineToPoint_)((X, Y))
    p.closePath()
    color(rgb, alpha).setFill()
    p.fill()
    color((0, 0, 0), 0.7).setStroke()
    p.setLineWidth_(1)
    p.stroke()


def dot(x, y, r, rgb, alpha=1.0):
    color(rgb, alpha).setFill()
    AppKit.NSBezierPath.bezierPathWithOvalInRect_(((x - r, y - r), (2 * r, 2 * r))).fill()


def compass(ang):
    arrows = "↑↖←↙↓↘→↗"
    return arrows[int(round((ang % (2 * math.pi)) / (math.pi / 4))) % 8]


def title(o):
    if o.get("n"):
        return o["n"]
    return {"player": "Player", "unit": f"Creature {o.get('e', '')}", "gameobject": "Object"}.get(o["k"], o["k"])


def project_heads(me, players, w, h):
    """World -> screen with a chase camera: target = us + cam-height, the
    camera dist back along yaw (our facing + the orbit offset), pitched down."""
    dist, pitch_deg, off = A.cam_dist, A.cam_pitch, math.radians(A.cam_yaw)
    yaw = me["o"] + off
    pitch = math.radians(pitch_deg)
    f = (math.cos(pitch) * math.cos(yaw), math.cos(pitch) * math.sin(yaw), -math.sin(pitch))
    r = (math.sin(yaw), -math.cos(yaw), 0.0)
    u = (r[1] * f[2] - r[2] * f[1], r[2] * f[0] - r[0] * f[2], r[0] * f[1] - r[1] * f[0])
    C = (me["x"] - f[0] * dist, me["y"] - f[1] * dist, me["z"] + A.cam_height - f[2] * dist)
    fo = (h / 2) / math.tan(math.radians(A.vfov) / 2)
    out = []
    for o in players:
        v = (o["x"] - C[0], o["y"] - C[1], o["z"] + A.head - C[2])
        z = v[0] * f[0] + v[1] * f[1] + v[2] * f[2]
        if z < 1:
            continue
        x = v[0] * r[0] + v[1] * r[1] + v[2] * r[2]
        y = v[0] * u[0] + v[1] * u[1] + v[2] * u[2]
        sx, sy = w / 2 + x / z * fo, h / 2 + y / z * fo  # non-flipped view: y up
        if -20 < sx < w + 20 and -20 < sy < h + 20:
            out.append((sx, sy, z, o))
    return out


def draw_heads(me, players, w, h):
    for sx, sy, z, o in sorted(project_heads(me, players, w, h), key=lambda t: -t[2]):
        d = math.hypot(o["x"] - me["x"], o["y"] - me["y"])
        k = max(0.55, min(1.0, 30 / max(z, 1)))  # nearer = bigger
        s = 9 * k
        p = AppKit.NSBezierPath.bezierPath()
        p.moveToPoint_((sx, sy))
        p.lineToPoint_((sx - s, sy + s * 1.6))
        p.lineToPoint_((sx + s, sy + s * 1.6))
        p.closePath()
        color(PLAYER, 0.95).setFill()
        p.fill()
        color((0, 0, 0), 0.8).setStroke()
        p.setLineWidth_(1)
        p.stroke()
        t = text(f"{title(o)}  {d:.0f} yd", 10 + 2 * k, PLAYER, 0.95, AppKit.NSFontWeightSemibold)
        t.drawAtPoint_((sx - t.size().width / 2, sy + s * 1.6 + 2))


class View(AppKit.NSView):
    def isFlipped(self):
        return False

    def drawRect_(self, rect):
        b = self.bounds()
        w, h = b.size.width, b.size.height
        with lock:
            s, err = state["snap"], state["err"]
        if (A.heads or A.heads_only) and s and s.get("self"):
            draw_heads(s["self"], [o for o in s.get("objects") or [] if o["k"] == "player"], w, h)
        if A.heads_only:
            return
        if not RANGE_SET:
            A.range = 100.0 if (A.mode == "level" or (A.mode == "auto" and s and s.get("level"))) else 200.0
        R = A.size / 2
        m = 24
        cx = w - m - R if A.corner in ("tr", "br") else m + R
        cy = h - m - R - 30 if A.corner in ("tr", "tl") else m + R + 30
        # backdrop and rings
        color((0.04, 0.06, 0.08), 0.55).setFill()
        AppKit.NSBezierPath.bezierPathWithOvalInRect_(((cx - R, cy - R), (2 * R, 2 * R))).fill()
        for i in (1, 2, 3, 4):
            r = R * i / 4
            p = AppKit.NSBezierPath.bezierPathWithOvalInRect_(((cx - r, cy - r), (2 * r, 2 * r)))
            color((1, 1, 1), 0.10 if i < 4 else 0.25).setStroke()
            p.setLineWidth_(1)
            p.stroke()
        t = text(f"{int(A.range)} yd", 10, DIM)
        t.drawAtPoint_((cx + R * 0.71 + 2, cy - R * 0.71 - 12))
        if s is None or s.get("self") is None:
            msg = "waiting for the radar…" if err else "waiting for you to move…"
            t = text(msg, 12, DIM)
            t.drawAtPoint_((cx - t.size().width / 2, cy - 6))
            return
        level_mode = A.mode == "level" or (A.mode == "auto" and s.get("level"))
        if level_mode:
            draw_level(s, cx, cy, R, A.range)
            return
        me = s["self"]
        scale = R / A.range
        # north marker on the rim
        nx, ny = to_screen(cx, cy, R / 1, 1, -me["o"])
        t = text("N", 11, DIM, 1, AppKit.NSFontWeightSemibold)
        t.drawAtPoint_((nx - t.size().width / 2, ny - t.size().height / 2))

        ups = draw_nodes(s, cx, cy, R, A.range)
        objs = s.get("objects") or []
        players = []
        # creatures and objects first, players on top
        for o in objs:
            k = o["k"]
            if k == "player":
                if not o.get("hostile"):
                    players.append(o)
                continue
            if k == "unit" and A.players_only:
                continue
            if k == "gameobject" and not A.objects:
                continue
            if k not in ("unit", "gameobject"):
                continue
            d, dz, ang = rel(me, o)
            if d > A.range:
                continue
            x, y = to_screen(cx, cy, scale, d, ang)
            rgb = UNIT if k == "unit" else GO
            if o.get("m"):
                d2, _, a2 = rel(me, {"x": o["tx"], "y": o["ty"], "z": o["tz"]})
                x2, y2 = to_screen(cx, cy, scale, min(d2, A.range), a2)
                p = AppKit.NSBezierPath.bezierPath()
                p.moveToPoint_((x, y))
                p.lineToPoint_((x2, y2))
                p.setLineWidth_(1)
                color(rgb, 0.5).setStroke()
                p.stroke()
            dot(x, y, 2.6 if k == "unit" else 2.0, rgb, 0.9 if abs(dz) < 15 else 0.45)

        near = sorted((rel(me, o) + (o,) for o in players), key=lambda n: n[0])
        # names on the radar go to players past the inner ring (the close ones crowd the middle; the list has them)
        labelled = {id(n[3]) for n in [n for n in near if n[0] > A.range / 4][:LABELS]}
        for d, dz, ang, o in reversed(near):
            edge = d > A.range
            x, y = to_screen(cx, cy, scale, min(d, A.range), ang)
            # the arrow points where they face, relative to us (screen: up = our facing)
            arrow(x, y, o["o"] - me["o"], 7, PLAYER, 0.55 if edge else 1)
            if id(o) in labelled:
                t = text(f"{title(o)} {d:.0f}", 10.5, PLAYER, 0.95, AppKit.NSFontWeightSemibold)
                t.drawAtPoint_((x - t.size().width / 2, y + 8))

        draw_threats(s, cx, cy, R, A.range)
        arrow(cx, cy, 0, 8, SELF)  # us, always facing up

        # the nearest players, under the radar
        y = cy - R - 22
        hdr = text(f"PLAYERS  {len(near)}", 11, DIM, 1, AppKit.NSFontWeightSemibold)
        hdr.drawAtPoint_((cx - R, y))
        for d, dz, ang, o in near[:LABELS]:
            y -= 18
            name = text(f"{compass(ang)}  {title(o)}", 12.5, PLAYER, 1, AppKit.NSFontWeightSemibold)
            name.drawAtPoint_((cx - R, y))
            dist = text(f"{d:.0f} yd  {'+' if dz >= 0 else ''}{dz:.0f}", 12, (0.9, 0.93, 0.95))
            dist.drawAtPoint_((cx + R - dist.size().width, y))
        draw_node_list(ups, cx - R, y, R)


def wow_window():
    best = None
    for w in Quartz.CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo(Quartz.kCGWindowListOptionOnScreenOnly, Quartz.kCGNullWindowID) or []:
        owner = str(w.get("kCGWindowOwnerName", ""))
        if not ("World of Warcraft" in owner or owner == "Wow") or w.get("kCGWindowLayer") != 0:
            continue
        b = w["kCGWindowBounds"]
        if best is None or b["Width"] * b["Height"] > best[0]["Width"] * best[0]["Height"]:
            best = (b, w["kCGWindowOwnerPID"])
    return best


class Controller(NSObject):
    def init(self):
        self = objc.super(Controller, self).init()
        self.started, self.last_find, self.found = time.monotonic(), 0, None
        style = AppKit.NSWindowStyleMaskBorderless | AppKit.NSWindowStyleMaskNonactivatingPanel
        self.panel = AppKit.NSPanel.alloc().initWithContentRect_styleMask_backing_defer_(
            ((0, 0), (800, 600)), style, AppKit.NSBackingStoreBuffered, False)
        self.panel.setOpaque_(False)
        self.panel.setBackgroundColor_(AppKit.NSColor.clearColor())
        self.panel.setHasShadow_(False)
        self.panel.setIgnoresMouseEvents_(True)
        self.panel.setLevel_(AppKit.NSStatusWindowLevel)
        self.panel.setCollectionBehavior_(AppKit.NSWindowCollectionBehaviorCanJoinAllSpaces
                                          | AppKit.NSWindowCollectionBehaviorStationary
                                          | AppKit.NSWindowCollectionBehaviorIgnoresCycle
                                          | AppKit.NSWindowCollectionBehaviorFullScreenAuxiliary)
        self.view = View.alloc().initWithFrame_(((0, 0), (800, 600)))
        self.panel.setContentView_(self.view)
        NSTimer.scheduledTimerWithTimeInterval_target_selector_userInfo_repeats_(1 / 30, self, "tick:", None, True)
        return self

    def tick_(self, _):
        if A.shot and time.monotonic() - self.started > A.after:
            self.saveTo_(A.shot)
            AppKit.NSApp.terminate_(None)
        screen = AppKit.NSScreen.screens()[0].frame()
        if A.always:
            rect = screen
        else:
            if time.monotonic() - self.last_find > 1:
                self.last_find, self.found = time.monotonic(), wow_window()
            front = AppKit.NSWorkspace.sharedWorkspace().frontmostApplication()
            if not self.found or front is None or front.processIdentifier() != self.found[1]:
                if self.panel.isVisible():
                    self.panel.orderOut_(None)
                return
            b = self.found[0]
            rect = ((b["X"], screen.size.height - b["Y"] - b["Height"]), (b["Width"], b["Height"]))
        if not AppKit.NSEqualRects(self.panel.frame(), rect):
            self.panel.setFrame_display_(rect, False)
        if not self.panel.isVisible():
            self.panel.orderFrontRegardless()
        self.view.setNeedsDisplay_(True)

    def saveTo_(self, path):
        b = self.view.bounds()
        w, h = int(b.size.width), int(b.size.height)
        rep = AppKit.NSBitmapImageRep.alloc().initWithBitmapDataPlanes_pixelsWide_pixelsHigh_bitsPerSample_samplesPerPixel_hasAlpha_isPlanar_colorSpaceName_bytesPerRow_bitsPerPixel_(
            None, w, h, 8, 4, True, False, AppKit.NSDeviceRGBColorSpace, 0, 0)
        ctx = AppKit.NSGraphicsContext.graphicsContextWithBitmapImageRep_(rep)
        AppKit.NSGraphicsContext.saveGraphicsState()
        AppKit.NSGraphicsContext.setCurrentContext_(ctx)
        AppKit.NSColor.colorWithRed_green_blue_alpha_(0.18, 0.22, 0.19, 1).setFill()
        AppKit.NSRectFill(b)
        self.view.drawRect_(b)
        AppKit.NSGraphicsContext.restoreGraphicsState()
        rep.representationUsingType_properties_(AppKit.NSBitmapImageFileTypePNG, None).writeToFile_atomically_(path, True)


def main():
    app = AppKit.NSApplication.sharedApplication()
    app.setActivationPolicy_(AppKit.NSApplicationActivationPolicyAccessory)
    threading.Thread(target=poller, daemon=True).start()
    Controller.alloc().init()
    app.run()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`radar/pvp.go`:

```go
package main

// Enemy players: the other faction's players near us, from the races the
// update fields carry (Forever; retail's fields do not decode yet), with how
// fast each is closing on us.

import (
	"math"
	"sort"
)

var allianceRaces = map[uint8]bool{1: true, 3: true, 4: true, 7: true, 11: true, 22: true, 25: true,
	29: true, 30: true, 32: true, 34: true, 37: true, 52: true}
var hordeRaces = map[uint8]bool{2: true, 5: true, 6: true, 8: true, 9: true, 10: true, 26: true,
	27: true, 28: true, 31: true, 35: true, 36: true, 70: true}

// faction is "alliance", "horde" or "" (unknown, or a neutral pandaren).
func faction(race uint8) string {
	switch {
	case allianceRaces[race]:
		return "alliance"
	case hordeRaces[race]:
		return "horde"
	}
	return ""
}

var classNames = map[uint8]string{1: "Warrior", 2: "Paladin", 3: "Hunter", 4: "Rogue", 5: "Priest",
	6: "Death Knight", 7: "Shaman", 8: "Mage", 9: "Warlock", 10: "Monk", 11: "Druid", 12: "Demon Hunter", 13: "Evoker"}

var raceNames = map[uint8]string{1: "Human", 2: "Orc", 3: "Dwarf", 4: "Night Elf", 5: "Undead", 6: "Tauren",
	7: "Gnome", 8: "Troll", 9: "Goblin", 10: "Blood Elf", 11: "Draenei"}

type threat struct {
	GUID  string  `json:"g"`
	Name  string  `json:"n,omitempty"`
	Level uint8   `json:"lvl,omitempty"`
	Class string  `json:"cls,omitempty"`
	Race  string  `json:"race,omitempty"`
	D     float64 `json:"d"`
	DZ    float64 `json:"dz"`
	Close float64 `json:"close"` // yards per second toward us (negative: moving away)
	Warn  bool    `json:"warn,omitempty"`
}

// Warning distances: anyone this close, or closing on us fast inside the
// outer one.
const (
	warnNear  = 60.0
	warnFar   = 120.0
	warnSpeed = 3.0
)

// threats lists the hostile players in objs, nearest first. A player is
// hostile when both factions are known and differ.
func threats(self *ent, objs []ent) []threat {
	mine := faction(self.Race)
	if mine == "" {
		return nil
	}
	var out []threat
	for i := range objs {
		o := &objs[i]
		if o.Kind != "player" {
			continue
		}
		f := faction(o.Race)
		if f == "" || f == mine {
			continue
		}
		o.Hostile = true
		dx, dy := float64(o.X-self.X), float64(o.Y-self.Y)
		d := math.Hypot(dx, dy)
		var closing float64
		if d > 0.1 {
			// their velocity toward us, less ours toward them
			closing = -(dx*float64(o.VX) + dy*float64(o.VY)) / d
			closing += (dx*float64(self.VX) + dy*float64(self.VY)) / d
		}
		t := threat{GUID: o.GUID, Name: o.Name, Level: o.Level, Class: classNames[o.Class], Race: raceNames[o.Race],
			D: math.Round(d*10) / 10, DZ: math.Round(float64(o.Z-self.Z)*10) / 10, Close: math.Round(closing*10) / 10}
		t.Warn = d < warnNear || d < warnFar && closing > warnSpeed
		out = append(out, t)
	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].D < out[j].D })
	return out
}
```

`radar/pvp_test.go`:

```go
package main

import "testing"

func TestThreats(t *testing.T) {
	self := &ent{Kind: "self", Race: 3} // dwarf: alliance
	objs := []ent{
		{GUID: "orc", Kind: "player", Race: 2, Class: 4, Level: 24, X: 100, VX: -7}, // 100 yd, running at us
		{GUID: "gnome", Kind: "player", Race: 7, X: 10},                             // our side
		{GUID: "troll", Kind: "player", Race: 8, X: 0, Y: 150},                      // far, standing
		{GUID: "?", Kind: "player", X: 5},                                           // race unknown
		{GUID: "undead", Kind: "player", Race: 5, Y: -40, VY: -5},                   // near, running away
	}
	got := threats(self, objs)
	if len(got) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("%d threats, want 3: %+v", len(got), got)
	}
	want := []struct {
		g    string
		warn bool
	}{{"undead", true}, {"orc", true}, {"troll", false}}
	for i, w := range want {
		if got[i].GUID != w.g || got[i].Warn != w.warn {
			t.Errorf("threat %d = %+v, want %s warn=%v", i, got[i], w.g, w.warn)
		}
	}
	if got[1].Close != 7 || got[1].Class != "Rogue" || got[0].Close != -5 {
		t.Errorf("closing speeds / class: %+v", got)
	}
	if !objs[0].Hostile || objs[1].Hostile {
		t.Error("hostile flags not set on the objects")
	}
	if threats(&ent{Kind: "self"}, objs) != nil {
		t.Error("threats with our own race unknown")
	}
}
```

`radar/tools/nodes-export.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Export every herb and ore spawn point in forever.db as world coordinates, for the radar.

forever.db has node spawns only as zone-map fractions (object_spawns: ui_map, x, y). The NPC
spawns (tc_spawns) have both the fraction and the world position, so each zone's map is fitted
to the world with a least-squares affine transform, and the node spawns go through it.

    python3 tools/nodes-export.py                  # -> nodes.json beside main.go
    go run . -nodes nodes.json ...                 # the radar's default

Output: {"entries": {"<object id>": "<name>"}, "spawns": [{"m": map, "n": name, "k": "herb"|"ore",
"x": wx, "y": wy}]} plus "fits" with each zone's residual, so a bad fit is visible.
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import sqlite3

import numpy as np

# numpy on macOS Accelerate warns about overflow in matmul that does not happen
np.seterr(all="ignore")


HERBS = [
    "Peacebloom", "Silverleaf", "Earthroot", "Mageroyal", "Briarthorn", "Stranglekelp", "Bruiseweed",
    "Wild Steelbloom", "Grave Moss", "Kingsblood", "Liferoot", "Fadeleaf", "Goldthorn", "Khadgar's Whisker",
    "Wintersbite", "Firebloom", "Purple Lotus", "Arthas' Tears", "Sungrass", "Blindweed", "Ghost Mushroom",
    "Gromsblood", "Golden Sansam", "Dreamfoil", "Mountain Silversage", "Plaguebloom", "Icecap", "Black Lotus",
    "Swiftthistle", "Wildvine",
]


def kind(name):
    """'herb', 'ore' or None. Forever's variants ('Wilted Peacebloom', 'Poor Copper Vein') count."""
    if not name:
        return None
    if name.endswith(" Vein") or name.endswith(" Deposit"):
        return "ore"
    if any(h in name for h in HERBS):
        return "herb"
    return None


def fit(rows):
    """World (wx, wy) from map (x, y): [wx wy] = [x y 1] @ M, least squares. Returns M, rms yards."""
    a = np.array([[x, y, 1.0] for x, y, _, _ in rows])
    b = np.array([[wx, wy] for _, _, wx, wy in rows])
    m, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(a, b, rcond=None)
    res = a @ m - b
    return m, float(np.sqrt((res ** 2).sum(axis=1).mean()))


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--db", default=os.environ.get("WOW_FOREVER_DB", os.path.expanduser("~/wow/host/data/forever.db")))
    ap.add_argument("--out", default=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "nodes.json"))
    ap.add_argument("--max-rms", type=float, default=5.0, help="skip zones whose fit is worse than this (yards)")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    c = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{a.db}?mode=ro", uri=True)

    entries = {i: n for i, n in c.execute("select id, name from objects") if kind(n)}

    pts = {}
    for ui, mp, x, y, wx, wy in c.execute(
            "select ui_map, map, x, y, wx, wy from tc_spawns where ui_map is not null and x between 0 and 1 and y between 0 and 1"):
        pts.setdefault(ui, []).append((mp, x, y, wx, wy))
    fits = {}
    for ui, rows in pts.items():
        maps = {}
        for r in rows:
            maps[r[0]] = maps.get(r[0], 0) + 1
        mp = max(maps, key=maps.get)  # a zone map belongs to one world map; drop strays
        rows = [r[1:] for r in rows if r[0] == mp]
        if len(rows) < 20:
            continue
        m, rms = fit(rows)
        # one pass dropping outliers (NPCs on other floors, phased copies)
        res = np.hypot(*(np.array([[x, y, 1.0] for x, y, _, _ in rows]) @ m - np.array([[wx, wy] for _, _, wx, wy in rows])).T)
        keep = [r for r, e in zip(rows, res) if e < max(3 * rms, 10)]
        if len(keep) >= 20:
            m, rms = fit(keep)
        fits[ui] = (mp, m, rms, len(keep))

    spawns, skipped = [], {}
    seen = set()
    for obj, ui, x, y in c.execute("select object, ui_map, x, y from object_spawns"):
        name = entries.get(obj)
        if not name:
            continue
        f = fits.get(ui)
        if not f or f[2] > a.max_rms:
            skipped[ui] = skipped.get(ui, 0) + 1
            continue
        mp, m, _, _ = f
        wx, wy = (np.array([x, y, 1.0]) @ m).tolist()
        key = (mp, round(wx / 3), round(wy / 3), name)  # the same spot listed by two sources
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        spawns.append({"m": mp, "n": name, "k": kind(name), "x": round(wx, 1), "y": round(wy, 1)})

    out = {
        "entries": {str(i): n for i, n in sorted(entries.items())},
        "spawns": spawns,
        "fits": {str(ui): {"map": mp, "rms": round(rms, 2), "n": n} for ui, (mp, _, rms, n) in sorted(fits.items())},
    }
    with open(a.out, "w") as fh:
        json.dump(out, fh, separators=(",", ":"))
    good = sum(1 for f in fits.values() if f[2] <= a.max_rms)
    print(f"{len(spawns)} node spawns, {len(entries)} node entries, {good}/{len(fits)} zones fitted "
          f"(rms <= {a.max_rms} yd); skipped {sum(skipped.values())} spawns in {len(skipped)} unfitted zones -> {a.out}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```
