`rotation/tools/havoc-helper`:

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# havoc-helper: play retail Havoc with the rotation helper over the game, in
# one command.
#
#   tools/havoc-helper            record, decode, suggest, draw; quit the game to stop
#   tools/havoc-helper --check    show what it would use and exit
#
# What runs:
#   1. capture-live --game retail: the bnet relay, tcpdump of the world port,
#      and the retail client (log in at the game's own screen, as usual).
#   2. Once the run folder exists: combatfeed -run <run> -follow (decrypts the
#      capture as it is written; combat events, auras, cooldowns, Fury)
#      | wow-rotation <havoc toml> --feed (the Havoc priority list; adds
#      "next" lines) | auraoverlay.py (the icon row, right to left, and the
#      aura bars, drawn over the WoW window while it is in front), with
#      wow-feed's feedhub between the rotation and the overlay: the same lines,
#      "next" included, on ws://$HUB_ADDR/feed for dashboards and bots, and a
#      live view at http://$HUB_ADDR/.
#   3. When the game exits, capture-live stops and decrypts, and the overlay
#      side is shut down with it. Ctrl-C stops everything.
#
# Where things come from (override with the environment variables):
#   WOW_FEED      the repo root (default: this checkout): capture-live and combatfeed
#   CAPTURE_LIVE  a capture-live that knows --game retail (default: the repo's)
#   ROTATION      the rotation binary (default: this repo's target/release/wow-rotation)
#   HAVOC_TOML    the rotation file (default rotations/havoc_fel_scarred.toml; keybinds: key = "...")
#   HAVOC_HASTE   your gear haste as a fraction, for the pull (default 0.18)
#   SPELLDATA     wago.tools CSVs for the retail build (fetched if missing)
#   LIVE_DIR      where capture-live puts its runs
#   HUB_ADDR      where feedhub listens (default 127.0.0.1:7373)
# Logs of the overlay side: <run>/helper-*.log
set -euo pipefail

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
WOW_FEED="${WOW_FEED:-$(cd "$HERE/.." && pwd)}"   # the repo root: capture-live, combatfeed, feedhub
BUILD="12.1.5.70783"
LIVE_DIR="${LIVE_DIR:-${WOW_LIVE_CAPTURES:-$WOW_FEED/captures}}"
SPELLDATA="${SPELLDATA:-$WOW_FEED/data/db2/$BUILD}"
ROTATION="${ROTATION:-$HERE/target/release/wow-rotation}"
HAVOC_TOML="${HAVOC_TOML:-$HERE/rotations/havoc_fel_scarred.toml}"
HUB_ADDR="${HUB_ADDR:-127.0.0.1:7373}"
HAVOC_HASTE="${HAVOC_HASTE:-0.18}"  # gear haste until the first Eye Beam measures it (the author's, 2026-11-05: 18.2%)

say() { printf '\033[1;35mhavoc-helper:\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
die() { say "$*"; exit 1; }

[[ -d "$WOW_FEED/tools/combatfeed" ]] || die "no tools/combatfeed under $WOW_FEED (set WOW_FEED to the repo root)"

# a capture-live with --game
if [[ -z "${CAPTURE_LIVE:-}" ]]; then
  for c in "$WOW_FEED/tools/capture-live"; do
    if [[ -x "$c" ]] && grep -q -- '--game' "$c"; then CAPTURE_LIVE="$c"; break; fi
  done
fi
[[ -n "${CAPTURE_LIVE:-}" ]] || die "no capture-live with --game retail found; set CAPTURE_LIVE"

[[ -f "$HAVOC_TOML" ]] || die "no rotation file at $HAVOC_TOML; set HAVOC_TOML"

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--check" ]]; then
  say "wow-feed:     $WOW_FEED ($(git -C "$WOW_FEED" log -1 --format=%h 2>/dev/null))"
  say "capture-live: $CAPTURE_LIVE"
  say "rotation:     $ROTATION ($([[ -x "$ROTATION" ]] && echo built || echo 'not built yet: cargo build --release'))"
  say "spec:         $HAVOC_TOML (haste $HAVOC_HASTE)"
  say "spell data:   $SPELLDATA ($(ls "$SPELLDATA"/*.csv 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') CSVs)"
  say "runs:         $LIVE_DIR"
  say "feed hub:     ws://$HUB_ADDR/feed (live view http://$HUB_ADDR/)"
  exit 0
fi

# the rotation, built once
if [[ ! -x "$ROTATION" ]]; then
  say "building the rotation (cargo build --release)"
  (cd "$HERE" && cargo build --release) || die "rotation build failed"
fi

# spell tables for cooldowns, charges, the GCD and names, fetched once
mkdir -p "$SPELLDATA"
for t in SpellName SpellCooldowns SpellCategories SpellCategory; do
  if [[ ! -s "$SPELLDATA/$t.csv" ]]; then
    say "fetching $t.csv for $BUILD from wago.tools"
    curl -fsS -A wow-forever -o "$SPELLDATA/$t.csv.part" "https://wago.tools/db2/$t/csv?build=$BUILD" \
      && mv "$SPELLDATA/$t.csv.part" "$SPELLDATA/$t.csv" || die "could not fetch $t.csv"
  fi
done

# the feed and the hub, built once per start so they match the wow-feed checkout
FEED="$(mktemp -t combatfeed)"
HUB="$(mktemp -t feedhub)"
(cd "$WOW_FEED" && go build -o "$FEED" ./tools/combatfeed) || die "combatfeed build failed"
(cd "$WOW_FEED" && go build -o "$HUB" ./tools/feedhub) || die "feedhub build failed"

before="$(ls -1 "$LIVE_DIR" 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -1 || true)"
PIPE_PID=""
cleanup() {
  if [[ -n "$PIPE_PID" ]]; then
    pkill -P "$PIPE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    kill "$PIPE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  rm -f "$FEED" "$HUB"
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM

# the overlay side waits for the new run folder, then follows it
(
  for _ in $(seq 1 600); do
    run="$(ls -1 "$LIVE_DIR" 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -1 || true)"
    [[ -n "$run" && "$run" != "$before" ]] && break
    sleep 0.5
  done
  [[ -n "$run" && "$run" != "$before" ]] || exit 0
  dir="$LIVE_DIR/$run"
  say "overlay following $dir (it shows over the game while WoW is in front)"
  say "feed on ws://$HUB_ADDR/feed, live view http://$HUB_ADDR/"
  "$FEED" -run "$dir" -follow -spelldata "$SPELLDATA" 2>"$dir/helper-feed.log" \
    | "$ROTATION" "$HAVOC_TOML" --feed --next 4 --haste "$HAVOC_HASTE" 2>"$dir/helper-rotation.log" \
    | "$HUB" -ws "$HUB_ADDR" 2>"$dir/helper-hub.log" \
    | python3 "$HERE/tools/auraoverlay/auraoverlay.py" --rotation 2>"$dir/helper-overlay.log"
) &
PIPE_PID=$!

"$CAPTURE_LIVE" --game retail
```

`rotation/tools/simc_apl.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Write an overlay's [[rotation]] straight from a SimC profile's default action list.

  python3 tools/simc_apl.py profiles/MID2_Demon_Hunter_Havoc.simc rotations/havoc_fel_scarred.toml

Every `actions=` / `actions+=/` line of the default list becomes one rule (or several, see
ALIASES), in SimC's order, with SimC's condition translated to the overlay's names. The rules
go between the `# >>> simc` and `# <<< simc` lines of the overlay file; everything else there
(spells, auras, talents, markers) is hand-written and says where the names come from.
Talent checks stay as `talent.X` and are read live from the player's passive auras.

Lines whose action the overlay has no spell for are kept as comments, as are action lists
other than the default one (items, potions).
"""
import re
import sys
import tomllib

# SimC actions that are not buttons the overlay suggests
SKIP = {"auto_attack", "retarget_auto_attack", "call_action_list", "pick_up_fragment", "snapshot_stats", "variable"}

# One SimC action is two buttons in the overlay: the form outside and inside Metamorphosis
# (SimC's immolation_aura casts Consuming Fire in Metamorphosis).
ALIASES = {"immolation_aura": ["consuming_fire", "immolation_aura"]}

# action.X.demonsurge_available -> the overlay's marker for that button
DEMONSURGE = {"immolation_aura": "consuming_fire", "eye_beam": "abyssal_gaze"}


def actions(profile):
    """(line number, action, options) for the default list, and its precombat variables."""
    out, variables = [], {}
    for n, line in enumerate(open(profile, encoding="utf-8"), 1):
        line = line.strip()
        m = re.match(r"actions(\.precombat)?(\+?=)/?(.*)$", line)
        if not m:
            continue
        name, *opts = m.group(3).split(",")
        kv = {}
        for o in opts:
            if "=" in o:
                k, v = o.split("=", 1)
                kv[k] = v
        if m.group(1):  # precombat: only its variable defaults matter here
            if name == "variable" and "default" in kv:
                variables[kv["name"]] = kv["default"]
            continue
        out.append((n, name, kv, line))
    return out, variables


def translate(cond, action, known, variables):
    auras, cooldowns, talents = known
    c = cond
    # (a>?b) is SimC's max
    c = re.sub(r"\(([\w.]+)>\?([\w.]+)\)", r"((\1)*((\1)>(\2))+(\2)*((\1)<=(\2)))", c)
    c = re.sub(r"action\.(\w+)\.demonsurge_available",
               lambda m: f"buff.demonsurge_{DEMONSURGE.get(m.group(1), m.group(1))}.up", c)
    c = re.sub(r"\b(buff|debuff)\.(\w+)\.down\b", r"!\1.\2.up", c)
    c = c.replace("gcd.max", "gcd").replace("hero_tree.felscarred", "talent.felscarred")
    c = re.sub(r"variable\.(\w+)", lambda m: variables.get(m.group(1), "0"), c)
    # SimC's bare charges / full_recharge_time are the action's own
    c = re.sub(r"(?<![.\w])(charges|full_recharge_time)\b", rf"cooldown.{action}.\1", c)
    # auras and debuffs of talents or hero trees the overlay doesn't track are never up
    def aura(m):
        return m.group(0) if m.group(2) in auras else "0"
    c = re.sub(r"\b(buff|debuff)\.(\w+)\.(up|remains|stack)\b", aura, c)
    c = re.sub(r"\bactive_dot\.\w+", "0", c)
    missing = [t for t in re.findall(r"\btalent\.(\w+)", c) if t not in talents]
    missing += [cd for cd in re.findall(r"\bcooldown\.(\w+)\.", c) if cd not in cooldowns]
    return c, missing


def main():
    profile, overlay = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    text = open(overlay, encoding="utf-8").read()
    spec = tomllib.loads(text)
    spells = {s["name"] for s in spec["spells"]}
    groups = spells | {s["group"] for s in spec["spells"] if "group" in s}
    auras = {a["name"] for a in spec.get("auras", [])} | {m["name"] for m in spec.get("markers", [])}
    talents = {t["name"] for t in spec.get("talents", [])}
    acts, variables = actions(profile)
    out, problems = [], []
    for n, name, kv, line in acts:
        if name in SKIP:
            continue
        cond = kv.get("if", "")
        buttons = [b for b in ALIASES.get(name, [name]) if b in spells]
        if not buttons:
            out.append(f"# [simc line {n}] no button for '{name}': {line}\n")
            continue
        out.append(f"# [simc line {n}] {line}\n")
        for b in buttons:
            c, missing = translate(cond, name, (auras, groups, talents), variables)
            problems += [f"line {n}: '{x}' not in {overlay}" for x in missing]
            out.append(f'[[rotation]]\naction = "{b}"\n' + (f'if = "{c}"\n' if c else "") + "\n")
    if problems:
        sys.exit("\n".join(sorted(set(problems))))
    start, end = text.index("# >>> simc\n"), text.index("# <<< simc")
    body = f"# Generated by tools/simc_apl.py from {profile}; edit there, not here.\n\n" + "".join(out)
    open(overlay, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(text[: start + len("# >>> simc\n")] + body + text[end:])
    print(f"{sum(1 for o in out if o.startswith('[['))} rules from {len(acts)} action lines")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`setup/connect-client.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# One-time machine setup for tools/capture-live (macOS).
#
#   sudo setup/connect-client.sh                  set up for both clients
#   sudo setup/connect-client.sh --game retail    only the retail client's portal file
#   sudo setup/connect-client.sh undo             put everything back
#
# What it does:
#   1. makes a local CA and a certificate for the portal name in certs/
#      (bnetrelay shows it to the client; certs/ is git-ignored, keep it private)
#   2. trusts that CA in the System keychain (the client checks its system roots)
#   3. maps the portal name to 127.0.0.1 in /etc/hosts, so the client logs in
#      through bnetrelay on this Mac
#   4. Forever: writes ForeverLauncher.wtf, a copy of Config.wtf whose portal is
#      that name (Config.wtf itself is untouched). Retail's RelayPortal.wtf is
#      written by capture-live on its first run.
#
# Paths: WOW_FOREVER_DIR (default /Applications/World of Warcraft/_forever_),
# WOW_LIVE_CERTS (default certs/ in this repo).
set -euo pipefail

REPO="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
CERTS="${WOW_LIVE_CERTS:-$REPO/certs}"
FOREVER="${WOW_FOREVER_DIR:-/Applications/World of Warcraft/_forever_}"
PORTAL=trinity.actual.battle.net
CA_NAME="wow-live local CA"
HOSTS_LINE="127.0.0.1 $PORTAL"
MARK="# wow-live capture relay"
GAME=all

[[ $EUID -eq 0 ]] || { echo "run with sudo: sudo $0 $*"; exit 1; }
OWNER="${SUDO_USER:-$(id -un)}"

case "${1:-}" in
  undo)
    sed -i '' "/$MARK/d" /etc/hosts
    dscacheutil -flushcache
    [[ -f "$CERTS/ca.cert.pem" ]] && security remove-trusted-cert -d "$CERTS/ca.cert.pem" 2>/dev/null || true
    security delete-certificate -c "$CA_NAME" /Library/Keychains/System.keychain 2>/dev/null || true
    rm -f "$FOREVER/WTF/ForeverLauncher.wtf"
    echo "undone (certs/ kept; delete it yourself if you like)"
    exit 0 ;;
  --game) GAME="${2:?--game forever|retail}" ;;
  "") ;;
  *) echo "usage: sudo $0 [--game forever|retail | undo]"; exit 2 ;;
esac

# 1. certificates
if [[ ! -f "$CERTS/server.chain.pem" ]]; then
  mkdir -p "$CERTS" && chmod 700 "$CERTS"
  cd "$CERTS"
  openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -days 3650 -sha256 \
    -subj "/CN=$CA_NAME" -keyout ca.key.pem -out ca.cert.pem 2>/dev/null
  openssl req -new -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -subj "/CN=$PORTAL" \
    -keyout server.key.pem -out server.csr 2>/dev/null
  printf 'subjectAltName=DNS:%s\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\nbasicConstraints=CA:FALSE\n' "$PORTAL" > ext.cnf
  openssl x509 -req -in server.csr -CA ca.cert.pem -CAkey ca.key.pem -CAcreateserial \
    -days 825 -sha256 -extfile ext.cnf -out server.cert.pem 2>/dev/null
  cat server.cert.pem ca.cert.pem > server.chain.pem
  rm -f server.csr ext.cnf
  chown -R "$OWNER" "$CERTS"
  chmod 600 "$CERTS"/*.pem
  echo "certs: made $CERTS (CA + $PORTAL)"
  cd - >/dev/null
fi

# 2. trust the CA
if ! security find-certificate -c "$CA_NAME" /Library/Keychains/System.keychain >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain "$CERTS/ca.cert.pem"
  echo "keychain: trusted $CA_NAME"
fi

# 3. the portal name resolves here
if ! grep -qF "$HOSTS_LINE" /etc/hosts; then
  printf '%s %s\n' "$HOSTS_LINE" "$MARK" >> /etc/hosts
  echo "hosts: added $HOSTS_LINE"
fi
dscacheutil -flushcache

# 4. Forever's portal file
if [[ "$GAME" != retail && -d "$FOREVER" ]]; then
  mkdir -p "$FOREVER/WTF"
  W="$FOREVER/WTF/ForeverLauncher.wtf"
  { [[ -f "$FOREVER/WTF/Config.wtf" ]] && grep -v '^SET portal ' "$FOREVER/WTF/Config.wtf"; echo "SET portal \"$PORTAL\""; } > "$W"
  chown "$OWNER" "$W"
  echo "forever: wrote $W"
fi

echo "set up. Next: tools/capture-live --dry-run"

```

`state/state.go`:

```go
// Package state holds the persistent world model that agents query.
//
// The object model mirrors the client's own object manager, whose classes are
// visible in shipped strings: CGObject_C, CGUnit_C, CGPlayer_C,
// CGActivePlayer_C, CGItem_C, CGContainer_C, CGGameObject_C, CGDynamicObject_C,
// CGCorpse_C, CGAreaTrigger_C, CGConversation_C, CGSceneObject_C.
//
// Only fields an agent needs for decisions are modelled. Everything is
// versioned: a snapshot carries the state version it was taken at so an agent
// can tell whether it acted on stale data.
package state

import (
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

// GUID is a 128-bit object identifier, as the client keys objects. The low
// half alone is not unique: in a real session the player's counter and a
// creature's spawn counter collide (both 3 in the 70755 Goldshire capture),
// so the state is keyed by both halves. It marshals as 32 hex digits, high
// half first (the same text as codec.GUID.String).
type GUID struct {
	Hi uint64
	Lo uint64
}

// LowGUID is a GUID with only the low half set (synthetic fixtures).
func LowGUID(lo uint64) GUID { return GUID{Lo: lo} }

// IsZero reports the empty GUID.
func (g GUID) IsZero() bool { return g.Hi == 0 && g.Lo == 0 }

// Less orders GUIDs by high half, then low half.
func (g GUID) Less(o GUID) bool {
	if g.Hi != o.Hi {
		return g.Hi < o.Hi
	}
	return g.Lo < o.Lo
}

// String formats g as 32 hex digits, high half first.
func (g GUID) String() string { return fmt.Sprintf("%016x%016x", g.Hi, g.Lo) }

// MarshalText implements encoding.TextMarshaler.
func (g GUID) MarshalText() ([]byte, error) { return []byte(g.String()), nil }

// UnmarshalText accepts 1..32 hex digits (a short form is the low half).
func (g *GUID) UnmarshalText(b []byte) error {
	s := string(b)
	if len(s) == 0 || len(s) > 32 {
		return fmt.Errorf("state: bad guid %q", s)
	}
	var hi, lo uint64
	if len(s) > 16 {
		if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(s[:len(s)-16], "%x", &hi); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("state: bad guid %q: %v", s, err)
		}
		s = s[len(s)-16:]
	}
	if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(s, "%x", &lo); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("state: bad guid %q: %v", string(b), err)
	}
	g.Hi, g.Lo = hi, lo
	return nil
}

// Kind classifies an object, one-to-one with the client's object classes.
type Kind string

// Object kinds.
const (
	KindPlayer        Kind = "player"
	KindUnit          Kind = "unit"
	KindGameObject    Kind = "gameobject"
	KindItem          Kind = "item"
	KindContainer     Kind = "container"
	KindDynamicObject Kind = "dynamicobject"
	KindCorpse        Kind = "corpse"
	KindAreaTrigger   Kind = "areatrigger"
	KindConversation  Kind = "conversation"
	KindSceneObject   Kind = "sceneobject"
)

// Vec3 is a world position in yards.
type Vec3 struct {
	X float32 `json:"x"`
	Y float32 `json:"y"`
	Z float32 `json:"z"`
}

// Object is one entity in the world.
type Object struct {
	GUID      GUID             `json:"guid"`
	Kind      Kind             `json:"kind"`
	Entry     uint32           `json:"entry,omitempty"`
	Name      string           `json:"name,omitempty"`
	Level     uint8            `json:"level,omitempty"`
	Class     uint8            `json:"class,omitempty"`
	Race      uint8            `json:"race,omitempty"`
	Position  Vec3             `json:"position"`
	Facing    float32          `json:"facing"`
	Health    int64            `json:"health,omitempty"`
	MaxHealth int64            `json:"max_health,omitempty"`
	Power     map[string]int64 `json:"power,omitempty"`
	Target    GUID             `json:"target"`
	// NpcFlags is UnitData.NpcFlags (0x2: quest giver).
	NpcFlags uint32   `json:"npc_flags,omitempty"`
	Auras    []string `json:"auras,omitempty"`
	Dead     bool     `json:"dead,omitempty"`
	// Equipment is the item id shown in each visible slot (PlayerData
	// VisibleItems, 0-18), only the slots with an item.
	Equipment map[int]int32 `json:"equipment,omitempty"`
	// GameObject and Item are set for those kinds only.
	GameObject *GameObjectInfo `json:"gameobject,omitempty"`
	Item       *ItemInfo       `json:"item,omitempty"`
	Updated    time.Time       `json:"updated"`
}

// Quat is a rotation quaternion.
type Quat struct {
	X float32 `json:"x"`
	Y float32 `json:"y"`
	Z float32 `json:"z"`
	W float32 `json:"w"`
}

// GameObjectInfo is what an agent needs about a game object (door, chest,
// herb, mailbox, ...). Values are as the server sends them: State is the
// GOState (0 active/open, 1 ready/closed, 2 alternative), Type the
// GameObject type (e.g. 3 chest, 19 mailbox), Flags the GameObjectFlags.
type GameObjectInfo struct {
	Display       uint32 `json:"display"`
	Type          int8   `json:"type"`
	State         int8   `json:"state"`
	Flags         uint32 `json:"flags,omitempty"`
	Faction       uint32 `json:"faction,omitempty"`
	Level         int32  `json:"level,omitempty"`
	ArtKit        uint32 `json:"art_kit,omitempty"`
	PercentHealth uint8  `json:"percent_health,omitempty"`
	// Rotation is the object's local rotation, from the create block.
	Rotation Quat `json:"rotation"`
	// CreatedBy is set for objects a player made (fishing bobbers, fires).
	CreatedBy GUID `json:"created_by"`
}

// ItemInfo describes an item object. Owner-only fields (stack count,
// durability) are zero for items the session does not own.
type ItemInfo struct {
	Owner         GUID   `json:"owner"`
	ContainedIn   GUID   `json:"contained_in"`
	StackCount    uint32 `json:"stack_count,omitempty"`
	Durability    uint32 `json:"durability,omitempty"`
	MaxDurability uint32 `json:"max_durability,omitempty"`
	DynamicFlags  uint32 `json:"dynamic_flags,omitempty"`
}

// clone deep-copies the parts of o that are shared by reference.
func (o Object) clone() Object {
	o.Power = copyIntMap(o.Power)
	if o.Auras != nil {
		o.Auras = append([]string(nil), o.Auras...)
	}
	if o.GameObject != nil {
		g := *o.GameObject
		o.GameObject = &g
	}
	if o.Item != nil {
		it := *o.Item
		o.Item = &it
	}
	if o.Equipment != nil {
		eq := make(map[int]int32, len(o.Equipment))
		for k, v := range o.Equipment {
			eq[k] = v
		}
		o.Equipment = eq
	}
	return o
}

// Snapshot is an immutable view of the world at one version.
type Snapshot struct {
	Version   uint64    `json:"version"`
	Taken     time.Time `json:"taken"`
	Realm     string    `json:"realm,omitempty"`
	Character string    `json:"character,omitempty"`
	Self      GUID      `json:"self"`
	Tick      uint32    `json:"tick"`
	Objects   []Object  `json:"objects"`
}

// State is the mutable world model. All methods are safe for concurrent use.
type State struct {
	mu        sync.RWMutex
	version   uint64
	realm     string
	character string
	self      GUID
	tick      uint32
	objects   map[GUID]Object
	clock     func() time.Time
}

// New returns an empty world model.
func New() *State {
	return &State{objects: make(map[GUID]Object), clock: time.Now}
}

func (s *State) bump() { s.version++ }

// Version reports the current state version.
func (s *State) Version() uint64 {
	s.mu.RLock()
	defer s.mu.RUnlock()
	return s.version
}

// SetSession records the realm and character name once the logon sequence
// reaches the world.
func (s *State) SetSession(realm, character string) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.realm, s.character = realm, character
	s.bump()
}

// SetSelf marks the object controlled by this session.
func (s *State) SetSelf(g GUID) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.self = g
	s.bump()
}

// Self returns the controlled GUID.
func (s *State) Self() GUID {
	s.mu.RLock()
	defer s.mu.RUnlock()
	return s.self
}

// AdvanceTick records the server tick counter.
func (s *State) AdvanceTick(tick uint32) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if tick != s.tick {
		s.tick = tick
		s.bump()
	}
}

// Upsert inserts or replaces an object and returns a copy of the stored value.
func (s *State) Upsert(o Object) Object {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if o.Updated.IsZero() {
		o.Updated = s.clock()
	}
	if prev, ok := s.objects[o.GUID]; ok && o.Kind == "" {
		o.Kind = prev.Kind
	}
	o = o.clone()
	s.objects[o.GUID] = o
	s.bump()
	return o.clone()
}

// Mutate applies fn to an existing object.
func (s *State) Mutate(g GUID, fn func(*Object)) error {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	o, ok := s.objects[g]
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("state: object %v not present", g)
	}
	o = o.clone()
	fn(&o)
	o.Updated = s.clock()
	s.objects[g] = o
	s.bump()
	return nil
}

// Remove deletes an object, reporting whether it was present.
func (s *State) Remove(g GUID) bool {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	_, ok := s.objects[g]
	delete(s.objects, g)
	if ok {
		s.bump()
	}
	return ok
}

// Object returns a deep copy of one object.
func (s *State) Object(g GUID) (Object, bool) {
	s.mu.RLock()
	defer s.mu.RUnlock()
	o, ok := s.objects[g]
	if !ok {
		return Object{}, false
	}
	return o.clone(), true
}

// Len reports how many objects are tracked.
func (s *State) Len() int {
	s.mu.RLock()
	defer s.mu.RUnlock()
	return len(s.objects)
}

// Snapshot returns a deep copy of the whole world, sorted by GUID for stable
// output.
func (s *State) Snapshot() Snapshot {
	s.mu.RLock()
	defer s.mu.RUnlock()
	out := Snapshot{
		Version:   s.version,
		Taken:     s.clock(),
		Realm:     s.realm,
		Character: s.character,
		Self:      s.self,
		Tick:      s.tick,
		Objects:   make([]Object, 0, len(s.objects)),
	}
	for _, o := range s.objects {
		out.Objects = append(out.Objects, o.clone())
	}
	sort.Slice(out.Objects, func(i, j int) bool { return out.Objects[i].GUID.Less(out.Objects[j].GUID) })
	return out
}

func copyIntMap(in map[string]int64) map[string]int64 {
	if in == nil {
		return nil
	}
	out := make(map[string]int64, len(in))
	for k, v := range in {
		out[k] = v
	}
	return out
}
```

```go
package state

import (
	"testing"

func TestUpsertAndSnapshotAreIndependent(t *testing.T) {
	s := New()
	o := s.Upsert(Object{GUID: LowGUID(1), Kind: KindPlayer, Name: "Jack", Health: 100, Power: map[string]int64{"MANA": 50}})
	if o.GUID != LowGUID(1) {
		t.Fatalf("guid %v", o.GUID)
	}
	snap := s.Snapshot()
	if len(snap.Objects) != 1 || snap.Version == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("snapshot %+v", snap)
	}
	// Mutating the snapshot must not touch the store, and vice versa.
	snap.Objects[0].Power["MANA"] = 1
	live, _ := s.Object(LowGUID(1))
	if live.Power["MANA"] != 50 {
		t.Fatalf("snapshot aliased live power map: %d", live.Power["MANA"])
	}
	live.Power["MANA"] = 99
	if s.Snapshot().Objects[0].Power["MANA"] != 50 {
		t.Fatal("Object returned an aliased map")
	}
}

func TestMutateMissingObjectFails(t *testing.T) {
	s := New()
	if err := s.Mutate(LowGUID(0xdead), func(*Object) {}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected error for missing object")
	}
}

func TestVersionIncreasesOnChange(t *testing.T) {
	s := New()
	v0 := s.Version()
	s.Upsert(Object{GUID: LowGUID(1), Kind: KindUnit})
	v1 := s.Version()
	if v1 <= v0 {
		t.Fatalf("version did not advance: %d -> %d", v0, v1)
	}
	s.Remove(LowGUID(1))
	if s.Version() <= v1 {
		t.Fatal("remove did not advance version")
	}
	if s.Remove(LowGUID(1)) {
		t.Fatal("second remove reported present")
	}
}

func TestSnapshotSortedByGUID(t *testing.T) {
	s := New()
	s.Upsert(Object{GUID: LowGUID(3), Kind: KindUnit})
	s.Upsert(Object{GUID: LowGUID(1), Kind: KindUnit})
	s.Upsert(Object{GUID: LowGUID(2), Kind: KindUnit})
	snap := s.Snapshot()
	for i, want := range []GUID{LowGUID(1), {Lo: 2}, {Lo: 3}} {
		if snap.Objects[i].GUID != want {
			t.Fatalf("position %d = %v, want %v", i, snap.Objects[i].GUID, want)
		}
	}
}

func TestConcurrentAccessIsSafe(t *testing.T) {
	s := New()
	done := make(chan struct{})
	for w := 0; w < 8; w++ {
		go func(w int) {
			for i := 0; i < 200; i++ {
				s.Upsert(Object{GUID: LowGUID(uint64(w*1000 + i)), Kind: KindUnit})
				_ = s.Snapshot()
				_ = s.Version()
```

`tools/agent_relay.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Relay between the game and the Battle.net Agent (127.0.0.1:51655 -> 127.0.0.1:51654).

The game finds the Agent through /Users/Shared/Battle.net/Agent/Agent.dat and keeps one connection
to it for the whole session. launch.sh points that file at this relay just while the game starts, so
only the game goes through here. Everything is passed through and logged.

The game's `GET /agent` gets `401 Unauthorized` and `Connection: close` (the Agent fails the game's
signature check). Directly connected, the game retries forever (~60% CPU in the Agent), and if the
Agent dies it spins on the dead socket (~120% in the game). Here the game's side stays open after the
Agent hangs up, so the game just waits and both stay idle.
"""
import argparse, asyncio, time

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("--listen", type=int, default=51655)
ap.add_argument("--agent", type=int, default=51654)
ap.add_argument("--log", default="/tmp/agent_relay.log")
args = ap.parse_args()

log_file = open(args.log, "a", buffering=1)
logged = {}


def log(direction, cid, data):
    # Log the first line of each distinct message a few times, then just count.
    head = data.split(b"\r\n", 1)[0][:160].decode("latin-1")
    key = (direction, head)
    logged[key] = logged.get(key, 0) + 1
    n = logged[key]
    if n <= 3 or n in (10, 100, 1000) or n % 10000 == 0:
        log_file.write(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} c{cid} {direction} x{n} {len(data)}B {data[:600]!r}\n")


async def pipe(reader, writer, direction, cid):
    try:
        while data := await reader.read(65536):
            log(direction, cid, data)
            writer.write(data)
            await writer.drain()
    except (ConnectionError, OSError):
        pass
    finally:
        log_file.write(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} c{cid} {direction} closed\n")


cids = iter(range(1, 1 << 30))


async def handle(game_r, game_w):
    cid = next(cids)
    log_file.write(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} c{cid} connected\n")
    agent_r, agent_w = await asyncio.open_connection("127.0.0.1", args.agent)
    await asyncio.gather(pipe(game_r, agent_w, "game>agent", cid), pipe(agent_r, game_w, "agent>game", cid))
    for w in (game_w, agent_w):
        w.close()


async def main():
    server = await asyncio.start_server(handle, "127.0.0.1", args.listen)
    log_file.write(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} relay :{args.listen} -> :{args.agent}\n")
    async with server:
        await server.serve_forever()


asyncio.run(main())

```

`tools/bnetrelay/main.go`:

```go
// Package main is bnetrelay: a Battle.net (bgs) relay between the stock
// client and a real bgs server, which decodes and records every message.
//
// The stock client logs in to the portal named in its config and trusts the
// Mac's keychain roots (setup/connect-client.sh sets
// both up for the local fork: portal trinity.actual.battle.net, /etc/hosts to
// 127.0.0.1, the fork's CA trusted). So with the fork's bnetserver stopped,
// this relay takes :1119 with the fork's certificate for that name, and the
// client talks to it. The relay opens its own TLS connection upstream (live
// Battle.net, or the fork on another port) and passes every frame through
// byte for byte, so neither side sees a difference.
//
// It writes, per run, under -out:
//
//	frames.jsonl   every frame: time, connection, direction, service, method,
//	               token, status, and the body in hex; responses are matched
//	               to their request's service and method by token
//	secrets.jsonl  what the world connection's keys come from: the client
//	               secret in Param_ClientInfo (RealmListTicket) and
//	               Param_JoinSecret, Param_ServerAddresses and the join ticket
//	               (RealmJoin), with the command and realm they belong to
//
//	go run ./tools/bnetrelay -upstream us.actual.battle.net:1119 -out /tmp/bnetrelay
package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"crypto/tls"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/auth/bnet"
	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/auth/realm"
)

const certs = "certs" // setup/connect-client.sh makes them; capture-live passes its own

func main() {
	listen := flag.String("listen", "127.0.0.1:1119", "where the client connects (the portal's address)")
	upstream := flag.String("upstream", "us.actual.battle.net:1119", "the real bgs server")
	sni := flag.String("sni", "", "TLS server name upstream (default: the -upstream host)")
	insecure := flag.Bool("insecure", false, "skip upstream certificate checks (the local fork's self-signed chain)")
	cert := flag.String("cert", certs+"/server.chain.pem", "certificate the client sees (valid for the portal name)")
	key := flag.String("key", certs+"/server.key.pem", "its private key")
	out := flag.String("out", "/tmp/bnetrelay", "directory for this run's records")
	flag.Parse()

	pair, err := tls.LoadX509KeyPair(home(*cert), home(*key))
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("bnetrelay: certificate: %v", err)
	}
	host, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(*upstream)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("bnetrelay: -upstream: %v", err)
	}
	if *sni == "" {
		*sni = host
	}
	dir := filepath.Join(*out, time.Now().Format("20060102-150405"))
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o700); err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	rec, err := newRecorder(dir)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	ln, err := tls.Listen("tcp", *listen, &tls.Config{Certificates: []tls.Certificate{pair}, MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12})
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("bnetrelay: listen: %v (is something else on it? a local bnetserver: tmux kill-session -t tc-bnet)", err)
	}
	log.Printf("bnetrelay: %s -> %s (sni %s); records in %s", *listen, *upstream, *sni, dir)
	up := &tls.Config{ServerName: *sni, MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12, InsecureSkipVerify: *insecure}
	for id := 1; ; id++ {
		c, err := ln.Accept()
		if err != nil {
			log.Fatal(err)
		}
		go relay(id, c, *upstream, up, rec)
	}
}

func home(p string) string {
	if strings.HasPrefix(p, "~/") {
		h, _ := os.UserHomeDir()
		return filepath.Join(h, p[2:])
	}
	return p
}

// relay passes one client connection through to its own upstream connection.
func relay(id int, client net.Conn, upstream string, cfg *tls.Config, rec *recorder) {
	defer client.Close()
	server, err := tls.DialWithDialer(&net.Dialer{Timeout: 15 * time.Second}, "tcp", upstream, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("c%d: upstream: %v", id, err)
		return
	}
	defer server.Close()
	log.Printf("c%d: client %s, upstream %s", id, client.RemoteAddr(), server.RemoteAddr())
	pending := &tokens{m: map[tokenKey]call{}}
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	wg.Add(2)
	go func() { defer wg.Done(); pump(id, "c2s", client, server, pending, rec); server.CloseWrite() }()
	go func() { defer wg.Done(); pump(id, "s2c", server, client, pending, rec); client.Close() }()
	wg.Wait()
	log.Printf("c%d: closed", id)
}

// call is what a request was, kept until its response comes back.
type call struct {
	hash, method uint32
	body         []byte
}

// tokenKey: a response travels the other way, so the requester's direction
// keys its token.
type tokenKey struct {
	dir   string
	token uint32
}

type tokens struct {
	mu sync.Mutex
	m  map[tokenKey]call
}

func (t *tokens) put(k tokenKey, c call) { t.mu.Lock(); t.m[k] = c; t.mu.Unlock() }
func (t *tokens) take(k tokenKey) (call, bool) {
	t.mu.Lock()
	defer t.mu.Unlock()
	c, ok := t.m[k]
	delete(t.m, k)
	return c, ok
}

func other(dir string) string {
	if dir == "c2s" {
		return "s2c"
	}
	return "c2s"
}

// pump copies frames from src to dst unchanged, recording each.
func pump(id int, dir string, src io.Reader, dst io.Writer, pending *tokens, rec *recorder) {
	r := bufio.NewReaderSize(src, 64<<10)
	for {
		raw, err := readRaw(r)
		if err != nil {
			if err != io.EOF {
				log.Printf("c%d %s: %v", id, dir, err)
			}
			return
		}
		if _, err := dst.Write(raw); err != nil {
			log.Printf("c%d %s: write: %v", id, dir, err)
			return
		}
		f, _, err := bnet.Decode(raw)
		if err != nil {
			rec.frame(entry{Conn: id, Dir: dir, Error: err.Error(), Raw: hex.EncodeToString(raw)})
			continue
		}
		h := f.Header
		e := entry{Conn: id, Dir: dir, Token: h.Token, Method: h.MethodID, Status: h.Status, Size: len(f.Body), Body: hex.EncodeToString(f.Body)}
		var req call
		if h.ServiceID == 254 || h.IsResponse {
			e.Response = true
			if c, ok := pending.take(tokenKey{other(dir), h.Token}); ok {
				req = c
				e.Method = c.method
				e.Hash = fmt.Sprintf("%#08x", c.hash)
				e.Service = serviceName(c.hash)
			}
		} else {
			e.Hash = fmt.Sprintf("%#08x", h.ServiceHash)
			e.Service = serviceName(h.ServiceHash)
			pending.put(tokenKey{dir, h.Token}, call{hash: h.ServiceHash, method: h.MethodID, body: f.Body})
		}
		rec.frame(e)
		if e.Response {
			rec.secrets(id, req, f.Body)
		}
	}
}

// readRaw reads one whole frame: u16be header length, the header, the body
// the header's size names.
func readRaw(r *bufio.Reader) ([]byte, error) {
	var pre [2]byte
	if _, err := io.ReadFull(r, pre[:]); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	hlen := int(binary.BigEndian.Uint16(pre[:]))
	buf := make([]byte, 2+hlen)
	copy(buf, pre[:])
	if _, err := io.ReadFull(r, buf[2:]); err != nil {
		return nil, io.ErrUnexpectedEOF
	}
	size, ok := headerSize(buf)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unreadable header (%d bytes)", hlen)
	}
	if size >= bnet.MaxPayload {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("body of %d bytes", size)
	}
	body := make([]byte, size)
	if _, err := io.ReadFull(r, body); err != nil {
		return nil, io.ErrUnexpectedEOF
	}
	return append(buf, body...), nil
}

// headerSize reads Header.size (field 5, varint) straight from the header.
func headerSize(frame []byte) (int, bool) {
	b := frame[2:]
	for i := 0; i < len(b); {
		tag, n := binary.Uvarint(b[i:])
		if n <= 0 {
			return 0, false
		}
		i += n
		field, wire := tag>>3, tag&7
		switch wire {
		case 0:
			v, n := binary.Uvarint(b[i:])
			if n <= 0 {
				return 0, false
			}
			i += n
			if field == 5 {
				return int(v), true
			}
		case 1:
			i += 8
		case 5:
			i += 4
		case 2:
			l, n := binary.Uvarint(b[i:])
			if n <= 0 {
				return 0, false
			}
			i += n + int(l)
		default:
			return 0, false
		}
	}
	return 0, true // no size field: an empty body
}

var names = func() map[uint32]string {
	m := map[uint32]string{}
	for _, s := range []bnet.Service{bnet.ConnectionService, bnet.AuthenticationService, bnet.AuthenticationListener, bnet.GameUtilities, bnet.AccountService} {
		m[s.Hash] = s.Name
	}
	m[bnet.GameUtilitiesV1Hash] = "bgs.protocol.game_utilities.v1.GameUtilitiesService"
	m[bnet.GameUtilitiesV2Hash] = "bgs.protocol.game_utilities.v2.GameUtilitiesService"
	for _, n := range []string{
		"bnet.protocol.challenge.ChallengeListener",
		"bnet.protocol.friends.FriendsService", "bnet.protocol.friends.FriendsListener",
		"bnet.protocol.presence.PresenceService", "bnet.protocol.presence.PresenceListener",
		"bnet.protocol.resources.Resources",
		"bnet.protocol.account.AccountListener",
		"bnet.protocol.report.ReportService",
		"bnet.protocol.user_manager.UserManagerService", "bnet.protocol.user_manager.UserManagerListener",
		"bnet.protocol.club.v1.membership.ClubMembershipService", "bnet.protocol.club.v1.membership.ClubMembershipListener",
		"bnet.protocol.club.v1.ClubService", "bnet.protocol.club.v1.ClubListener",
		"bnet.protocol.session.SessionService", "bnet.protocol.session.SessionListener",
		"bnet.protocol.notification.NotificationService", "bnet.protocol.notification.NotificationListener",
		"bnet.protocol.whisper.v1.WhisperService", "bnet.protocol.whisper.v1.WhisperListener",
		"bnet.protocol.game_utilities.GameUtilities",
	} {
		m[bnet.ServiceHash(n)] = n
	}
	return m
}()

func serviceName(h uint32) string {
	if n, ok := names[h]; ok {
		return n
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("service %#08x", h)
}

type entry struct {
	T        string `json:"t"`
	Conn     int    `json:"conn"`
	Dir      string `json:"dir"`
	Service  string `json:"service,omitempty"`
	Hash     string `json:"hash,omitempty"`
	Method   uint32 `json:"method"`
	Token    uint32 `json:"token"`
	Response bool   `json:"response,omitempty"`
	Status   uint32 `json:"status,omitempty"`
	Size     int    `json:"size"`
	Body     string `json:"body,omitempty"`
	Raw      string `json:"raw,omitempty"`
	Error    string `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type recorder struct {
	mu            sync.Mutex
	frames, found *json.Encoder
	start         time.Time
}

func newRecorder(dir string) (*recorder, error) {
	f, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(dir, "frames.jsonl"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0o600)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	s, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(dir, "secrets.jsonl"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0o600)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &recorder{frames: json.NewEncoder(f), found: json.NewEncoder(s), start: time.Now()}, nil
}

func (r *recorder) frame(e entry) {
	e.T = fmt.Sprintf("%.3f", time.Since(r.start).Seconds())
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	_ = r.frames.Encode(e)
	what := e.Service
	if what == "" {
		what = "?"
	}
	kind := "req"
	if e.Response {
		kind = "resp"
	}
	log.Printf("c%d %s %-4s %s/%d token %d status %#x, %d B", e.Conn, e.Dir, kind, short(what), e.Method, e.Token, e.Status, e.Size)
}

func short(n string) string {
	if i := strings.LastIndex(n, "."); i >= 0 {
		return n[i+1:]
	}
	return n
}

// secrets pulls out of a ProcessTask round trip what the world keys need.
func (r *recorder) secrets(conn int, req call, resp []byte) {
	if req.hash != bnet.GameUtilities.Hash && req.hash != bnet.GameUtilitiesV2Hash {
		return
	}
	q, err := bnet.DecodeProcessTaskRequest(req.body)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	cmd := ""
	for _, a := range q.Attributes {
		if strings.HasPrefix(a.Name, "Command_") {
			cmd = a.Name
		}
	}
	rec := map[string]any{"t": fmt.Sprintf("%.3f", time.Since(r.start).Seconds()), "conn": conn, "command": cmd}
	if a, ok := bnet.Lookup(q.Attributes, realm.ParamClientInfo); ok {
		rec["client_info"] = blobText(a.Value)
	}
	if a, ok := bnet.Lookup(q.Attributes, realm.ParamRealmAddress); ok {
		rec["realm_address"] = fmt.Sprintf("%#x", a.Value.Uint)
	}
	p, err := bnet.DecodeProcessTaskResponse(resp)
	if err == nil {
		if a, ok := bnet.Lookup(p.Results, realm.ParamJoinSecret); ok {
			rec["join_secret"] = hex.EncodeToString(a.Value.Blob)
		}
		if a, ok := bnet.Lookup(p.Results, realm.ParamRealmJoinTicket); ok {
			rec["join_ticket"] = hex.EncodeToString(a.Value.Blob)
		}
		if a, ok := bnet.Lookup(p.Results, realm.ParamServerAddresses); ok {
			if addrs, err := realm.DecodeServerAddresses(a.Value.Blob); err == nil {
				rec["server_addresses"] = addrs
			}
		}
	}
	if len(rec) == 3 {
		return
	}
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	_ = r.found.Encode(rec)
	log.Printf("c%d secrets: %s (%d fields)", conn, cmd, len(rec)-3)
}

func blobText(v bnet.Variant) string {
	if v.Kind == bnet.VariantBlob {
		return strings.TrimRight(string(v.Blob), "\x00")
	}
	return v.String
}
```

`tools/capture-live`:

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# shellcheck disable=SC2329  # cleanup and decrypt run from the EXIT trap
# capture-live: record the stock client on Blizzard's live servers in one
# command, decrypt its world connections, and put the machine back as it was.
#
#   tools/capture-live                 live US (us.actual.battle.net)
#   tools/capture-live -region eu      live EU
#   tools/capture-live --dry-run       print each step, change nothing
#   tools/capture-live --game retail   the retail client (Midnight) instead of
#                                      Forever; RelayPortal.wtf is made from
#                                      its Config.wtf, UDP is recorded too
#                                      (QUIC), see docs/RETAIL.md
#   tools/capture-live --decrypt <run> step 8 again on an earlier run's folder
#
# This is EVIDENCE E45 done by hand, in order:
#   1. preflight: game not running, sudo works (tcpdump), /etc/hosts maps the
#      portal to 127.0.0.1 and ForeverLauncher.wtf exists (connect-client.sh)
#   2. free :1119: stop the fork's bnetserver (tmux tc-bnet), remembering it
#   3. build and start tools/bnetrelay on 127.0.0.1:1119 -> <region>.actual.battle.net
#   4. sudo tcpdump the world port (3724) into <run>/world.pcap
#   5. start the client through the Agent relay (no key patch), Agent.dat
#      51655 until the game is on the relay, then 51654 again
#   6. wait until the game exits (log in at the game's own login screen)
#   7. cleanup, also on Ctrl-C: stop relay and tcpdump, Agent.dat = 51654,
#      restart tc-bnet if it was running
#   8. tools/worlddecrypt the capture, print its summary and the top 20
#      messages per connection
#
# A run lives in captures/<timestamp>/ in this repo, or $WOW_LIVE_CAPTURES (mode 0700:
# secrets.jsonl holds the session's world keys; never commit it).
#
# Testing without live (does not touch tc-bnet or the game):
#   tools/capture-live --no-game --listen 127.0.0.1:11190 --upstream 127.0.0.1:1119 --insecure
# runs steps 1-4 and 7-8 against the local fork and waits for Ctrl-C instead
# of the game.
set -uo pipefail

REPO="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
TC="${WOW_TC:-$HOME/wow/server/wow-forever-tc}"  # optional: a local TrinityCore fork whose bnetserver is paused while recording
CAPTURES="${WOW_LIVE_CAPTURES:-$REPO/captures}"
CERTS="${WOW_LIVE_CERTS:-$REPO/certs}"   # made by setup/connect-client.sh
GAME_KIND=forever
AGENT_RELAY="$REPO/tools/agent_relay.py"
AGENT_RELAY_LOG="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/agent_relay.log"
AGENT_DAT=/Users/Shared/Battle.net/Agent/Agent.dat
PORTAL=trinity.actual.battle.net

REGION=us
LISTEN=127.0.0.1:1119
UPSTREAM=""
INSECURE=0
DRY=0
NO_GAME=0
DECRYPT_ONLY=""

usage() { sed -n '2,30p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; exit "${1:-0}"; }
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --game) GAME_KIND="${2:?}"; shift 2 ;;
    -region|--region) REGION="${2:?}"; shift 2 ;;
    --upstream) UPSTREAM="${2:?}"; shift 2 ;;
    --listen) LISTEN="${2:?}"; shift 2 ;;
    --insecure) INSECURE=1; shift ;;
    -n|--dry-run) DRY=1; shift ;;
    --no-game) NO_GAME=1; shift ;;
    --decrypt) DECRYPT_ONLY="${2:?}"; shift 2 ;;
    -h|--help) usage 0 ;;
    *) echo "capture-live: unknown argument $1" >&2; usage 2 ;;
  esac
done
case "$REGION" in us|eu|kr|tw) ;; *) echo "capture-live: -region us|eu|kr|tw" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
[[ -n "$UPSTREAM" ]] || UPSTREAM="$REGION.actual.battle.net:1119"
LISTEN_PORT="${LISTEN##*:}"
case "$GAME_KIND" in
  forever) WOW="${WOW_FOREVER_DIR:-/Applications/World of Warcraft/_forever_}"; WTF=ForeverLauncher.wtf
           PCAP_FILTER='tcp port 3724'; BUILD=70755 ;;
  retail)  WOW="${WOW_RETAIL_DIR:-/Applications/World of Warcraft/_retail_}"; WTF=RelayPortal.wtf
           # QUIC is open (README): keep every UDP flow but DNS/mDNS as well as TCP 3724.
           PCAP_FILTER='tcp port 3724 or (udp and not port 53 and not port 5353)'; BUILD=70783 ;;
  *) echo "capture-live: --game forever|retail" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
GAME="$WOW/World of Warcraft.app/Contents/MacOS/World of Warcraft"

RUN="$CAPTURES/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
BIN="$RUN/bin"

step() { printf '\n\033[1m== %s\033[0m\n' "$*"; }
say()  { printf '   %s\n' "$*"; }
die()  { printf '\033[31mcapture-live: %s\033[0m\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
# do: run a command, or in a dry run print it.
do_() {
  if (( DRY )); then printf '   $ %s\n' "$*"; else "$@"; fi
}
# check: a preflight condition; fatal for real, reported in a dry run.
check() {
  local msg="$1"; shift
  if "$@"; then say "ok: $msg"
  elif (( DRY )); then say "WOULD FAIL: $msg"
  else die "$msg"
  fi
}
alive() { ps -p "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }  # works for root processes too (kill -0 does not)
listening() { lsof -nP -iTCP:"$1" -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; }
detach() {  # start "$@" in its own session (Ctrl-C here does not reach it); print its pid
  python3 -c 'import subprocess, sys
p = subprocess.Popen(sys.argv[2:], start_new_session=True, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                     stdout=open(sys.argv[1], "ab"), stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print(p.pid)' "$@"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- state
TC_BNET_WAS=0
RELAY_PID=""
TCPDUMP_PID=""
GAME_PID=""
AGENT_DAT_TOUCHED=0
CLEANED=0

cleanup() {
  (( CLEANED )) && return
  CLEANED=1
  (( DRY )) && return
  step "7. cleanup"
  if [[ -n "$TCPDUMP_PID" ]]; then
    # tcpdump runs as root: signal it through sudo; SIGINT flushes the capture.
    sudo -n pkill -INT -P "$TCPDUMP_PID" tcpdump 2>/dev/null || sudo -n kill -INT "$TCPDUMP_PID" 2>/dev/null
    for _ in $(seq 1 20); do alive "$TCPDUMP_PID" || break; sleep 0.25; done
    sudo -n chown "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$RUN/world.pcap" 2>/dev/null
    say "tcpdump stopped ($(du -h "$RUN/world.pcap" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1) captured)"
  fi
  if [[ -n "$RELAY_PID" ]]; then
    kill "$RELAY_PID" 2>/dev/null
    for _ in $(seq 1 20); do kill -0 "$RELAY_PID" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.25; done
    say "bnetrelay stopped"
  fi
  if (( AGENT_DAT_TOUCHED )) && [[ "$(cat "$AGENT_DAT" 2>/dev/null)" != 51654 ]]; then
    printf 51654 > "$AGENT_DAT" && say "Agent.dat back to 51654"
  fi
  if [[ -n "$GAME_PID" ]] && kill -0 "$GAME_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    say "the game is still running (pid $GAME_PID); it was left alone"
  fi
  if (( TC_BNET_WAS )); then
    "$TC/start.sh" >/dev/null && say "tc-bnet restarted (start.sh)"
  fi
  decrypt
}

decrypt() {
  step "8. decrypt"
  local secrets="" pcap="" s
  for s in "$RUN"/bnet/*/secrets.jsonl "$RUN"/*/secrets.jsonl; do [[ -s "$s" ]] && secrets="$s"; done
  for s in "$RUN"/world*.pcap; do [[ -s "$s" ]] && pcap="$s"; done
  if [[ -z "$pcap" ]]; then say "no capture in $RUN"; return; fi
  if [[ -z "$secrets" || ! -s "$secrets" ]]; then
    say "no world secrets recorded (the client never joined a realm through the relay); capture kept in $RUN"
    return
  fi
  "$BIN/worlddecrypt" -build "$BUILD" -pcap "$pcap" -secrets "$secrets" -out "$RUN/decrypted" 2>&1 | sed 's/^/   /'
  local f
  for f in "$RUN"/decrypted/conn-*.jsonl; do
    [[ -s "$f" ]] || continue
    printf '\n   %s: %s messages\n' "$(basename "$f" .jsonl)" "$(wc -l < "$f" | tr -d ' ')"
    jq -r '"\(.dir) \(.name)"' "$f" | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20 | sed 's/^/     /'
  done
  printf '\n   run: %s\n' "$RUN"
}

if [[ -n "$DECRYPT_ONLY" ]]; then  # step 8 again, on an earlier run's folder
  RUN="$(cd "$DECRYPT_ONLY" && pwd)" || exit 1
  BIN="$(mktemp -d)"
  (cd "$REPO" && go build -o "$BIN/worlddecrypt" ./tools/worlddecrypt) || die "building worlddecrypt failed"
  decrypt
  rm -rf "$BIN"
  exit 0
fi

trap 'cleanup' EXIT
trap 'echo; say "interrupted"; exit 130' INT TERM

(( DRY )) && echo "capture-live: DRY RUN (nothing is started, stopped or written)"
echo "capture-live: upstream $UPSTREAM, relay on $LISTEN, run $RUN"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. preflight
step "1. preflight"
if (( ! NO_GAME )); then
  check "the game is not running" bash -c '! pgrep -x "World of Warcraft" >/dev/null'
  check "$GAME exists" test -x "$GAME"
  if [[ "$GAME_KIND" == retail && ! -f "$WOW/WTF/$WTF" ]]; then
    # Same trick as connect-client.sh: a separate config whose portal is the
    # name the fork's trusted certificate is valid for. Config.wtf is untouched.
    if (( DRY )); then say "\$ grep -v '^SET portal ' Config.wtf + SET portal \"$PORTAL\" > $WOW/WTF/$WTF"
    else { grep -v '^SET portal ' "$WOW/WTF/Config.wtf"; echo "SET portal \"$PORTAL\""; } > "$WOW/WTF/$WTF" && say "wrote $WOW/WTF/$WTF"; fi
  fi
  (( DRY )) && [[ "$GAME_KIND" == retail ]] || check "$WTF exists (else: sudo setup/connect-client.sh --game $GAME_KIND)" test -f "$WOW/WTF/$WTF"
  check "/etc/hosts has 127.0.0.1 $PORTAL (else: sudo setup/connect-client.sh)" grep -qE "^127\.0\.0\.1[[:space:]]+$PORTAL" /etc/hosts
  check "Agent relay script exists ($AGENT_RELAY)" test -f "$AGENT_RELAY"
  check "certificates exist in $CERTS (else: sudo setup/connect-client.sh)" test -f "$CERTS/server.chain.pem"
  check "Agent.dat is writable" test -w "$AGENT_DAT"
fi
check "sudo works without a password (tcpdump needs it; run 'sudo -v' first)" sudo -n true
check "go, jq and python3 are installed" bash -c 'command -v go jq python3 >/dev/null'

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2. free :1119
step "2. free :$LISTEN_PORT"
if [[ "$LISTEN_PORT" == 1119 ]] && tmux has-session -t tc-bnet 2>/dev/null; then
  TC_BNET_WAS=1
  say "the fork's bnetserver (tmux tc-bnet) is running; stopping it (restarted at the end)"
  do_ tmux kill-session -t tc-bnet
  (( DRY )) || for _ in $(seq 1 20); do listening "$LISTEN_PORT" || break; sleep 0.25; done
else
  say "tc-bnet not running (or not on this port): nothing to stop"
fi
if (( ! DRY )) && listening "$LISTEN_PORT"; then
  die ":$LISTEN_PORT is still taken: $(lsof -nP -iTCP:"$LISTEN_PORT" -sTCP:LISTEN | tail -n +2)"
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3. bnetrelay
step "3. build and start bnetrelay"
do_ mkdir -p "$BIN"
do_ chmod 700 "$CAPTURES"
do_ chmod 700 "$RUN"
(cd "$REPO" && do_ go build -o "$BIN/bnetrelay" ./tools/bnetrelay) || die "building bnetrelay failed"
(cd "$REPO" && do_ go build -o "$BIN/worlddecrypt" ./tools/worlddecrypt) || die "building worlddecrypt failed"
RELAY_ARGS=(-listen "$LISTEN" -upstream "$UPSTREAM" -out "$RUN/bnet" -cert "$CERTS/server.chain.pem" -key "$CERTS/server.key.pem")
(( INSECURE )) && RELAY_ARGS+=(-insecure)
if (( DRY )); then
  say "\$ $BIN/bnetrelay ${RELAY_ARGS[*]}  >$RUN/bnetrelay.log 2>&1 &"
else
  RELAY_PID="$(detach "$RUN/bnetrelay.log" "$BIN/bnetrelay" "${RELAY_ARGS[@]}")"
  for _ in $(seq 1 40); do listening "$LISTEN_PORT" && break; kill -0 "$RELAY_PID" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.25; done
  listening "$LISTEN_PORT" || die "bnetrelay did not start: $(tail -5 "$RUN/bnetrelay.log")"
  say "bnetrelay pid $RELAY_PID on $LISTEN -> $UPSTREAM (log $RUN/bnetrelay.log)"
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 4. tcpdump
step "4. tcpdump the world port"
TCPDUMP=(sudo -n tcpdump -i any -s 0 -U -w "$RUN/world.pcap" "$PCAP_FILTER")
if (( DRY )); then
  say "\$ ${TCPDUMP[*]}  >$RUN/tcpdump.log 2>&1 &"
else
  # A plain background job, not detached: sudo's ticket belongs to this terminal.
  "${TCPDUMP[@]}" >"$RUN/tcpdump.log" 2>&1 &
  TCPDUMP_PID=$!
  for _ in $(seq 1 20); do [[ -e "$RUN/world.pcap" ]] && break; sleep 0.25; done
  alive "$TCPDUMP_PID" || die "tcpdump did not start: $(cat "$RUN/tcpdump.log")"
  say "tcpdump (sudo pid $TCPDUMP_PID) -> $RUN/world.pcap"
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5. the client
if (( NO_GAME )); then
  step "5-6. --no-game: not starting the client; Ctrl-C to stop"
  (( DRY )) || while :; do sleep 1; done
  exit 0
fi

step "5. start the client through the Agent relay (no key patch)"
if ! listening 51655; then
  say "Agent relay not on 51655: starting it"
  if (( DRY )); then
    say "\$ python3 $AGENT_RELAY --log $AGENT_RELAY_LOG  (own session)"
  else
    detach /dev/null python3 "$AGENT_RELAY" --log "$AGENT_RELAY_LOG" >/dev/null
    for _ in $(seq 1 20); do listening 51655 && break; sleep 0.25; done
    listening 51655 || die "the Agent relay did not start"
  fi
else
  say "Agent relay already on 51655"
fi
AGENT_DAT_TOUCHED=1
if (( DRY )); then say "\$ printf 51655 > $AGENT_DAT"; else printf 51655 > "$AGENT_DAT"; fi
if (( DRY )); then
  say "\$ cd \"$WOW\" && \"$GAME\" -config $WTF  >$RUN/client.log 2>&1 (own session)"
  say "wait until the game has an ESTABLISHED connection to 51655 (90 s), then printf 51654 > $AGENT_DAT"
else
  GAME_PID="$(cd "$WOW" && detach "$RUN/client.log" "$GAME" -config "$WTF")"
  say "client pid $GAME_PID"
  for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
    lsof -a -nP -p "$GAME_PID" -iTCP:51655 2>/dev/null | grep -q ESTABLISHED && break
    kill -0 "$GAME_PID" 2>/dev/null || break
    sleep 1
  done
  printf 51654 > "$AGENT_DAT"
  if lsof -a -nP -p "$GAME_PID" -iTCP:51655 2>/dev/null | grep -q ESTABLISHED; then
    say "game is on the Agent relay; Agent.dat back to 51654"
  else
    say "game did not connect to the Agent relay (it may spin this session); Agent.dat back to 51654"
  fi
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 6. wait
step "6. recording"
printf '\n   \033[1;32m>>> Log in in the game now. Quit the game when done (Ctrl-C here stops the recording). <<<\033[0m\n\n'
if (( ! DRY )); then
  while kill -0 "$GAME_PID" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 2; done
  say "the game exited"
else
  say "wait until pid exits"
  step "7. cleanup (on exit or Ctrl-C)"
  say "stop tcpdump (sudo kill -INT) and bnetrelay; chown world.pcap; Agent.dat = 51654"
  say "restart tc-bnet with $TC/start.sh if it was running (it was: $( tmux has-session -t tc-bnet 2>/dev/null && echo yes || echo no))"
  step "8. decrypt"
  say "\$ $BIN/worlddecrypt -build $BUILD -pcap $RUN/world.pcap -secrets $RUN/bnet/<relay run>/secrets.jsonl -out $RUN/decrypted"
  say "then per connection: message count and the top 20 (dir, name)"
fi
exit 0

```

`tools/combatfeed/main.go`:

```go
// Command combatfeed turns a world session into a live combat feed: one JSON
// object per line on stdout, as it happens. It is what an overlay
// (tools/auraoverlay) or an addon bridge reads in place of the
// COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED the 12.x client no longer gives addons.
//
//	# the stock client on live, through tools/capture-live's relay and tcpdump
//	go run ./tools/combatfeed -run captures/<stamp> -follow
//	go run ./tools/combatfeed -pcap world.pcap -secrets secrets.jsonl -follow     # the same, by file
//	# the stock client on the local fork: the server's own packet log, no decryption
//	go run ./tools/combatfeed -pkt <fork>/logs/World.pkt -follow -from-end
//	# a recorded fight played back in real time (try it with the overlay)
//	go run ./tools/combatfeed -pkt <fork>/logs/World.pkt -start 610 -replay 1
//
// Lines:
//
//	{"type":"player","guid":"..."}                        CMSG_PLAYER_LOGIN seen
//	{"type":"target","guid":"..."}                        CMSG_SET_SELECTION
//	{"type":"event","t":...,"sub":"SPELL_DAMAGE",...}     every combat event
//	{"type":"auras","unit":"player","auras":[...]}        the unit's auras, on every change
//	{"type":"cooldowns","gcd_ms":...,"cooldowns":[...]}   what is still recovering (absent = ready)
//	{"type":"power","powers":[{"type":17,"name":"fury","amount":42}]}
//
// The player and target come from the client's own messages, so the feed
// knows whose buffs to show and what you have selected.
package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/csv"
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/codec"
	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/combatlog"
	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/opcodes"
	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/pktlog"
	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/spellstate"
	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/worldstream"
)

type msg struct {
	name string
	c2s  bool
	t    uint32 // ms
	body []byte
}

func main() {
	home, _ := os.UserHomeDir()
	pkt := flag.String("pkt", "", "the fork's packet log (logs/World.pkt)")
	pcap := flag.String("pcap", "", "a tcpdump pcapng of the world port (live, with -secrets)")
	secrets := flag.String("secrets", "", "bnetrelay's secrets.jsonl for -pcap")
	build := flag.Int("build", 0, "with -pcap/-run: 70755 Forever, 70783 retail, 0 to tell from the capture")
	run := flag.String("run", "", "a tools/capture-live run directory: its world.pcap and bnet/*/secrets.jsonl (waits for both)")
	follow := flag.Bool("follow", false, "keep reading as the file grows")
	fromEnd := flag.Bool("from-end", false, "with -follow: skip what is already in the file (the player and target are still picked up from it)")
	start := flag.Float64("start", 0, "skip messages before this many seconds into the log")
	replay := flag.Float64("replay", 0, "play a finished log back at this speed (1 = real time)")
	poll := flag.Duration("poll", 50*time.Millisecond, "with -follow: the longest wait for new data (on macOS the feed wakes the moment the file grows)")
	opcodesH := flag.String("opcodes-h", filepath.Join(envOr("WOW_TC", filepath.Join(home, "wow/server/wow-forever-tc")), "TrinityCore/src/server/game/Server/Protocol/Opcodes.h"), "the fork's Opcodes.h (names a World.pkt's numbers)")
	spellsCSV := flag.String("spells", "", "a wago.tools SpellName.csv (ID,Name_lang) for spell names, e.g. retail's")
	spellData := flag.String("spelldata", "", "a directory of wago.tools CSVs (SpellCooldowns, SpellCategories, SpellCategory, SpellName) for cooldowns, charges and the GCD")
	db := flag.String("db", envOr("WOW_FOREVER_DB", filepath.Join(home, "wow/host/data/forever.db")), "forever.db for spell names")
	flag.Parse()

	if *run != "" {
		*pcap = filepath.Join(*run, "world.pcap")
		for said := false; ; said = true {
			m, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(*run, "bnet", "*", "secrets.jsonl"))
			_, perr := os.Stat(*pcap)
			if len(m) > 0 && perr == nil {
				*secrets = m[len(m)-1]
				break
			}
			if !said {
				fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "combatfeed: waiting for", *pcap, "and the relay's secrets.jsonl (log in now)")
			}
			time.Sleep(500 * time.Millisecond)
		}
	}
	var next func() ([]msg, error)
	switch {
	case *pkt != "":
		names, err := forkNames(*opcodesH)
		check(err)
		t, err := pktlog.OpenTail(*pkt)
		check(err)
		next = func() ([]msg, error) {
			ps, err := t.Next()
			var out []msg
			for _, p := range ps {
				c2s := p.Dir == pktlog.C2S
				out = append(out, msg{names[key(c2s, p.Opcode)], c2s, p.TicksMs, p.Body})
			}
			return out, err
		}
	case *pcap != "" && *secrets != "":
		t, err := worldstream.OpenTail(*pcap)
		check(err)
		d := worldstream.New(*build, *secrets)
		var t0 time.Time
		next = func() ([]msg, error) {
			segs, err := t.Next()
			var out []msg
			for _, s := range segs {
				for _, m := range d.Feed(s) {
					if t0.IsZero() {
						t0 = m.T
					}
					out = append(out, msg{m.Short(), m.Dir == opcodes.ClientToServer, uint32(m.T.Sub(t0).Milliseconds()), m.Body})
				}
			}
			return out, err
		}
	default:
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "combatfeed: need -pkt, or -pcap with -secrets")
		os.Exit(2)
	}

	spells := spellNames(*db)
	var data *spellstate.Data
	if *spellData != "" {
		d, err := spellstate.LoadWago(*spellData)
		check(err)
		data = d
		for id, n := range d.Names {
			spells[id] = n
		}
	}
	if *spellsCSV != "" {
		check(readSpellCSV(*spellsCSV, spells))
	}
	followed := *pkt
	if followed == "" {
		followed = *pcap
	}
	var wake *waker
	if *follow {
		wake = newWaker(followed)
	}
	f := &feed{log: combatlog.New(), spells: spells, out: json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout), auraSig: map[string]string{}, cd: spellstate.New(data)}
	live := false // false while catching up on what was in the file
	var last uint32
	wall := time.Now()
	for first := true; ; first = false {
		ms, err := next()
		check(err)
		if first && *follow && *fromEnd {
			for _, m := range ms {
				f.quiet(m) // learn the player, target and auras; emit nothing
			}
			ms = nil
		}
		for _, m := range ms {
			if float64(m.t)/1000 < *start {
				f.quiet(m)
				continue
			}
			if *replay > 0 && !live {
				if last != 0 && m.t > last {
					target := time.Duration(float64(m.t-last)/(*replay)) * time.Millisecond
					if gap := target - time.Since(wall); gap > 0 {
						time.Sleep(min(gap, 5*time.Second))
					}
				}
				last, wall = m.t, time.Now()
			}
			if !f.primed {
				f.prime(m.t)
			}
			f.handle(m)
		}
		if !*follow {
			if len(ms) == 0 {
				return
			}
			continue
		}
		live = true
		if len(ms) == 0 {
			wake.wait(*poll) // returns as soon as the capture grows
		}
	}
}

type feed struct {
	log     *combatlog.Log
	spells  map[int32]string
	out     *json.Encoder
	player  codec.GUID
	target  codec.GUID
	auraSig map[string]string
	primed  bool
	cd      *spellstate.Tracker
	cdSig   string
	pwSig   string
}

// prime announces what was picked up quietly: the player, target and auras.
func (f *feed) prime(t uint32) {
	f.primed = true
	if !f.player.IsEmpty() {
		f.emit(map[string]any{"type": "player", "guid": f.player.String(), "t": t})
	}
	f.emit(map[string]any{"type": "target", "guid": f.target.String(), "unit": unitName(f.target), "t": t})
	f.auras(t, true)
}

// quiet takes a message in without emitting anything.
func (f *feed) quiet(m msg) {
	if !f.track(m) && !m.c2s {
		f.cd.Message(m.name, m.t, m.body)
		evs, _ := f.log.Feed(m.name, m.t, m.body)
		for _, e := range evs {
			f.cd.Event(e)
		}
	}
}

// track follows the player and target from the client's own messages.
func (f *feed) track(m msg) bool {
	if !m.c2s {
		return false
	}
	switch m.name {
	case "CMSG_PLAYER_LOGIN":
		if g, err := codec.NewReader(m.body).GUID(); err == nil {
			f.player, f.target = g, codec.GUID{}
			f.cd.Player = g
			return true
		}
	case "CMSG_SET_SELECTION":
		if g, err := codec.NewReader(m.body).GUID(); err == nil && g != f.target {
			f.target = g
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func (f *feed) handle(m msg) {
	if m.c2s {
		if f.track(m) {
			if m.name == "CMSG_PLAYER_LOGIN" {
				f.emit(map[string]any{"type": "player", "guid": f.player.String(), "t": m.t})
			}
			f.emit(map[string]any{"type": "target", "guid": f.target.String(), "unit": unitName(f.target), "t": m.t})
			f.auras(m.t, true)
		}
		return
	}
	changed := f.cd.Message(m.name, m.t, m.body)
	evs, err := f.log.Feed(m.name, m.t, m.body)
	if err != nil {
		if err != combatlog.ErrUnknown {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		}
		if changed {
			f.cooldowns(m.t)
		}
		return
	}
	for _, ev := range evs {
		if f.cd.Event(ev) {
			changed = true
		}
	}
	for _, ev := range evs {
		o := map[string]any{
			"type": "event", "t": ev.TimeMs, "sub": ev.Sub,
			"src": unitName(ev.Source), "dst": unitName(ev.Dest),
			"mine": !f.player.IsEmpty() && ev.Source == f.player,
			"me":   !f.player.IsEmpty() && ev.Dest == f.player,
		}
		if ev.SpellID != 0 {
			o["spell"], o["name"] = ev.SpellID, f.spells[ev.SpellID]
		}
		for k, v := range map[string]int64{"amount": ev.Amount, "over": int64(max(ev.Over, 0)), "absorbed": int64(ev.Absorbed), "school": int64(ev.School), "extra": int64(ev.Extra), "hp": ev.Health} {
			if v != 0 {
				o[k] = v
			}
		}
		if ev.Crit {
			o["crit"] = true
		}
		f.emit(o)
	}
	f.auras(m.t, false)
	if changed {
		f.cooldowns(m.t)
		f.power(m.t)
	}
}

// cooldowns emits the player's GCD and everything still recovering, when it
// changed. Anything not listed is ready.
func (f *feed) cooldowns(t uint32) {
	cds := f.cd.Cooldowns(t)
	for i := range cds {
		if cds[i].Name == "" && cds[i].Spell != 0 {
			cds[i].Name = f.spells[cds[i].Spell]
		}
	}
	gcd := f.cd.GCD(t)
	b, _ := json.Marshal(cds)
	sig := fmt.Sprintf("%d|%s", gcd/50, b) // the same state 50 ms later is not news
	if sig == f.cdSig {
		return
	}
	f.cdSig = sig
	if cds == nil {
		cds = []spellstate.Cooldown{}
	}
	f.emit(map[string]any{"type": "cooldowns", "t": t, "gcd_ms": gcd, "cooldowns": cds})
}

// power emits the player's known power amounts when they changed.
func (f *feed) power(t uint32) {
	pw, ok := f.cd.Power()
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	var list []map[string]any
	var keys []int
	for k := range pw {
		keys = append(keys, int(k))
	}
	sort.Ints(keys)
	for _, k := range keys {
		list = append(list, map[string]any{"type": k, "name": spellstate.PowerNames[int8(k)], "amount": pw[int8(k)]})
	}
	b, _ := json.Marshal(list)
	if string(b) == f.pwSig {
		return
	}
	f.pwSig = string(b)
	f.emit(map[string]any{"type": "power", "t": t, "powers": list})
}

// auras emits the player's and the target's auras when they changed.
func (f *feed) auras(t uint32, force bool) {
	for _, u := range []struct {
		name string
		g    codec.GUID
	}{{"player", f.player}, {"target", f.target}} {
		list := []map[string]any{}
		var sig strings.Builder
		if !u.g.IsEmpty() {
			for _, a := range f.log.Auras(u.g) {
				rem := int64(0)
				if a.ExpiresMs > t {
					rem = int64(a.ExpiresMs - t)
				}
				list = append(list, map[string]any{
					"spell": a.SpellID, "name": f.spells[a.SpellID], "stacks": a.Stacks,
					"duration_ms": a.DurationMs, "remaining_ms": rem,
					"mine": a.Caster == f.player || a.Caster.IsEmpty() && u.g == f.player,
				})
				fmt.Fprintf(&sig, "%d:%d:%d:%d;", a.SpellID, a.Stacks, a.ExpiresMs, a.Slot)
			}
		}
		s := u.g.String() + "|" + sig.String()
		if !force && f.auraSig[u.name] == s {
			continue
		}
		f.auraSig[u.name] = s
		f.emit(map[string]any{"type": "auras", "t": t, "unit": u.name, "guid": u.g.String(), "auras": list})
	}
}

func (f *feed) emit(o map[string]any) {
	_ = f.out.Encode(o)
}

func unitName(g codec.GUID) string {
	if g.IsEmpty() {
		return ""
	}
	switch g.Hi >> 58 {
	case 2:
		return fmt.Sprintf("Player-%d", g.Lo&0xFFFFFFFFFF)
	case 8, 9, 12:
		return fmt.Sprintf("Creature-%d", (g.Hi>>6)&0x7FFFFF)
	}
	return g.String()
}

func key(c2s bool, op uint32) uint64 {
	if c2s {
		return 1<<32 | uint64(op)
	}
	return uint64(op)
}

var opLine = regexp.MustCompile(`\b([CS])(MSG_\w+)\s*=\s*(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)`)

func forkNames(path string) (map[uint64]string, error) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := map[uint64]string{}
	for _, m := range opLine.FindAllStringSubmatch(string(b), -1) {
		v, _ := strconv.ParseUint(m[3], 0, 32)
		out[key(m[1] == "C", uint32(v))] = m[1] + m[2]
	}
	return out, nil
}

func spellNames(db string) map[int32]string {
	out := map[int32]string{}
	b, err := exec.Command("sqlite3", "-separator", "\t", db, "select id, name from spells").Output()
	if err != nil {
		return out
	}
	sc := bufio.NewScanner(strings.NewReader(string(b)))
	for sc.Scan() {
		id, name, ok := strings.Cut(sc.Text(), "\t")
		if v, err := strconv.Atoi(id); ok && err == nil {
			out[int32(v)] = name
		}
	}
	return out
}

// readSpellCSV adds a wago.tools DB2 export (ID,Name_lang) to names (from
// tools/combatlog on claude/cool-swanson-47f3cf, 08f31ca).
func readSpellCSV(path string, names map[int32]string) error {
	f, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	rows, err := csv.NewReader(f).ReadAll()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, r := range rows[1:] {
		if id, err := strconv.Atoi(r[0]); err == nil && len(r) > 1 {
			names[int32(id)] = r[1]
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func check(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "combatfeed:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

// envOr is the environment variable k, or def when it is unset.
func envOr(k, def string) string {
	if v := os.Getenv(k); v != "" {
		return v
	}
	return def
}
```

`tools/combatfeed/wake_darwin.go`:

```go
package main

import (
	"os"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

// waker blocks until the followed file is written to, or the timeout passes.
// On macOS it asks the kernel (kqueue, EVFILT_VNODE) to wake it the moment
// tcpdump appends a packet, so a packet reaches the feed in microseconds
// instead of waiting out a poll interval.
type waker struct {
	kq int
	f  *os.File
}

func newWaker(path string) *waker {
	f, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	kq, err := syscall.Kqueue()
	if err != nil {
		f.Close()
		return nil
	}
	ev := syscall.Kevent_t{
		Ident:  uint64(f.Fd()),
		Filter: syscall.EVFILT_VNODE,
		Flags:  syscall.EV_ADD | syscall.EV_CLEAR,
		Fflags: syscall.NOTE_WRITE | syscall.NOTE_EXTEND,
	}
	if _, err := syscall.Kevent(kq, []syscall.Kevent_t{ev}, nil, nil); err != nil {
		syscall.Close(kq)
		f.Close()
		return nil
	}
	return &waker{kq: kq, f: f}
}

// wait returns when the file grows or after timeout; with no waker it sleeps.
func (w *waker) wait(timeout time.Duration) {
	if w == nil {
		time.Sleep(timeout)
		return
	}
	ts := syscall.NsecToTimespec(timeout.Nanoseconds())
	out := make([]syscall.Kevent_t, 1)
	_, _ = syscall.Kevent(w.kq, nil, out, &ts)
}

```

```go
package main

import "time"

// waker falls back to sleeping where kqueue file events aren't available.
type waker struct{}

func newWaker(string) *waker { return nil }

func (w *waker) wait(timeout time.Duration) { time.Sleep(timeout) }
```

`tools/combatlog/main.go`:

```go
// Command combatlog prints the combat log of a recorded session, rebuilt from
// the server's messages (protocol/combatlog), in the shape of the old
// COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED / WoWCombatLog.txt lines.
//
//	go run ./tools/combatlog <fork>/logs/World.pkt         # the fork's packet log
//	go run ./tools/combatlog decrypted/conn-55882.jsonl                  # a worlddecrypt connection
//
// Spell names come from forever.db (-db, via the sqlite3 CLI); creatures show
// as Creature-<entry>-<spawn>, players as Player-<low guid>. -stats prints counts only.
package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/csv"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/codec"
	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/combatlog"
	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/pktlog"
)

func main() {
	home, _ := os.UserHomeDir()
	opcodesH := flag.String("opcodes-h", filepath.Join(envOr("WOW_TC", filepath.Join(home, "wow/server/wow-forever-tc")), "TrinityCore/src/server/game/Server/Protocol/Opcodes.h"), "the fork's Opcodes.h, to name a World.pkt's numbers")
	db := flag.String("db", envOr("WOW_FOREVER_DB", filepath.Join(home, "wow/host/data/forever.db")), "forever.db for spell names (empty: ids only)")
	spellCSV := flag.String("spells", "", "SpellName.csv (ID,Name_lang), e.g. from wago.tools/db2/SpellName/csv?build=12.1.5.70783 for retail; overrides -db")
	stats := flag.Bool("stats", false, "print event and failure counts only")
	flag.Parse()
	if flag.NArg() != 1 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: combatlog [flags] <World.pkt | conn-*.jsonl>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	msgs, err := load(flag.Arg(0), *opcodesH)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	spells := spellNames(*db)
	if *spellCSV != "" {
		if err := readSpellCSV(*spellCSV, spells); err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "combatlog:", err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	}

	l := combatlog.New()
	subs := map[string]int{}
	seen := map[string]int{}
	failed := map[string]int{}
	var firstErr = map[string]string{}
	w := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	defer w.Flush()
	for _, m := range msgs {
		evs, err := l.Feed(m.name, m.t, m.body)
		if err == combatlog.ErrUnknown {
			continue
		}
		seen[m.name]++
		if err != nil {
			failed[m.name]++
			if firstErr[m.name] == "" {
				firstErr[m.name] = err.Error()
			}
			continue
		}
		for _, ev := range evs {
			subs[ev.Sub]++
			if !*stats {
				fmt.Fprintln(w, line(ev, spells))
			}
		}
	}
	{
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "messages decoded (failed / seen):")
		for _, n := range sortedKeys(seen) {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %-34s %4d / %4d  %s\n", n, failed[n], seen[n], firstErr[n])
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "events:")
		for _, n := range sortedKeys(subs) {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %-26s %5d\n", n, subs[n])
		}
	}
}

type msg struct {
	name string
	t    uint32
	body []byte
}

func load(path, opcodesH string) ([]msg, error) {
	if strings.HasSuffix(path, ".jsonl") {
		return loadJSONL(path)
	}
	names, err := forkNames(opcodesH)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	lg, err := pktlog.ReadPKTFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var out []msg
	for _, p := range lg.Packets {
		if p.Dir != pktlog.S2C {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, msg{names[p.Opcode], p.TicksMs, p.Body})
	}
	return out, nil
}

var tilde = regexp.MustCompile(`~(SMSG_\w+)`)

func loadJSONL(path string) ([]msg, error) {
	f, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	sc := bufio.NewScanner(f)
	sc.Buffer(make([]byte, 1<<20), 1<<24)
	var out []msg
	for sc.Scan() {
		var d struct {
			T, Dir, Name, Body string
		}
		if json.Unmarshal(sc.Bytes(), &d) != nil || d.Dir != "s2c" {
			continue
		}
		m := tilde.FindStringSubmatch(d.Name)
		if m == nil {
			continue
		}
		b, _ := hex.DecodeString(d.Body)
		out = append(out, msg{m[1], clockMs(d.T), b})
	}
	return out, sc.Err()
}

func clockMs(t string) uint32 {
	var h, m int
	var s float64
	fmt.Sscanf(t, "%d:%d:%f", &h, &m, &s)
	return uint32((h*3600+m*60)*1000 + int(s*1000))
}

var opLine = regexp.MustCompile(`\b(SMSG_\w+)\s*=\s*(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)`)

func forkNames(path string) (map[uint32]string, error) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := map[uint32]string{}
	for _, m := range opLine.FindAllStringSubmatch(string(b), -1) {
		v, _ := strconv.ParseUint(m[2], 0, 32)
		out[uint32(v)] = m[1]
	}
	return out, nil
}

func spellNames(db string) map[int32]string {
	out := map[int32]string{}
	if db == "" {
		return out
	}
	b, err := exec.Command("sqlite3", "-separator", "\t", db, "select id, name from spells").Output()
	if err != nil {
		return out
	}
	for _, l := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
		id, name, ok := strings.Cut(l, "\t")
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		if v, err := strconv.Atoi(id); err == nil {
			out[int32(v)] = name
		}
	}
	return out
}

// unit names a GUID: type from the high 6 bits, entry from bits 6..28.
func unit(g codec.GUID) string {
	if g.IsEmpty() {
		return "nil"
	}
	switch g.Hi >> 58 {
	case 2:
		return fmt.Sprintf("Player-%d", g.Lo&0xFFFFFFFFFF)
	case 8, 9, 12:
		return fmt.Sprintf("Creature-%d-%010X", (g.Hi>>6)&0x7FFFFF, g.Lo&0xFFFFFFFFFF) // entry, spawn (as CLEU)
	default:
		return g.String()
	}
}

func line(ev combatlog.Event, spells map[int32]string) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%8.3f  %-24s %-16s > %-16s", float64(ev.TimeMs)/1000, ev.Sub, unit(ev.Source), unit(ev.Dest))
	if ev.SpellID != 0 {
		name := spells[ev.SpellID]
		if name == "" {
			name = "?"
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, " %d %q", ev.SpellID, name)
	}
	switch {
	case strings.HasSuffix(ev.Sub, "_DAMAGE") || strings.HasSuffix(ev.Sub, "_HEAL") || strings.HasSuffix(ev.Sub, "ENERGIZE") || strings.HasSuffix(ev.Sub, "LEECH"):
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, " amount=%d", ev.Amount)
		if ev.Over > 0 {
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, " over=%d", ev.Over)
		}
		if ev.Absorbed != 0 {
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, " absorbed=%d", ev.Absorbed)
		}
		if ev.Crit {
			b.WriteString(" crit")
		}
	case strings.HasPrefix(ev.Sub, "SPELL_AURA_APPLIED") || ev.Sub == "SPELL_AURA_REFRESH":
		if strings.HasSuffix(ev.Sub, "DOSE") {
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, " stacks=%d", ev.Amount)
		} else if ev.Amount != 0 {
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, " remaining=%.1fs", float64(ev.Amount)/1000)
		}
	case ev.Sub == "SPELL_CAST_START":
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, " cast=%.2fs", float64(ev.Amount)/1000)
	case ev.Sub == "SPELL_INTERRUPT":
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, " interrupted=%d %q", ev.Extra, spells[ev.Extra])
	case strings.HasSuffix(ev.Sub, "_MISSED"):
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, " reason=%d", ev.Extra)
	}
	if ev.Health != 0 {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, " hp=%d", ev.Health)
	}
	return b.String()
}

func sortedKeys(m map[string]int) []string {
	var k []string
	for n := range m {
		k = append(k, n)
	}
	sort.Strings(k)
	return k
}

// readSpellCSV adds a wago.tools DB2 export (ID,Name_lang) to names.
func readSpellCSV(path string, names map[int32]string) error {
	f, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	rows, err := csv.NewReader(f).ReadAll()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, r := range rows[1:] {
		if id, err := strconv.Atoi(r[0]); err == nil && len(r) > 1 {
			names[int32(id)] = r[1]
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// envOr is the environment variable k, or def when it is unset.
func envOr(k, def string) string {
	if v := os.Getenv(k); v != "" {
		return v
	}
	return def
}
```
