`world/crypt_test.go`:

```go
package world

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"testing"
)

// Vector from an independent AES-256-GCM implementation (Python `cryptography`,
// /tmp/gcmref.py) with key = 0x00..0x1f, nonce = counter 0 ‖ "CLNT" and the
// plaintext 0x01004600 ‖ "hello world".
func TestSealVectorMatchesTagAndBody(t *testing.T) {
	key := make([]byte, 32)
	for i := range key {
		key[i] = byte(i)
	}
	c, err := NewCipher(key, Send)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	plain := append([]byte{0x01, 0x00, 0x46, 0x00}, "hello world"...)
	sealed, err := c.Seal(make([]byte, 0, len(plain)+16), plain)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	tag := [12]byte(sealed[len(plain):])
	body := sealed[:len(plain)]
	wantBody, _ := hex.DecodeString("defef3098ab8e9f494d0021657748e")
	wantTag, _ := hex.DecodeString("46102c06b63a74af29389168")
	if !bytes.Equal(tag[:], wantTag) {
		t.Fatalf("tag = %x, want %x", tag, wantTag)
	}
	// A second cipher at counter 0 must produce byte-identical output.
	body, err = c0Body(t, key, plain)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(body, wantBody) {
		t.Fatalf("body = %x, want %x", body, wantBody)
	}
	if c.Counter() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("counter = %d, want 1", c.Counter())
	}
}

func c0Body(t *testing.T, key, plain []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	t.Helper()
	c, err := NewCipher(key, Send)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	sealed, err := c.Seal(make([]byte, 0, len(plain)+16), plain)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	buf, tag := sealed[:len(plain)], [12]byte(sealed[len(plain):])
	rc, err := NewCipher(key, Recv)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	// The receive side uses the SRVR magic, so recompute the nonce by hand to
	// compare bytes with the reference that also used CLNT.
	if _, err := rcvOpenWithNonce(t, rc, buf, tag, 0, magicSend); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return buf, nil
}

func rcvOpenWithNonce(t *testing.T, c *Cipher, body []byte, tag [12]byte, counter uint64, magic [4]byte) ([]byte, error) {
	t.Helper()
	saved := c.magic
	savedN := c.counter
	c.magic = magic
	c.counter = counter
	out, err := c.Open(nil, body, tag[:])
	c.magic, c.counter = saved, savedN
	return out, err
}

func TestSerpentBadKeyLength(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := NewCipher(make([]byte, 16), Send); !errors.Is(err, ErrBadKeyLen) {
		t.Fatalf("err = %v, want ErrBadKeyLen", err)
	}
}

func TestRecvAndSendUseDifferentMagics(t *testing.T) {
	key := bytes.Repeat([]byte{7}, 32)
	s, err := NewCipher(key, Send)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	r, err := NewCipher(key, Recv)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if s.magic != magicSend || r.magic != magicRecv {
		t.Fatalf("magics = %q, %q", s.magic, r.magic)
	}
}

func TestRoundTripAndCounterAdvance(t *testing.T) {
	key := bytes.Repeat([]byte{9}, 32)
	s, _ := NewCipher(key, Send)
	r, _ := NewCipher(key, Recv)

	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		plain := append([]byte{byte(i), 0, 0, 0}, bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x5A}, 40)...)
		sealed, err := s.Seal(make([]byte, 0, len(plain)+16), plain)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		buf, tag := sealed[:len(plain)], [12]byte(sealed[len(plain):])
		// Mirror the send magic on the receive cipher: both sides of one
		// direction share the magic, the test's receive cipher is the same
		// direction's peer.
		r.magic = magicSend
		out, err := r.Open(nil, buf, tag[:])
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if !bytes.Equal(out, plain) {
			t.Fatalf("round trip %d mismatch", i)
		}
		if s.Counter() != uint64(i+1) || r.Counter() != uint64(i+1) {
			t.Fatalf("counters = %d, %d", s.Counter(), r.Counter())
		}
	}
}

func TestOpenRejectsTamperedBodyAndTag(t *testing.T) {
	key := bytes.Repeat([]byte{3}, 32)
	s, _ := NewCipher(key, Send)
	r, _ := NewCipher(key, Recv)
	r.magic = magicSend

	plain := []byte{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8}
	sealed, _ := s.Seal(make([]byte, 0, len(plain)+16), plain)
	buf, tag := sealed[:len(plain)], [12]byte(sealed[len(plain):])

	badBody := append([]byte(nil), buf...)
	badBody[2] ^= 0xFF
	if _, err := r.Open(nil, badBody, tag[:]); !errors.Is(err, ErrAuthFailed) {
		t.Fatalf("tampered body err = %v", err)
	}
	r.counter = 0
	badTag := tag
	badTag[0] ^= 0xFF
	if _, err := r.Open(nil, buf, badTag[:]); !errors.Is(err, ErrAuthFailed) {
		t.Fatalf("tampered tag err = %v", err)
	}
	r.counter = 0
	if _, err := r.Open(nil, buf, tag[:3]); !errors.Is(err, ErrBadTag) {
		t.Fatalf("short tag err = %v", err)
	}
}
```

`world/session.go`:

```go
package world

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha512"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/framing"
	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/opcodes"
	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/transport"
)

// Opcodes the connection itself needs. They are looked up by name in the
// versioned table so a build with a different numbering only needs a new table.
const (
	opAuthChallenge    = "SMSG_AUTH_CHALLENGE"
	opAuthSession      = "CMSG_AUTH_SESSION"
	opAuthContinued    = "CMSG_AUTH_CONTINUED_SESSION"
	opEnterEncrypted   = "SMSG_ENTER_ENCRYPTED_MODE"
	opEncryptedModeAck = "CMSG_ENTER_ENCRYPTED_MODE_ACK"
	opLogDisconnect    = "CMSG_LOG_DISCONNECT"
)

var (
	// ErrHandshake means the server's connect line was not the shipped one.
	ErrHandshake = errors.New("world: unexpected server handshake")
	// ErrServerIdentity means the ENTER_ENCRYPTED_MODE signature did not verify.
	ErrServerIdentity = errors.New("world: server identity check failed")
	// ErrEncoding means the server sent a message the protocol does not allow
	// in the current mode.
	ErrEncoding = errors.New("world: unexpected message for the connection mode")
	// ErrMode means a mode transition was out of order.
	ErrMode = errors.New("world: encryption mode change out of order")
)

// Verifier checks a SMSG_ENTER_ENCRYPTED_MODE signature (ed25519ctx over
// HMAC-SHA512(encryptKey, enabled ‖ seed)) against the shipped key store.
//
// The store is game data (TACT file 0x75E1DA), keyed by region group
// (research/encryption.md §2), so it is a dependency rather than part of this
// package.
type Verifier interface {
	VerifySignature(regionGroup uint32, signed, sig []byte, enabled bool) (bool, error)
}

// Ed25519Verifier verifies with a fixed public key. It is the shape a loaded
// key store implements per region group; tests use it directly.
type Ed25519Verifier struct {
	Pub     ed25519.PublicKey
	Enabled bool
}

// VerifySignature implements Verifier.
func (v Ed25519Verifier) VerifySignature(_ uint32, signed, sig []byte, enabled bool) (bool, error) {
	if len(v.Pub) != ed25519.PublicKeySize || len(sig) != ed25519.SignatureSize {
		return false, nil
	}
	return ed25519.VerifyWithOptions(v.Pub, signed, sig, &ed25519.Options{
		Context: string(EnableEncryptionContext),
	}) == nil, nil
}

// AcceptAllVerifier trusts any signature. It is what a connection to a server
// whose key store is unknown falls back to, and it says so.
type AcceptAllVerifier struct{}

// VerifySignature implements Verifier.
func (AcceptAllVerifier) VerifySignature(_ uint32, _, _ []byte, _ bool) (bool, error) {
	return true, nil
}

// Config is everything one world connection needs.
type Config struct {
	Dialer transport.Dialer
	Target transport.Target
	Table  *opcodes.Table
	// KeyData is the 64-byte Battle.net session-key material from the
	// realm-join ticket, and Ticket the ticket itself.
	KeyData []byte
	Ticket  []byte
	// BuildKey is the 16-byte per-build auth key. Nil means the known key of
	// Table's build (BuildAuthKey; 70707 when there is no table); set
	// SkipBuildKey to send none, which only a server with its check disabled
	// accepts.
	BuildKey *[BuildKeyLen]byte
	// SkipBuildKey omits the build key from the digest entirely.
	SkipBuildKey bool
	Region       uint32
	// Battlegroup and Realm are sent as-is; the client reads all three from its
	// realm identity (client 0x1014b336c, 0x1014b337c, 0x1014b3384).
	Battlegroup uint32
	Realm       uint32
	UseIPv6     bool
	// Timeout bounds the handshake and auth phase. Zero means 30 s.
	Timeout time.Duration
	// Verifier checks the server identity; nil uses AcceptAllVerifier.
	Verifier Verifier
	// DoSMaxNonce bounds the hashcash search; zero means unbounded.
	DoSMaxNonce uint64
}

// Session is a connection past auth. It is not safe for concurrent use; a
// caller reads and writes from one goroutine or serializes itself.
type Session struct {
	conn   transport.Conn
	stream *framing.Stream
	send   *Cipher
	recv   *Cipher

	table *opcodes.Table
	ids   struct {
		ack     uint32
		disc    uint32
		encMode uint32
	}

	// sessionKey is the 40-byte key this connection derived. A continued
	// session (SMSG_CONNECT_TO) authenticates with it and derives its own
	// encryption key from it.
	sessionKey [SessionKeyLen]byte

	encrypted bool
	closed    bool
	buf       []byte
	pending   []framing.Message
	// pendingClear counts the queued messages that arrived before the cipher
	// armed and are therefore still plaintext.
	pendingClear int
	// framesSent/framesRecv count the frames of each direction from the first
	// one, cleartext included. The GCM nonce counter continues across the
	// switch to encrypted mode instead of restarting at 0, so these are the
	// counters the ciphers are armed with (research/encryption.md §1).
	framesSent, framesRecv uint64
	readBuf                [4096]byte
}

func (c *Config) timeout() time.Duration {
	if c.Timeout > 0 {
		return c.Timeout
	}
	return 30 * time.Second
}

func (c *Config) verifier() Verifier {
	if c.Verifier != nil {
		return c.Verifier
	}
	return AcceptAllVerifier{}
}

// Connect dials, performs the handshake and auth exchange, verifies the server
// identity, sends the encrypted-mode ACK and arms the cipher.
//
// It returns only once the connection is fully established; messages the server
// sends after ENTER_ENCRYPTED_MODE stay buffered and come out of Read.
func Connect(ctx context.Context, c *Config) (*Session, error) {
	if c.Dialer == nil || c.Table == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("world: config needs a dialer and an opcode table")
	}
	if len(c.KeyData) != KeyDataLen {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("world: key data must be %d bytes", KeyDataLen)
	}
	if !c.SkipBuildKey && c.BuildKey == nil {
		if _, ok := BuildAuthKey(c.Table.Build); !ok {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("world: no auth key known for build %d; set BuildKey or SkipBuildKey", c.Table.Build)
		}
	}
	_, encID, err := c.Table.RequireID(opEnterEncrypted)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	_, ackID, err := c.Table.RequireID(opEncryptedModeAck)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	_, authID, err := c.Table.RequireID(opAuthSession)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	_, discID, err := c.Table.RequireID(opLogDisconnect)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, _, err := c.Table.RequireID(opAuthChallenge); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return dialAndAuth(ctx, c.Dialer, c.Target, c.Table, c.timeout(), encID, ackID, discID,
		func(s *Session) error { return s.auth(c, authID) })
}

// dialAndAuth dials, runs the handshake line, then auth, and clears the
// handshake deadline. Connect and ConnectContinued differ only in auth.
func dialAndAuth(ctx context.Context, d transport.Dialer, target transport.Target, table *opcodes.Table,
	timeout time.Duration, encID, ackID, discID uint32, auth func(*Session) error) (*Session, error) {
	conn, err := d.Dial(ctx, target)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	s := &Session{conn: conn, table: table}
	s.ids.encMode, s.ids.ack, s.ids.disc = encID, ackID, discID
	if err := conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(timeout)); err != nil {
		conn.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := s.handshake(); err != nil {
		conn.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	// The line was read straight off the socket, so the frame stream starts
	// already past it.
	s.stream = framing.NewStream(framing.TaggedCrypt{})
	if err := auth(s); err != nil {
		s.disconnect(4)
		conn.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	// The deadline bounds the handshake only. Left in place it kills the
	// session with an i/o timeout once c.timeout() has passed since the dial,
	// however healthy the connection is; keepalive is the session loop's job.
	if err := conn.SetDeadline(time.Time{}); err != nil {
		conn.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	return s, nil
}

// handshake reads the server's connect line, answers it, and returns.
func (s *Session) handshake() error {
	line, err := s.readHandshake()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if string(line) != framing.ServerConnect {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %q", ErrHandshake, line)
	}
	if _, err := s.conn.Write(framing.ConnectLine()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func (s *Session) readHandshake() ([]byte, error) {
	var one [1]byte
	var line []byte
	for {
		n, err := s.conn.Read(one[:])
		if n > 0 {
			if one[0] == '\n' {
				// Anything already pushed into the stream is handled by the
				// normal read loop; the line itself is complete.
				return line, nil
			}
			line = append(line, one[0])
			if len(line) > framing.MaxHandshakeLine {
				return nil, framing.ErrHandshakeTooLong
			}
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) && len(line) > 0 {
				return line, nil
			}
			return nil, err
		}
	}
}

// auth runs the challenge response up to and including the ACK.
func (s *Session) auth(c *Config, authID uint32) error {
	// SMSG_AUTH_CHALLENGE must be the first framed message.
	msg, err := s.next(ChallengeLen)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if msg.Opcode != replyOpcode(c.Table, "SMSG_AUTH_CHALLENGE") {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: first message %#08x is not AUTH_CHALLENGE", ErrEncoding, msg.Opcode)
	}
	var dos [32]byte
	copy(dos[:], msg.Body[:32])
	var server [ChallengeLen]byte
	copy(server[:], msg.Body[32:64])
	zeroBits := msg.Body[64]

	var local [ChallengeLen]byte
	if _, err := rand.Read(local[:]); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	digest, err := AuthDigest(c.KeyData, c.buildKey(), local[:], server[:])
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	sessionKey, err := SessionKey(c.KeyData, local[:], server[:])
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	encKey, err := EncryptionKey(sessionKey[:], local[:], server[:])
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.sessionKey = sessionKey
	nonce, err := DoSProof(local[:], server[:], digest[:], dos[:], zeroBits, c.DoSMaxNonce)
	if os.Getenv("WOW_DBG_KEY") != "" {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "DBG server=%x local=%x enc=%x keydata=%x sess=%x\n", server, local, encKey, c.KeyData, sessionKey)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	a := AuthSession{
		DosResponse:   nonce,
		RegionID:      c.Region,
		BattlegroupID: c.Battlegroup,
		RealmID:       c.Realm,
		UseIPv6:       c.UseIPv6,
		Ticket:        c.Ticket,
	}
	a.LocalChallenge = local
	a.Digest = digest
	if _, err := s.conn.Write(framing.Frame(framing.Tagged{}, authID, a.Encode(0)[4:])); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.framesSent++

	// The server answers with ENTER_ENCRYPTED_MODE.
	msg, err = s.next(1)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if msg.Opcode != s.ids.encMode {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: expected ENTER_ENCRYPTED_MODE, got %#08x", ErrMode, msg.Opcode)
	}
	if err := s.handleEnterEncryptedMode(msg.Body, encKey[:], c.verifier()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

// ContinuedConfig is everything a continued session needs: where
// SMSG_CONNECT_TO pointed, what it handed over, and the first connection's
// session key.
type ContinuedConfig struct {
	Dialer     transport.Dialer
	Target     transport.Target
	Table      *opcodes.Table
	SessionKey [SessionKeyLen]byte
	// ConnectTo is the decoded SMSG_CONNECT_TO; Key, NativeRealmAddress and
	// Key3 are echoed back.
	ConnectTo ConnectTo
	// Timeout bounds the handshake and auth phase. Zero means 30 s.
	Timeout     time.Duration
	Verifier    Verifier
	DoSMaxNonce uint64
}

// ConnectContinued opens the connection SMSG_CONNECT_TO asked for: the same
// handshake line and AUTH_CHALLENGE as Connect, answered with
// CMSG_AUTH_CONTINUED_SESSION instead of AUTH_SESSION, then the same signed
// ENTER_ENCRYPTED_MODE and ACK.
//
// The digest is HMAC-SHA512(sessionKey, key ‖ local ‖ server ‖
// ContinuedSessionSeed)[:24], the hashcash takes the session key where the
// first connection takes the digest (client 0x101094f9c), and the encryption
// key is derived from the same session key with this connection's challenges
// (the fork's HandleAuthContinuedSessionCallback).
func ConnectContinued(ctx context.Context, c *ContinuedConfig) (*Session, error) {
	if c.Dialer == nil || c.Table == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("world: continued config needs a dialer and an opcode table")
	}
	ids := make([]uint32, 4)
	for i, name := range []string{opEnterEncrypted, opEncryptedModeAck, opAuthContinued, opLogDisconnect} {
		_, id, err := c.Table.RequireID(name)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		ids[i] = id
	}
	if _, _, err := c.Table.RequireID(opAuthChallenge); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	timeout := c.Timeout
	if timeout <= 0 {
		timeout = 30 * time.Second
	}
	return dialAndAuth(ctx, c.Dialer, c.Target, c.Table, timeout, ids[0], ids[1], ids[3],
		func(s *Session) error { return s.authContinued(c, ids[2]) })
}

func (s *Session) authContinued(c *ContinuedConfig, authID uint32) error {
	msg, err := s.next(ChallengeLen)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if msg.Opcode != replyOpcode(c.Table, opAuthChallenge) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: first message %#08x is not AUTH_CHALLENGE", ErrEncoding, msg.Opcode)
	}
	if len(msg.Body) < 65 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: AUTH_CHALLENGE is %d bytes", ErrEncoding, len(msg.Body))
	}
	dos := msg.Body[:32]
	server := msg.Body[32:64]
	zeroBits := msg.Body[64]

	var local [ChallengeLen]byte
	if _, err := rand.Read(local[:]); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	digest, err := ContinuedSessionDigest(c.SessionKey[:], c.ConnectTo.Key, local[:], server)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	encKey, err := EncryptionKey(c.SessionKey[:], local[:], server)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	nonce, err := DoSProof(local[:], server, c.SessionKey[:], dos, zeroBits, c.DoSMaxNonce)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.sessionKey = c.SessionKey
	a := AuthContinuedSession{
		DosResponse:        nonce,
		LocalChallenge:     local,
		Digest:             digest,
		Key:                c.ConnectTo.Key,
		NativeRealmAddress: c.ConnectTo.NativeRealmAddress,
		Key3:               c.ConnectTo.Key3,
	}
	if _, err := s.conn.Write(framing.Frame(framing.Tagged{}, authID, a.Encode(0)[4:])); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.framesSent++

	msg, err = s.next(1)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if msg.Opcode != s.ids.encMode {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: expected ENTER_ENCRYPTED_MODE, got %#08x", ErrMode, msg.Opcode)
	}
	v := c.Verifier
	if v == nil {
		v = AcceptAllVerifier{}
	}
	return s.handleEnterEncryptedMode(msg.Body, encKey[:], v)
}

// SessionKey returns the 40-byte session key the connection derived (or, for
// a continued session, was given).
func (s *Session) SessionKey() [SessionKeyLen]byte { return s.sessionKey }

// handleEnterEncryptedMode verifies the signature, sends the ACK and arms the
// cipher. The ACK is the last cleartext frame, exactly as the client does
// (research/encryption.md §2).
func (s *Session) handleEnterEncryptedMode(body, encKey []byte, v Verifier) error {
	if len(body) < 4+64 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: ENTER_ENCRYPTED_MODE body is %d bytes", ErrEncoding, len(body))
	}
	region := uint32(body[0]) | uint32(body[1])<<8 | uint32(body[2])<<16 | uint32(body[3])<<24
	sig := body[4:68]
	enabled := body[68]&0x80 != 0
	ok, err := v.VerifySignature(region, EnableEncryptionMessage(encKey, enabled), sig, enabled)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !ok {
		return ErrServerIdentity
	}
	if _, err := s.conn.Write(framing.Frame(framing.Tagged{}, s.ids.ack, nil)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.framesSent++
	if !enabled {
		return nil
	}
	// The ACK is the last cleartext frame but it still consumes nonce 1; the
	// counters continue, they do not restart at 0, so the cipher starts at the
	// number of frames already written (AUTH_SESSION and the ACK).
	if s.send, err = NewCipherAt(encKey, Send, s.framesSent); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if s.recv, err = NewCipherAt(encKey, Recv, s.framesRecv); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.encrypted = true
	s.pendingClear = len(s.pending)
	return nil
}

// next reads exactly one message with at least minLen body bytes.
func (s *Session) next(minLen int) (framing.Message, error) {
	for {
		msgs, err := s.stream.Push(s.buf)
		s.buf = nil
		if err != nil {
			return framing.Message{}, err
		}
		if len(msgs) > 0 {
			m := msgs[0]
			s.framesRecv++
			for _, extra := range msgs[1:] {
				s.pending = append(s.pending, extra)
			}
			if len(m.Body) < minLen {
				return m, fmt.Errorf("%w: %#08x body is %d bytes, want %d", ErrEncoding, m.Opcode, len(m.Body), minLen)
			}
			return m, nil
		}
		n, err := s.conn.Read(s.readBuf[:])
		if n > 0 {
			s.buf = append(s.buf, s.readBuf[:n]...)
		}
		if err != nil {
			return framing.Message{}, err
		}
	}
}

// Read returns the next message, decrypting it when the cipher is armed.
func (s *Session) Read() (framing.Message, error) {
	if s.closed {
		return framing.Message{}, transport.ErrClosed
	}
	if len(s.pending) > 0 {
		m := s.pending[0]
		s.pending = s.pending[1:]
		s.framesRecv++
		if s.pendingClear > 0 {
			s.pendingClear--
			return m, nil
		}
		return s.unseal(m)
	}
	for {
		msgs, err := s.stream.Push(s.buf)
		s.buf = nil
		if err != nil {
			return framing.Message{}, err
		}
		if len(msgs) > 0 {
			s.pending = append(s.pending, msgs[1:]...)
			s.framesRecv++
			if s.pendingClear > 0 {
				s.pendingClear--
				return msgs[0], nil
			}
			return s.unseal(msgs[0])
		}
		n, err := s.conn.Read(s.readBuf[:])
		if n > 0 {
			s.buf = append(s.buf, s.readBuf[:n]...)
		}
		if err != nil {
			return framing.Message{}, err
		}
	}
}

func (s *Session) unseal(m framing.Message) (framing.Message, error) {
	if !s.encrypted {
		return m, nil
	}
	plain, err := s.recv.Open(nil, m.Body, m.Tag[:])
	if err != nil {
		return m, fmt.Errorf("world: unseal len=%d counter=%d: %w", len(m.Body), s.recv.Counter()-1, err)
	}
	if len(plain) < 4 {
		return m, ErrEncoding
	}
	m.Opcode = uint32(plain[0]) | uint32(plain[1])<<8 | uint32(plain[2])<<16 | uint32(plain[3])<<24
	m.Body = plain[4:]
	return m, nil
}

// Send frames one message, sealing it when the cipher is armed.
func (s *Session) Send(opcode uint32, body []byte) error {
	plain := make([]byte, 0, len(body)+4)
	plain = append(plain, byte(opcode), byte(opcode>>8), byte(opcode>>16), byte(opcode>>24))
	plain = append(plain, body...)

	if !s.encrypted {
		if _, err := s.conn.Write(framing.Frame(framing.Tagged{}, opcode, body)); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		s.framesSent++
		return nil
	}
	sealed, err := s.send.Seal(make([]byte, 0, len(plain)+framing.TagLen), plain)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	overhead := framing.TagLen
	ct, tag := sealed[:len(sealed)-overhead], sealed[len(sealed)-overhead:]
	// The header carries the first four ciphertext bytes, not the opcode: the
	// receiver keeps those in its header struct and prepends them back, so on
	// the wire the payload is one continuous ciphertext behind the tag, and
	// the size counts it whole (opcode included).
	hdr := framing.TaggedCrypt{}.EncodeSealed(ct, [framing.TagLen]byte(tag))
	if os.Getenv("WOW_DBG_FRAME") != "" {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "DBG SEND op=%#x plain=%x ct=%x hdr=%x rest=%x\n", opcode, plain, ct, hdr, ct[4:])
	}
	if _, err := s.conn.Write(hdr); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = s.conn.Write(ct[4:])
	return err
}

// disconnect sends CMSG_LOG_DISCONNECT with a reason, ignoring errors because
// the caller is already failing.
func (s *Session) disconnect(reason uint32) {
	if s.ids.disc == 0 {
		return
	}
	b := []byte{byte(reason), byte(reason >> 8), byte(reason >> 16), byte(reason >> 24)}
	_ = s.Send(s.ids.disc, b)
}

// Close closes the connection. A second Close is a no-op.
func (s *Session) Close() error {
	if s.closed {
		return nil
	}
	s.closed = true
	return s.conn.Close()
}

// Encrypted reports whether the cipher is armed.
func (s *Session) Encrypted() bool { return s.encrypted }

// Describe returns a log-safe description of the route.
func (s *Session) Describe() string { return s.conn.Describe() }

// buildKey resolves the digest's build key: an explicit one, or the known key
// of the table's build (70707's without a table), or none when SkipBuildKey
// is set.
func (c *Config) buildKey() []byte {
	if c.SkipBuildKey {
		return nil
	}
	if c.BuildKey != nil {
		return c.BuildKey[:]
	}
	if c.Table != nil {
		if k, ok := BuildAuthKey(c.Table.Build); ok {
			return k[:]
		}
		return nil
	}
	return ForeverBuildAuthKey[:]
}

func replyOpcode(t *opcodes.Table, name string) uint32 {
	if e, ok := t.ByName(name); ok && e.ID != nil {
		return *e.ID
	}
	return 0
}

// ensure sha512 stays referenced for the documented derivation
var _ = sha512.Size

```

`world/session_test.go`:

```go
package world

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/framing"
	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/protocol/opcodes"
	"github.com/Ltz-lab/wow-live/transport"
)

const (
	testAuthChallenge = 0x4E0000
	testEncMode       = 0x4E0004
	testAuthSession   = 0x460001
	testAck           = 0x460005
	testDisc          = 0x460007
	testPing          = 0x470001
)

func testTable(t *testing.T) *opcodes.Table {
	t.Helper()
	ent := func(name string, dir opcodes.Direction, id uint32) string {
		return `{"name":"` + name + `","direction":"` + string(dir) + `","id":` +
			itoa(id) + `,"confidence":"verified"}`
	}
	raw := `{"protocol":"wowf","product":"wowf","build":70707,"status":"test","entries":[` +
		ent("SMSG_AUTH_CHALLENGE", opcodes.ServerToClient, testAuthChallenge) + `,` +
		ent("SMSG_ENTER_ENCRYPTED_MODE", opcodes.ServerToClient, testEncMode) + `,` +
		ent("CMSG_AUTH_SESSION", opcodes.ClientToServer, testAuthSession) + `,` +
		ent("CMSG_ENTER_ENCRYPTED_MODE_ACK", opcodes.ClientToServer, testAck) + `,` +
		ent("CMSG_LOG_DISCONNECT", opcodes.ClientToServer, testDisc) + `,` +
		ent("SMSG_PING", opcodes.ServerToClient, testPing) + `]}`
	tbl, err := opcodes.Load([]byte(raw))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return tbl
}

func itoa(v uint32) string {
	if v == 0 {
		return "0"
	}
	var b []byte
	for v > 0 {
		b = append([]byte{byte('0' + v%10)}, b...)
		v /= 10
	}
	return string(b)
}

// pipeDialer hands the client one end of an in-memory connection.
type pipeDialer struct {
	client    transport.Conn
	serverNet net.Conn
}

func newPipeDialer() *pipeDialer {
	c, s := net.Pipe()
	return &pipeDialer{client: &pipeConn{c}, serverNet: s}
}

func (d *pipeDialer) Dial(ctx context.Context, _ transport.Target) (transport.Conn, error) {
	return d.client, nil
}

type pipeConn struct{ net.Conn }

func (c *pipeConn) Describe() string              { return "pipe" }
func (c *pipeConn) SetDeadline(t time.Time) error { return c.Conn.SetDeadline(t) }

func testConfig(t *testing.T, d transport.Dialer, v Verifier) *Config {
	t.Helper()
	key := make([]byte, KeyDataLen)
	if _, err := rand.Read(key); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var build [BuildKeyLen]byte
	copy(build[:], []byte("0123456789abcdef"))
	return &Config{
		Dialer:   d,
		Target:   transport.Target{Address: "pipe"},
		Table:    testTable(t),
		KeyData:  key,
		Ticket:   []byte("ticket-bytes"),
		BuildKey: &build,
		Region:   1, Battlegroup: 2, Realm: 3,
		Timeout:  5 * time.Second,
		Verifier: v,
	}
}

// serverSide is the fork's half of the exchange, enough of it to check the
// client end.
var dosBody []byte

type serverSide struct {
	t     *testing.T
	conn  net.Conn
	key   []byte
	build *[BuildKeyLen]byte
	priv  ed25519.PrivateKey
	pub   ed25519.PublicKey
	// results
	gotLocal  [ChallengeLen]byte
	gotNonce  uint64
	gotTicket string
	encKey    [EncryptionKeyLen]byte
	acked     bool
}

func (s *serverSide) readMessage() (framing.Message, error) {
	stream := framing.NewStream(framing.Tagged{})
	var buf []byte
	one := make([]byte, 4096)
	for {
		msgs, err := stream.Push(buf)
		buf = nil
		if err != nil {
			return framing.Message{}, err
		}
		if len(msgs) > 0 {
			return msgs[0], nil
		}
		n, err := s.conn.Read(one)
		if n > 0 {
			buf = append(buf, one[:n]...)
		}
		if err != nil {
			return framing.Message{}, err
		}
	}
}

func (s *serverSide) run(challengeZeroBits byte) {
	// server handshake line first
	if _, err := s.conn.Write(append([]byte(framing.ServerConnect), '\n')); err != nil {
		s.t.Error(err)
		return
	}
	readExact := func(n int) []byte {
		b := make([]byte, n)
		if _, err := io.ReadFull(s.conn, b); err != nil {
			s.t.Error(err)
		}
		return b
	}
	line := readExact(len(framing.ClientConnect) + 1)
	if string(line) != framing.ClientConnect+"\n" {
		s.t.Errorf("client line = %q", line)
		return
	}

	body := make([]byte, 0, 65)
	dos := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x11}, 32)
	server := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x22}, ChallengeLen)
	body = append(body, dos...)
	body = append(body, server...)
	body = append(body, challengeZeroBits)
	if _, err := s.conn.Write(framing.Frame(framing.Tagged{}, testAuthChallenge, body)); err != nil {
		s.t.Error(err)
		return
	}

	msg, err := s.readMessage()
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Error(err)
		return
	}
	if msg.Opcode != testAuthSession {
		s.t.Errorf("got opcode %#08x, want AUTH_SESSION", msg.Opcode)
		return
	}
	b := msg.Body
	s.gotNonce = binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(b[0:8])
	copy(s.gotLocal[:], b[20:52])
	digest := b[52:76]
	ticketLen := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(b[77:81])
	s.gotTicket = string(b[81 : 81+ticketLen])

	want, err := AuthDigest(s.key, s.build[:], s.gotLocal[:], server)
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Error(err)
		return
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(digest, want[:]) {
		s.t.Errorf("digest = %x, want %x", digest, want)
	}
	session, err := SessionKey(s.key, s.gotLocal[:], server)
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Error(err)
		return
	}
	s.encKey, err = EncryptionKey(session[:], s.gotLocal[:], server)
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Error(err)
		return
	}

	signed := EnableEncryptionMessage(s.encKey[:], true)
	sig, err := s.priv.Sign(rand.Reader, signed, &ed25519.Options{Context: string(EnableEncryptionContext)})
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Error(err)
		return
	}
	enc := make([]byte, 0, 4+64+1)
	enc = binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint32(enc, 1) // region group
	enc = append(enc, sig...)
	enc = append(enc, 0x80) // Enabled, as one high bit
	if _, err := s.conn.Write(framing.Frame(framing.Tagged{}, testEncMode, enc)); err != nil {
		s.t.Error(err)
		return
	}

	msg, err = s.readMessage()
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Error(err)
		return
	}
	if msg.Opcode == testDisc {
		return // a rejection path: the client logs the disconnect
	}
	if msg.Opcode != testAck || len(msg.Body) != 0 {
		s.t.Errorf("got %#08x len %d, want the empty ACK", msg.Opcode, len(msg.Body))
		return
	}
	s.acked = true

	// One encrypted message. The server's send direction is the client's
	// receive direction, so it uses the "SRVR" magic.
	// Its send counter continues from the two cleartext frames it already sent
	// (AUTH_CHALLENGE, ENTER_ENCRYPTED_MODE), exactly as the client's receive
	// counter does.
	send, err := NewCipherAt(s.encKey[:], Recv, 2)
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Error(err)
		return
	}
	plain := binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint32(nil, testPing)
	plain = append(plain, []byte("pong")...)
	sealed, err := send.Seal(make([]byte, 0, len(plain)+16), plain)
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Error(err)
		return
	}
	ct, tag := sealed[:len(plain)], sealed[len(plain):]
	hdr := framing.TaggedCrypt{}.EncodeSealed(ct, [framing.TagLen]byte(tag))
	if _, err := s.conn.Write(append(hdr, ct[4:]...)); err != nil {
		s.t.Error(err)
	}
}

func TestConnectFullExchange(t *testing.T) {
	pub, priv, err := ed25519.GenerateKey(rand.Reader)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	d := newPipeDialer()
	cfg := testConfig(t, d, Ed25519Verifier{Pub: pub, Enabled: true})
	srv := &serverSide{t: t, key: cfg.KeyData, build: cfg.BuildKey, priv: priv, pub: pub}
	dosBody = bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x11}, 32)

	done := make(chan struct{})
	srv.conn = d.serverNet
	go func() {
		defer close(done)
		srv.run(1)
	}()

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	sess, err := Connect(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("connect: %v", err)
	}
	defer sess.Close()
	if !sess.Encrypted() {
		t.Fatal("cipher not armed")
	}

	msg, err := sess.Read()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read: %v", err)
	}
	if msg.Opcode != testPing || string(msg.Body) != "pong" {
		t.Fatalf("got %#08x %q", msg.Opcode, msg.Body)
	}
	<-done

	if !srv.acked {
		t.Fatal("server never saw the ACK")
	}
	if srv.gotTicket != "ticket-bytes" {
		t.Fatalf("ticket = %q", srv.gotTicket)
	}
	// The nonce is the lowest value with the requested zero bits, and the
	// server-side recheck must accept it.
	digest, err := AuthDigest(srv.key, srv.build[:], srv.gotLocal[:], bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x22}, ChallengeLen))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ok, err := DoSCheck(srv.gotLocal[:], bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x22}, ChallengeLen), digest[:], dosBody, srv.gotNonce, 1)
	if err != nil || !ok {
		t.Fatalf("server rejected the proof: %v %v", ok, err)
	}
}

func TestConnectRejectsWrongHandshake(t *testing.T) {
	d := newPipeDialer()
	cfg := testConfig(t, d, AcceptAllVerifier{})
	go func() {
		d.serverNet.Write([]byte("NOT THE LINE\n"))
		io.ReadFull(d.serverNet, make([]byte, len(framing.ClientConnect)+1))
	}()
	ctx := context.Background()
	_, err := Connect(ctx, cfg)
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrHandshake) {
		t.Fatalf("err = %v, want ErrHandshake", err)
	}
}

func TestConnectRejectsBadSignature(t *testing.T) {
	pub, priv, err := ed25519.GenerateKey(rand.Reader)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	otherPub, _, err := ed25519.GenerateKey(rand.Reader)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	d := newPipeDialer()
	cfg := testConfig(t, d, Ed25519Verifier{Pub: otherPub})
	srv := &serverSide{t: t, key: cfg.KeyData, build: cfg.BuildKey, priv: priv, pub: pub}
	srv.conn = d.serverNet
	go func() { srv.run(1) }()

	_, err = Connect(context.Background(), cfg)
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrServerIdentity) {
		t.Fatalf("err = %v, want ErrServerIdentity", err)
	}
}

func TestConfigBuildKeyDefaultsToForeverKey(t *testing.T) {
	c := &Config{}
	if got := c.buildKey(); string(got) != string(ForeverBuildAuthKey[:]) {
		t.Fatalf("default build key = %x, want %x", got, ForeverBuildAuthKey)
	}
	c.SkipBuildKey = true
	if c.buildKey() != nil {
		t.Fatal("SkipBuildKey should yield a nil build key")
	}
	for _, b := range []int{70707, 70755} {
		tbl, err := opcodes.ForBuild(b)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		want, _ := BuildAuthKey(b)
		if got := (&Config{Table: tbl}).buildKey(); string(got) != string(want[:]) {
			t.Fatalf("build %d: default key %x, want %x", b, got, want)
		}
	}
	if BuildAuthKey70755 == ForeverBuildAuthKey {
		t.Fatal("70755 and 70707 keys must differ")
	}
	var explicit [BuildKeyLen]byte
	explicit[0] = 0x99
	c2 := &Config{BuildKey: &explicit}
	if got := c2.buildKey(); got[0] != 0x99 {
		t.Fatalf("explicit build key not used: %x", got)
	}
}

// world.Connect resolves its five opcodes by name; the shipped tables of every
// known build must have them.
func TestShippedTablesHaveWorldOpcodes(t *testing.T) {
	for _, b := range []int{70707, 70755} {
		tbl, err := opcodes.ForBuild(b)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for name, want := range map[string]uint32{
			opAuthChallenge: 0x4E0000, opAuthSession: 0x460001, opEnterEncrypted: 0x4E0004,
			opEncryptedModeAck: 0x460005, opLogDisconnect: 0x460007,
		} {
			if _, id, err := tbl.RequireID(name); err != nil || id != want {
				t.Errorf("build %d %s = %#x, %v; want %#x", b, name, id, err, want)
			}
		}
	}
}

// deadlineConn records the last deadline set on it.
type deadlineConn struct {
	pipeConn
	last time.Time
}

func (c *deadlineConn) SetDeadline(t time.Time) error { c.last = t; return c.pipeConn.SetDeadline(t) }

// TestConnectClearsDeadline: the handshake deadline is lifted once Connect
// returns. Left in place it killed live sessions with an i/o timeout after
// -timeout, however healthy they were.
func TestConnectClearsDeadline(t *testing.T) {
	pub, priv, err := ed25519.GenerateKey(rand.Reader)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	d := newPipeDialer()
	dc := &deadlineConn{pipeConn: *d.client.(*pipeConn)}
	d.client = dc
	cfg := testConfig(t, d, Ed25519Verifier{Pub: pub, Enabled: true})
	srv := &serverSide{t: t, key: cfg.KeyData, build: cfg.BuildKey, priv: priv, pub: pub, conn: d.serverNet}
	dosBody = bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x11}, 32)
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() { defer close(done); srv.run(1) }()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	sess, err := Connect(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("connect: %v", err)
	}
	defer sess.Close()
	if !dc.last.IsZero() {
		t.Fatalf("deadline left at %v after Connect", dc.last)
	}
	_, _ = sess.Read()
	<-done
}
```
